chunks.chineseText:
条锁成“1”，面板还被阴影糊住，肯定处于特殊状态。

自我之神究竟在搞什么？！

“好……你、你真的没问题？”深红亲王道，“我的伤还很重，不能战斗。”

“没问题，你把路带到就成。”夏兮风语气冷静，紧握的双手指节泛白，“我想到了禁地，自我之神会直接来找我。”

虽然不知道秦琅现在是个什么状态，但他猜测，自我之神的目的已经达到。

就算没达到，秦琅的状态栏“凝固”，自我之神也该找自己去“试炼”了。

深红亲王没多话。

他重新启动传送阵。

已经化为飞灰，到最后都没有发表反派自我剖析感言的前血族真祖，带夏兮风来的地方是正确的，启动传送阵的方式也是正确的。

因为这个传送阵血族亲王们也知道。她在腐化夏兮风之前，不能让其他人产生怀疑。

传送阵开启，夏兮风和深红亲王还没有走进传送阵，传送阵上已经出现了一个人影。

虽然人影面貌模糊，但夏兮风立刻就猜到了那个人影是谁。

深红亲王已经跪伏在地。

“来吧，他在这里。”自我之神微笑着转身。

传送阵消失，自我之神踏入了空间裂缝。

夏兮风毫不犹豫地抬脚跟了上去。
chunks.englishText:
With one bar locked at "1" and his status panel smeared over with shadows, he was definitely in a special state.

What in the world was the God of Self up to?!

“Alright… Are—are you really sure you’re fine?” the Crimson Prince asked. “My injuries are still severe; I can’t fight.”

“No problem. Just lead the way,” Xia Xifeng said in a calm tone, though his tightly clenched fists turned his knuckles white. “I reckon once we reach the forbidden grounds, the God of Self will come directly for me.”

Although he didn’t know what state Qin Lang was currently in, he guessed that the God of Self had already achieved his objective.

Even if he hadn't, with Qin Lang's status panel "frozen," it was about time the God of Self came to subject Xia Xifeng to a "trial" as well.

The Crimson Prince didn't say another word.

He reactivated the teleportation array.

The former Blood True Ancestor—who had already turned to ashes without even getting to deliver a villainous self-analytical parting monologue—had brought Xia Xifeng to the correct location, and the method to activate the teleportation array was also correct.

This was because the Vampire Princes were also aware of this teleportation array. Before she could corrupt Xia Xifeng, she couldn't afford to raise suspicion among the others.

As the array lit up, before Xia Xifeng and the Crimson Prince could step into it, a figure had already materialized atop the teleportation array.

Though the figure's face was blurry, Xia Xifeng instantly recognized who it was.

The Crimson Prince was already prostrate on the ground.

“Come. He is here,” the God of Self said with a smile, turning around.

The teleportation array vanished, and the God of Self stepped into a spatial rift.

Xia Xifeng didn't hesitate for a second before stepping forward to follow.

chunks.chineseText:
第89章 一更

即使登临传说之境的人，也会被空间裂缝中的乱流撕裂。

自我之神当然稳定了空间通道，能保护夏兮风的安全，但祂很好奇自己没有提前说明，夏兮风怎么就敢跟上来，难道是太蠢了？

能孕育出恶魔的神灵，性格当然很恶劣。自我之神便和夏兮风开了个小玩笑，放了一缕空间乱流贴近夏兮风。

这一缕空间乱流擦过夏兮风的手背，连红痕都没擦出来。

自我之神：“……”

苏尔是巨龙，防御很高正常。这夏兮风是怎么回事？

只加血防的夏兮风完全没感到自我之神的试探。

自我之神按捺住自己试探夏兮风极限的蠢蠢欲动，安全地把夏兮风引导到了目的地。

空间裂缝的另一头是一个山洞入口。

夏兮风看了一眼系统地图，系统地图没有标注地图名称。这里应该是特殊地图。

自我之神对夏兮风点头示意，走向山洞。

夏兮风继续紧跟自我之神的脚步。

反正结果不是见到秦琅，就是自我之神给他也来个“神之试炼”，试炼后再见到秦琅，都一样。

实力太差，只能被神左右。等他把秦琅养得更强了，再把这些不干好事的神都揍一顿。

走到山洞尽头，又走下几层楼梯，他们来到地底深处。

自我之神的脚步停在一扇被锁链牢牢绑住的大门处。

在大门旁，站着一位面貌平凡，平凡到让人一错眼就想不起面容的人。

那人的视线投向夏兮风。

夏兮风浑身一冷，明明心里不害怕，却诡异的有一种濒死的错觉。

这错觉只是一瞬，夏兮风就挣脱开来。

系统提示，他免疫了即死状态。

夏兮风嘴角微抽。

一眼即死？这家伙是死亡之神？自我之神怎么和死亡之神联手？

太阳等神灵联系不上自我的时候，死亡正和太阳联手围剿血月。

祂就看着太阳祂们跳脚，一声不吭是吧？

死亡之神没有自我介绍，夏兮风也懒得走剧情，就闭嘴等着两位神灵下一步动作。

见夏兮风免疫了即死状态，死亡之神微微颔首。

祂将手放在被粗壮锁链拴住的大门上。

链条断裂，大门缓缓打开。

自我之神的声音中带着戏谑：“敢自己进去吗？”

夏兮风瞥了自我之神一眼：“秦琅怎么了？”

他走出空间裂缝后，一直在系统里戳秦琅。直到大门上的锁链断裂时，系统才没有再提示秦琅不在联络范围。

秦琅肯定就在门后面。但夏兮风发了一连串话，秦琅一个字都没回，状态栏上的阴影也没有消除。

秦琅肯定出事了。

虽然两位神灵看着镇定自若，但夏兮风直觉这两位神灵肯定是罪魁祸首。

自我之神优雅地笑道：“只是帮他提升力量，不小心提升太快，令他神志有些不清醒。你唤醒他，他就无事了。”

夏兮风道：“我要怎么做？”

他没问自我之神怎么帮秦琅提升的力量。

秦琅正晕着，不能浪费时间。这些细节等秦琅无事后再说。

自我之神仍旧一副谜语人的微笑：“你进去就知道了。”

夏兮风咬了一下后槽牙。总有一天，要把这群装谜语人的神灵都揍一顿。

他看向死亡之神。

死亡之神一声不吭，仿佛事不关己似的。

夏兮风憋气。成，回去问问老师，有什么办法把死亡之神也揍一顿。

见两位神灵不肯多说了，夏兮风提脚走进开了一半的大门。

他刚走进大门，身后轰隆一声，大门合上。

哐当金属声响起，门外的锁链肯定也拴上了。

夏兮风回头：“……”

深呼吸。

不气不气，等秦琅醒来，就出去找老师和阿穆若先生告状。

夏兮风把头转回去，嘀咕道：“到处灰蒙蒙的，秦琅在哪？”

他刚嘀咕完，房间就亮了起来。

原来墙壁上镶嵌了许多明珠。明珠一颗接一颗地点亮，把房间映得如白昼一般，雾气也被光芒驱散。

这时房间才展现出全貌。

宽广的房间里什么摆设都没有，中间耸立着一座祭坛般的高台；墙壁上的明珠和地面上反射光芒的宝石形成一个套一个的封印魔法阵，组成封印魔法罩；罩子中灰黑色雾气涌动，如触手般拍打着魔法罩，每一次拍打，罩子上不断有符文流光闪烁。

夏兮风视线投向如祭坛般的高台。在雾气最浓厚的地方，隐约能看到一个人影。

“秦琅？！”夏兮风惊得握不住手中法杖。

法杖在落地前被收入背包，夏兮风双手按在魔法罩上，慌张得脑海里一片空白。

夏兮风呼喊秦琅时，被封在晶壁中的人影仍旧阖目，神情纹丝不动，但魔法罩中的雾气如开水般沸腾，如海啸般狠狠撞在罩子上。

罩子上符文光芒大作。光芒朝着罩子内部蔓延，将雾气往祭坛处挤压。

光芒和雾气你推我攘，形成僵持。

雾气在沸腾时，晶壁中的人影稍稍清晰了一些。

果然是秦琅。

秦琅被封在晶壁中，四肢、胸口都被从地面冒出的尖刺透体而过。细小的锁链从刺穿身体的尖端冒出，将他牢牢固定在尖刺上。

雾气便是从晶壁中涌出。雾气膨胀收缩，仿佛呼吸。

夏兮风脑子嗡的一响。谁干的？！

不，不用问了，还能是谁？门口两个神你们是找死吗！

夏兮风理智上知道那两个神对秦琅没有恶意，可能封印是必须的，但非得用这种看着就疼死了的方式封印吗？！

等下次你们需要封印的时候，我也给你们身上扎十根八根刺！！

就在夏兮风在心里狂骂的时候，自我之神的声音响起。

“我将放开防护。你进入后，要么将他唤醒，要么被他的意识吞噬。敢去吗？”

夏兮风狠狠一拳砸在防护罩上：“别废话！”

“脾气真差。”

防护罩打开了一条口子。

夏兮风不知道进去后会是什么情况。

他激活了防御魔导器，各类一次性防御符咒也拖到了背包最显眼的地方，可以“一键”丢出。

在防护罩开启的时候，夏兮风就把符咒砸了出去，自己发动跑路技能，朝着祭台冲去。

冲进去的时候很顺利。魔法罩子在夏兮风身后关闭。

但夏兮风穿过符文光芒和雾气潮汐拉锯的分界线，完全进入雾气中的时候，他感到了极大的压力，身上防御魔导器的能量急速降低，魔导器上出现裂痕。

“秦琅！放我过去！”夏兮风又打出防御符咒，在雾气震荡的一瞬更换新的防御魔导器。

雾气再次翻涌，不仅没有给夏兮风让开一条路，夏兮风所受到的压力更重了，防御魔导器的损耗比刚才还快。

“秦狗！你是和我有仇吗！”夏兮风气得破口大骂，“老子来救你，你还加大攻击功率是吧？！”

骂归骂，夏兮风没有回头，继续往雾气里钻。

雾气的攻击越来越急。它收回和封印相抗的力量，所有雾气都涌向夏兮风，真像和夏兮风有血海深仇似的。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 89: First Update (Part 1)

Even those who had ascended to the Legendary Realm could be torn to shreds by the chaotic turbulence within a spatial rift.

Naturally, the God of Self had stabilized the spatial passage to guarantee Xia Xifeng’s safety. However, He was deeply curious—having offered no prior explanation, how did Xia Xifeng dare to follow him right in? Was he simply that foolish?

A deity capable of giving birth to demons naturally possessed a thoroughly terrible personality. Thus, the God of Self played a little joke on Xia Xifeng, letting a strand of spatial turbulence drift close to him.

The strand of spatial turbulence brushed past the back of Xia Xifeng’s hand, failing to leave even a red mark.

God of Self: "..."

Sol was a giant dragon, so high defense made sense. But what was up with this Xia Xifeng?

Xia Xifeng, who had put all his stat points purely into Health and Defense, didn't notice the God of Self's probe at all.

Suppressing the itch to test Xia Xifeng’s limits, the God of Self safely guided him to their destination.

The other end of the spatial rift led to the entrance of a cave.

Xia Xifeng glanced at the system map. It bore no location name. This was likely a special hidden zone.

The God of Self nodded to Xia Xifeng and walked into the cave.

Xia Xifeng kept following right behind Him.

Either way, the outcome would be meeting Qin Lang, or the God of Self subjecting him to a "Divine Trial" as well before letting him see Qin Lang. It was all the same.

His strength was too weak right now, leaving him at the mercy of the gods. Once he nurtured Qin Lang to be even stronger, he would give every last one of these troublemaking deities a thorough beating.

Reaching the end of the cave and descending several flights of stairs, they arrived deep underground.

The God of Self stopped before a massive door tightly bound by thick chains.

Standing beside the door was someone with an utterly ordinary face—so plain that looking away for a single second would make one forget what they looked like.

That person’s gaze fell upon Xia Xifeng.

A cold chill swept over Xia Xifeng. Even though he felt no fear in his heart, he bizarrely suffered the illusion of being on the brink of death.

The illusion lasted only a moment before Xia Xifeng broke free.

A system notification popped up: *You have resisted the Instant Death status.*

Xia Xifeng’s lips twitched slightly.

An Instant Death glare? Was this guy the God of Death? How did the God of Self end up teaming up with the God of Death?

Back when the Sun God and the other deities couldn't contact the God of Self, the God of Death had been working with the Sun to besiege the Blood Moon.

So He just watched the Sun God and the others jump in anxiety while keeping completely silent, huh?

The God of Death offered no introduction, and Xia Xifeng didn't feel like playing through story cutscenes either, so he kept quiet and waited for the two gods' next move.

Seeing that Xia Xifeng was immune to Instant Death, the God of Death gave a slight nod.

He placed His hand on the door chained by thick links.

The chains shattered, and the door slowly opened.

The God of Self’s voice carried a playful tease: "Do you dare to enter alone?"

Xia Xifeng gave the God of Self a sideways glance. "What happened to Qin Lang?"

Ever since stepping out of the spatial rift, he had been spamming Qin Lang's name on the system interface. Only when the chains on the door snapped did the system stop notifying him that Qin Lang was out of range.

Qin Lang was definitely behind that door. But despite Xia Xifeng sending a flurry of messages, Qin Lang hadn't replied with a single word, and the shadows on his status bar remained.

Something had definitely happened to Qin Lang.

Though the two deities appeared calm and composed, Xia Xifeng had an inkling that they were definitely the culprits.

The God of Self chuckled elegantly, "We merely assisted him in increasing his power. Unintentionally raising it too quickly left his mind somewhat clouded. Wake him up, and he will be fine."

Xia Xifeng asked, "What do I need to do?"

He didn't ask how the God of Self helped Qin Lang gain power.

Qin Lang was unconscious; there was no time to waste. Details could wait until Qin Lang was safe.

The God of Self maintained a cryptic, riddle-master smile: "You will know once you step inside."

Xia Xifeng gritted his teeth. *One day, I’m going to beat up all these gods who act like cryptic riddle-mongers.*

He looked at the God of Death.

The God of Death remained utterly silent, acting as though none of this concerned Him.

Xia Xifeng fumed inwardly. *Fine. Once I get back, I’ll ask Teacher how I can beat up the God of Death too.*

Seeing that neither deity intended to say more, Xia Xifeng stepped through the half-open doorway.

The moment he stepped inside, a heavy thud resounded behind him as the door slammed shut.

A loud metallic clatter followed; the chains outside had undoubtedly been secured as well.

Xia Xifeng looked back: "..."

*Deep breath.*

*Don't be angry, don't be angry. Once Qin Lang wakes up, I’ll go tattle to Teacher and Mr. Amuroh.*

Xia Xifeng turned back and muttered, "It’s all hazy grey everywhere. Where is Qin Lang?"

The moment he finished muttering, the room illuminated.

It turned out numerous luminous pearls were embedded in the walls. The pearls lit up one after another, brightening the room like broad daylight and driving away the mist.

Only then was the full room revealed.

The vast room was completely bare of furniture, save for an altar-like raised platform standing in the center. The luminous pearls on the walls and the light-reflecting gemstones on the floor formed nested sealing magic circles that created a barrier of sealing magic. Within the barrier, greyish-black mist churned like tentacles, slamming against the magical field, causing runic light to flicker across its surface with every strike.

Xia Xifeng cast his gaze toward the altar-like platform. In the densest part of the mist, a figure was vaguely visible.

"Qin Lang?!" Xia Xifeng was so startled he almost dropped his staff.

Stashing the staff back into his inventory before it hit the ground, Xia Xifeng pressed both hands against the magic barrier, panic wiping his mind blank.

When Xia Xifeng called out to him, the figure sealed inside the crystal wall remained eyes closed, expression unmoving. However, the mist inside the magical barrier boiled like scalding water, crashing violently against the barrier like a tsunami.

The runic light on the barrier blazed brilliantly, spreading inward and compressing the mist back toward the altar.

The light and mist pushed against each other in a locked stalemate.

As the mist churned, the figure within the crystal wall became slightly clearer.

It really was Qin Lang.

Qin Lang was sealed within the crystal wall, spikes protruding from the ground skewering his limbs and chest. Fine chains extended from the tips that pierced his body, anchoring him firmly to the spikes.

The mist surged directly from the crystal wall, expanding and contracting like breathing.

Xia Xifeng’s brain buzzed. *Who did this?!*

*No, no need to ask—who else could it be? You two gods at the door, do you have a death wish?!*

Rationally, Xia Xifeng knew the two gods bore no ill intent toward Qin Lang and that the seal was likely necessary. But did they really have to seal him using a method that looked so agonizingly painful?!

*Next time you guys need to be sealed, I’ll stick eight or ten spikes into you too!!*

Just as Xia Xifeng was cursing furiously in his heart, the voice of the God of Self echoed.

"I am going to open the barrier. Once inside, you must either awaken him or be consumed by his consciousness. Do you dare to go?"

Xia Xifeng slammed a fist hard against the barrier. "Cut the chatter!"

"What a terrible temper."

A gap opened in the protective barrier.

Xia Xifeng didn't know what to expect once inside.

He activated his defense magic tool and dragged various single-use defense talismans to the most prominent spot in his inventory so he could throw them out with a single click.

The instant the barrier opened, Xia Xifeng hurled out the talismans and triggered a mobility skill, hurtling straight toward the altar.

Entering went smoothly. The magical barrier snapped shut behind Xia Xifeng.

However, as Xia Xifeng crossed the dividing line where the runic light and mist tide struggled, stepping entirely into the mist, immense pressure crushed down on him. The energy of his defense magic tools drained rapidly, cracks spreading across their surfaces.

"Qin Lang! Let me through!" Xia Xifeng tossed out more defense talismans, swapping in a new defense magic tool during the momentary shockwave in the mist.

The mist surged once more. Instead of parting a path for Xia Xifeng, the pressure mounted even heavier, degrading his defense magic tools faster than before.

"Qin Dog! Do you have a grudge against me?!" Xia Xifeng yelled angrily. "I came to save you, and you're turning up the power of your attack?!"

Despite his swearing, Xia Xifeng didn't turn back, driving deeper into the mist.

The mist's attacks grew increasingly relentless. Pulling back the force that was resisting the seal, all the mist surged toward Xia Xifeng, as though it truly held a mortal vendetta against him.

chunks.chineseText:
虽然夏兮风还有很多符咒，但符咒一触及雾气就侵蚀焚毁，无法再给他提供更换防御魔法器的机会。

夏兮风看着摇摇欲坠的防御魔法器，心一横，不管不顾，继续朝着晶壁艰难走去。

他就像是走在黏稠的水中，与波浪的方向逆行。

“我就不信，你还能弄死我。”防御魔导器破碎，夏兮风被雾气吞没。他盯着与他只差两三米的晶壁，恶狠狠道。

雾气没过夏兮风的头顶。夏兮风的四肢像是被什么绑着往下拖。

明明他的双脚就踩在地面上，却仿佛被拖入深深的水底。他睁开双眼，还能看到水面上透来的天光。

“咕噜……”

夏兮风张开嘴，想继续呼唤秦琅，只吐出一串气泡。

明明传说职介已经可以很久不需要呼吸，他却有窒息溺水的感觉。

细小的触须轻轻拂过夏兮风的脸，如眼带般遮住了夏兮风的双眼。这一刻，夏兮风明悟，他溺水的地方是秦琅溢出的精神之海。

如果精神之海冲破封印，秦琅不仅是身体破碎，整个人的“存在”都会破碎，只剩下一片拥有神灵力量、没有自我意识的精神残渣。

眼泪从夏兮风被精神触须遮住的眼角滴落。

都是我的错。

不是我太不小心，秦琅就不会来到这个世界，遇到这样的危险。

眼泪仿佛失重般地凝结成水珠，从夏兮风两颊两侧滚落，随着下沉的夏兮风轻飘飘地一同坠落。

两簇精神触须轻轻触碰水珠，水珠消散。

晶壁里仿佛石雕般的秦琅睁开了双眼。

他双眼没有焦距，脸上仍旧没有表情，仍旧如石雕似的，睁开双眼的动作就像是错觉。

夏兮风已经被拖入精神之海的更深处。

（“呀，为什么要我帮你做蝴蝶标本？”

“不能杀蝴蝶？这有什么关系？你不是刚打死一只蚊子吗？”

“啊？蚊子没关系？为什么？”）

夏兮风睁开双眼，这里是哪里？我……我要做什么？

胖乎乎的小孩不断追问为什么，俊朗但神情木然的小孩一言不发。

夏兮风不由自主对神情木然的小孩伸出手。

他刚伸出手，情景消失，仿如肥皂泡在他指尖消散。

新的肥皂泡形成。

（“啊！气死我了！不就是个小混混，揍他！你揍不过，我帮你！”

“不能动手。”

“为什么啊！算了，你不去，我去！”）

夏兮风混沌的意识渐渐清醒。

他记起来，他和秦琅关系越来越不好，不仅是秦琅老烦他多管闲事，他也烦秦琅的麻烦“懦弱”。
chunks.englishText:
Although Xia Xifeng still had plenty of talismans, they disintegrated and burned away the moment they touched the mist, leaving him no opportunity to swap out defense magic tools.

Staring at the crumbling defense magic tool, Xia Xifeng hardened his resolve, throwing caution to the wind as he trudged doggedly toward the crystal wall.

It was like wading through thick, viscous water, pressing forward against incoming waves.

"I don't believe you can actually kill me." The defense magic tool shattered, and Xia Xifeng was swallowed by the mist. Glaring at the crystal wall merely two or three meters away, he growled fiercely.

The mist submerged the crown of Xia Xifeng's head. His limbs felt as though dragged down by unseen bindings.

Even though his feet were planted firm on the ground, it felt as if he were being pulled into deep underwater depths. Opening his eyes, he could still see light filtering down through the surface above.

"Gurgle..."

Xia Xifeng opened his mouth to call out for Qin Lang again, but only a string of bubbles escaped.

Even though reaching a Legendary Class meant he didn't need to breathe for long periods, he felt an acute sense of suffocation and drowning.

Slender tentacles lightly brushed across Xia Xifeng's face, covering his eyes like a blindfold. At that moment, Xia Xifeng realized that the watery depth he was drowning in was Qin Lang's overflowing sea of consciousness.

If this mental sea broke through the seal, not only would Qin Lang's body shatter, but his entire "existence" would crumble, leaving behind nothing but mental dregs possessing divine power without self-awareness.

Tears trickled down from the corners of Xia Xifeng's eyes beneath the mental tentacles.

*It's all my fault.*

*If I hadn't been so careless, Qin Lang wouldn't have come to this world and faced such danger.*

As if weightless, his tears coalesced into water droplets, rolling down both sides of Xia Xifeng's cheeks and floating down gently alongside his sinking body.

Two clusters of mental tentacles gently touched the water droplets, causing them to disperse.

Inside the crystal wall, Qin Lang—who had been still like a stone sculpture—opened his eyes.

His eyes were unfocused, his face remained devoid of expression, still resembling a stone statue so much that the act of opening his eyes felt like an illusion.

Xia Xifeng had already been dragged into the deeper depths of the sea of consciousness.

("Why do you want me to help you make butterfly specimens?"

"Can't kill butterflies? What does that matter? Didn't you just kill a mosquito?"

"Huh? Mosquitoes are fine? Why?")

Xia Xifeng opened his eyes. *Where is this? What... what am I supposed to do?*

A chubby little child kept asking *why*, while a handsome but expressionless child remained completely silent.

Xia Xifeng reached out his hand toward the expressionless child without realizing it.

The moment his hand reached out, the scene dissolved like a soap bubble popping at his fingertips.

A new soap bubble formed.

("Agh! I'm so pissed! It's just a punk—beat him up! If you can't, I'll help you!"

"Can't use violence."

"Why?! Fine, if you won't go, I will!")

Xia Xifeng's muddled consciousness gradually regained clarity.

He remembered—the rift between him and Qin Lang had grown wider not just because Qin Lang found his interference annoying, but also because he was sick of Qin Lang's troublesome "cowardice."

第90章 一更

秦琅与外人交流的时候，遇到冲突总选择不计较。为了避免冲突，秦琅总是假装孤僻木讷，不交朋友，不和人深入交流感情。

小时候，他经常为了秦琅打架。

呵，他经常担忧秦琅被欺负，秦琅还不领情！

（“一起去玩啊。”

“不去。”

“由不得你，走！”

“别拉我……松手！”）

（“我不给你打电话，你是不是就不联系我？”

“嗯。”

“啊？你还嗯？！算了，我和你说啊，我今天……”）

（“大学我们也选同一个学校好不好？”

“不好。”

“啊？你过分了，这次我真的生气了！”）

不领情就罢了，总是他主动约秦琅玩，主动伸手拉住秦琅。

虽然秦琅在他伸手的时候会停下来任他拉住，但秦琅从来没有过一次主动联系他！

所以他决定再也不主动联系秦琅了。

（“喂？在？打的材料别便宜其他人啊，给我给我！你要的装备我也能做。”）

（“陪我打BOSS去。”）

（“这痛苦号也太痛苦了！救命救命救命！帮我直播！”）

（“来做任务，新鲜出炉的传说任务哦！”）

（“账号密码给你，帮我刷本。你的账号密码给我，我帮你过剧情。”）

（“喂喂喂？挂机还是在线？”）……

夏兮风缓缓抬起双手遮住脸，恼羞成怒。

他厌烦了每次都是自己主动联系秦琅。所以上大学后，他发誓再也不主动联系秦琅。

游、游戏里联系工具人，不算在内！

他确实没有再和秦琅聊过生活，没有主动约秦琅去玩，只是缺一个刷材料和帮他过boss的工具人。

找其他朋友太麻烦人家，找职业代练会花钱技术还不如秦琅。秦琅读本科的时候十分悠闲，读研之后才会忙起来，他当然选择抓紧时间压榨秦琅。

本来他没觉得有什么，但这些事集中在他眼前播放，搞得他好像……好像……

夏兮风破罐子破摔地放下手，恶声恶气道：“啊对对对，我就是口是心非。总不能真的和你绝交吧！”

他就是放心不下秦琅。总觉得如果自己松手，秦琅就真的不见踪影，谁都找不到了。

他知道秦琅和父母感情不错，对师长也很尊敬，虽然人际关系淡薄但在外人中口碑不差，就像是一个平平常常普普通通，只是不爱交际的人。

但夏兮风就是有这样的错觉。

还有许多没有夏兮风的记忆碎片出现在远方。

而出现了夏兮风的记忆碎片被夏兮风吸引，环绕着夏兮风漂浮着，一一出现又一一破碎。

无数肥皂泡簇拥着夏兮风。

灰黑色的触须又攀上了夏兮风的双腿。夏兮风刚清醒的脑子又变得混沌。

他所穿的装备就像不存在似的，触须沿着他的双腿往上攀爬，再次缠绕上了他的四肢。

他能感觉到精神触须摩挲着他每一寸肌肤，沁入他的灵魂，冰凉得令人打寒颤。

明明是精神形成的触须，却仿佛是万年不化的寒冰雕塑而成。

被摩挲的肌肤阵阵酥痒，温度升高，泛起粉红的色泽。

但他的身体再温暖，也捂不热缠绕着他的冰凉。他的体温越高，就冷得越是发颤。

精神触须中，流淌着丝丝缕缕神性，勾引着夏兮风潜藏在心底的思绪。他自己都不一定觉察到的思绪。

以前用道德和法律压制的许多负面情感从他心底爆发，自私自利的想法一一涌现。

绝对的自我是什么？就是自私自利。

夏兮风神志有了一瞬的清醒，明白秦琅意识海的崩溃，是因为自我之神的神性。

秦琅的意识海中怎么会有自我之神的神性？！

他明白了这一点，却不知道该怎么把秦琅唤醒。甚至他自己的意识也被自我之神的神性缠绕，就像是灵魂都被兜在网中，拖着他更深更沉地溺在秦琅的意识海中。

夏兮风看到了秦琅更多关于他，但他不知道的记忆。

比如秦琅为了帮他代练痛苦号，私下开了全职业痛苦号默默训练了好久，才能每次都一次性代练成功。

咦？秦琅不是说不麻烦吗？

夏兮风眉头微皱。

最初他只是“看到”，后来直接“体会”。

他体会到秦琅的“自我”，是怎么被秦琅自己用一条一条的“现实规则”缠绕束缚压制。

秦琅总不杀生（蚊子除外）……

秦琅总不事后报复别人……

秦琅总不主动联系自己……

（“总不能变成精神病。”）

什么屁话，你本来就不是精神病！就算你做了这些，也不会变成精神病！精神病是那么容易变的吗！而且主动联系自己怎么会变成精神病？这也太奇怪了吧！

正在夏兮风用只有一丁点清醒的意识狂骂秦琅时，他又感觉到当令人冻僵的寒意沁入身体时，他的意识也融进了秦琅的意识中。

他好像要融入秦琅的意识海，完全与秦琅融为一体，被夹杂着神性的精神彻底吞噬。

他有一种自己的记忆也被人翻看的感觉。

“咕噜……咳咳咳！”

夏兮风回神。

他的腰被一根雾气触手缠住，猛地拔出“水面”。

晶壁已经破碎。仍旧被尖刺和锁链束缚住的秦琅正和他面对面，眼瞪眼。

他面无表情，但夏兮风多了解他啊，一眼就能看出秦琅剧烈波动的眼神中透露着尴尬和郁闷。

咳，不就是被自己看了点记忆，有什么不好意思。咱们知道的对方的黑历史还少吗？

夏兮风抱着粗壮的触须瑟瑟发抖：“快、快冻死了！”

秦琅眼眸微闪。

环绕着夏兮风腰的触须慢慢变暖。夏兮风发白的脸色有了血色。

“活、活过来了。”夏兮风一只手继续抱着触须，一只手伸向秦琅，“别愣着，再近一点，我碰不到你。”

【你碰到我又如何？】

秦琅的嘴唇未动，声音直接出现在夏兮风的脑海中。

夏兮风努力伸长手臂：“当然是想办法把你的封印解开。你都醒了，还需要什么封印？赶紧的！你不送我过去，把我放下来，我自己走过去。”

秦琅没立刻回答。

夏兮风酸溜溜道：“反正我都习惯了。放我下来，我自己走。”

秦琅动了动手指头，锁链摩擦作响，尖刺上出现血渍。

夏兮风大惊：“别乱动啊！等我过来！”

“咔擦”。

锁链崩裂，尖刺折断，秦琅一个踉跄，重重半跪在地上。

夏兮风浑身一抖，感觉自己浑身都好像在疼了。

他使劲扒拉腰间的雾气：“松开，松开！放我过去！”

秦琅大喘了一口气，晃晃悠悠站起来，往前走了一步，抓住了夏兮风的手。

他手一拽，禁锢着夏兮风腰间的触须融化成一团雾气，夏兮风往前一倒，落到他怀里。

夏兮风条件反射抱住秦琅，又咋咋呼呼地松开手：“是不是碰到你的伤口了？”

“别乱动。”秦琅的手臂紧紧箍着夏兮风，把夏兮风拖到了高台中央。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 90: First Update (Part 1)

When interacting with outsiders, Qin Lang always chose not to make a fuss whenever conflicts arose.

To avoid conflict, Qin Lang always feigned aloofness and dullness, refusing to make friends or form deep emotional connections with anyone.

When they were kids, Xia Xifeng had often gotten into fights for Qin Lang's sake.

*Heh, he was constantly worried about Qin Lang getting bullied, yet Qin Lang never even appreciated it!*

("Let's go play together."

"Not going."

"You don't get a say. Let's go!"

"Don't pull me... let go!")

("If I didn't call you, would you just never contact me?"

"Yeah."

"Huh? You actually said 'yeah'?! Forget it, let me tell you, today I...")

("How about we pick the same university?"

"No."

"Huh? You're too much, I'm really mad this time!")

Not appreciating it was one thing, but it was always *him* who took the initiative to ask Qin Lang out, always *him* who reached out to pull Qin Lang along.

Even though Qin Lang would stop and let himself be dragged along whenever Xia Xifeng reached out, Qin Lang had *never once* taken the initiative to contact him!

So he had decided never to reach out to Qin Lang again.

("Hey? You there? Don't sell those materials cheap to others, give them to me! I can craft the gear you want too.")

("Come kill a BOSS with me.")

("This pain-in-the-ass account is way too painful! Help help help! Stream it for me!")

("Come do quests, fresh legendary quest off the press!")

("Sending you my login info, help me farm dungeons. Give me your login info, I'll help you clear the story quests.")

("Hey hey hey? AFK or online?") ...

Xia Xifeng slowly raised both hands to cover his face, blushing with embarrassment and anger.

He was sick of being the one who initiated contact with Qin Lang every single time. So after entering university, he swore he would never contact Qin Lang on his own initiative again.

G-Gaming contact with a tool-guy didn't count!

He really hadn't chatted with Qin Lang about daily life or invited Qin Lang out to hang out anymore; he just needed a tool-guy to farm materials and clear bosses for him.

Bothering other friends was too troublesome, hiring professional power-levelers cost money and their skill wasn't even as good as Qin Lang's. Qin Lang had been very relaxed during his undergraduate years and only got busy in graduate school, so of course he seized the opportunity to exploit Qin Lang.

Originally he didn't feel there was anything wrong with it, but having these memories replayed all at once right in front of him made it look like he was... like he was...

Throwing caution to the wind, Xia Xifeng dropped his hands and snapped viciously, "Yeah yeah yeah, I'm just tsundere and dishonest with my feelings! I couldn't *actually* break off our friendship, could I?!"

He just couldn't bring himself to stop worrying about Qin Lang. He always felt that if he let go, Qin Lang would truly vanish into thin air, beyond anyone's reach.

He knew Qin Lang had a good relationship with his parents and respected his teachers. Though his interpersonal ties were sparse, his reputation among outsiders was decent—he seemed like an ordinary, everyday guy who just didn't enjoy socializing.

Yet Xia Xifeng couldn't shake off this lingering illusion.

Beyond, many memory fragments devoid of Xia Xifeng floated in the distance.

Meanwhile, memory fragments containing Xia Xifeng were drawn to him, swirling around him as they appeared one by one and shattered one by one.

Countless soap bubbles crowded around Xia Xifeng.

Greyish-black tentacles climbed up Xia Xifeng's legs once more. His newly cleared mind grew muddled again.

His equipped gear proved useless against them; the tentacles slithered up his legs, coiling around his limbs once more.

He could feel the mental tentacles rubbing against every inch of his skin, seeping into his very soul, so frigid it sent shivers through him.

Though formed purely from mental energy, they felt sculpted from ten-thousand-year unmelting ice.

Where they rubbed, his skin tingled and flared with heat, flushing a soft pink hue.

Yet no matter how warm his body grew, it could not warm the icy cold wrapping around him. The higher his temperature rose, the harder he trembled from the chill.

Wisps of divinity flowed through the mental tentacles, luring out thoughts hidden deep in Xia Xifeng's heart—thoughts he himself might not have even recognized.

Many negative emotions previously suppressed by morality and law erupted from within him, selfish thoughts surging forth one after another.

What was absolute self? It was pure selfishness.

Xia Xifeng regained a flash of clarity, realizing that the collapse of Qin Lang's sea of consciousness was due to the divinity of the God of Self.

*How could the God of Self's divinity be inside Qin Lang's sea of consciousness?!*

He understood this, yet had no idea how to wake Qin Lang up. In fact, his own consciousness was now ensnared by the God of Self's divinity, like his soul was caught in a net, dragging him deeper into the drowning depths of Qin Lang's mental sea.

Xia Xifeng saw even more memories Qin Lang had about him—memories he hadn't known existed.

For instance, to pilot Xia Xifeng's agony alt accounts, Qin Lang had secretly created agony accounts for every single class and practiced endlessly in private just so he could successfully clear them in one go every time.

*Huh? Didn't Qin Lang say it was no trouble at all?*

Xia Xifeng frowned slightly.

At first he merely "observed," but soon he directly "experienced" it.

He experienced how Qin Lang's "self" had been bound, shackled, and suppressed by Qin Lang himself through rule after rule of "reality."

Qin Lang never took life (except mosquitoes)...

Qin Lang never retaliated against others after the fact...

Qin Lang never initiated contact with him...

("I can't go crazy and become a psychopath.")

*What kind of bullcrap is that! You were never crazy in the first place! Even if you did those things, you wouldn't become a psychopath! Is turning crazy really that easy?! And how would initiating contact with me turn you into a psychopath? That's way too weird!*

While Xia Xifeng used his tiny sliver of remaining clarity to curse Qin Lang inwardly, he felt the freezing chill seep deep into his body as his consciousness merged into Qin Lang's.

It felt as if he were merging into Qin Lang's sea of consciousness, completely fusing with him, swallowed whole by the mental force laced with divinity.

He felt as though his own memories were being flipped through by someone else.

"Gurgle... *cough cough cough!*"

Xia Xifeng snapped back to reality.

A mist tentacle wrapped around his waist, violently hauling him out of the "water."

The crystal wall had shattered. Still bound by spikes and chains, Qin Lang was right before him, staring face to face, eye to eye.

He was poker-faced, but Xia Xifeng knew him so well that a single glance revealed the awkwardness and frustration flickering in Qin Lang's violently turbulent eyes.

*Ahem, so what if I saw a few of your memories? What's there to be embarrassed about? As if we don't already know enough of each other's embarrassing pasts!*

Xia Xifeng hugged the thick tentacle, shivering uncontrollably: "I—I'm freezing to death!"

Qin Lang's eyes flickered slightly.

The tentacle wrapped around Xia Xifeng's waist gradually warmed up. The color returned to Xia Xifeng's pale face.

"I—I'm alive again." Xia Xifeng kept holding onto the tentacle with one hand while stretching his other hand out to Qin Lang. "Don't just stand there, get closer! I can't reach you."

【What difference will it make if you touch me?】

Qin Lang's lips didn't move; his voice echoed directly inside Xia Xifeng's mind.

Xia Xifeng stretched his arm out as far as he could: "To break your seal, of course! You're awake now, so what do you still need a seal for? Hurry up! If you won't bring me over, put me down and I'll walk over myself."

Qin Lang didn't answer immediately.

Xia Xifeng added sourly, "Not like I'm not used to it anyway. Put me down, I'll walk myself."

Qin Lang flexed his fingers. The chains clattered, bloodstains appearing on the spikes.

Xia Xifeng panicked: "Don't move recklessly! Wait till I get over there!"

*Crack.*

Chains snapped, spikes shattered, and Qin Lang stumbled, collapsing heavily onto one knee.

Xia Xifeng shuddered all over, feeling phantom pain across his own body.

He tugged frantically at the mist around his waist: "Let go, let go! Put me over there!"

Qin Lang let out a heavy breath, unsteadily standing up. He took a step forward and seized Xia Xifeng's hand.

With a tug of his hand, the tentacle pinning Xia Xifeng's waist melted into a cloud of mist. Xia Xifeng tumbled forward, landing squarely in his arms.

Xia Xifeng reflexively hugged Qin Lang, then immediately released him in a panic: "Did I bump into your wounds?!"

"Don't move." Qin Lang's arms locked tightly around Xia Xifeng, dragging him straight to the center of the platform.

chunks.chineseText:
雾气不知为何再次沸腾。这次它们试图把高台淹没。

只是当它们快靠近高台的时候，就再不能接近。雾气便化作汹涌的海潮，一波又一波拍打着高台。高台就像是孤崖，耸立在海潮中。

夏兮风小心翼翼地环住秦琅的脖子，免得碰到他的伤口：“那不是你的意识海吗？怎么不听你话啊。”

秦琅的声音很虚弱：“被自我之神和死亡之神坑了。祂们把自我之神的神格和外神神格糅杂在一起，不知道弄出个什么东西给我塞了进去，连系统都没能阻止。”

“可能祂只想塞给你自我神格，加外神神格只是为了突破天父对我们的保护。”夏兮风一边分析，一边给秦琅已经解锁的状态栏砸红蓝药。

“怎么血和蓝都加不起来，还是锁‘1’啊。”夏兮风都急哭了，“怎么办……怎么办……”

秦琅听到夏兮风的哭音，身体一僵。

他迟疑着移动着手臂，轻轻抚了抚夏兮风的背：“我没事，别哭。”

“我没哭！”夏兮风低下头，用秦琅的肩膀狠狠蹭了蹭眼睛，“我再试试！”

不管什么增益的药，夏兮风挨个砸一遍。

都没用。全部没用。

秦琅的状态栏看似解锁了，其实还是锁着的，别说加血加蓝，什么状态都加不上。

夏兮风只能眼睁睁看着秦琅的血条和蓝条一直停留在“1”，好像吹口气就会消失。

他把肩膀埋在秦琅的肩膀上，身体的颤抖幅度越来越大。

秦琅感觉到颈窝的湿意，一时手足无措，只能继续轻抚夏兮风的背。

“我就不信什么都做不了！”夏兮风又在秦琅肩膀上猛蹭两下，咬牙切齿道。

听着夏兮风恢复活力的声音，秦琅有些想笑。

总是这样。夏兮风总会很快脱离情绪低落，不管有用没用，先努力试试。

乐观大傻子，精神半身人。

夏兮风双手按在秦琅的肩膀上，把抱着他的秦琅推开。

秦琅：“？”

夏兮风拍了拍秦琅的肩膀，虽然没有任何理由，但信心十足道：“既然是你的意识海溢出，你把溢出的意识海吞下去，说不定就赢了！现在你吞不下，肯定是缺少媒介。我看你的意识海老追我，说不定我就是那个媒介呢！啊？你什么眼神？信我！反正也没有其他办法，不如试试！”

秦琅收起怀疑的眼神：“很危险。”

夏兮风再次拍了拍秦琅的肩膀：“不危险，我信你！就算不受控，你的意识海也是你自己的意识，肯定不会伤害我！”

秦琅再次：“……”

每次都是这样，面对夏兮风，他心里总有很多嘈难以吐出来。

他自己都不信自己，夏兮风凭什么信他？

秦琅眉头挑了挑，嘴角勾起似讽刺，似自嘲：“你已经看过我的记忆，还能说出这种话？”

夏兮风困惑：“看过，怎么？为什么不能？”

秦琅：“……”

他沉默了一会儿，为了不让夏兮风冲出去，重伤的自己拦不住，艰难道：“你还记得我为什么从不主动联系你？”

夏兮风一听就暴躁：“因为你有病！”

秦琅还未有反应，夏兮风紧接着道：“你说你有病！主动联系我就犯病！我看你这才有病！退一万步，你伤害我了又怎么？我还能生你气不成？”

秦琅：“？？？”

他一直担心自己变成精神病，破坏安谧的生活，伤害重视的人。

自己现在肯定还没有变成精神病，但夏兮风真的是神经病。

什么叫“我还能生你气不成”？听听这话，不是发神经是什么？

夏兮风一只手继续按住秦琅的肩膀，免得秦琅退缩，一只手狠狠拍胸脯：“放心。你绝对不会伤害我！”

秦琅真是无力了。

所以我都不信我自己，你究竟对我哪来的那么多信任？

“行，别后悔。”秦琅都不知道自己被自我和外神神性勾得暴/动的潜意识会做出什么。

就像他不知道如果主动走近夏兮风，自己会做什么。

For some reason, the mist began to boil once more. This time, it attempted to submerge the high platform.

Yet, as it drew near, it could advance no further. Instead, the mist transformed into a surging tide, battering the platform wave after wave. The high platform stood like a solitary cliff, towering amidst the raging sea.

Xia Xifeng carefully wrapped his arms around Qin Lang's neck, taking care not to touch his wounds. "Isn't that your sea of consciousness? Why isn't it listening to you?"

Qin Lang's voice was incredibly weak. "I was set up by the God of Ego and the God of Death. They fused the divinity of the God of Ego with that of an Outer God, shoved whatever monstrosity they created into me, and not even the system could stop them."

"Maybe they only wanted to force the Ego divinity onto you, and the Outer God divinity was just to break through the Heavenly Father's protection over us," Xia Xifeng analyzed while frantically throwing health and mana potions at Qin Lang's unlocked status bar.

"Why aren't your HP and MP going up? They're still locked at '1'!" Xia Xifeng was on the verge of tears from anxiety. "What do we do... What do we do..."

Hearing the tremor of tears in Xia Xifeng's voice, Qin Lang's body stiffened.

He hesitantly moved his arm, gently patting Xia Xifeng's back. "I'm fine. Don't cry."

"I'm not crying!" Xia Xifeng lowered his head and rubbed his eyes fiercely against Qin Lang's shoulder. "Let me try again!"

No matter what buff potions he had, Xia Xifeng threw them one by one.

None of them worked. Absolutely none of them.

Qin Lang's status bar appeared unlocked, but in reality, it was still sealed. Forget restoring health and mana; not a single buff could be applied.

Xia Xifeng could only watch helplessly as Qin Lang's HP and MP bars remained stubbornly at "1", looking as though they might vanish with a single breath.

He buried his face in Qin Lang's shoulder, his body trembling more and more violently.

Feeling the dampness at the crook of his neck, Qin Lang was momentarily at a loss, able only to continue gently stroking Xia Xifeng's back.

"I refuse to believe there's nothing I can do!" Xia Xifeng rubbed his face against Qin Lang's shoulder twice more, grinding his teeth.

Hearing Xia Xifeng regain his vigor, Qin Lang wanted to laugh.

It was always like this. Xia Xifeng would always snap out of his depression quickly. Regardless of whether it would work, he would always try his best first.

An optimistic big idiot, a spiritual halfling.

Xia Xifeng pressed his hands against Qin Lang's shoulders, pushing away the man holding him.

Qin Lang: "?"

Xia Xifeng patted Qin Lang's shoulder. Though he had no logical basis, he spoke with absolute confidence. "Since this is your sea of consciousness overflowing, if you swallow it back down, maybe you'll win! Right now you can't swallow it, so you must be lacking a medium. I noticed your sea of consciousness keeps chasing me—maybe I'm that medium! Huh? What's with that look? Trust me! There's no other way anyway, so we might as well try!"

Qin Lang withdrew his skeptical gaze. "It's very dangerous."

Xia Xifeng patted Qin Lang's shoulder again. "It's not dangerous, I trust you! Even if it's out of control, your sea of consciousness is still your own mind. It definitely won't hurt me!"

Qin Lang: "..." once more.

It was always like this. Facing Xia Xifeng, he always had so many complaints locked in his chest with no way to voice them.

He didn't even trust himself. On what basis did Xia Xifeng trust him so blindly?

Qin Lang's brow twitched, his lips curling into a smile that was half-mocking, half-self-deprecating. "You've already seen my memories, and you can still say something like that?"

Xia Xifeng was puzzled. "I've seen them, so what? Why shouldn't I say it?"

Qin Lang: "..."

He fell silent for a moment. To prevent Xia Xifeng from rushing out—since he was too heavily injured to stop him—he said with great difficulty, "Do you still remember why I never took the initiative to contact you?"

Hearing this, Xia Xifeng instantly grew irritable. "Because you're sick!"

Before Qin Lang could react, Xia Xifeng immediately followed up, "You said you're sick! That taking the initiative to contact me triggers your illness! I think *that* is what's actually wrong with you! Even if we take ten thousand steps back, so what if you hurt me? Could I actually stay mad at you?"

Qin Lang: "???"

He had always worried about becoming mentally unstable, ruining their peaceful life, and hurting the person he cherished.

He certainly hadn't become a lunatic yet, but Xia Xifeng was definitely a madman.

What did he mean by "Could I actually stay mad at you"? Listen to those words—if that wasn't being a lunatic, what was?

Xia Xifeng kept one hand pressed on Qin Lang's shoulder to prevent him from backing away, while using his other hand to thump his own chest hard. "Don't worry. You will absolutely never hurt me!"

Qin Lang felt utterly powerless.

*I don't even trust myself, so where on earth does all your trust in me come from?*

"Fine. Don't regret it." Qin Lang didn't even know what his subconscious, rioting under the influence of the Ego and Outer God divinities, would do.

Just as he didn't know what he would do if he actively approached Xia Xifeng.

第91章 一更

这时秦琅自己都没意识到，他又莫名信了夏兮风毫无缘由的“试试看”。

秦琅伸手挥开夏兮风按着他肩膀的手，祭坛边缘的雾气涌来，以他们二人为中心旋转。

他们就像是台风眼。浓厚的雾气在他们周围形成厚重的墙壁，将他们封锁其中。

丝丝缕缕的雾气从墙壁中飘向夏兮风，就像是从墙壁中伸出的触须。

夏兮风一动不动地任由触须触碰他的脸颊，不忘嘴贱：“秦琅，你画风大变，变触手邪神系了。”

正用尽全力不让“墙壁”往内挤压的秦琅力道一松，“墙壁”差点倒塌。

他咬牙切齿：“闭嘴！”

夏兮风对秦琅笑了笑，趁着秦琅不在意，伸手触碰边缘的“墙壁”。

只一瞬，浓厚的雾气就裹上了夏兮风手，顺着他的手臂向上蔓延。

“太慢了。”夏兮风看着表情惊恐的秦琅眨了眨眼，“我都说信任你了。”

秦琅忙将夏兮风揽进怀里。“墙壁”向内塌陷，雾气完全裹住了两人。

黑暗中本不可视物，秦琅却能清晰地看清怀里人的模样。

雾气揉捏吮吸着夏兮风的身体，无比怜爱。夏兮风已经完全失神。

他眉头皱起，眼尾殷红，身体微微颤抖，牙齿咬住下唇，不可抑制的轻吟从齿缝中溢出。

秦琅的发尾轻轻飘起，双目褪去所有情感，瞳孔如平静的深潭，只能映出倒影，看不见深潭中的景象。

他一只手护着夏兮风，一只手抬起，拇指轻轻揉了揉夏兮风眼角的殷红。

夏兮风的视线艰难聚焦，眼泪从眼角殷红处溢出，身体一阵一阵轻颤，看着甚是可怜。

“后悔了？”秦琅低头，额头靠近夏兮风的额头。

夏兮风很努力地发出声音：“别……小瞧我！”

秦琅的额头轻轻碰了一下夏兮风的额头，鼻尖轻触夏兮风的鼻尖：“你真的搞清处境了吗？”

“都说……别小瞧我。”夏兮风使出浑身力气，终于能抬起手臂。

他想环住秦琅，但手刚抬高一点就失去了所有的力气，只能在下落之前攥住秦琅的衣角。

感觉到衣角轻微的牵扯感，秦琅的眼眸剧烈一颤，快被庞大意识海冲散的理智短暂清醒。

他赶紧抬起头，松开环抱着夏兮风的手，迅速后退了一步。

夏兮风攥着秦琅衣角的手却不松开。

“逃什么？胆子这么小吗！”夏兮风浑身没力气，还要开嘲讽。

他顺着秦琅后退的力道，上半身向着秦琅倾倒。那恶狠狠的表情和语气，就像他朝着秦琅猛扑过去似的。

“喂！”秦琅往后栽倒，不顾差点后脑勺着地，双手护住砸在他身上的夏兮风。

在秦琅后背贴在地上的时候，两人的脸不可避免地贴近。

夏兮风凶狠地咬了秦琅嘴唇一口，并一键撤掉了他和秦琅所有装备衣物。

秦琅身体僵硬，把夏兮风不断凑过来的大脑袋推开，声音惊得变了调，理智完全回归：“小风！！”

紧密相贴的触感让夏兮风的身体也是一僵。他结结巴巴，心里有点犯怂，嘴上不服输：“能、能救你，这点算什么？是不是男人？你想、想都想了，别怂啊！”

秦琅慌慌张张给两人装备上衣服，又被夏兮风撤掉。他看着被自己捧在手心的大脸，心梗。

紧密相贴的身体体温逐渐升高，夏兮风用尽了最后一点力气，脑子昏昏沉沉，又要恍惚过去的时候，突然天旋地转，光洁的脊背触上坚硬的冰凉。

他张嘴欲叫，一抹温软压住了他的舌根，堵住了他的声音。

夏兮风眼睑轻抖，对上一双暗得看不清情绪的眼，他的意识便混沌了，只有身后一疼时醒来“嘶”了一声，又很快被身上游走的手安抚，再次昏昏沉沉。

待夏兮风再次清醒的时候，他身上已经热得没了知觉，只有鬓间头发和耳廓相互摩擦的触感特别恼人。

拥着自己那人似乎察觉到了他的醒来，厮磨的动作停下，略带喘息的声音在他的耳畔响起：“小风，现在后悔了吗？”

夏兮风低下头，用力咬了眼前的肩膀一口：“阿琅，闭嘴！”

而后他身体一晃，又是天旋地转，似乎是由仰面躺着变成了半跪着趴着，腰腹被人紧紧搂住。

当后背覆上滚烫的热度时，夏兮风再次被扯入昏沉的漩涡中。

恍惚间，他感到耳垂疼了一下，似乎是对他刚才那一口的报复。

夏兮风完全晕过去之前，只见脸颊两侧垂下的不属于自己的长长的黑色发丝，像蛛丝又像牢笼般把自己罩住。

……

不知道昏睡了多久，夏兮风睁开眼，看见的是普普通通的床幔。

他脑袋卡壳了许久，才左右转头东张西望。

有点眼熟……哦，是在魔导车里的大床上。

他小心翼翼地扭动了一下身体，有点酸疼，再多的不适就没有了。之前的事像一场梦。

夏兮风正悄悄检查身体时，身边一塌。

他扭头，看见穿戴整齐，冷淡的表情与平常无二的秦琅坐在了床边。

夏兮风赶紧把头扭到一边，不去看秦琅。

侧坐在床边的秦琅俯身，伸手将夏兮风的脸掰过来，与夏兮风双唇相接。

“唔？唔！”夏兮风呼吸被夺，弱弱地挣扎了一下。

秦琅收回舌头，含着夏兮风的嘴唇研磨了一下，才放开了夏兮风。

“自我之神还在石门外，我去捅死他。你要一起去，还是再躺会儿？”秦琅的语气一如既往的平静。好像刚才的动作是夏兮风的错觉。

夏兮风陷入混乱。

其实他最初提议秦琅放开控制的时候，没想到会……咳……

秦琅的记忆他看到了一些，担忧他也体会了一些，但他还以为秦琅不想看见他和其他人玩，是好朋友的独占欲呢。

就像他也不喜欢看秦琅在游戏里和其他人组队，为其他人打工。他们这么多年交情，排他多正常啊。

当雾气把他裹住，全往不可言说的地方蹭的时候，夏兮风脑袋上才灯泡一亮，脑海里闪过一幅幅他和大学室友玩大冒险输了的时候，被罚看的当时他认为不符合他性向的片中的画面。

虽然那画面很是辣眼睛，看得他当时恨不得自戳双眼，惹得室友们哈哈大笑，但画面中的人如果换成秦琅和自己……啊？原来秦琅是这个意思吗？

好怪。

再想想，还是好怪。

如果是在穿越前，夏兮风都要吓得一蹦三丈高，头发都炸开了。

但他们已经穿越好几年，自己霸占秦琅另一半被窝好几年，再说排斥惊讶不适什么的……虽然自己从来没想过，但要能救秦琅，牺牲一下色相也……好像不需要犹豫？

虽然秦琅似乎不太想配合，但性命攸关，由不得他不配合。

反正总是自己主动伸手，主动走向他，这次也一样便好了。

一切顺利。

这糟心事结束后，夏兮风还没想好怎么面对秦琅。

估计秦琅也一样。

以秦琅的性格，肯定会避开自己，自己有的是时间把乱糟糟的想法理清楚。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 91

At this moment, Qin Lang didn't even realize that he had once again inexplicably believed Xia Xifeng's groundless "let's try it."

Qin Lang reached out and brushed away Xia Xifeng's hand from his shoulder. The mist at the edge of the altar surged forward, swirling with the two of them at the center.

They were like the eye of a typhoon. The dense mist formed a thick wall around them, locking them inside.

Wisps of mist drifted from the wall toward Xia Xifeng, like tentacles reaching out from the barrier.

Xia Xifeng stood perfectly still, letting the tentacles touch his cheeks, not forgetting to make a snide remark. "Qin Lang, your art style has completely changed. You've gone full tentacle evil god."

Qin Lang, who was exerting all his strength to prevent the "wall" from collapsing inward, faltered. The wall almost crumbled.

He ground his teeth. "Shut up!"

Xia Xifeng smiled at Qin Lang. Taking advantage of Qin Lang's distraction, he reached out to touch the surrounding "wall."

In an instant, the dense mist wrapped around Xia Xifeng's hand, creeping up his arm.

"Too slow." Xia Xifeng blinked at Qin Lang's horrified expression. "I told you, I trust you."

Qin Lang hastily pulled Xia Xifeng into his embrace. The "wall" collapsed inward, and the mist completely enveloped them both.

Though it should have been pitch-black, Qin Lang could clearly see the face of the person in his arms.

The mist kneaded and caressed Xia Xifeng's body with immense tenderness. Xia Xifeng had completely lost himself.

His brow furrowed, the corners of his eyes flushed a deep crimson, and his body trembled slightly. He bit his lower lip, but uncontrollable soft whimpers still escaped from between his teeth.

The tips of Qin Lang's hair floated gently. All emotion drained from his eyes, leaving his pupils like a tranquil, deep pool—reflecting only images, with the depths hidden from sight.

Protecting Xia Xifeng with one hand, he raised his other hand, his thumb gently rubbing the crimson flush at the corner of Xia Xifeng's eye.

Xia Xifeng struggled to focus his gaze. Tears welled up from the crimson corners of his eyes, and his body shuddered in waves, making him look incredibly pitiful.

"Regretting it?" Qin Lang lowered his head, bringing his forehead close to Xia Xifeng's.

Xia Xifeng squeezed out a voice with great effort: "Don't... underestimate me!"

Qin Lang's forehead lightly tapped Xia Xifeng's, his nose brushing against Xia Xifeng's nose. "Do you really understand your situation?"

"I said... don't underestimate me." Summoning every ounce of his strength, Xia Xifeng finally managed to raise his arm.

He wanted to wrap his arms around Qin Lang, but the moment his hand lifted slightly, he lost all strength. He could only grab a fistful of Qin Lang's robe before his hand fell.

Feeling the slight tug on his robe, Qin Lang's eyes trembled violently. His sanity, which had been on the verge of being swept away by the massive sea of consciousness, briefly returned.

He quickly raised his head, released his hold on Xia Xifeng, and took a swift step back.

Yet, Xia Xifeng did not let go of Qin Lang's robe.

"Why are you running? Are you that much of a coward?" Even with no strength left in his body, Xia Xifeng still had to mock him.

Pulled by the force of Qin Lang's retreat, his upper body fell forward toward Qin Lang. His fierce expression and tone made it look as though he were pouncing on him.

"Hey!" Qin Lang fell backward. Disregarding the fact that the back of his head almost hit the ground, he used both hands to shield Xia Xifeng, who crashed onto him.

As Qin Lang's back hit the ground, their faces were inevitably brought close together.

Xia Xifeng fiercely bit Qin Lang's lip, and with a single click, stripped away all of his and Qin Lang's equipment and clothing.

Qin Lang's body stiffened. He pushed away Xia Xifeng's large head, which kept leaning in close. His voice cracked with shock as his sanity returned completely. "Xiao Feng!!"

The sensation of their skin pressed tightly together made Xia Xifeng's body stiffen as well. He stammered, feeling a bit cowardly inside, but his mouth refused to back down. "I-it can save you, so what does this matter? Are you a man or not? You've already th-thought about it, so don't wimp out now!"

Qin Lang frantically tried to equip clothes on both of them, only for Xia Xifeng to strip them off again. Looking at the face cupped in his hands, he felt a sudden chest pain of exasperation.

Their pressed bodies grew increasingly warm. Xia Xifeng had used up his last bit of strength. His mind grew hazy, and just as he was about to drift off, the world suddenly spun. His bare back pressed against a hard, cold surface.

He opened his mouth to cry out, but a soft warmth pressed against the root of his tongue, choking back his voice.

Xia Xifeng's eyelids trembled slightly. Meeting a pair of eyes so dark that no emotion could be read, his consciousness dissolved into chaos. He only woke briefly with a sharp gasp when a sudden pain bloomed behind him, but he was quickly soothed by the hands wandering over his body, drifting back into a stupor.

By the time Xia Xifeng woke up again, his body was so hot he had lost all sensation, save for the highly irritating feeling of his hair rubbing against his ear.

The person holding him seemed to sense his awakening. The nuzzling stopped, and a slightly breathless voice whispered in his ear, "Xiao Feng, do you regret it now?"

Xia Xifeng lowered his head and bit the shoulder in front of him hard. "A-Lang, shut up!"

Then, his body swayed, and the world spun once more. He seemed to have been turned from lying on his back to kneeling on all fours, his waist and abdomen tightly embraced.

As a scorching heat pressed against his back, Xia Xifeng was dragged back into the vortex of unconsciousness.

In his daze, he felt a sharp pinch on his earlobe, seemingly in retaliation for his bite just now.

Before Xia Xifeng completely blacked out, all he saw were long black strands of hair that did not belong to him draping down on both sides of his cheeks, shrouding him like spider silk, or a cage.

……

He didn't know how long he had slept. When Xia Xifeng opened his eyes, he saw ordinary bed curtains.

His brain stalled for a long time before he finally turned his head to look around.

It looked a bit familiar... Oh, he was on the large bed inside the magic carriage.

He carefully wiggled his body. It was a bit sore, but there was no other discomfort. What had happened before felt like a dream.

Just as Xia Xifeng was quietly checking his body, the space beside him sank.

He turned his head and saw Qin Lang sitting by the edge of the bed, fully dressed, with his usual indifferent expression.

Xia Xifeng quickly turned his head to the side, avoiding Qin Lang's gaze.

Sitting sideways on the edge of the bed, Qin Lang leaned over, reached out to turn Xia Xifeng's face back, and pressed his lips against Xia Xifeng's.

"Mph? Mmh!" His breath stolen, Xia Xifeng struggled weakly.

Qin Lang withdrew his tongue, nibbled and ground against Xia Xifeng's lips for a moment, and then let him go.

"The God of Ego is still outside the stone gate. I'm going to stab him to death. Do you want to come with me, or do you want to lie down a bit longer?" Qin Lang's tone was as calm as ever, as if his actions just now were merely Xia Xifeng's hallucination.

Xia Xifeng fell into utter confusion.

Actually, when he first suggested that Qin Lang let go of his control, he hadn't expected... *cough*...

He had seen some of Qin Lang's memories and felt some of his worries, but he had assumed Qin Lang's dislike of seeing him play with others was just a close friend's possessiveness.

Just as he didn't like seeing Qin Lang party up with others in the game or work for them. With their many years of friendship, wasn't it normal to be exclusive?

It was only when the mist wrapped around him and rubbed against all those unspeakable places that a lightbulb finally went off in Xia Xifeng's head. Scenes flashed through his mind—scenes from movies he had been forced to watch back in college after losing a game of Truth or Dare, movies he had deemed incompatible with his sexual orientation at the time.

Although those scenes had been an eyesore that made him want to gouge his own eyes out while his roommates roared with laughter, if the people in those scenes were replaced by Qin Lang and himself... Ah? So *that* was what Qin Lang meant?

So weird.

Thinking about it again, it was still so weird.

If this had been before they transmigrated, Xia Xifeng would have jumped three feet in the air, his hair standing on end from shock.

But they had already been transmigrated for several years, and he had monopolized the other half of Qin Lang's bed for just as long. To talk about rejection, surprise, or discomfort now... Though he had never thought about it before, if it could save Qin Lang, sacrificing his body... didn't seem to require much hesitation?

Although Qin Lang hadn't seemed very willing to cooperate, it was a matter of life and death, so he had no choice.

In any case, he was always the one to reach out first, to walk toward him first. It was fine for this time to be the same.

Everything went smoothly.

Now that this troublesome business was over, Xia Xifeng still hadn't figured out how to face Qin Lang.

He figured Qin Lang was probably the same.

Given Qin Lang's personality, he would definitely avoid him, giving him plenty of time to sort out his messy thoughts.

chunks.chineseText:
可是……竟然……

啊啊啊啊啊秦琅怎么亲上来啦怎么回事秦琅你怎么崩人设啦！！！

难道你神魂还伤着没痊愈？

夏兮风正混乱着，听见秦琅要出去捅个人……啊不，捅个神。

他瞬间精神了。

“去去去，一起去……啊，哎哟！”夏兮风双手一撑就坐起来，被子从他光光的身体上滑落。

夏兮风赶紧往后一倒，后脑勺砸在枕头上，发出“咚”的一声巨响。

他拉起被子遮住身体，扭来扭去痛呼不已。

秦琅故作平静的表情差点崩开一条缝。

他看向夏兮风枕着的冬暖夏凉宝石枕——巨龙特别收藏，好大的一整块宝石雕刻而成的宝石枕。

早知道夏兮风的血防都很高，没想到他的血防会高到巨龙磨爪子的宝石都不能把他后脑勺砸个包的程度。

“你怎么不帮我穿衣服！”夏兮风抱怨。

秦琅：“刚给你上药。”

夏兮风：“啊？什么药？”

秦琅正考虑要怎么回答才不会让夏兮风害羞或者进一步恼羞成怒，夏兮风又“噌”地一下坐了起来。

他已经一键换好装了。

“快快快，别让祂逃了！”和秦琅的复杂关系夏兮风准备等会儿再理清。现在他只想把差点害死秦琅的自我之神狠狠揍一顿！

看着刚才还别别扭扭的夏兮风精神抖擞地从被子里窜出来，秦琅满腹无语，又有些遗憾。

夏兮风制作的伤药效果极其好，一擦上去，什么痕迹都没了，所以秦琅特意在夏兮风背上看不到的地方留了点红痕，算是给这个自动扑上来的大傻子打上标记。

可惜从系统面板穿衣服就是快，完全没有一丁点半遮半掩的旖旎的余地。

“哎哟！”跳下床的夏兮风又是一声惨叫，双腿一软，往前摔倒。

秦琅一把捞起夏兮风的腰，把夏兮风放腿上环住。

“啊，嘶……”夏兮风扶腰。

躺着还不觉得，站起来时他才发现自己的腰和腿都酸软无比，一点力都使不上。

夏兮风震惊：“不对啊，我不是血高防高耐力高吗？你比起我就是个脆皮！不该是你被我榨干爬不起来吗？”

秦琅：“……”

他深吸一口气，认真地问道：“你知道你在说什么吗？”

夏兮风疑惑：“我怎么会不知道我在说什么？”

秦琅把夏兮风抱着往床上一按，手撑在夏兮风颈边，双腿一屈，将夏兮风禁锢其中。

夏兮风：“咦？”

夏兮风：“唔！”

夏兮风：“咳咳咳！你、你发什么疯啊！不是说好的……唔！说好的……唔……出门打架吗！自我之神要跑路啦！”

就算被亲得喘不过气，夏兮风也要把话说完。

秦琅把头埋在夏兮风的颈间，闷声笑了。

夏兮风满头雾水。
chunks.englishText:
But... actually...

Ahhhhh! Why did Qin Lang kiss me?! What's going on?! Qin Lang, why did you break character like that?!

Could it be that your soul is still injured and hasn't fully healed?

While Xia Xifeng was in a state of chaos, he heard Qin Lang say he was going out to stab someone... no, stab a god.

He instantly perked up.

"Yes, yes, yes, let's go together... Ah, ow!" Xia Xifeng pushed himself up with both hands, and the blanket slid down his bare body.

Xia Xifeng quickly fell backward, the back of his head hitting the pillow with a loud thud.

He pulled up the blanket to cover himself, squirming and crying out in pain.

Qin Lang's feigned calm almost cracked.

He looked at the gem pillow Xia Xifeng was resting on—a special dragon collectible, carved from a massive, single piece of gemstone that stayed warm in winter and cool in summer.

He had always known Xia Xifeng's HP and defense were extremely high, but he hadn't expected his defense to be so high that even a gemstone used by dragons to sharpen their claws couldn't leave a bump on the back of his head.

"Why didn't you help me get dressed!" Xia Xifeng complained.

Qin Lang: "I just applied medicine to you."

Xia Xifeng: "Huh? What medicine?"

Just as Qin Lang was considering how to answer without making Xia Xifeng embarrassed or driving him to further anger, Xia Xifeng sat up again with a whoosh.

He had already equipped his clothes with a single click.

"Hurry, hurry, hurry, don't let him escape!" Xia Xifeng decided to sort out his complicated relationship with Qin Lang later. Right now, he only wanted to give the God of Ego, who had almost killed Qin Lang, a thorough beating!

Seeing Xia Xifeng, who had been so awkward just a moment ago, spring out of the blanket full of energy, Qin Lang was utterly speechless, yet felt a trace of regret.

The healing medicine Xia Xifeng made was incredibly effective; once applied, all traces vanished. Thus, Qin Lang had deliberately left a few red marks on Xia Xifeng's back where he couldn't see them, as a way of marking this big idiot who had pounced on him of his own accord.

Unfortunately, equipping clothes through the system panel was simply too fast, leaving absolutely no room for any half-hidden, lingering intimacy.

"Ow!" Jumping out of bed, Xia Xifeng let out another cry of pain. His legs gave out, and he tumbled forward.

Qin Lang caught Xia Xifeng by the waist in one swift motion, pulling him onto his lap and wrapping his arms around him.

"Ah, hiss..." Xia Xifeng held his waist.

He hadn't felt it while lying down, but upon standing up, he realized his waist and legs were incredibly sore and weak, completely devoid of strength.

Xia Xifeng was shocked. "Wait, this isn't right. Don't I have high HP, high defense, and high stamina? Compared to me, you're a glass cannon! Shouldn't you be the one drained dry and unable to get up?"

Qin Lang: "..."

He took a deep breath and asked seriously, "Do you have any idea what you are saying?"

Xia Xifeng was puzzled. "How could I not know what I'm saying?"

Qin Lang pressed Xia Xifeng down onto the bed, bracing his hands beside Xia Xifeng's neck and bending his knees to pin him in place.

Xia Xifeng: "Eh?"

Xia Xifeng: "Mph!"

Xia Xifeng: "Cough, cough, cough! Wh-what madness has possessed you! Didn't we agree... mph! Agree to... mph... go out and fight! The God of Ego is going to run away!"

Even though he was kissed breathless, Xia Xifeng still insisted on finishing his sentence.

Qin Lang buried his head in the crook of Xia Xifeng's neck and laughed softly.

Xia Xifeng was completely bewildered.

chunks.chineseText:
第92章 二更合一

最终秦琅还是放开了夏兮风。

有陌生人在门外候着，随时可能闯进来。虽然他们在魔导车里，也不必让人守着车门围观。

脸还是要的。

夏兮风警觉地盯着秦琅。

但他腰酸腿软，喝了精力药剂也药不对症站不稳，警觉了一小会儿，还是主动趴在秦琅背后，让秦琅背他出去打架。

秦琅背起夏兮风：“你这样还能打架？”

夏兮风拍拍秦琅的后脑勺：“就要去！我要亲眼看到自我之神被你暴揍！”

秦琅本想问夏兮风，自己背着夏兮风还怎么暴揍自我之神，但思及夏兮风比他自己还要信任自己，就懒得问了。

他自己想办法吧。

收起魔导车后，石室的大门还紧闭着，两位神灵没闯进来。

秦琅一脚踹开沉重还绑了锁链的石门。夏兮风帮秦琅调整装备，补充药品食物。

他嘀嘀咕咕，十分不开心。

秦琅的状态栏已经拂去阴影，变回正常的模样。夏兮风记得之前刚接触到秦琅的时候，秦琅升的级已经加在了他的等级上，他也一跃200级满级，来到了萌新玩家的起点。

秦琅虽然已经在自己睡觉的时候换上了背包里最高等级的装备，但装备离现在的级别还差三十九级呢！

见秦琅不能穿着合适的装备打架，夏兮风心里那个抓挠啊，抓得嘎吱嘎吱响。

闭关闭关！赶紧搓一套满级装备出来！

夏兮风艰难地不去看秦琅穿戴着的不合适的装备，把秦琅背包里低级别的装备都丢系统废品箱卖掉。

虽然这些装备可以卖给其他人，但满级之后，系统商店刷出了更多的好东西，夏兮风更缺系统货币，现实中的货币倒是不怎么紧要了。老师可以借给他嘛。

曾经打欠条会尴尬的夏兮风，现在也是被巨龙老师惯坏了。

“一、二、三……四十二？”夏兮风数着数着数，就愤怒地骂了起来，“每个级别的双剑都剩下不到一半！狗日的自我和死亡是想害死你吗！”

自我之神和死亡之神：“……”

夏兮风一手按住秦琅的肩膀，努力把自己上半身撑高一点，指着前面的自我之神和死亡之神怒骂。

“我和老秦好心好意给你传递消息，你就抓着人这么折腾？”

“死亡你在太阳祂们到处找自我的时候，看戏看得很开心是吧？”

“我和老秦都不是这个世界的人，再折腾你们自己玩去吧！我不干啦！”……

秦琅护着快从自己背上蹦起来的夏兮风，脑袋往旁边歪，耳朵被夏兮风的大嗓门震得嗡嗡响。

夏兮风越骂越愤怒，用上了脏话国骂，不仅把自我和死亡从头到尾骂了一遍，把养出这群奇葩神灵的天父都骂了一顿。

遇见外神，对方是敌人，再怎么折腾他和秦琅都正常。友方没事找事，夏兮风气炸了！

自我之神被骂习惯了，但没想到夏兮风连天父都骂，愣神了好久。

死亡之神后退了一步，藏在了阴影中。

自我之神瞥了死亡之神一眼，干咳一声：“护道者在试炼中也收获良多……”

“多个屁！”夏兮风横眉冷对，头发都要竖起来了，“我家老秦升级本来就快，没你折腾至多半年也能满级！你搞这么一出就是想把自我神格塞给老秦，逼他看顾深渊那群恶魔别死绝种了！”

什么升级什么满级，自我之神没听懂，但夏兮风后半截话，让祂的笑容冷了去。

自我之神神色淡漠，这时才有了点神灵的模样：“不愧是先知，这也在你预言中？”

“我的预言可没看见你。这是推断！”夏兮风用最凶恶的眼神瞪着自我之神，“你都做得这么明显，还以为别人看不出来你的险恶用心？！”

玩游戏的时候，剧情党就为深渊没沦陷这件事讨论了很久。

世界某一个种族某一个位面毁灭不等于世界毁灭，深渊和深渊恶魔全毁了其他种族都只会拍手称快，地上的外神爪牙还没驱逐干净，其他神灵的神眷者还要帮深渊干活，实在让玩家难以理解。

更何况，其他NPC和玩家在给深渊帮忙的时候，深渊恶魔还可能因为乐子魂发作拖后腿，实在是让人想把他们全部图图图了。

虽然夏兮风是个好人，但玩游戏的时候谁没杀过点傻叉NPC？

后来通过深渊相关任务中收集的只言片语，玩家猜测自我之神估计挂了，挂之前把自我神格交易给了其他神灵。

神格能增强神灵的力量，但持有神格就要庇佑信众。

至少，不能让信众死绝种了。

深渊位面是自我之神的根基，算半个神域。深渊恶魔虽然令所有种族厌恶，但自私自利到了极点的他们确实是自我之神最忠实的信众。

如果是和平时代，拥有自我神格的新神灵可以逐步建设自己的领域、寻找自己的信众，但在和外神战斗的关键时刻可没空做这些事。

《奇域幻想》的剧情很碎片化，玩家只是猜测。

自我之神究竟做了什么交易，和谁做了交易，或许要在游戏结局后，甚至游戏第二部才会全部揭晓。

夏兮风虽然不知道事情全貌，但自我之神把秦琅抓走，就为了把自我神格塞给秦琅，他就猜到了自我之神的目的。

不就是深渊恶魔实在是不讨人喜欢，祂怕没人救祂的信徒，就找人接盘吗？！

新生的护道者需要急速成长才能护住新生的先知，即使他不登临神位，神格的力量也能让他急速蜕变。

还有比新生的护道者更合适的接盘侠吗？！

“外神中对应自我的神灵已经死亡。”自我之神摘下右手的白手套，右手放在胸侧，优雅地对秦琅和夏兮风鞠躬，“融合两种自我神性的自我神格只是单纯的力量源泉，不会把护道者固定在神位上。只要信仰不灭，力量源泉就不会干涸。”

自我之神鞠躬之后，身体站直，脸上又恢复了之前那优雅的笑容：“深渊便是信仰和力量的转换器。深渊不毁，护道者便再也不用担心魔力枯竭。”

夏兮风狐疑：“神灵根本不需要信仰就能变强，信仰也不能直接转化成魔力。你说的根本不符合世界的规则。”

自我之神微笑：“所以我吞掉了外神。”

夏兮风更加狐疑：“规则不相容，你不会消化不良？”

自我之神的笑容依旧：“会。请护道者送我一程。”

夏兮风深吸一口气：“我只是想让秦琅揍你一顿，结果你是想寻死？”

怎么又来一个寻死的神灵？你们神灵能不能爱惜生命啊！

自我之神伸手做邀请状：“请。死亡之神已经为我们搭建出不会被他人影响的战场。我想护道者的力量刚提升，应该很需要一场酣畅淋漓的战斗消化力量。”

夏兮风：“……”他都不知道说什么好了。

外神能腐蚀梦世界本土神灵的神格，但本土神灵却不能吃外神神格。

就像是丧尸能吃健康的血肉，健康的人不能吃丧尸腐朽的肉一样。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 92: Two Chapters Merged (Part 1)

In the end, Qin Lang let go of Xia Xifeng.

With strangers waiting outside the door, they could burst in at any moment. Even though they were inside a magitech vehicle, there was no need to have someone standing guard at the door just to be watched.

One still had to maintain some dignity.

Xia Xifeng stared at Qin Lang with a wary gaze.

However, his waist was sore and his legs were weak. Even after drinking a stamina potion, it didn't address the root cause, and he couldn't stand steadily. After being vigilant for a short while, he took the initiative to climb onto Qin Lang’s back, letting Qin Lang carry him out to fight.

Qin Lang hoisted Xia Xifeng up: "Can you even fight like this?"

Xia Xifeng patted the back of Qin Lang’s head: "We have to go! I want to see you beat the God of Self into a pulp with my own eyes!"

Qin Lang originally wanted to ask Xia Xifeng how he was supposed to beat the God of Self while carrying him, but considering that Xia Xifeng trusted him even more than he trusted himself, he couldn't be bothered to ask.

He would just have to figure it out himself.

After putting away the magitech vehicle, the stone chamber door remained tightly shut; the two deities had not broken in.

Qin Lang kicked open the heavy, chain-bound stone door. Xia Xifeng helped Qin Lang adjust his equipment and restock on potions and food.

He was grumbling, looking extremely unhappy.

The status bar on Qin Lang’s interface had shed its shadows and returned to normal. Xia Xifeng remembered that when he first made contact with Qin Lang, the levels Qin Lang had gained were added to his own, and he had leaped to the level 200 cap, reaching the starting point of a newbie player.

Although Qin Lang had already equipped the highest-level gear from his inventory while he was sleeping, that gear was still thirty-nine levels below his current level!

Seeing that Qin Lang couldn't fight in proper gear made Xia Xifeng’s heart itch and claw with frustration.

*Cultivate! I need to cultivate! I need to craft a set of max-level gear right now!*

Xia Xifeng struggled to look away from the ill-fitting gear Qin Lang was wearing and tossed all the low-level equipment from Qin Lang’s inventory into the system’s junk bin to be sold.

Although this gear could be sold to others, the system shop had refreshed with even better items after hitting the level cap. Xia Xifeng was more in need of system currency; real-world currency wasn't that important anymore. His teacher could just lend it to him.

Xia Xifeng, who used to feel awkward about writing IOUs, had now been thoroughly spoiled by his dragon teacher.

"One, two, three... forty-two?" As Xia Xifeng counted, he began to curse in anger. "There’s less than half of the dual swords left for each level! Are those bastards 'Self' and 'Death' trying to get you killed?!"

The God of Self and the God of Death: "..."

Xia Xifeng pressed one hand against Qin Lang’s shoulder, trying to prop his upper body up higher, and pointed at the God of Self and the God of Death ahead, berating them furiously.

"Old Qin and I were kind enough to pass you information, and this is how you treat people?"

"Death, you were watching the show quite happily while the Sun and the others were searching everywhere for 'Self,' weren't you?"

"Neither Old Qin nor I belong to this world. Go play your games by yourselves! I’m done!"...

Qin Lang shielded Xia Xifeng, who was about to bounce off his back, tilting his head to the side as his ears buzzed from Xia Xifeng’s loud shouting.

The more Xia Xifeng cursed, the angrier he became, resorting to profanity and national-level insults. He didn't just curse the God of Self and the God of Death from head to toe; he even cursed the Heavenly Father who had raised this bunch of bizarre deities.

Meeting an Outer God, where the opponent is an enemy, meant any amount of tormenting him and Qin Lang was expected. But when allies were looking for trouble for no reason, Xia Xifeng was absolutely livid!

The God of Self was used to being cursed at, but didn't expect Xia Xifeng to even curse the Heavenly Father, and was stunned for a long time.

The God of Death took a step back, hiding in the shadows.

The God of Self glanced at the God of Death and gave a dry cough: "The Guardian has also gained much from the trial..."

"Gained my ass!" Xia Xifeng glared, his hair practically standing on end. "My Old Qin levels up fast enough on his own; without your meddling, he would have reached the level cap in six months at most! You pulled this stunt just to shove the Godhead of Self onto Old Qin, forcing him to watch over those demons in the Abyss so they don't go extinct!"

The God of Self didn't understand what "leveling up" or "level cap" meant, but the latter half of Xia Xifeng’s words made the smile on His face turn cold.

The God of Self looked indifferent, finally appearing a bit like a deity: "As expected of a Prophet, was this also in your prophecies?"

"My prophecies didn't see you. This is deduction!" Xia Xifeng glared at the God of Self with the fiercest look he could muster. "You made it so obvious, did you really think others wouldn't see your sinister intentions?!"

When playing the game, the lore-focused players had debated for a long time about why the Abyss hadn't fallen.

The destruction of a race or a plane in the world did not equal the destruction of the world itself. If the Abyss and the Abyssal demons were all destroyed, other races would only applaud. Yet, the minions of the Outer Gods on the surface hadn't been purged, and the followers of other deities still had to work for the Abyss—it was truly hard for players to understand.

Moreover, when other NPCs and players helped the Abyss, the Abyssal demons might even drag them down because of their "fun-seeking" souls, which made people want to just wipe them all out.

Although Xia Xifeng was a good person, who hadn't killed a few idiotic NPCs while playing games?

Later, through fragments collected from Abyss-related quests, players speculated that the God of Self had likely died, and before dying, had traded the Godhead of Self to other deities.

A Godhead could enhance a deity’s power, but holding it meant protecting the believers.

At the very least, one couldn't let the believers go extinct.

The Abyssal plane was the foundation of the God of Self, counting as half a divine realm. Although Abyssal demons were loathed by all races, their extreme selfishness made them the most loyal believers of the God of Self.

In times of peace, a new deity with the Godhead of Self could gradually build their domain and find believers, but in the critical moment of fighting Outer Gods, there was no time for such things.

The plot of *Fantasy of the Strange Realm* was very fragmented; players were only guessing.

What kind of deal the God of Self had made, and with whom, might only be revealed after the game’s ending, or perhaps even in the game’s sequel.

Although Xia Xifeng didn't know the full picture, the fact that the God of Self had kidnapped Qin Lang just to shove the Godhead of Self onto him made him guess the deity’s purpose.

It was just that the Abyssal demons were truly unlikable, and the deity was afraid no one would save His believers, so He was looking for someone to take over the mess!

A newborn Guardian needed to grow rapidly to protect the newborn Prophet; even if he didn't ascend to a divine throne, the power of a Godhead could force him to undergo a rapid transformation.

Was there any better "fall guy" than a newborn Guardian?!

"The deity corresponding to 'Self' among the Outer Gods has already perished." The God of Self removed the white glove from His right hand, placed it against His chest, and bowed elegantly to Qin Lang and Xia Xifeng. "The Godhead of Self, which fuses two types of self-divinity, is merely a pure source of power and will not fix the Guardian to a divine throne. As long as faith does not perish, the source of power will not run dry."

After bowing, the God of Self stood straight, the elegant smile returning to His face: "The Abyss is the converter of faith and power. As long as the Abyss is not destroyed, the Guardian will never have to worry about magic power depletion."

Xia Xifeng was suspicious: "Deities don't need faith to become stronger, and faith cannot be directly converted into magic power. What you’re saying doesn't conform to the rules of the world at all."

The God of Self smiled: "That is why I devoured the Outer God."

Xia Xifeng was even more suspicious: "The rules are incompatible; won't you get indigestion?"

The God of Self’s smile remained: "I will. Please, Guardian, send me on my way."

Xia Xifeng took a deep breath: "I just wanted Qin Lang to beat you up, and it turns out you’re looking for death?"

Why was there another deity looking for death? Could you deities please cherish your lives!

The God of Self gestured with an invitation: "Please. The God of Death has already constructed a battlefield that will not be affected by others. I believe that since the Guardian’s power has just increased, he should be in great need of a hearty battle to digest that power."

Xia Xifeng: "..." He didn't know what to say anymore.

Outer Gods could corrupt the Godheads of native deities in the Dream World, but native deities could not consume the Godheads of Outer Gods.

It was like how zombies could eat healthy flesh, but healthy people could not eat the rotting flesh of zombies.

chunks.chineseText:
自我之神吃掉了外神，剥离了神格，就为了“逼迫”其他神灵伸出援手，保住深渊和深渊恶魔？

这不是保住某一支恶魔，某一个具体的恶魔。只要深渊不毁灭，深渊恶魔不绝种就行，条件挺宽松的。

为了深渊恶魔不死觉，祂就能忍受外神神格腐蚀身体的痛苦，忍受神格剥离时神魂凌迟般的疼痛，直至灰飞烟灭，半点活路都不给自己留？

如果说进化之神和智慧之神死时神格还在，或许还能留一两点灵魂转世，自我之神都和外神神格纠缠不清，死了就会被这个世界的规则彻底清除。

秦琅放下夏兮风。

夏兮风晃了晃身体站稳，仍旧不敢置信：“你可是自我之神，最自私自利的神灵，怎么会为了信众牺牲自己？”

自我之神轻笑着摇摇头：“何为自我？何为自私自利？就是遵从本心。这一点，护道者应该最为明白。所有护道者，都是最为自私之人。”

秦琅挑了一下眉头，没回答。

夏兮风想反驳，被秦琅按住嘴唇。

“不必多说，杀就杀。”秦琅冷漠道，“又不是第一次弑神。”

夏兮风想起副本世界中的进化之神和智慧之神。

哦，对了，还有两个神灵在排队等死。虽然祂们可能没有自我之神死得那么干净，但就算能转世，也不再是祂们，所以还是相当于死得干干净净了。

“请接受我的礼物。”自我之神拿出早就准备好的装备。

夏兮风检查了一下，衣服、饰品、双剑齐全，全是满级装备，还有套装效果。

全套神装啊。

夏兮风略带不爽地给秦琅穿上，小声对着秦琅道：“回去我给你做更好的！”

“嗯。”秦琅道，“帮我加血。”

夏兮风挺起胸膛：“那当然！我们绝不单打独斗！”

秦琅跟着自我之神走进死亡之神划开的空间裂缝中，夏兮风赶紧跟了上去。

死亡之神拎住夏兮风的后衣领，打量一脚深一脚浅的夏兮风，若有所思。

夏兮风汗毛都快炸了起来：“看什么看！”

死亡之神淡漠道：“我带你去。”

这个护道者有点不体贴。

反正阿穆若对苏尔，比这个护道者对小先知体贴。

不过也可能是苏尔是巨龙，更耐折腾。小先知只是脆弱的人类。

死亡之神不爱张嘴说话，心里的话却很多。

他带着夏兮风来到战场，看着夏兮风盘腿坐下，瓶瓶罐罐摆了一地，随时准备支援秦琅。

自我之神和秦琅已经打了起来，战场上只剩残影，连空间都被割裂，需要死亡之神出手稳定空间。

死亡之神的眼神有些寂寞。

自我之神是一个很好的话搭子。就算自己不张口说话，祂也能接住自己心里的话。

死亡之神想，祂应该是视自我之神为友的。

因此，死亡之神在此见证自我之神的死亡。

愿吾友如愿以偿。

……

一人一神打得激烈，聊天的语气却很平和，和没有剧烈运动似的。

自我之神很热情地向秦琅介绍深渊的势力构成，和祂的那些可爱的“孩子们”，就像是离职交接的老班主任。

秦琅很礼貌地“嗯嗯”回应，让系统“录”下自我之神的话，全部发给夏兮风。

既然夏兮风已经回到他身边，那战斗之外的游戏任务，他是一点兴趣都没有。

自我之神无视秦琅毫无感情的礼貌回应，自顾自地说个不停。

这确实很自我了。

战斗了一会儿，秦琅看了一眼面板。

战斗的时候，不仅血量蓝量在缓慢回升，连武器的耐久度都在回升。

这里应该是自我之神或者死亡之神的神域，如智慧之神和进化之神的试炼塔一样。

那这里的时间流速和外界应该也不同。或许自己完全将自我之神的神格力量化为己用前，这场试炼是不会结束了。

秦琅分心给夏兮风发消息：【不用加buff了。做你的事。】

夏兮风秒回：【哦哦。我正在刷技能熟练度，等会儿就回现实世界和老师报一声平安。深渊应该能通讯了。】

秦琅嘴角上勾。

不用他提醒，夏兮风也在适应新的力量。

自我之神戏谑道：“在和夏联系？有他为后盾，你很安心。有安心的伙伴真好啊。”

秦琅不回答。

自我之神想说话时，可不管对方回答不回答。

他继续戏谑道：“帮你破局，你是不是该感谢一下我这个媒人？”

秦琅眉头微微耸动了一下，终于对自我之神说了单音节之外的话：“不用你多事也一样。你多事，反而麻烦。”

自我之神笑话道：“你不是一直在压抑自我吗？我帮你解放自我。”

秦琅：“自我就是遵从内心，没有人能评定别人的自我，自我之神也不能。”

自我之神沉默了一会儿，又笑道：“你还在生气啊。”

秦琅再次闭口不言，只是攻击更加凌厉。

今后如何相处是他和夏兮风自己的事。无论后续怎么发展，夏兮风的安危凌驾一切之上。

他希望能掌控一切和夏兮风相处时的不安定因素。即使他知道夏兮风就算受了来自自己的伤害也不会在意，那也不行。

“自我”就是纯粹从自己的心意出发，与他人的反馈无关。

自我之神扰乱他的精神，为夏兮风带来了危险，即使自我之神不找死，他也会杀了自我之神。

可惜自我之神自己找死，他杀了自我之神也没什么报复的快感。

“不用向我介绍你的深渊。”秦琅道，“你既然放弃了神位，深渊就是新的深渊之神的深渊。”

自我之神嘴角笑意散去。

笑容到了秦琅的嘴角。

对极端自我的人而言，精心打造的玩具箱成了别人的，心情不会好吧？

再装模作样不在意，其实还是很在意。这样他的死亡，才会让人开心。

自我之神轻哼一声：“你这太过计较的脾气，遇上先知那种圣人，一定很难过吧？他对其他人倾注太多善意，就是对你无情啊。”

秦琅的笑意完全没有动摇：“不，我担忧的从来不是这个。他对倾注善意的人才无情。”

自我之神：“？”

……

看着秦琅的身影消失，夏兮风脸上阳光灿烂的笑容一点一点地褪去。

死亡之神用眼角余光打量夏兮风。

夏兮风现在的神情和没见到秦琅时差不多，只是没了焦躁。

他看上去余怒未消。

观察了一会儿秦琅的面板，发现这次战斗指导自带缓回后，夏兮风就搬出工作台，开始磨炼生活技能。

满级之后，穿越副本中能打的怪，现实中他们也能打了。但穿越副本没危险，现实中死了就不一定能活。

思及外神对本土方方面面的侵蚀，夏兮风不放心秦琅在面对外神的时候穿本土打造的装备。他必须亲手把秦琅武装一遍才安心。

等级一键满级，技能没有一键满级。

夏兮风思索现在最需要的装备和buff，仔细分配了升级后给的技能点。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 92: Two Chapters Merged (Part 2)

The God of Self ate an Outer God and stripped away the Godhead, just to "force" other deities to extend a helping hand and preserve the Abyss and the Abyssal demons?

This wasn't about preserving a specific branch of demons, or any specific demon. As long as the Abyss wasn't destroyed and the Abyssal demons didn't go extinct, the conditions were quite loose.

To keep the Abyssal demons from going extinct, He could endure the pain of an Outer God’s Godhead corrupting His body, endure the agony of His divine soul being sliced to ribbons during the stripping of the Godhead, until He turned to ash, leaving Himself no path to survival?

If the God of Evolution and the God of Wisdom still had their Godheads when they died, perhaps they could have left a sliver of soul for reincarnation. But the God of Self was so entangled with the Outer God’s Godhead that if He died, He would be completely erased by the rules of this world.

Qin Lang set Xia Xifeng down.

Xia Xifeng swayed as he stood steady, still unable to believe it: "You are the God of Self, the most selfish deity of all; how could you sacrifice yourself for your believers?"

The God of Self chuckled and shook His head: "What is 'Self'? What is selfishness? It is simply following one’s own heart. On this point, the Guardian should understand best. All Guardians are the most selfish of people."

Qin Lang raised an eyebrow but didn't answer.

Xia Xifeng wanted to retort, but Qin Lang pressed a finger to his lips.

"No need to say more, just kill him." Qin Lang said coldly, "It’s not like it’s the first time I’ve killed a god."

Xia Xifeng remembered the God of Evolution and the God of Wisdom in the dungeon world.

Oh, right, there were two more deities waiting in line to die. Although they might not have died as cleanly as the God of Self, even if they could reincarnate, they would no longer be themselves, so it was effectively the same as dying completely.

"Please accept my gift." The God of Self produced the equipment He had prepared long ago.

Xia Xifeng checked it; clothes, accessories, and dual swords were all there, all max-level gear, and there was even a set bonus.

A full set of divine gear.

Xia Xifeng put it on Qin Lang with a hint of annoyance, whispering to him: "I’ll make you something better when we get back!"

"Mm," Qin Lang said, "Help me with healing."

Xia Xifeng puffed out his chest: "Of course! We never fight alone!"

Qin Lang followed the God of Self into the spatial rift opened by the God of Death, and Xia Xifeng hurried to follow.

The God of Death grabbed Xia Xifeng by the back of his collar, eyeing the stumbling Xia Xifeng with a thoughtful expression.

Xia Xifeng’s hackles nearly rose: "What are you looking at!"

The God of Death said indifferently: "I’ll take you."

This Guardian was a bit inconsiderate.

At any rate, Amuro was more considerate to Sur than this Guardian was to the little Prophet.

But then again, maybe it was because Sur was a dragon and could handle more rough treatment. The little Prophet was just a fragile human.

The God of Death didn't like to speak, but He had many thoughts in His heart.

He brought Xia Xifeng to the battlefield and watched as Xia Xifeng sat cross-legged, bottles and jars spread all over the ground, ready to support Qin Lang at any moment.

The God of Self and Qin Lang were already fighting; only afterimages remained on the battlefield, and even space was being sliced apart, requiring the God of Death to step in and stabilize it.

The God of Death’s eyes were somewhat lonely.

The God of Self was a very good conversationalist. Even if He didn't speak, He could always pick up on the thoughts in His heart.

The God of Death thought that He should consider the God of Self a friend.

Therefore, the God of Death was here to witness the death of the God of Self.

May my friend get what He wishes.

...

The man and the god fought fiercely, yet their tone of conversation was as calm as if they weren't engaged in strenuous exercise.

The God of Self was very enthusiastic about introducing the power structure of the Abyss to Qin Lang, along with His lovely "children," much like a retiring head teacher handing over his duties.

Qin Lang responded politely with "Mm, mm," letting the system "record" the God of Self’s words and send them all to Xia Xifeng.

Since Xia Xifeng was already back by his side, he had zero interest in any game quests outside of the combat.

The God of Self ignored Qin Lang’s emotionless, polite responses and kept talking to Himself.

That was indeed very "Self" of Him.

After fighting for a while, Qin Lang glanced at his panel.

During the fight, not only were his HP and MP slowly recovering, but even the durability of his weapons was recovering.

This must be the divine realm of the God of Self or the God of Death, just like the trial towers of the God of Wisdom and the God of Evolution.

Then the flow of time here must be different from the outside world. Perhaps this trial wouldn't end until he had completely assimilated the power of the God of Self’s Godhead.

Qin Lang distracted himself to send a message to Xia Xifeng: [No need to add buffs. Do your own thing.]

Xia Xifeng replied instantly: [Oh, oh. I’m grinding skill proficiency; I’ll go back to the real world in a bit to report that we’re safe to the teacher. Communication should be available in the Abyss now.]

The corners of Qin Lang’s mouth curled up.

Without him needing to remind him, Xia Xifeng was also adapting to his new power.

The God of Self teased: "Communicating with Xia? You’re very at ease with him as your backing. It’s good to have a reassuring partner."

Qin Lang didn't answer.

When the God of Self wanted to talk, He didn't care whether the other party answered or not.

He continued to tease: "Since I helped you break the deadlock, shouldn't you thank me, the matchmaker?"

Qin Lang’s brows twitched slightly, and he finally said something other than a monosyllable to the God of Self: "I would have managed without your meddling. Your meddling just made things troublesome."

The God of Self joked: "Aren't you always suppressing your 'Self'? I’m helping you liberate it."

Qin Lang: "The 'Self' is just following one’s heart; no one can judge another’s 'Self,' not even the God of Self."

The God of Self was silent for a moment, then laughed again: "You’re still angry."

Qin Lang closed his mouth again, his attacks becoming even sharper.

How they would get along in the future was a matter for him and Xia Xifeng. No matter how things developed, Xia Xifeng’s safety took precedence over everything.

He hoped to control all the unstable factors in his time with Xia Xifeng. Even if he knew Xia Xifeng wouldn't care if he were hurt by him, it still wasn't allowed.

"Self" was purely about following one’s own heart, regardless of others' feedback.

The God of Self had disturbed his mind and brought danger to Xia Xifeng; even if the God of Self weren't seeking death, he would have killed Him.

It was just a pity that the God of Self was seeking death, so he felt no thrill of revenge in killing Him.

"No need to introduce your Abyss to me," Qin Lang said. "Since you’ve abandoned the divine throne, the Abyss belongs to the new God of the Abyss."

The smile faded from the God of Self’s lips.

A smile appeared on Qin Lang’s.

For someone extremely self-centered, it wouldn't feel good to have a meticulously crafted toy box become someone else’s, right?

Even if He pretended not to care, He actually cared a lot. Only then would His death make people happy.

The God of Self gave a light hum: "With your overly calculating temper, it must be very hard to be with a saint like the Prophet, right? He pours too much kindness on others, which is being heartless to you."

Qin Lang’s smile didn't waver at all: "No, that’s never what I’ve worried about. He is only heartless to those he pours his kindness upon."

The God of Self: "?"

...

Watching Qin Lang’s figure disappear, the sunny, bright smile on Xia Xifeng’s face faded bit by bit.

The God of Death eyed Xia Xifeng from the corner of His vision.

Xia Xifeng’s expression now was much the same as it had been before he saw Qin Lang, only the restlessness was gone.

He looked like his lingering anger had yet to subside.

After observing Qin Lang’s panel for a while and discovering that this combat guidance came with automatic recovery, Xia Xifeng moved out his workbench and began to hone his life skills.

After reaching the level cap, the monsters they could fight in the dungeon could also be fought in reality. But dungeons had no real danger, while dying in reality might not mean coming back.

Thinking of how the Outer Gods were eroding everything native to the world, Xia Xifeng didn't trust Qin Lang to wear native-made gear when facing them. He had to arm Qin Lang with his own hands to feel at ease.

Levels could be maxed out with one click, but skills couldn't.

Xia Xifeng pondered the gear and buffs he needed most right now, carefully allocating the skill points he’d gained from leveling up.

chunks.chineseText:
所有技能树开放，所有物品他都能做，所有套路他都能玩了。单独战斗后，夏兮风对如何武装自己也有了新的思路，力图把自己打造成带刺和军火的厚壳乌龟。

他可不希望秦琅在战斗的时候，自己只能躲在一旁。

再遇到一次敌人打着打着就把秦琅拎走了怎么办？他们去哪都要一起。

夏兮风一遍又一遍地用系统自动制造物品，无数知识注入他的灵魂。他缓了缓，看了一眼秦琅的状态，为秦琅补了buff，就开始手工制作。

满级后，夏兮风也点燃了神火。手工制作就不需要系统给的工作台了。夏兮风打了个响指，火焰在他指尖跃动。

堆在地面的材料飘起。他弹了一下手指，火星飞到材料上，材料全部熔化。

连木头材质，按照常理而言应该被点燃的材料也全部熔化。

夏兮风手指轻勾，融化的材料分出极细的丝线，一缕一缕地旋转缠绕，缠成了一个一个的丝线球。

死亡之神将视线从战场收回，看向夏兮风。

死亡之神从不参与纷争，人格还未更替过。所有英雄都会从死亡那里走一遭，没有复活传说的英雄都不能叫英雄。所以天赋很高的生灵，他见得多了。

无论天赋再高，成长都需要时间。秦琅的力量是自我之神强行灌输的，他本该如小孩拿着重锤一样，不能熟练使用过于强大的力量。但秦琅已经和自我之神打得难分难解，欠缺的似乎只是对自我神性的运用。

夏兮风也一样。他对“知识”的接受程度太快了。

或许天父用其他方式提前给两人灌输过“经验”和“知识”，但死亡之神确信在两人出现之前，所有从死亡之门走过的灵魂都和夏兮风、秦琅毫无关系，所以他们肯定没经过实战。

如果只是灌输“知识”和“经验”就能造就强者，不说神灵，就是寻常传说职阶的生灵都能批量制造传说职阶了。

这两个本身就天赋极强。

天父从哪拐来的？那个世界的创世神会允许自家能成神的好苗子被外来者薅走？

死亡之神万年不起波澜的心里生出了好奇，不再对即将逝去的朋友行注目礼。他颇有兴趣地观看夏兮风“编织”。

无论什么材料，夏兮风都能将其融化抽成丝线；无论什么物品，夏兮风都能将其“编织”。

盔甲可以“编织”，武器可以“编织”，饰品可以“编织”，药品可以“编织”……一切的一切，都可以编织。

夏兮风不再需要依据材料本身特性选择工具，也不再需要遵循材料的物理化学性质。他已经点燃了神火，神火可以融化一切概念。

如果他愿意，也可以用大锤子来打造一切物品，如锻造之神。但一切外在的形态，本质都是一样的，用什么工具打造都是一样的。

没有比神火更强大的火焰，只是费神，还会给装备打上自己的烙印。所以神灵制造非自己穿的装备时，也会借助其他火焰和工具，采集大自然中仅次于神火的火焰。

夏兮风的一切都和秦琅分享，秦琅也一样。他用神火为秦琅打造的物品，秦琅用着就和用自己的神火打造的一样舒心。

神器只有用神火锻造才能“完美品质”，而神器即使“完美”制造，也不能像低于“神器”的物品一样，用系统批量制造“完美品质”。

夏兮风好不容易搓出一把完美品质的短剑，眉头紧皱。

这下要想再给秦琅塞99件替换的装备，所花的精力和时间就很夸张了。还好神器的耐久度很高，秦琅很难穿坏，可以慢慢搓。

想到这，夏兮风记起秦琅在试炼中穿坏的几十件装备，没忍住狠狠瞪了战场一眼，嘴里骂了自我之神一句脏话。

死亡之神为自家友人说好话：“自我虽然手段激烈了些，但护道者得到的好处也很大，足够抵消他的不敬。”

夏兮风本就不想理睬死亡之神这个共犯，闻言冷笑道：“秦琅没有这次倒霉经历也能很快满级，他的升级速度已经够快了。这次升级过快，我还担心他境界不稳呢。”

升级？满级？死亡之神咀嚼着这两个字眼。升级祂能懂，何为满级？点燃神火吗？

开了话匣子，夏兮风就忍不住骂人的话了。

“我家秦琅本来就心思纤细又柔软，总容易想多，这次不知道他又要拧巴多久！心理伤害不是伤害吗？还要帮自我之神照顾深渊那一大帮熊孩子，我们赚哪了？”夏兮风叉腰大骂，“我们已经够吃亏了，还说什么抵消？你们神灵的脸皮这么厚，怎么不糊在世界之壁上，外神就进不来啦！”

死亡之神：“？”

心思纤细又柔软？谁？祂就算不了解这位小护道者，还不了解天父挑选护道者的标准吗？

被骂几句死亡之神不在意，但小先知对小护道者的评价，祂超惊悚。

先知都是这么评价护道者吗？那苏尔难道也是这么看待阿穆若的？

神火都吓得崩裂火花了！

夏兮风看着死亡之神困惑的表情，更加生气。

算了，天生的神灵，和祂们生气有屁用，祂们不懂。

夏兮风不再和死亡之神聊天，继续练习生活技能。

死亡之神从惊悚中回过神，正思考再找些什么聊天话题。以后自我之神不在了，祂得学会自己主动和人聊天。趁着其他神灵看不到，祂正好做练习。

夏兮风停下手，愤愤的脸上绽放笑容。

死亡之神不用想，就知道他正在和护道者“通话”。
