Chapter 94: Two Chapters in One (Part 3)

Xia Xifeng had thought the God of Death would say a few more words.

He glanced at Qin Lang’s status bar again and cast a defensive buff on Qin Lang’s avatar to show he had returned, before teleporting back to the Abyss.

When he returned to the basement, Xia Xifeng saw that the atmosphere was very wrong, with a sense of tension.

He thought for a moment and threw out the Qin Lang clone that had been stuck to his wrist.

Qin Lang’s clone transformed into a gray figure as usual, following Xia Xifeng as a guard.

"For those who are already dead, I will send their souls back to the land of eternal rest. For those who are not yet dead, I will try to save them. If their will to live is firm, they might live," Xia Xifeng paused and said, "They might also die. If you have any acquaintances you want to save who are still alive, encourage them more; it might be useful."

The six Demon Kings immediately gave up glaring at each other and hurried to find the living members of their own clans.

The Vampire True Ancestor had a large appetite; she had captured people from every race to some extent.

Rousa said excitedly: "My Lord..."

Xia Xifeng interrupted: "Don't waste time."

Rousa quickly shut his mouth, turned to look at his half-brother, and muttered something unknown.

He probed his mental power into the cylinder, intending to share the despair with the person inside.

Xia Xifeng focused his observation on Rousa’s brother.

He saw the brother’s fingers curl, and his eyelids were trembling.

Hmm, this one could probably live.

He observed the other living people. Most of them had a heavy intent to die, completely swallowed by despair. Although the other five Demon Kings were also trying their best to call out, they didn't have the close relationship Rousa had with the person in the cylinder, so the effect of their calling was naturally not very good.

After checking the status of all the imprisoned, Xia Xifeng found that Rousa had withdrawn his mental power from the cylinder and began calling to other vampires.

His state was already poor, yet he was still piercing his mental power into the cylinders of several other Vampire Princes.

"You have a good relationship with them too?" Xia Xifeng asked curiously.

Rousa shook his head: "The vampires were mostly destroyed by the ancestor; I want to do my best to save more people. And... and my brother told me to do it."

"Oh? His consciousness is clear enough to talk to you?" Xia Xifeng was surprised.

A proud smile appeared on Rousa’s face, not looking much like a vampire at all: "My brother is naturally the most amazing."

Xia Xifeng retorted: "You are the most amazing now; you are the Vampire True Ancestor. He could even call you 'Ancestor'."

Rousa: "..."

Xia Xifeng walked away leisurely.

【Xia Xifeng: Teasing the little succubus is so much fun.

Perilla: Who are you bullying again?

Leo: Remember to record it!

Damon: Are you sick for mutting me! Believe it or not, I’ll stop working!】

Suer in Green Sand City showed a kind smile and kicked Amuro, who couldn't enter the group chat.

Qin Lang glanced at the group chat, his cold eyes warming slightly.

Even if the God of Self had stripped away His divinity, He still had a sense of the major events in the Abyss.

He sighed: "The Prophet is truly a saint. Aren't you afraid that he will be hurt by those he saves who aren't grateful? You don't have to worry about that in the Abyss; if anyone doesn't know how to be grateful, just kill them. There aren't as many rules as on the surface; you should like it."

"I do like it," Qin Lang acknowledged.

Although as long as it wasn't substantial harm, Xia Xifeng wouldn't feel hurt in his heart because of the other party’s bad attitude.

When Xia Xifeng did good deeds, he was very clear that kindness wasn't always followed by flowers and applause.

Precisely because of this, he couldn't stand Xia Xifeng’s behavior.

This world was truly great and very suitable for him.

In the basement of the Abyss, Xia Xifeng had already begun to save people.

The divinity granted by the God of Death served as a staff, and the Silver Moon fragment transformed into the gem on the staff. Xia Xifeng held the staff and tapped lightly on the cylinders containing the dead.

The cylinder and the body of the imprisoned turned into fly ash together, leaving only a translucent soul floating.

The light of the Silver Moon covered the soul like a veil, the twisted expression on the soul gradually becoming peaceful, and the black mud poured out of the soul’s seven orifices, turning into black smoke and dissipating.

The blurred features of the soul became clear, but the spirit body became fainter.

The Vampire True Ancestor had not only devoured flesh and blood but had also eaten a lot of soul power.

However, the rule of death was activated; even if the soul was broken, it could enter the land of eternal rest to sleep.

It was just that they might have recalled their previous life in the next life and inherited their previous talents. Now, they could only become mediocre people in their next life.

The purified soul bowed to Xia Xifeng, turned into a ball of light, and flew into the staff.

Even if the Demon Kings had many disagreements with Xia Xifeng as the Lord of the Abyss, at this moment, they stood solemnly to the side, bowing their heads and bending their waists to Xia Xifeng.

They respected and were grateful for the helping hand Xia Xifeng had extended.

Rousa, who was pale and had to use a cane to stand, looked excited.

Demons were selfish, so they hoped that the gods they followed were full of kindness toward their followers.

As long as the vampires could offer enough loyalty, this young god would definitely protect the vampires!

chunks.chineseText:
第95章 二更合一

夏兮风不知道新的血族真祖的谋划。

知道了，他也不会有什么多余的想法。他不打算长期做这个深渊之主，秦琅肯定也一样。

即使自我神格已经被改造成了力量增幅器，夏兮风仍旧膈应。

这个力量增幅器是自我神格加外神神格杂糅的试验品，秦琅受的苦，也是炼制这个“神器”的一环。

虽然夏兮风能使用，但归属权仍旧是秦琅的。夏兮风使用的时候，没觉得有什么副作用，但他总觉得秦琅估计不是这样。

既然秦琅的自我神格能卸下来，那就可以丢给其他人，等他们回去后好好研究一下。

就算没有副作用，夏兮风认为他们也不需要神格这玩意儿。

神格就代表着责任。在原本的世界束缚太多，不得自由。这个世界好不容易有了自由的资本，除了经营好希望之城这个可以归去的小家之外，他和秦琅都没打算承担更多的责任。

至于做好事，那是爱好，不是责任。

你说救世的责任？他不是反击侵略者的芸芸众生中的一员吗？

夏兮风深呼吸了一下，休息了一会儿。

心里杂思太多，他还是被被禁锢者的绝望记忆影响了情绪。

不过比起当初的莱欧和佩瑞拉，他已经好太多。

莱欧和佩瑞拉是以第一人称体会绝望，代入感极强。大概是因为夏兮风本就是外来者，共情感弱虚弱，他很快就进入第三视角，就像是看了许多场悲惨的全息影视片段，也就是影响心情而已。

夏兮风休息的时候，看见六魔王那闪烁的小眼神，就知道他们心里又在打什么小九九。

“我已经尝试过，能救，是血月的手段。”夏兮风道，“太阳的神眷者莱欧和佩瑞拉已经救过一次。我教你们怎么做。”

夏兮风露出一个瞧不出感情的笑容：“太阳神眷者的年龄还不到你们的零头，他们能做到的你们应该也能做到。虽然你们可能不愿意为救族人而付出什么，但这是安全地体会邪神手段的机会，我还是建议你们试一试。”

夏兮风已经把最岌岌可危的灵魂从禁锢中解救出来，剩下的就算施救者不熟练，也不会导致失败。

这六个深渊魔王还有空互瞪，就是太闲了。自己的人自己救，自己的深渊自己保护，别什么都指望别人。

夏兮风对深渊恶魔的心理把控很精准。

他们可能不会伤害自己去拯救族人，但一说能提前安全地体验邪神力量，他们就愿意做了。

都是神眷者，他们的力量不会比不过岁数只是他们零头的太阳神眷者。既然莱欧和佩瑞拉都没死，他们一定也没问题。

事实确实如此。

夏兮风手把手教他们几次后，连力量最弱的新任血族真祖也能解除禁锢。

只是比起夏兮风，他们受绝望记忆影响严重许多。

不过他们在体验一次绝望记忆之后，态度倒是端正不少，没有心情再互瞪了。

以前没有亲身与邪神爪牙敌对过，深渊魔王还是没有神战开启的实感，任夏兮风说破嘴皮子，他们脑袋里首先想的还是那点争权夺利的事。

夏兮风的视线扫过柔萨。只有新任的血族真祖在外神那里吃了大亏，态度一开始就很端正。

柔萨的兄长状况还不错，夏兮风没有最先救下柔萨的兄长，他也没有选择最先把兄长救下。他似乎想先练一练手。

夏兮风拿出一把椅子坐在一旁，控制银月和死亡的神性笼罩着所有被禁锢的人，只需要深渊魔王承受被禁锢者的绝望记忆，唤醒被禁锢者的神智，勾起被禁锢者的自我。

自我之神的神眷者都能使用自我之神的部分力量，虽然他们已经很久没有使用过神眷者的力量，时隔多年再回归神眷者的身份，他们也还算适应。

在使用自我之神的力量时，他们也再次确定，坐在一旁的那个年轻人，确实是他们新的神灵。

或许是承受太多绝望记忆，让他们感性了一些，他们开始担心原本的深渊之主，赐予他们神眷者身份的“主上”。

主上只是将神格让与他人，还是已经……

面对神眷者的背叛，主上是否不再信任任何神眷者？

诸多念头在他们心头翻滚，他们终于开始脱离原本习以为常的思维惯性，开始进入神眷者和深渊守护者的视角思考。

见深渊魔王们没有因受伤而退缩，夏兮风从他们身上收回注意力。

使用了这么久的神格力量，他细细感受身体的变化。

夏兮风很快就发现自身发生了变化。

在刚穿越的时候，他虽然能使用奇特的力量，但并未感觉自己和以前有什么变化。

他使用技能时，无数的知识在脑海中流淌。当他截留了部分知识碎片，将其变成自己的知识，即手工完美制作了物品的时候，变化开始发生。

最初变化太细微，他没有察觉。晋升入传说后，夏兮风才有较为直接的感觉。

随着等级升高，刷成“完美”的技能增加，这种感觉越来越强烈。

夏兮风竖起食指，食指指头先是腾起淡淡的白光，而后淡淡的蓝色光辉镀在了白光外侧。白光膨胀，将蓝色光辉吞入其中；蓝光吞吐，与白色光辉相互交映。

这种力量，最先出现在夏兮风和秦琅第一次进入血月梦境的时候。

血月投影将污染降下，他与秦琅身上腾起白色与蓝色光辉，将血月污染隔绝在外。

之后每一次他们面对外神或者外神爪牙，外神污染都不能侵蚀他们。所以夏兮风才敢徒手切断刺穿辛格的黑线，也才敢让“夜莺”捅他一刀，以伤换伤。

之前夏兮风只是简单粗暴地把其归为系统的防护。晋升为传说后，夏兮风开始思考这种力量的本质。

如今点燃神火，夏兮风终于有一点眉目。

白光和蓝光是两种力量。它给自己的感觉，很像使用自我之神神格时，经由自己的神火所点燃的自我之神神性。

但白光和蓝光的力量比自我之神的神性更纯粹，仿佛层次更高。

如果系统是天父给的，那么这两种力量是天父的神性？

夏兮风仔细体会两种力量。

在他在系统中加点的时候，系统涌动的力量波动和白光相似，但蓝光没有反应。

或许白光确实和系统有关，但蓝光不同，它给自己的感觉更亲切，且只有在外神神性侵蚀神魂的时候，它才会出现。

“不会是老家创世神给的抗污染buff吧？”夏兮风脑洞大开。

他挥了挥手指，手指上光辉散去。

不管这力量哪来的，没害就是了。

以前夏兮风只觉得这力量是隔绝外神污染，当点燃神火的时候，夏兮风有一种古怪的感觉，这两种力量还隔绝了其他东西。

它似乎也隔在自己神魂和身体中，阻碍刚点燃的神火的影响。在自己疯狂练技能的时候，它才会稍稍变弱一些。这时候，他的身体会有一点不舒服，但随即有一种自己真的变强了，而不是“角色”变强了的感觉。

夏兮风长长地舒了口气。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 95: Two Chapters in One (Part 1)

Xia Xifeng was unaware of the new Blood Progenitor’s schemes.

Even if he knew, he wouldn’t have harbored any superfluous thoughts. He had no intention of staying the Lord of the Abyss for long, and Qin Lang undoubtedly felt the same.

Even though his Divine Spark of Self had been repurposed into a power amplifier, Xia Xifeng still felt a lingering distaste for it.

This power amplifier was an experimental concoction forged from his own Divine Spark merged with that of an Outer God; the suffering Qin Lang had endured was merely a single link in the process of refining this "divine artifact."

Although Xia Xifeng could use it, the ultimate ownership still belonged to Qin Lang. When Xia Xifeng drew upon its power, he did not feel any adverse side effects, yet he always suspected that things were likely not so simple for Qin Lang.

Since Qin Lang’s Divine Spark of Self could be unequipped, it could be tossed to someone else later so they could study it thoroughly once they returned.

Even if there were no side effects, Xia Xifeng believed they had no need for such a thing as a Divine Spark anyway.

A Divine Spark represented responsibility. Bound by too many shackles in their original world, they lacked freedom. Having finally earned the capital to enjoy freedom in this realm, aside from maintaining Hope City—a little place they could call home—neither he nor Qin Lang intended to shoulder any more burdens.

As for doing good deeds, that was a hobby, not a duty.

What about the responsibility of saving the world? Wasn't he already just one of the innumerable living beings fighting back against the invaders?

Xia Xifeng took a deep breath and rested for a moment.

With too many stray thoughts cluttering his mind, his mood had inevitably been impacted by the desperate memories of the imprisoned.

However, compared to Lio and Perilla back then, he was doing far better.

Lio and Perilla had experienced that despair from a first-person perspective, making their sense of immersion intensely overwhelming. Likely because Xia Xifeng was fundamentally an outsider whose capacity for empathy was somewhat blunted, he quickly shifted into a third-person perspective—as if he were merely watching several tragic holographic film clips, which did little more than sour his mood.

While Xia Xifeng was resting, he caught the flickering glances of the six Demon Kings and knew immediately what little schemes were brewing in their heads.

"I’ve already tested it. They can be saved; it’s a method tied to the Blood Moon," Xia Xifeng said. "Lio and Perilla, the god-favored of the Sun, have already performed a rescue once. I’ll teach you how to do it."

Xia Xifeng flashed an emotionless smile. "The sun’s god-favored aren't even a fraction of your age. If they can achieve it, you should be able to as well. Although you might be unwilling to pay any price to save your kin, this is a safe opportunity to experience the methods of an evil god firsthand. I still suggest you give it a try."

Xia Xifeng had already rescued the souls in the most precarious conditions from their imprisonment. As for the rest, even if the rescuers were unskillful, it would not result in failure.

If these six Abyssal Demon Kings still had the energy to glare at each other, it meant they were simply too idle. Let them save their own people and protect their own Abyss instead of relying on others for everything.

Xia Xifeng had an exceptionally precise grasp of the abyssal demons' psyche.

They might not be willing to harm themselves for the sake of saving their kin, but the moment they heard they could safely experience the power of an evil god in advance, they would jump at the chance.

Since they were all god-favored, their strength could not possibly be inferior to sun god-favored who were not even a fraction of their age. Since Lio and Perilla hadn't died, they would certainly be fine as well.

And indeed, that proved to be the case.

After Xia Xifeng personally guided them a few times, even the weakest among them—the new Blood Progenitor—could undo the bindings of imprisonment.

It was just that, compared to Xia Xifeng, they were far more severely affected by the memories of despair.

However, after experiencing those desperate memories once, their attitudes straightened out considerably, completely losing any inclination to glare at one another.

Having never personally clashed with the minions of an evil god before, the Abyssal Demon Kings had lacked any real sense of the impending divine war. No matter how much Xia Xifeng talked until his lips were dry, the first things popping into their minds were still those petty power struggles.

Xia Xifeng’s gaze swept over Rosa. Only the new Blood Progenitor had suffered a massive loss at the hands of the Outer God, so his attitude had been serious right from the start.

Rosa’s elder brother was in relatively decent shape. Xia Xifeng had not prioritized saving Rosa’s brother, nor had Rosa chosen to rescue his brother first. It seemed he wanted to practice his skills first.

Xia Xifeng pulled out a chair, sat down off to the side, and controlled the divinities of the Silver Moon and Death to envelop all the imprisoned individuals. All the Abyssal Demon Kings needed to do was endure the memories of despair of the bound, awaken their divine consciousness, and spark their sense of self.

The god-favored of the God of Self could all draw upon a portion of the God of Self's power. Although they had not used their god-favored abilities for a very long time, returning to that identity after so many years was something they adapted to quite well.

As they harnessed the power of the God of Self, they also reaffirmed that the young man sitting nearby was indeed their new deity.

Perhaps enduring so many desperate memories had made them somewhat more emotional; they actually began to worry about the original Lord of the Abyss—their "Lord" who had granted them their status as god-favored.

Had their Lord merely yielded the Divine Spark to another, or had He already...

In the face of His god-favored's betrayal, did their Lord no longer trust any of them?

Countless thoughts swirled in their minds as they finally began to break free from their accustomed inertia, viewing the world through the lens of god-favored and guardians of the Abyss.

Seeing that the Demon Kings showed no sign of flinching due to injury, Xia Xifeng retracted his attention from them.

Having wielded the power of the Divine Spark for so long, he carefully felt the changes within his body.

Xia Xifeng quickly realized that a transformation had taken place within himself.

When he had first transmigrated, though he could utilize strange powers, he had not felt any different from his former self.

Whenever he activated a skill, endless streams of knowledge would flow through his mind. When he intercepted fragments of that knowledge and made them his own—such as when he crafted items of perfect quality by hand—the changes began to occur.

At first, the transformation was so subtle that he failed to notice it. It was only after he ascended to the Legendary realm that Xia Xifeng gained a more direct sensation of it.

As his level rose and the number of skills maxed out to "Perfect" increased, this sensation grew increasingly pronounced.

Xia Xifeng raised his index finger. A faint white light first welled up at the tip, followed by a soft blue glow coating the outer layer of the white light. The white light expanded, swallowing the blue glow into itself; the blue light flickered, interweaving with the white luminescence in mutual radiance.

This kind of power had first manifested when Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang entered the Blood Moon dreamscape for the very first time.

When the projection of the Blood Moon rained down corruption, white and blue luminescence had surged from both his and Qin Lang’s bodies, walling off the Blood Moon’s corruption.

Afterward, every single time they faced Outer Gods or their minions, the Outer Gods' corruption could never erode them. That was precisely why Xia Xifeng had dared to sever the black threads piercing Singh with his bare hands, and why he had dared to let "Nightingale" stab him to trade injury for injury.

Previously, Xia Xifeng had simply and crudely attributed it to the system’s protection. But after ascending to Legendary, Xia Xifeng began to contemplate the true nature of this power.

Now that he had ignited his divine fire, Xia Xifeng finally gained a slight inkling.

The white light and blue light were two distinct forms of power. The sensation they gave him was remarkably similar to the divine nature of Self ignited by his own divine fire when utilizing the Divine Spark of Self.

Yet, the power of the white and blue lights was even purer than the divinity of the God of Self, as if existing on a higher plane.

If the system was granted by the Heavenly Father, could these two powers be the divine nature of the Heavenly Father Himself?

Xia Xifeng meticulously analyzed the two forces.

When he allocated points within the system, the surges of power from the system were similar to the white light, but the blue light showed no reaction whatsoever.

Perhaps the white light was indeed connected to the system, but the blue light was different—it felt far more intimate to him, and it would only manifest when the divinity of an Outer God attempted to erode his divine soul.

"It couldn't be a anti-pollution buff granted by the Creator God of our home world, could it?" Xia Xifeng let his imagination run wild.

He waved his finger, and the radiance on his tip dispersed.

Regardless of where this power came from, at least it was harmless.

Before, Xia Xifeng had thought this power was merely meant to block out Outer God corruption. But the moment his divine fire ignited, a strange feeling washed over him—these two forces were also walling off something else.

It seemed to stand between his divine soul and his physical body, hindering the influence of the newly ignited divine fire. Only when he frantically leveled up his skills would it weaken slightly. During those moments, his body would feel a fleeting sense of discomfort, immediately followed by the genuine feeling that *he* was growing stronger, rather than just the "character."

Xia Xifeng let out a long, deep sigh of relief.

chunks.chineseText:
等秦琅和自我之神打完，他和秦琅讨论一下。如果秦琅的感觉和自己一样，那就不是自己的错觉。

或许，他们确实在真正掌握力量中。

控制银月和死亡神性的是夏兮风，所以他其实很累，除了思考，也做不了其他事。

所幸深渊魔王在熟练之后，解救被禁锢者的速度还算快。不到半日时间，所有被禁锢者的灵魂都被解放。

让夏兮风感到欣慰的是，就算呼唤的效果不是很好，但被禁锢者中还未死亡的人，全部都坚强地活了下来，没有在被解除禁锢时死亡。

生存是本能，也是所有生灵刻在灵魂之中最深刻的欲/望。血月给予他们的绝望，没有压过他们求生的欲/望。

不过依照本能活下来，也可能神智疯狂。这些人最难得的是，他们都还保持着清醒，并没有陷入癫狂。

夏兮风感受了一下，这些人有的和自我神格有共鸣，有的和死亡、银月的神性有共鸣——深渊之中，也是可能出现其他神灵的神眷者的。

看来血月挑选“祭品”的眼光一如既往的好。祂这是又截胡了神眷者好苗子呢。

从血月残害中死里逃生的人，肯定会成为对抗邪神最精锐的战士。不过组建兵团、带着人打架这种事，夏兮风就不勉强自己了，等秦琅得空再说吧。

反正外神已经来深渊很久了，不差这点时间。

不过夏兮风不怀好意地扫了深渊魔王——自我之神的五个神眷者一眼。

现在他和秦琅掌握着自我神格，便有更换神眷者的权力。如果深渊魔王不想履行神眷者的职责，这群被救出来的人中选个神眷者也不错。

看看他们的精气神，确实比几个老家伙强些。

等秦琅打完，和秦琅商量后再说吧。

夏兮风瞅了一眼秦琅的面板。

秦琅的血量很正常，身上也没有太多奇奇怪怪的buff。

“人救了，神战局势也已经告知你们了，我先回去了。”被救下来的活人向夏兮风单膝跪下表示忠诚和感激，夏兮风随意摆摆手，让跪下的人站起来，没有接受他们的忠诚，“放心，我会把灵魂安全地送到死亡之神面前。”

夏兮风收起椅子，准备离开时，深渊魔王焦急道：“您就要离开了吗？”

体会了外神的力量，深渊魔王终于有点紧张感了。

他们从被残害的同族的记忆中，看到了邪神的诡谲。已经许久没有与同层次，甚至更高层次的敌人战斗过，深渊魔王们有点心虚。

即使他们仍旧不太认可突然就成为深渊之主的年轻人类，但深渊没有深渊之主带领的时候就是一盘散沙，他们谁也不敢信任谁，还是有个名义上的统领会更好。

夏兮风看着他们的挽留，笑了。

机会难得，他再次为自我之神造谣。

“对应自我之神的那位邪神，已经被自我之神斩落。自我之神因此身受重伤，被神眷者背叛，又为寻求地面援军，自愿剥离神格，步入连死亡都不敢期盼的虚无。地面上的人已经举起屠神的旗帜，深渊威胁已经解决大半，我想你们应该能自救。”夏兮风微笑道。

说完，夏兮风也不等人辩解便启动了传送石。

夏兮风的身影消失时，轻飘飘落下许多句话。

“太阳的神眷者为了拯救太阳，从时空中抹掉了自己的存在；银月的神眷者为了拯救银月，历经无数次死亡轮回而不悔；大海的神眷者为了拯救大海，以身替代大海的消亡……”

“深渊之主为了深渊步入虚无，却遭遇了神眷者的背叛。剩余的神眷者还在希求新任的自我之神再为他们拼搏一把。”

“真不愧是深渊啊。”

“我仍是那句疑问，当你们感知到深渊之主陨落时，是会为他流下一滴真挚的眼泪，还是抱怨祂太弱小，不能把所有危险都挡在你们之前？”

“我与你们同行这么久，没有一个人询问我如何救一救你们的神啊。”

“深渊之主啊，你的牺牲值得吗？”

夏兮风的身影出现在试炼战场边缘。

死亡之神那张僵硬如雕塑的脸上，露出了点尴尬的表情：“自我有点生气。”

夏兮风就知道自我之神一定在偷窥自己，乐道：“你说我如果写个死亡之神的传记，把‘深渊之主啊，你的牺牲值得吗’写在封面上如何？”

死亡之神思考自己的挚友会不会被气活。

自我之神所有谋划都有祂参与，祂自然知道挚友的牺牲只是基于神灵的自尊和责任，和深渊居民们没关系。神眷者的背叛也是祂的纵容和……引诱，最初血月其实没想找上深渊。

自我之神猜测，外神之间也有竞争。祂将母巢和血月引入深渊，减弱了“自我”对应的外神的力量，才能将其吞噬。

“祂不愿意也没办法，一死万事消，谁也管不到自己的身后名。”夏兮风站在战场边缘，抱着手臂大喊，“你说是不是啊，自我之神！我现在就开始写你的传记，在你死之前给你看初版草稿！”

夏兮风看见秦琅的血条在自己喊出声后瞬间下降一小半。

他立刻给秦琅加血，并给秦琅发消息。

【夏兮风：自我之神恼羞成怒了？

秦琅：没关系，你可以继续骂。

夏兮风：我这是夸祂善啊，怎么能叫骂？

秦琅：嗯，你继续夸。】

夏兮风得意扬扬。秦琅果然很赞同他。

死亡之神往旁边挪动了一步。

祂在思考一个很严肃的问题。自己也算坑了这位小先知，小先知会不会也给自己写个什么传记？

应该……不会吧？

夏兮风还真打算写。他准备造谣死亡之神和自我之神的爱恨情仇生离死别的伟大爱情，给祂们来个十世轮回相爱相杀。

伟大的神灵，应该不会在意别人给祂编爱情小花边故事吧？

看看每个教的圣典，不比花边小故事羞耻？就这么愉快地决定了！

“进化和智慧的试炼能改变时间流速，这里不可以吗？”夏兮风恶心完自我之神后，开始说正事。

死亡之神道：“可以，最高可以十倍流速。但一旦开启时间法阵，在自我之神消逝之前，空间都不会打开，你们不知道会被困多少年。祂让我等你们开口。”

夏兮风没好气道：“就算等我们开口，也该先告知我们，而不是我们去问。假如我不知道有时间加速这件事呢？”

死亡之神想了想，点头：“你说得对，是我忽视了。”

夏兮风：“……”死亡之神道歉太诚恳，让他怪不适应的。

【夏兮风：改变时间流速吗？最高十倍流速。改变后，你杀了自我之神前咱们出不去，可能会错过很多事。

秦琅：开。

夏兮风：我也是这么想的。末日马上要到来，我们现在的实力能掺和的事，不需要我们也能做；等末日到来，我们俩已经在外神那里挂了号，实力说不定连自保都不够了。

Chapter 95: Two Chapters in One (Part 2)

Once Qin Lang finished fighting the God of Self, he would discuss it with him. If Qin Lang’s experience mirrored his own, then it wasn't merely his imagination.

Perhaps they were truly coming into genuine possession of this power.

Controlling the divinities of the Silver Moon and Death was Xia Xifeng’s task, which left him thoroughly exhausted. Aside from thinking, he could do little else.

Fortunately, once the Demon Kings grew proficient, their speed in rescuing the imprisoned was fairly swift. In less than half a day, all the bound souls had been liberated.

What brought Xia Xifeng relief was that even if the effect of the awakening calls was mediocre, every single imprisoned person who had not yet perished managed to cling to life tenaciously, none succumbing to death upon being freed from their chains.

Survival was an instinct, the deepest desire etched into the soul of every living being. The despair wrought by the Blood Moon had failed to overpower their will to live.

Yet, surviving on mere instinct could easily drive one insane. What was most remarkable about these survivors was that every one of them retained their sanity, without a single soul descending into madness.

Xia Xifeng sensed their conditions briefy. Some resonated with the Divine Spark of Self, while others resonated with the divinity of Death or the Silver Moon—even within the depths of the Abyss, god-favored of other deities could still emerge.

It appeared the Blood Moon’s taste in selecting "sacrifices" remained as sharp as ever; It had intercepted yet another batch of prime candidates for god-favored.

Those who narrowly escaped the Blood Moon's atrocities would undoubtedly become the most elite warriors against the evil gods. However, when it came to assembling armies and leading troops into battle, Xia Xifeng wasn't about to force himself. He would leave that for Qin Lang to deal with once he had free time.

At any rate, the Outer Gods had been creeping into the Abyss for a long time; a little extra time wouldn't make a difference.

Still, Xia Xifeng cast a malevolent glare toward the five Demon Kings—the five god-favored of the God of Self.

Now that he and Qin Lang possessed the Divine Spark of Self, they held the authority to replace god-favored. If the Abyssal Demon Kings proved unwilling to fulfill their duties, picking new god-favored from among these rescued survivors would be a fine alternative.

Looking at their mental fortitude, they were indeed far superior to those old fogies.

He would decide after Qin Lang finished his fight and they had a chance to talk it over.

Xia Xifeng glanced at Qin Lang’s status panel.

Qin Lang’s health was completely stable, and there weren't many strange debuffs cluttering his status.

"The people have been saved, and the state of the divine war has been explained to you. I’m heading back first." The rescued survivors dropped to one knee before Xia Xifeng to express their loyalty and gratitude. Xia Xifeng casually waved a hand, motioning for them to stand without accepting their allegiance. "Rest assured, I will deliver these souls safely before the God of Death."

As Xia Xifeng stowed his chair and prepared to depart, the Demon Kings called out anxiously, "Are you leaving already?"

Having experienced the power of the Outer Gods firsthand, the Demon Kings finally felt a sense of urgency.

Through the memories of their slaughtered kin, they had witnessed the treacherous cunning of the evil god. Having not fought enemies of the same tier—let alone higher tiers—for a very long time, the Demon Kings were feeling somewhat faint-hearted.

Even if they still found it difficult to accept a young human who had suddenly become the Lord of the Abyss, the Abyss without a leader was nothing more than a heap of loose sand. None of them dared to trust one another, so having a nominal leader was vastly preferable.

Xia Xifeng looked at their desperate attempts to stall him and smiled.

Since the opportunity was rare, he decided to spread another rumor about the God of Self.

"The evil god corresponding to the God of Self has already been slain by Him. Because of this, the God of Self suffered catastrophic injuries. Betrayed by His god-favored, and seeking reinforcements from the surface, He willingly stripped Himself of His Divine Spark and stepped into a void where even death cannot be hoped for. The people on the surface have already raised the banner of god-slaying, and the threat to the Abyss has been largely resolved. I trust you are capable of saving yourselves," Xia Xifeng said with a gentle smile.

Without waiting for anyone to offer a counterargument, Xia Xifeng activated a Teleportation Stone.

As Xia Xifeng’s figure vanished, a volley of faint, parting words drifted down:

"To save the Sun, the god-favored of the Sun erased his own existence from space and time; to save the Silver Moon, the god-favored of the Silver Moon braved endless cycles of death without regret; to save the Ocean, the god-favored of the Ocean took the decay of the sea upon his own body..."

"The Lord of the Abyss stepped into the void for the sake of the Abyss, only to meet with the betrayal of His god-favored. And the remaining god-favored still beg the new God of Self to fight another round for their sakes."

"As expected of the Abyss."

"I leave you with the same question: when you perceive the demise of the Lord of the Abyss, will you shed a single genuine tear for Him, or will you merely complain that He was too weak to shield you from every danger?"

"I have walked alongside you for so long, yet not a single one of you has asked me how to save your God."

"O Lord of the Abyss... was your sacrifice truly worth it?"

***

Xia Xifeng’s figure reappeared at the edge of the Trial Battlefield.

Across from him, the God of Death’s face—as stiff and rigid as a stone sculpture—wore a faint trace of awkwardness. "Self is... a bit angry."

Xia Xifeng knew the God of Self had to be secretly spying on him, and chuckled merrily. "What do you think if I wrote a biography for the God of Death, and put 'O Lord of the Abyss, was your sacrifice truly worth it?' right on the cover?"

The God of Death seriously pondered whether His dear friend would be infuriated back to life.

Every single one of the God of Self's schemes had involved His participation. Naturally, He knew that His friend’s sacrifice was rooted purely in a deity's pride and duty, having nothing to do with the denizens of the Abyss. The betrayal of the god-favored had also been met with His tacit approval and... temptation. Originally, the Blood Moon had not even intended to target the Abyss.

The God of Self had deduced that competition existed among the Outer Gods as well. By luring both the Broodmother and the Blood Moon into the Abyss, He had weakened the power of the Outer God corresponding to "Self," thereby enabling Himself to devour it.

"He can't do anything about it even if He's unwilling. Death ends all things; no one can control their reputation after they're gone," Xia Xifeng stood at the edge of the battlefield, crossing his arms and shouting at the top of his lungs, "Isn't that right, God of Self?! I’m starting to write your biography right now, and I’ll show you the first draft before you kick the bucket!"

Xia Xifeng watched as Qin Lang’s health bar instantly plunged by nearly half the moment he shouted those words.

He immediately cast a heal on Qin Lang and fired off a message.

[Xia Xifeng: Did the God of Self fly into a rage out of humiliation?

Qin Lang: Doesn't matter, you can keep scolding Him.

Xia Xifeng: I'm praising His benevolence! How can you call it scolding?

Qin Lang: Mm, keep praising Him then.]

Xia Xifeng felt immensely pleased with himself. Qin Lang truly agreed with him.

The God of Death shuffled a step to the side.

He was contemplating a deeply serious question. Considering He had technically played a part in pulling a fast one on this little Prophet, would the little Prophet write some kind of biography about Him as well?

Surely... He wouldn't, right?

Xia Xifeng genuinely intended to write it. He was planning to fabricate a grand, tragic romance of love, hatred, and tearful partings between the God of Death and the God of Self, giving them a dramatic saga of ten reincarnated lives of loving and killing each other.

A great and mighty deity surely wouldn't mind someone inventing a few romantic gossip stories about Him, right?

Just look at the holy scriptures of every religion—aren't those far more embarrassing than some gossip tales? Settled then!

"The Trial of Evolution and Wisdom can alter the flow of time. Can it not be done here?" Having thoroughly disgusted the God of Self, Xia Xifeng turned his attention to serious matters.

The God of Death replied, "It can. At most, a tenfold flow of time. However, once the temporal array is activated, the spatial barrier will not open until the God of Self completely perishes. You will not know how many years you'll be trapped inside. He asked me to wait for you two to speak up."

Xia Xifeng said testily, "Even if you were waiting for us to ask, you should have informed us beforehand instead of waiting for us to bring it up. What if I didn't know time acceleration was an option?"

The God of Death thought it over, then nodded. "You are right. It was my oversight."

Xia Xifeng: "..." The God of Death’s apology was so sincere that it actually made him feel profoundly uncomfortable.

[Xia Xifeng: Should we alter the flow of time? Up to tenfold speed. But once it's changed, we won't be able to leave until you slay the God of Self, and we might miss out on a lot of things outside.

Qin Lang: Turn it on.

Xia Xifeng: I was thinking the same thing. The apocalypse is right around the corner. With our current strength, the affairs we could meddle in don't strictly require us anyway; by the time the apocalypse descends, both of us will already be blacklisted by the Outer Gods. Our strength might not even be enough for self-preservation by then.

chunks.chineseText:
夏兮风：虽然我还知道一些末日前的外神袭击事件，但神灵已经提前与外神开战，不需要我提醒，他们也会警惕了。我们留在这里也没关系。那就同意了啰？

秦琅：我已经回答过了。

夏兮风：再回答一次你会死吗！说一个字比说一句话更累吗？！】

秦琅仍旧轻而易举地挑起了夏兮风莫名其妙的怒火，夏兮风骂了秦琅几句后，才对死亡之神说：“开启时间法阵后，又不能和外界沟通了吧？我先和苏尔老师说一声。”

他发现来到这里，已经拉的系统群还能用，仍旧可以和四星好友们联系。

不过时间流速不同后，系统群理应不能用了。

死亡之神点头。

夏兮风在群里通知了一声。

苏尔老师让夏兮风不用担心，他会盯着外神。

莱欧在哀嚎，等下次见面，夏兮风和秦琅都登神了，太可怕了。佩瑞拉附和。

戴蒙崩溃，嚎着自己要篡了夏兮风和秦琅城主的位置。

夏兮风和老师、友人们嘻嘻哈哈了几句，关闭了群聊：“我需要许多材料练手。既然自我之神把神格都给我们了，他的宝库也一样吧？堂堂深渊之主应该不穷吧？”

死亡之神道：“等自我陨落之后，你们才能继承祂的宝库。不过你需要什么就告诉我，我给你。”

夏兮风本想狮子大开口，但他看着死亡之神木然的脸，别开了视线：“我只会取需要的。”

在死亡之神提起自我之神陨落时，虽然神情仍旧木然如雕塑，眼中却沉淀着浓厚的悲伤。

夏兮风本来很气死亡之神这个帮凶，但比起自我之神坦然以自身陨落为算计，所以祂死得其所，不会悲伤后悔，死亡之神应该和自我之神是朋友，祂应该是会为离别悲伤的。

即使这是友人的愿望，所以祂协助了友人，但“再见”变成“再也不见”，不可能不悲伤。

同样有不愿离别的友人的夏兮风，突然就说不出刺激死亡之神的话了。

死亡之神开启了时间法阵。

时间法阵开启十倍流速，其核心是自我之神自己。只要自我之神没有消亡，法阵不灭。

夏兮风找了一把最舒服的椅子，拿出了一堆的材料，开始刷技能。

点燃神火之后，他确实感觉到了与凡人时不同——这么久了，他都没有饥饿，也没有困意。

夏兮风操控神火，开始刷技能熟练度。

如果他什么都不做，甚至连疲惫都感受不到；刷技能刷得疲惫后，闭目冥想一会儿就能恢复精神。

材料堆减少，制作的各种物品增加。

夏兮风全神贯注地沉浸在系统灌输给他的知识中，神火上隐约浮现的白光和蓝光越来越少。神火显现出黑金色的璀璨光辉。

战场上，秦琅的双剑燃起了火焰。

他的火焰也是黑金色，只是夏兮风的神火金色更多，而他的火焰以黑色为主，只有掺杂着些许金尘。

自我之神神情唏嘘。

秦琅如果是这个世界的本土居民，即使没有任何神眷，他也一定能点燃神火。

而夏兮风，哦，他这种性格和天赋，定是会被神灵注视和宠爱的，所以不可能没有神眷。

天父寻求外援的眼光真是好，一定也付出了不少代价。

祂很好奇秦琅和夏兮风所在的世界，很想和友人去旅行。

死之前告知友人一声，等世界危机结束后，让友人替自己去看一眼，满足自己的好奇心吧。

想必友人经历这场危机，定是能到脱离这个世界的层次。

可惜，祂无法再与友人同游了。

自我之神的攻击越发凌厉，一往无前，毫无动摇。

秦琅身上多了许多伤口，每当他来不及喝血药的时候，全神贯注制作物品的夏兮风如同条件反射似的，立刻就把他的血补满。

渐渐地，不知道过了多久没有停歇的战斗，秦琅来不及加血的时间越来越少。他再次只靠着神格的回血，便能抵御自我之神的攻击了。

下界，深渊中。

夏兮风撂下讽刺的话后便离开，深渊之中再也寻不到他的气息。

深渊魔王们心里憋屈，想骂人。

刚被救出来的深渊恶魔也很难受。

深渊神眷者们不询问深渊之主的状态，只是没想过深渊之主会为他们陨落，也对夏兮风口中“为深渊牺牲的自我之神”这种奇怪的话没有实感。

说白了，他们半信半疑，或者根本没信。

突然来个陌生人说什么深渊之神为你们死了，怎么想都很奇怪，不可能立刻相信吧？

所以当深渊之中或取乐、或厮杀、或无所事事的恶魔们心中突然一恸时，深渊魔王也从心底感到莫大的悲伤时，他们才怔然，相信了夏兮风的话。

既然是完全遵循内心的恶魔，那么内心悲恸时，或许也会遵循本心流下眼泪吧。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 95: Two Chapters in One (Part 3)

[Xia Xifeng: Although I still know about a few pre-apocalyptic Outer God attack incidents, the gods have already engaged the Outer Gods ahead of schedule. They'll be on guard even without my warnings. It won't hurt for us to stay here. So, we're agreeing to it then?

Qin Lang: I already gave my answer.

Xia Xifeng: Would it kill you to answer one more time?! Is saying one word really more tiring than saying a whole sentence?!]

Qin Lang still managed to effortlessly ignite Xia Xifeng’s inexplicable irritation. Only after hurling a few scoldings at Qin Lang did Xia Xifeng turn to the God of Death and say, "Once the temporal array is activated, we won't be able to communicate with the outside world again, right? Let me inform Master Sol first."

He discovered that the system group chat he had created earlier was still functional, allowing him to stay in touch with his four-star friends.

However, once the flow of time diverged, the system chat logically shouldn't work anymore.

The God of Death nodded.

Xia Xifeng sent a quick notification in the group.

Master Sol told Xia Xifeng not to worry; he would keep a close eye on the Outer Gods.

Lio wailed in despair, lamenting how terrifying it was that by the time they met again, both Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang would have ascended to godhood. Perilla chimed in to agree.

Damon suffered a mental breakdown, howling that he was going to usurp Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang’s positions as City Lords.

After bantering and laughing with his teacher and friends for a few moments, Xia Xifeng closed the chat. "I’ll need plenty of materials to practice my crafting skills. Since the God of Self gave us His Divine Spark, His treasury should be included too, right? A grand Lord of the Abyss shouldn't be broke, should He?"

The God of Death said, "Only after Self has perished will you be able to inherit His treasury. However, tell me whatever you need, and I shall grant it to you."

Xia Xifeng had originally intended to demand astronomical amounts, but looking at the God of Death’s expressionless face, he averted his gaze. "I'll only take what I need."

When the God of Death mentioned the demise of the God of Self, although His face remained as wood-carved and impassive as ever, a deep, heavy grief was settled within His eyes.

Xia Xifeng had originally been furious at the God of Death for being an accomplice. Yet, unlike the God of Self—who calmly used His own downfall as a calculated gambit, died for a worthy cause, and thus felt neither grief nor regret—the God of Death was His friend. He was bound to feel sorrow over such a parting.

Even if this was His friend's wish and He had merely assisted Him in fulfilling it, when "goodbye" turned into "farewell forever," it was impossible not to feel heartbroken.

Possessing a friend whom he likewise refused to part with, Xia Xifeng suddenly found himself unable to utter another word that might wound the God of Death.

The God of Death activated the temporal array.

The temporal array ran at ten times the normal speed of time, anchored at its core by the God of Self Himself. So long as the God of Self did not perish, the array would never break.

Xia Xifeng found the most comfortable chair available, pulled out a massive mountain of materials, and began grinding his skills.

After igniting his divine fire, he truly felt the stark difference from his mortal days—throughout such a long period, he felt neither hunger nor exhaustion.

Controlling his divine fire, Xia Xifeng began grinding his skill proficiencies.

If he did nothing, he wouldn't even feel the slightest trace of fatigue; when he grew mentally drained from grinding skills, closing his eyes to meditate for a short while was enough to completely restore his spirit.

The pile of materials dwindled as the number of crafted items multiplied.

Xia Xifeng threw himself wholeheartedly into the vast knowledge instilled by the system, and the faint white and blue light flickering over his divine fire gradually receded. In its place, the divine fire radiated a brilliant, resplendent black-gold light.

***

On the battlefield, dual swords flared with fire in Qin Lang’s hands.

His flames were also black-gold, except Xia Xifeng’s divine fire carried far more gold, whereas Qin Lang’s flames were predominantly black, laced only with a delicate dust of gold.

The God of Self watched with an expression of profound emotion.

Had Qin Lang been a native inhabitant of this world, he undoubtedly would have ignited his divine fire even without receiving a single divine favor.

As for Xia Xifeng... ah, a temperament and talent such as his were destined to be watched over and doted upon by gods, making it impossible for him to exist without divine favor.

The Heavenly Father’s eye for recruiting external help was exceptional indeed; He must have paid quite a heavy price for it.

He was immensely curious about the world Qin Lang and Xia Xifeng hailed from, and desperately wished He could travel there alongside His dear friend.

Before dying, He would tell His friend—once the crisis of this world concluded, He would let His friend go take a look on His behalf to satisfy His curiosity.

Surely, after enduring this ordeal, His friend would attain a level capable of transcending this realm.

Regrettably, He would no longer be able to journey together with His friend.

The God of Self’s attacks grew increasingly fierce, unyielding and relentless, driving forward without a shred of hesitation.

Wounds multiplied across Qin Lang’s body. Whenever he lacked the time to chug a health potion, Xia Xifeng—who was fully immersed in crafting items—would instantly top off his health as if by sheer muscle memory.

Gradually, after a stretch of battle so long that time itself lost all meaning, the moments where Qin Lang lacked time to heal grew fewer and fewer. Once again, relying solely on the passive health regeneration of the Divine Spark was enough for him to withstand the God of Self’s ferocious onslaught.

***

Down below, within the Abyss.

After leaving behind those sharp, mocking remarks, Xia Xifeng had departed, his presence vanishing entirely from the realm.

The Abyssal Demon Kings felt an intense suffocation in their chests, desperate to curse aloud.

The demonic survivors who had just been rescued felt equally miserable.

The god-favored of the Abyss had never inquired about the status of the Lord of the Abyss simply because they had never imagined the Lord of the Abyss would perish for their sakes, nor could they feel any sense of reality toward Xia Xifeng’s strange words regarding "the God of Self who sacrificed Himself for the Abyss."

To put it bluntly, they had been half-doubting, if not entirely skeptical.

When a complete stranger suddenly showed up and declared that the God of the Abyss had died for them, it sounded bizarre no matter how one looked at it. How could anyone believe it immediately?

And so, when the demons across the Abyss—whether engaged in pleasure, slaughter, or idle wandering—felt a sudden, agonizing pang in their hearts, and when the Abyssal Demon Kings were gripped by a immense sorrow from the depths of their souls, they froze in stunned realization, finally believing Xia Xifeng’s words.

Since they were demons who acted entirely upon the desires of their hearts, perhaps when their hearts were stricken with profound grief, they would also obey their true natures... and shed genuine tears.

第96章 二更合一

神战已经开启了三四年。

对于普通人而言，神战和普通战火没有太大区别。

同样是凡人间的厮杀，同样是千奇百怪的魔兽的攻击，大部分普通人并不能理解各种力量之间的差别，也不能分辨各种魔兽的不同，在他们眼中，遍燃战火的世界很危险，但并未感到如同天翻地覆的变化。

有些人没有生活在战火范围中。神战对他们来说更只是一个新奇的故事，他们的生活仍旧是充斥着鸡毛蒜皮烦恼的平静而普通的生活。

直到有一天，太阳碎裂。

在某一个平平无奇的白日，阴影投向地面，仿佛乌云遮掩住了天空。

一些人抬头看天，嘀咕着是不是要下雨，却没看到乌云。

他们看见，太阳变暗淡了。

诞生之日表面蒙上了一层阴影，而希望之日，它之上遍布裂纹，就像是摔碎的镜子。

咔嚓。

太阳离地面很遥远，地上的人们本不该听见太阳碎裂的声音，但声音却像是直接在他们脑海中响起，每一条裂纹增加时，刺耳的声音便如此响亮。

咔嚓，咔嚓，咔嚓。

有一片太阳落下，白日中居然出现了肉眼可见的流星。

人们惊恐地尖叫，战士们握紧了手中的武器，魔法师们站在塔顶，担忧地望着太阳。

这时，整个梦世界都发生了地震。

虽然只是轻微的颤抖，但这种颤抖，所有人都能清楚地感受到。

沉睡许久的苏尔醒来，走到了庭院中。

阿穆若正站在庭院中抬头望天。

“末世降临了。”苏尔道。

阿穆若伸手揽过苏尔的肩头：“别担忧，我们定能走出末世。”

苏尔勉强挤出一个笑容：“嗯。我不担忧我们不能胜利，只是……”

只是……在末世之中，会有多少生灵湮灭呢？

希望之城的太阳祭坛上，莱欧和佩瑞拉手牵着手，也仰头看天中。

佩瑞拉神情悲伤又愤怒，牙齿紧咬，眼泪不能抑制地沾湿了面容。

他的神灵，希望之日，正在碎裂。

莱欧的表情还算好，他安慰道：“别哭了，不是早几年就知道希望之日重伤了吗？现在只是祂的伤势能被观察到了而已。至少祂在最后关头发现自己快死了，现在应该能剩下一小点，死不了。”

佩瑞拉悲愤的神情一滞，狠狠瞪了莱欧一眼。

莱欧感到头上有熟悉的神性波动，忙大喊：“你能不能省点力气？都濒死了，这时候还要乱来吗？！”

他头上的神性波动散去。

佩瑞拉彻底哭不出来了。

如果你的神灵已经濒死，还要执着地降下力量烧你的小伙伴的头发，你也哭不出来。

两位半身人一边继续用祭坛沟通太阳，用太阳信徒的信仰延缓太阳的碎裂和黯淡，并窃窃私语。

“风和琅都失踪快一年了。”

“不是失踪，是试炼。”

“他们该回来了吧？都末日了。”

“不知道。”

“唉，好想念琅的蜂蜜小蛋糕。”

“有点。”

“你只是有点的话，等琅回来，你的蜂蜜小蛋糕给我吃。”

“滚！”

太阳信徒悲伤地跪在地上，虔诚地祈祷，根本不知道两位神眷者嘴里念叨的不是和他们一样的祈祷。

重建的海神殿中，辛格手持三叉戟，闭目坐在海神的神像下。

如果夏兮风和秦琅在这里，会发现他的姿态和在副本中见到的辛格一模一样。

海神将大海的权柄向辛格分享，辛格虽然没有点燃神火，也能替海神观测海面。

今日一个极其普通的时间，只一瞬间，大海便毫无征兆地被染黑了大半，只有亚特兰蒂斯王国和海神殿附近的海面还保持着湛蓝，更远处的岛屿国家已经全部失去了联系。

曾经遭遇重创，这几年恢复了一点元气的海神殿派出船队，在湛蓝海面和黑暗海面的交界处等候逃难而来的同胞们，目前还没发现任何逃亡而来的船只。

还好，地面上的水流，尚且没有被黑潮污染。或许能走陆路，从海岸旁来检测黑色大海的情况。

辛格再次在心底过了一遍早就整理了无数次的计划，松了口气。

目前的情况，在预想中算是好的了。

他在心底呼唤神灵：【吾主，你的情况还好吗？】

海神很快回应：【比希望之日那个大傻子好，哈哈哈！祂才是碎得只剩下一小点了！】

辛格嘴角抽搐。

“祂才是碎得只剩下一小点”……这句话很明显是对应夏兮风几年前的嘀咕。

这句话，他的神灵居然记了好几年。

但你只比希望之日好一点，你还很骄傲吗？！

莫名被甩了“海神”的锅，快要点燃神火，晋升为半神的辛格心很累。

他相信正被关在试炼之地，一头雾水被自我之神塞了神格的秦琅和夏兮风一定能体会他的心情。

辛格：【吾主，自我之神的神域仍旧关闭着吗？】

海神：【仍旧关闭，但我能感觉到，自我之神已经陨落。虽然自我之神的神格仍旧存在，但并没有新的自我之神诞生的气息，很奇怪。真不知道自我之神找死的时候干了什么，好好奇。】

辛格：【请你停止好奇。】

自我之神陨落，那秦琅和夏兮风应该已经脱离了试炼之地。辛格刚松了口气，就听见他的神灵对自我之神的作死很好奇，心立刻提了起来。

他的神灵已经够作死了，可不能学得更坏。

海神感觉到了他不承认自己是神眷者的神眷者，那令人愤怒的侮辱，即使力量已经很微弱了，也努力给辛格头上浇了一瓢水。

辛格捋了捋湿漉漉的头发，咬紧牙关。

看在吾主重伤的份上，我忍！

在一旁为镇压大海异象的辛格护法的里乔悄悄往阴影中挪动。

可不能让神灵记起自己。他还是当个没存在感的神眷者更好。

银月城中，银月祭典正在举行；

人类帝都中，皇帝召唤出了祖先庇佑附身；

精灵帝都中，世界树的守卫正在宣誓复仇；

矮人王国中，矮人王手持巨斧，盯着沸腾的岩浆如临大敌；

而在世界的边缘，人们时隔千百年，再一次看到了巨龙腾空。

咔嚓。

最后一声。

太阳如击碎的明镜般崩裂，仅剩一点不规则的碎片，悬挂在天空之中。

诞生之日靠近希望之日，光芒将完全没有了太阳模样的希望之日笼罩，仿佛是希望之日护在羽翼下。

地上的生灵心头涌出极大的恐慌，无知的孩童莫名啼哭。

他们什么都不知道，却都有一种前路黯淡的绝望从心头涌出。

占星台上的魔法师和术士们捂住了眼睛，血液从指缝中溢出。

星光大乱，他们看不见未来了，仿佛这个世界的未来之路已经被截断。

天空的异象停止，地面的震动越来越大。

几年前落在地面的小树发出了耀眼的光芒，小树附近的地面停止了震动。

但在小树光芒之外，地面上污泥翻滚，吞噬了草木、石头、动物……地面上所有的一切都被污泥覆盖。

Chapter 96: Two Chapters Combined (Part 1)

The Divine War had been raging for three or four years.

For ordinary people, the Divine War was not much different from ordinary warfare.

It was still the same slaughter between mortals, the same attacks by bizarre and monstrous beasts. Most commoners could not comprehend the differences between various powers, nor could they distinguish between the types of beasts. In their eyes, a world engulfed in flames was dangerous, but they did not feel as if the world had been turned upside down.

Some lived outside the reach of the war. For them, the Divine War was merely a novel story; their lives remained peaceful and ordinary, filled with trivial, everyday worries.

Until one day, the sun shattered.

On a perfectly ordinary day, a shadow cast itself upon the ground, as if dark clouds were obscuring the sky.

Some people looked up, muttering about whether it was going to rain, but they saw no clouds.

They saw the sun dimming.

The surface of the Sun of Birth was veiled in a layer of shadow, while the Sun of Hope was covered in cracks, like a shattered mirror.

*Crack.*

The sun was far from the ground; the people below should not have been able to hear it breaking, yet the sound resonated directly within their minds. Every time a new crack appeared, the piercing noise grew louder.

*Crack, crack, crack.*

A piece of the sun fell, and in the middle of the day, visible meteors appeared.

People screamed in terror, warriors gripped their weapons tightly, and mages stood atop their towers, watching the sun with anxiety.

At that moment, an earthquake shook the entire Dream World.

Though it was only a slight tremor, everyone could feel it clearly.

Su Er, who had been sleeping for a long time, woke up and walked into the courtyard.

Amuro was standing in the courtyard, looking up at the sky.

"The apocalypse has arrived," Su Er said.

Amuro reached out and pulled Su Er into his arms. "Do not worry. We will surely survive the apocalypse."

Su Er forced a smile. "Mm. I am not worried that we won't win, it's just..."

It's just... in this apocalypse, how many souls will be annihilated?

On the Sun Altar in the City of Hope, Leo and Perilla held hands, also looking up at the sky.

Perilla’s expression was one of sorrow and rage; his teeth were clenched, and tears uncontrollably stained his face.

His deity, the Sun of Hope, was shattering.

Leo’s expression was relatively calm. He comforted him, "Stop crying. Didn't we know a few years ago that the Sun of Hope was severely wounded? Now, his injuries are simply visible. At the very least, he realized he was dying at the last moment; he should have a little bit left. He won't die."

Perilla’s grief-stricken expression froze, and he glared fiercely at Leo.

Leo felt a familiar divine fluctuation above his head and hurriedly shouted, "Can you save some energy? You’re already on the verge of death, do you have to act out now?!"

The divine fluctuation above his head dissipated.

Perilla could no longer cry.

If your deity is already dying and still insists on raining down power to burn your friend’s hair, you wouldn't be able to cry either.

The two halflings continued to use the altar to communicate with the sun, using the faith of the sun-worshippers to delay the shattering and dimming of the sun, all while whispering to each other.

"Feng and Lang have been missing for almost a year."

"They aren't missing; they're in a trial."

"They should be back by now, shouldn't they? It’s the apocalypse."

"I don't know."

"Sigh, I really miss Lang’s honey cupcakes."

"A little."

"If you only miss them a little, then when Lang comes back, give your honey cupcakes to me."

"Get lost!"

The sun-worshippers knelt on the ground in sorrow, praying devoutly, completely unaware that the two god-favored ones were muttering about things entirely unrelated to their prayers.

In the rebuilt Sea God Temple, Singer held a trident, sitting with his eyes closed beneath the statue of the Sea God.

If Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang were here, they would find his posture identical to the Singer they saw in the dungeon.

The Sea God shared the authority of the ocean with Singer. Although Singer had not ignited a divine fire, he could still observe the sea surface on behalf of the Sea God.

Today, at a perfectly ordinary time, in just an instant, the ocean was blackened without warning. Only the sea near the Atlantis Kingdom and the Sea God Temple remained deep blue; the island nations further away had already lost all contact.

The Sea God Temple, which had suffered heavy losses and had only just begun to recover some vitality in recent years, dispatched a fleet to wait at the boundary between the blue and black seas for refugees. So far, no ships had arrived.

Fortunately, the water on the land had not yet been polluted by the black tide. Perhaps they could travel by land and monitor the situation of the black ocean from the coast.

Singer went over the plan he had organized countless times in his heart once more and let out a sigh of relief.

The current situation was, in his estimation, better than expected.

He called out to the deity in his heart: [My Lord, how is your situation?]

The Sea God responded quickly: [Better than that big idiot, the Sun of Hope, hahaha! He’s the one who’s shattered until only a tiny bit is left!]

Singer’s mouth twitched.

"He’s the one who’s shattered until only a tiny bit is left"... this sentence was clearly a response to Xia Xifeng’s muttering from years ago.

His deity had actually remembered this sentence for several years.

But you’re only slightly better off than the Sun of Hope, are you really that proud?!

Unfairly saddled with the burden of being the "Sea God," Singer, who was about to ignite his divine fire and ascend to demigod status, felt very weary.

He believed that Qin Lang and Xia Xifeng, who were currently trapped in the trial grounds and had been forced to accept godhood by the God of Self while completely bewildered, would surely understand his feelings.

Singer: [My Lord, is the divine domain of the God of Self still closed?]

Sea God: [Still closed, but I can feel that the God of Self has fallen. Although the godhood of the God of Self still exists, there is no aura of a new God of Self being born. It’s very strange. I really don’t know what the God of Self was doing when he was courting death; I’m so curious.]

Singer: [Please stop being curious.]

The God of Self had fallen, so Qin Lang and Xia Xifeng should have escaped the trial grounds. Singer had just breathed a sigh of relief when he heard his deity expressing curiosity about the God of Self’s suicidal behavior, and his heart immediately sank.

His deity was already reckless enough; he couldn't afford to learn even worse habits.

The Sea God sensed the insulting thoughts of his god-favored one—who refused to admit he was a god-favored one—and even though his power was very weak, he still tried his best to pour a ladle of water over Singer’s head.

Singer smoothed his wet hair and gritted his teeth.

For the sake of my Lord’s severe injuries, I will endure this!

Riccio, who was guarding Singer as he suppressed the ocean’s anomalies, quietly moved into the shadows.

He couldn't let the deity remember him. It was better to remain an inconspicuous god-favored one.

In Silvermoon City, the Silvermoon Festival was being held;

In the Human Empire, the Emperor summoned the protection of his ancestors;

In the Elven Empire, the guardians of the World Tree were swearing revenge;

In the Dwarf Kingdom, the Dwarf King held a giant axe, staring at the boiling magma as if facing a formidable enemy;

And at the edge of the world, for the first time in thousands of years, people saw a dragon take flight.

*Crack.*

The final sound.

The sun shattered like a broken mirror, with only a few irregular fragments left hanging in the sky.

The Sun of Birth moved closer to the Sun of Hope, its light enveloping the Sun of Hope—which no longer looked like a sun at all—as if shielding it beneath its wings.

A great panic surged in the hearts of the living on the ground, and ignorant children cried for no reason.

They knew nothing, yet a despair of a bleak future welled up from within them.

The mages and warlocks on the observatory covered their eyes, blood seeping through their fingers.

The starlight was in chaos; they could no longer see the future, as if the path to the future of this world had been severed.

The anomalies in the sky ceased, and the tremors on the ground grew more intense.

The small tree that had fallen to the ground years ago emitted a dazzling light, and the ground near the tree stopped shaking.

But outside the light of the small tree, mud churned on the ground, swallowing grass, trees, stones, animals... everything on the ground was covered by the mud.

chunks.chineseText:
震动更加剧烈。随着时间推移，污泥褪去了令人厌恶的颜色，变得清澈而绚丽，仿佛是谁用最好的水彩颜料在作画。

奇异而漂亮的植物……

遍地如同宝石般的石头……

与曾经动物似是而非的漂亮魔兽……

平平无奇的世界变得绮丽绚烂。

曾经让人厌恶的丑恶，居然都化作了诡谲的美丽。

在一座废弃的高塔上，夏兮风垂腿坐在塔顶边缘，秦琅站在他的身侧。

他们不仅杀掉了自我之神，还在末日来临的最后一刻，为进化之神与智慧之神送别。

就如当年在平行世界的副本中一样，他们手中的武器透过了进化之神和智慧之神的胸膛，外神在神域边缘无能地暴怒。

秦琅揽着夏兮风离开崩塌的神域之前，夏兮风对着外神比了个中指。

我知道你们看到我了，有本事降临地面，来找你爷爷我啊！

呵，我知道你们下不来。

“丑恶变得美丽，就是外神规则侵入梦世界，梦世界的规则正在被颠覆的证明。”夏兮风双眼变成纯粹的金色，不见瞳孔，“不过规则还未完全崩塌，外神仍旧不能直接降世，神灵的战场仍旧在神域。只有我们俩这样把神格当外置装备的伪神灵，才能在地面上使用神格的力量。地面上没有观测到半神。”

秦琅道：“阿穆若老师也去神域了？”

夏兮风点头：“所有半神应该都加入神域的战争了。不过以阿穆若老师的性格，他肯定在绿沙城留了分/身。”

秦琅道：“现在是开服的时间点，离外神驱赶怪物攻打绿沙城，还有一个月。”

夏兮风合上双眼，闭了一会儿眼睛，眼睛再睁开时，眼白和瞳孔已经恢复正常的颜色。

他正准备揉眼睛，被秦琅拦下。

秦琅弯下腰，给夏兮风滴眼药水。

夏兮风的生活技能中，有一个技能叫“鉴定术”，是生活玩家必备的技能。

如今这个“鉴定术”已经能够观测整个世界，变成夏兮风这个半神的“神术”了。

就是费眼睛。

夏兮风第一个自创神级药品，就是自用的眼药水。

夏兮风眼睛舒服一些后，扶着秦琅的手臂站起来：“我多希望系统响起‘游戏公测已经开服’的声音，然后第四天灾降临。”

秦琅不置可否。

“唉，没有更多的第四天灾，只能我俩当这个第四天灾了。”夏兮风清理了一下背包。

他的背包多了三个仓库，分别是“自我之神的库藏”“智慧之神的库藏”“进化之神的库藏”。

智慧之神和进化之神的神格也在背包里，是“不可佩戴”的特殊物品。

物品描述中，说明神格只是在夏兮风和秦琅的背包里藏一藏，免得被外神完全吞噬。等世界脱离末世，神格会重归世界规则，等待点燃神火的半神们争夺。

外神在神域壁垒外暴跳如雷，就是祂们发现进化之神和智慧之神虽然被污染，神格居然还是纯净的，而且到嘴的肉还被别人叼走了。

虽然不能佩戴进化之神和智慧之神的神格，但两位神灵积攒的许多珍宝都归了夏兮风和秦琅。

原本神格争夺中，如果旧神被新神替代，新神是能夺取旧神的遗产的。

可怜的未来智慧之神和进化之神，祂们得从零开始自己攒家底了。

“走，准备回家！”夏兮风纵身一跳，挂在了秦琅的背上。

秦琅背起夏兮风，身影骤然消失。

……

夏兮风怎么也没想到，这一场试炼会持续如此的久。

好像点燃神火之后，他的时间观念一下子就和以前不同了。

每天搓道具，练技能，学习系统展现的知识，感受身体和神魂的变化，瞅一眼秦琅的状态，不知饥饿困顿，如果不是系统面板上有末日的倒计时，他都没感到时间的流逝。

夏兮风偶尔还会拿出魔导车，虽然不困，也钻进去睡一觉，假装自己还是个凡人。

秦琅才是个牲口。那么高强度的战斗，自我之神不喊停，他愣是不停的。

自我之神剥离神格之后，战斗一段时间就要休息一下，让死亡之神给祂补点神性，才能继续指导秦琅。

如果秦琅不停歇地和他战斗，他们早就从试炼场出来了。

不过没有比神灵更厉害的对手了。秦琅缺的就是和一个狡猾又强大的对手的实战经验。末日将近，秦琅和夏兮风都决定压榨自我之神到最后一刻。

后来夏兮风也想练一练战斗，一直如石像般立在战场边缘的死亡之神便来当他的对手，召唤无数死灵来磨砺夏兮风。

如此在试炼场中磨砺了几个月，两人两神的关系缓和许多。

秦琅和夏兮风不再埋头训练，训练一段时间，他们就停下来和自我之神、死亡之神聊一会儿天，探讨收获。

自我之神和死亡之神活了许多年，是很好的老师。

所有未登神的生灵死后都会归于死亡的怀抱，死亡之神的神域所藏之书多如繁星。他的知识渊博，仅次于智慧之神。

死亡之神和智慧之神的区别，只是祂就只看看书，不会细细研究。

夏兮风从未想过，自己如此耐得住寂寞——他甚至没感到寂寞。

做着做着东西就几个月过去了，读着读着书就几个月过去了，闭着眼想着最近的收获，又是几个月过去了。

他总算明白了为什么海神为什么会为一千年的丢脸耿耿于怀。一千年对神灵而言，就算达不到弹指一瞬间的程度，也确实算不上漫长。

如果说这近十年有什么东西确实不同了，那可能是他和秦琅之间的关系吧。

两人因为自我之神的算计滚在了一起，滚完之后他们立刻出门捅了个神，来不及梳理这巨变的关系。如果是在外界，夏兮风不知道秦琅怎么想，他肯定还是会纠结一下。

但这个试炼地，就只有他和秦琅两人。他们即使不主动亲密，聊一聊对系统的新发现，聊一聊最近的学习成果，聊一聊自身的变化，时间便飞速过去了。

在试炼地的时候，夏兮风有时候会梦见小学的夏天。

天气很炎热，伙伴们都不愿意出门玩，他也不想出门。

那时还没有空调。他与秦琅就躺在铺在地面的凉席上，电风扇呼啦呼啦地扇，凉席旁的小矮桌上放着半个西瓜，西瓜里插着两把金属勺子。

父母都在上班，爷爷奶奶外公外婆都在外地避暑，只有他和秦琅在家里。

秦琅趴在凉席上看书，他就在秦琅身边慢悠悠滚过来滚过去。

“好热啊。”

“你不乱动就不热。”

暑假对小孩子而言眨眼就过去了，但每一个炎热的等待父母回家的夏日却很漫长。

如同现在一样。

试炼之地的时间流逝得很快，只有在他和秦琅单独相处的时候，时间才变得正常。

在这样习以为常的朝夕相处中，再多尴尬和别扭也被细水长流磨得光滑。

这磨着磨着，这两人又滚了一次，然后连滚床单都变得习以为常了。

Chapter 96: Two Chapters Combined (Part 2)

The tremors grew more violent. As time passed, the mud shed its repulsive color, becoming clear and brilliant, as if someone were painting with the finest watercolors.

Strange and beautiful plants...

Stones like jewels scattered everywhere...

Beautiful magical beasts that resembled animals from the past...

The plain, unremarkable world had become gorgeous and resplendent.

The ugliness that people once loathed had actually transformed into a bizarre beauty.

On an abandoned high tower, Xia Xifeng sat on the edge with his legs dangling, while Qin Lang stood by his side.

They had not only killed the God of Self, but at the final moment of the apocalypse, they had also bid farewell to the God of Evolution and the God of Wisdom.

Just as in the parallel world dungeon years ago, the weapons in their hands had pierced the chests of the God of Evolution and the God of Wisdom, while the Outer Gods raged impotently at the edge of the divine domain.

Before Qin Lang took Xia Xifeng and left the collapsing divine domain, Xia Xifeng had flipped the middle finger at the Outer Gods.

*I know you can see me. If you have the guts, descend to the ground and come find your grandpa!*

*Heh, I know you can't come down.*

"The ugliness turning into beauty is proof that the rules of the Outer Gods are invading the Dream World, and the rules of the Dream World are being subverted," Xia Xifeng’s eyes turned a pure gold, his pupils invisible. "However, the rules haven't completely collapsed yet, so the Outer Gods still cannot descend directly. The battlefield of the deities remains in the divine domain. Only pseudo-deities like us, who treat godhood as external equipment, can use the power of godhood on the ground. No demigods have been detected on the ground."

Qin Lang asked, "Did Teacher Amuro also go to the divine domain?"

Xia Xifeng nodded. "All demigods should have joined the war in the divine domain. But given Teacher Amuro’s personality, he definitely left a clone in Green Sand City."

Qin Lang said, "It’s the time for the server to open. There is still one month until the Outer Gods drive the monsters to attack Green Sand City."

Xia Xifeng closed his eyes for a moment, and when he opened them again, the whites and pupils had returned to their normal colors.

He was about to rub his eyes when Qin Lang stopped him.

Qin Lang bent down and applied eye drops for Xia Xifeng.

Among Xia Xifeng’s life skills, there was one called "Appraisal," a must-have skill for life-profession players.

Now, this "Appraisal" could observe the entire world, having become a "divine art" for Xia Xifeng, the demigod.

It was just hard on the eyes.

The first god-level medicine Xia Xifeng created was the eye drops he used himself.

After his eyes felt more comfortable, Xia Xifeng leaned on Qin Lang’s arm and stood up. "I really wish the system would play the sound of 'The game has officially launched,' and then the Fourth Calamity would descend."

Qin Lang was noncommittal.

"Sigh, without more of the Fourth Calamity, it’s up to the two of us to be this Fourth Calamity." Xia Xifeng cleared his inventory.

His inventory now had three extra warehouses: "The Treasury of the God of Self," "The Treasury of the God of Wisdom," and "The Treasury of the God of Evolution."

The godhood of the God of Wisdom and the God of Evolution were also in his inventory, as special items that were "non-equippable."

The item descriptions explained that the godhood was merely hiding in Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang’s inventory to avoid being completely devoured by the Outer Gods. Once the world was free from the apocalypse, the godhood would return to the world’s rules, waiting for the demigods who ignited their divine fire to compete for them.

The Outer Gods were furious outside the barriers of the divine domain because they discovered that although the God of Evolution and the God of Wisdom had been polluted, their godhood was still pure, and the meat that was already in their mouths had been snatched away by someone else.

Although they couldn't equip the godhood of the God of Evolution and the God of Wisdom, many treasures accumulated by the two deities now belonged to Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang.

Originally, in the competition for godhood, if an old god was replaced by a new god, the new god could seize the legacy of the old god.

Poor future God of Wisdom and God of Evolution; they would have to start from scratch and accumulate their own wealth.

"Let’s go, time to go home!" Xia Xifeng jumped and hung onto Qin Lang’s back.

Qin Lang carried Xia Xifeng, and their figures suddenly vanished.

...

Xia Xifeng never expected that this trial would last so long.

It seemed that after igniting the divine fire, his concept of time had changed completely from before.

Every day was spent crafting items, practicing skills, learning the knowledge displayed by the system, feeling the changes in his body and soul, and glancing at Qin Lang’s status. He felt no hunger or fatigue. If it weren't for the countdown to the apocalypse on the system panel, he wouldn't have felt the passage of time at all.

Xia Xifeng would occasionally take out the magic-guided car, and even though he wasn't tired, he would crawl inside and sleep, pretending he was still a mortal.

Qin Lang was a beast. In such high-intensity combat, as long as the God of Self didn't call a stop, he simply wouldn't stop.

After the God of Self stripped away his godhood, he had to rest after fighting for a while, letting the God of Death replenish some divinity for him, before he could continue guiding Qin Lang.

If Qin Lang had fought him without stopping, they would have come out of the trial grounds long ago.

However, there was no opponent more powerful than a deity. What Qin Lang lacked was real combat experience against a cunning and powerful opponent. With the apocalypse approaching, Qin Lang and Xia Xifeng both decided to squeeze the God of Self for every last bit of value.

Later, Xia Xifeng also wanted to practice combat, so the God of Death, who had stood like a stone statue at the edge of the battlefield, came to be his opponent, summoning countless undead to hone Xia Xifeng.

After honing themselves in the trial grounds for several months like this, the relationship between the two humans and the two deities softened considerably.

Qin Lang and Xia Xifeng no longer buried themselves in training. After training for a while, they would stop to chat with the God of Self and the God of Death, discussing their gains.

The God of Self and the God of Death had lived for many years and were excellent teachers.

All creatures that had not ascended to godhood would return to the embrace of death after they died, and the divine domain of the God of Death held as many books as there were stars. His knowledge was vast, second only to the God of Wisdom.

The difference between the God of Death and the God of Wisdom was that he only read the books and didn't study them in detail.

Xia Xifeng had never imagined that he could endure such loneliness—he didn't even feel lonely.

Months passed as he crafted things, months passed as he read books, and months passed as he closed his eyes and thought about his recent gains.

He finally understood why the Sea God would harbor a grudge over a thousand years of embarrassment. For a deity, a thousand years, even if it didn't reach the level of a blink of an eye, was certainly not considered long.

If there was one thing that had truly changed in these nearly ten years, it might be the relationship between him and Qin Lang.

The two of them had ended up together because of the schemes of the God of Self, and after that, they immediately went out to stab a god, leaving no time to sort out this massive change in their relationship. If they were in the outside world, Xia Xifeng didn't know what Qin Lang was thinking, but he would certainly have struggled with it.

But in this trial ground, there were only him and Qin Lang. Even if they didn't actively seek intimacy, chatting about new discoveries in the system, recent learning achievements, and their own changes, time flew by.

When they were in the trial grounds, Xia Xifeng would sometimes dream of the summer in elementary school.

The weather was very hot, and his friends didn't want to go out to play, and he didn't want to go out either.

There was no air conditioning back then. He and Qin Lang would lie on a straw mat spread on the floor, the electric fan whirring, and on the small table next to the mat was half a watermelon with two metal spoons stuck in it.

His parents were both at work, and his grandparents were away to escape the heat; only he and Qin Lang were at home.

Qin Lang would lie on the mat reading a book, and he would roll back and forth slowly beside Qin Lang.

"It’s so hot."

"You wouldn't be hot if you didn't move around."

Summer vacation passed in the blink of an eye for a child, but every hot summer day waiting for his parents to come home felt very long.

Just like now.

Time passed very quickly in the trial grounds, and only when he and Qin Lang were alone together did time feel normal.

In such a routine of being together day and night, any awkwardness or discomfort was worn smooth by the long, flowing stream of time.

As they wore each other down, the two of them rolled together again, and then even rolling in bed became a matter of routine.

想来他们本就已经朝夕相处十几年，上大学后的分别时间不过两年。在这个世界又朝夕相处十几年，若在原本的世界，半辈子都一同吵闹着过去了，确实很难再有什么羞涩回避的心情。

不过两人却也一直没对对方说过喜欢啊爱什么。

夏兮风坚称如果自己承认喜欢秦琅，会显得他眼光不好。

好巧，秦琅听了夏兮风的话，也是这么想。

长相他们不在意这个，性格又确实不合，连三观都有差别，说什么爱，那真不知道是怎么爱上的。

总之，不能承认自己眼光不好，审美很差。

反正两个人就这么处着，耗着，谁知道未来会如何。

末世都到来了，他们大概暂时也没心情去折腾这个。

自我之神的灵魂散去，死亡之神捧着自我之神消失后的一捧飞灰离开，将虚无的灰烬葬入了死亡的花园。

没有坟墓，没有碑文，神灵的记忆就是祂的坟墓碑文。神灵的记忆有多长，这坟墓和碑文就能存在多久。

送别智慧之神和进化之神后，夏兮风和秦琅也将被烧尽的灰烬送往死亡之境，和自我之神做了邻居，假装神灵燃尽自己，灰飞烟灭之后也能有来生。

智慧之神、进化之神、自我之神都是神格诞生之初就伴生神格诞生的最初的神灵，许多小神灵几经更迭，祂们从未更替。祂们都是生灵诞生后最“基础”的神灵。

【生灵诞生后开始进化，进化之后有了自我，自我开始产生智慧。】

【最初的生灵之神，为生灵献出了生命。】

【祝福我的子民，终有未来。】

【主线任务《生灵之神的祝福》结束，奖励正在计算，即将发放。】

夏兮风趴在秦琅背上，看了一眼系统提醒：“回去之前，咱们先再去一次深渊吧。”

秦琅：“换几个神眷者？”

夏兮风道：“看看深渊的神眷者干得怎么样，干得不好就换，干得好就加几个。说起来，我忘记给新的血族真祖神眷者身份了。”

秦琅：“没关系。”

秦琅替血族原谅了夏兮风。

两人悄悄潜入深渊。佩戴了自我之神神格后，谁也没发现他们来了一趟。

上一次夏兮风在深渊使用自我之神神格时，没有任何限制。这次他们再佩戴自我神格改造的增幅器，神格竟然变成了现实佩戴的装备，半小时后就会自动回到背包，冷却七日之后才能继续使用。

两人看了装备新出现的说明，神格增幅器在地面上的限制更大，只能使用十分钟，也是冷却七日后才能继续使用。

这也是外神规则已经入侵的证明。

在夏兮风最初佩戴神格增幅器的时候，世界的规则还没破坏，深渊就是深渊之主的深渊，自我神格自然是无敌的。现在别说深渊，整个世界都已经被外神抢走一半，自我神格便有限制了。

自我之神用外神神性改造自己的神格，便是料到了这个。

神格增幅器中包含外神的规则，才让力量增幅器在末世后还能继续使用。

虽然有时间限制，但地面上神灵不降世，都在神域战斗，七日一次的“降神”，足以改变许多事。

再者，没佩戴神格增幅器，秦琅和夏兮风也是半神。经过近十年的磨砺，他们基本掌握了半神的力量，不去神域的话，单对单几乎没有敌手了。

不过外神向来不要脸，如果发现他们的踪迹，就不可能和他们单对单。

“这下要打一枪换一个地方了。”

“嗯。”

“我们从新手任务开始做起吗？”

“不。”

“有点仪式感啊！”

“没有。”

“不行，必须有仪式感。走，我们回去就找城卫大姐接新手村任务。”

“你当面叫她一声大姐试试。”

“不试。”

夏兮风悄悄给血族真祖柔萨套了个神眷者光环，吓得柔萨从王座上蹦了起来。

站在他旁边充当护卫的他哥把他按了回去。

夏兮风又给他哥套了个神眷者光环。

这下兄弟二人都没办法好好开会，一同东张西望找他们的神灵了。

夏兮风贼兮兮地笑了笑，拍拍秦琅的后脑勺，让秦琅跑路了。

太阳在深渊也有投影，深渊恶魔们也知道了末世到来。他们也终于知道，原来邪神不是本土神灵，而是外来者。当外神彻底占领梦世界，他们也全都得完蛋，从灵魂到身体都变成全新物种，自我自然也全不存在了。

深渊恶魔是最在意自我的种族，这能忍？忍不了一点。

和地面上那群看不顺眼的生灵合作，都能忍了。

秦琅背着夏兮风在深渊转了一圈，居然没有收回一个神眷者资格。

夏兮风看见深渊魔王们一边看《自我之神传记（夏兮风著）》一边抹眼泪，差点笑出声。

秦琅在夏兮风笑出声，暴露隐藏地点时，背着夏兮风跑路了。

“全部搞定，回家啰。”

末世降临，咱们回新手村，从头开始游戏。

Chapter 96: Two Chapters Combined (Part 3)

Thinking about it, they had already been together day and night for over a decade, and their time apart after entering university was only two years. Having spent another decade together in this world, if they were back in their original world, they would have spent half their lives bickering together; it was indeed hard to feel any shyness or avoidance.

However, the two of them had never said "I like you" or "I love you" to each other.

Xia Xifeng insisted that if he admitted to liking Qin Lang, it would make his taste look bad.

Coincidentally, Qin Lang, after hearing Xia Xifeng’s words, thought the same thing.

They didn't care about their looks, but their personalities really didn't match, and even their worldviews were different. To talk about love—they really didn't know how they had fallen in love.

In any case, they couldn't admit that their taste was bad and their aesthetic sense was poor.

Anyway, the two of them just stayed together, dragging it out, who knew what the future would hold.

The apocalypse had arrived, and they probably didn't have the mood to fuss over this for now.

The soul of the God of Self dissipated, and the God of Death held the handful of ashes left after the God of Self disappeared, burying the void ashes into the Garden of Death.

There were no graves, no inscriptions; the memories of a deity were their grave and inscription. As long as the memories of the deity lasted, the grave and inscription could exist.

After bidding farewell to the God of Wisdom and the God of Evolution, Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang also sent the burnt ashes to the Realm of Death, making them neighbors with the God of Self, pretending that even after a deity burns themselves out and turns to ash, they could still have an afterlife.

The God of Wisdom, the God of Evolution, and the God of Self were the original deities born alongside their godhood at the beginning of time. Many minor deities had changed hands several times, but they had never been replaced. They were the most "foundational" deities born after the birth of living beings.

[After living beings were born, they began to evolve; after evolution, they gained a self; and the self began to produce wisdom.]

[The original God of Life sacrificed his life for the living.]

[Bless my people, that they may have a future.]

[Main quest "Blessing of the God of Life" completed. Rewards are being calculated and will be distributed shortly.]

Xia Xifeng lay on Qin Lang’s back and glanced at the system notification: "Before we go back, let’s go to the Abyss one more time."

Qin Lang: "To change a few god-favored ones?"

Xia Xifeng said: "Let’s see how the god-favored ones of the Abyss are doing. If they aren't doing well, we’ll replace them; if they are doing well, we’ll add a few more. Speaking of which, I forgot to give the new Vampire Progenitor the status of a god-favored one."

Qin Lang: "It doesn't matter."

Qin Lang forgave Xia Xifeng on behalf of the vampires.

The two quietly infiltrated the Abyss. After equipping the godhood of the God of Self, no one discovered they had visited.

The last time Xia Xifeng used the godhood of the God of Self in the Abyss, there were no restrictions. This time, when they wore the amplifier modified by the godhood of the God of Self, the godhood actually became a piece of equipment that could be worn in reality, automatically returning to the inventory after half an hour, and requiring a seven-day cooldown before it could be used again.

The two looked at the new description of the equipment: the godhood amplifier had even greater restrictions on the ground, allowing only ten minutes of use, also requiring a seven-day cooldown.

This was proof that the rules of the Outer Gods had already invaded.

When Xia Xifeng first wore the godhood amplifier, the rules of the world had not been destroyed, and the Abyss was the Abyss of the Lord of the Abyss; the godhood of the God of Self was naturally invincible. Now, let alone the Abyss, the entire world had already been half-seized by the Outer Gods, so the godhood of the God of Self had restrictions.

The God of Self had used the divinity of the Outer Gods to modify his own godhood, anticipating this.

The godhood amplifier contained the rules of the Outer Gods, which allowed the power amplifier to continue to be used after the apocalypse.

Although there was a time limit, the deities on the ground were not descending and were all fighting in the divine domain, so a "divine descent" once every seven days was enough to change many things.

Furthermore, even without wearing the godhood amplifier, Qin Lang and Xia Xifeng were demigods. After nearly ten years of honing, they had basically mastered the power of demigods, and if they didn't go to the divine domain, they had almost no rivals in one-on-one combat.

However, the Outer Gods had always been shameless; if they discovered their tracks, they wouldn't fight them one-on-one.

"Now we have to hit and run."

"Mm."

"Should we start from the novice quests?"

"No."

"We need a bit of a sense of ritual!"

"No."

"No, it must have a sense of ritual. Let’s go, as soon as we get back, we’ll find the City Guard Big Sister to take on the novice village quest."

"Try calling her 'Big Sister' to her face."

"I won't."

Xia Xifeng quietly placed a god-favored halo on the Vampire Progenitor, Rou Sa, scaring him so much that he jumped off his throne.

His brother, who was acting as a guard beside him, pressed him back down.

Xia Xifeng then placed a god-favored halo on his brother as well.

Now, neither of the brothers could hold their meeting properly, both looking around, searching for their deity.

Xia Xifeng smiled sneakily, patted the back of Qin Lang’s head, and let Qin Lang run away.

The sun also had a projection in the Abyss, and the Abyss demons also knew that the apocalypse had arrived. They finally realized that the evil gods were not local deities, but outsiders. When the Outer Gods completely occupied the Dream World, they would all be finished, their souls and bodies turned into a brand-new species, and their sense of self would cease to exist.

The Abyss demons were the race that cared most about their "self." Could they tolerate this? Not even a little bit.

They could even tolerate cooperating with that group of annoying living beings on the ground.

Qin Lang carried Xia Xifeng around the Abyss, but didn't revoke a single god-favored qualification.

Xia Xifeng saw the Abyss Demon Kings wiping away tears while reading "Biography of the God of Self (Authored by Xia Xifeng)," and almost laughed out loud.

Qin Lang carried Xia Xifeng and ran away just as Xia Xifeng was about to laugh out loud and expose their hiding spot.

"Everything is done, let’s go home."

The apocalypse has arrived; let’s return to the novice village and start the game from the beginning.
