Chapter 99: Two Chapters in One (Part 2)

Furthermore, the game *Fantasy of the Strange Realm* was clearly related to the Heavenly Father, who had laid out his plans in their world long ago. Perhaps after they completed the mission, the Heavenly Father would allow them to teleport back and forth between the two worlds, which would leave even less to worry about.

The God of Death told Xia Xifeng to use his divine fire more often, and to perceive how to temper his body while doing so.

The God of Self had a wilder approach. He suggested that when Qin Lang was closest to Xia Xifeng's body and soul, he should use his own divine fire to guide Xia Xifeng's divine fire in tempering his body.

Uh, wasn't that... dual cultivation? There was dual cultivation in a magical world too?!

Well, it didn't seem like there was anything to be surprised about.

Xia Xifeng had proactively dragged Qin Lang to try it once, but after that, he didn't dare to try it lightly again.

Because...

Xia Xifeng felt, with a sense of dread, Qin Lang's divine fire enter his body without any resistance, drawing close to his own divine fire.

Qin Lang caressed Xia Xifeng's brow and eyes. "If you're not used to it, you need to practice more to get used to it."

Even as Qin Lang spoke, Xia Xifeng's divine fire ignored his own resistance and affectionately threw itself toward Qin Lang's divine fire.

Sparks splattered, splitting into fine threads. The two clusters of divine fire clung to each other stickily, wrapping together as if they were one.

Xia Xifeng's body shuddered violently. With a *bang*, his mind went completely blank, blown away by the sudden fireworks.

Having tried it once, he didn't dare try it again easily.

Because for the first time, he learned that excessive pleasure could actually give someone the illusion of dying.

Qin Lang stroked Xia Xifeng's dazed brow and eyes over and over. Compared to his actions, which had started to become slightly rough again, his touch was incredibly gentle.

He was not someone obsessed with physical desires. Although he had looked into related knowledge, he had never had any interest in actively exploring it.

But he loved seeing Xia Xifeng's current expression, so he always wanted to see more of it.

Xia Xifeng stared at him with vacant eyes, reflecting only him, and his mind was undoubtedly filled with nothing but him.

Qin Lang gazed intently at his reflection in Xia Xifeng's eyes, utterly satisfied.

...

When Xia Xifeng woke up again, he stared blankly for a long time before his neck stiffly turned toward the person holding him.

Both of them were already dressed. Qin Lang was half-reclining on the bed, processing the documents sent over by Damon.

*Damon came by? When? What state were he and Qin Lang in at that time?*

Xia Xifeng wanted to slide back under the covers and suffocate himself with the blanket.

"He didn't come over himself. I had Mao Da go fetch the documents to prevent him from dropping by." Qin Lang's gaze remained on the documents. Even without looking at Xia Xifeng's expression, he knew the unvoiced question in his mind.

Xia Xifeng let out a sigh of relief, then immediately sucked it back in, angrily turning Qin Lang's head toward himself.

Qin Lang's gaze flickered slightly. He felt a bit guilty for insisting on taking things too far despite Xia Xifeng's refusal, and for lying in bed with Xia Xifeng for an extra day.

He was already prepared to apologize swiftly the moment Xia Xifeng scolded him.

"What do they mean, 'blind'!" Xia Xifeng said angrily. "And you actually agreed with them!"

"Huh?" Qin Lang didn't quite follow.

Xia Xifeng angrily slapped Qin Lang's face with both hands. "You've never done anything bad. Does just thinking about it make you a bad person? Then when I was a kid, I wanted to blow up my school every day! How could Mr. Amuro say that about you!"

"Huh??" Qin Lang was lost once more. *What did Teacher say about me?*

Xia Xifeng pinched Qin Lang's cheeks and pulled them outward. "Listen! You're just too simple-minded, which is why you worry about whatever other people say. Can you stop being so sensitive? Is there anyone who knows you better than I do? Listen to me! What do they mean, I'm blind? They're the ones who are blind!"

Qin Lang: "..." He roughly understood now. Xia Xifeng believed that Mr. Su Er and his teacher's psychological counseling had completely wronged and victimized him?

Xia Xifeng said furiously, "If you keep letting other people's words make you overthink, I'm really going to get angry!"

*You're already angry right now.* Qin Lang sighed deeply. "I... you... forget it, okay."

To avoid Xia Xifeng's nagging, Qin Lang agreed immediately.

But even though he agreed, it didn't save him from Xia Xifeng's lecture.

This was what annoyed Xia Xifeng the most about Qin Lang.

Just because others said he was bad, did that make him bad? Let alone judging actions over thoughts—even judging thoughts, Qin Lang had never done anything bad, so on what grounds could they say his heart was bad? It was precisely because people kept evaluating Qin Lang as this or that bad thing every day that Qin Lang had been brainwashed by them into thinking he was a dangerous element!

He himself had clung to Qin Lang as a bolster before he could even talk or walk. Who was more qualified than him to judge what kind of person Qin Lang was?

Qin Lang always believed this person and that person, but just wouldn't believe him, and even said he was blind. It really ticked him off!

"Teacher and Mr. Amuro were just worried you'd be in a bad mood. Why are you talking nonsense and pretending to be some dangerous figure? Do you have eighth-grader syndrome?!" Xia Xifeng tugged and shook Qin Lang's cheeks.

Qin Lang took a deep breath, completely choked up by Xia Xifeng's words.

He admitted that he had let Xia Xifeng see that memory because he wanted to see just how ridiculously far Xia Xifeng's favoritism toward him could go.

Although Xia Xifeng had already "seen" his past thoughts, he had never spoken them aloud. Perhaps Xia Xifeng was too stupid and hadn't "seen" them clearly?

He was wrong. Xia Xifeng was indeed ridiculous.

What did he mean, "eighth-grader syndrome"?!

To prevent Xia Xifeng from saying anything even more outrageous, Qin Lang decisively sold out Teacher Amuro.

"I was just playing along with Teacher's words. I didn't actually think that way." To avoid further torment from Xia Xifeng, Qin Lang would rather admit he was just being childish and mouthy. "Teacher himself is a dangerous element, so playing along with his thoughts made it easier for him to believe me."

Xia Xifeng pulled a bottle of specially blended fruit juice from his backpack and took a swig, moistening his dry lips and throat from all the nagging.

After drinking, Xia Xifeng shoved the bottle's nozzle into Qin Lang's mouth, forcing him to shut up. "Whether you're sincere or pretending, do you think I can't tell? I'm not listening to your excuses."

Qin Lang almost choked on the juice.

He pulled the bottle away, changed the subject, and continued to sell out his teacher. "You can complain to Teacher Su Er, telling him that Amuro called you blind and tried to drive a wedge between us."

Xia Xifeng hesitated. "Mr. Amuro was also just caring about us. Even though his words weren't quite right, complaining about him isn't very nice, is it?"

Qin Lang: "It's not complaining; it's informing Mr. Su Er of the truth. Teacher believes that his relationship with Mr. Su Er will fluctuate in the future and that Mr. Su Er will fall out of love. Isn't that an insult to Mr. Su Er's character?"

Xia Xifeng hesitated. "Teacher Amuro is probably just insecure, right?"

Qin Lang: "Mr. Su Er is so good to Teacher, and his character is so noble. Teacher being insecure is a lack of trust in their relationship and in Mr. Su Er's character."

Xia Xifeng glanced at Qin Lang. "Is this really okay?" Did Qin Lang think he couldn't see through his wicked, master-betraying intentions?

Qin Lang blinked, his expression exceptionally innocent.

He was truly unsuited for such an expression, which amused Xia Xifeng so much that he doubled over, almost sliding out of his arms from laughing.

Qin Lang caught the sliding Xia Xifeng and placed the juice bottle on the nightstand. "Are you going to complain?"

Xia Xifeng's eyes curved. "I'm complaining!"

Qin Lang closed the reviewed documents on his lap, left Xia Xifeng to lean against the headboard and message Su Er, and stepped out of the bedroom to order Mao Da and Mao Er to cook.

He knew Xia Xifeng. Although Xia Xifeng wouldn't feel hungry after igniting his divine fire, the moment he realized he hadn't eaten all day, he would definitely crave food.

Wearing a mischievous grin, Xia Xifeng privately messaged Teacher Su Er to twist the facts.

*Mr. Amuro is really too awful! He actually doubted your character, Teacher! Not only does he doubt you, but he's also leading Qin Lang astray!*

After twisting a whole bunch of facts, Xia Xifeng thought about it and added to his teacher that he was doing this deliberately to sow discord because Mr. Amuro had slandered him by calling him blind.

Su Er replied to Xia Xifeng with a smile, promising to give Amuro a good scolding.

Xia Xifeng was delighted. He leaped up from the bed, but his legs gave out, and with a *thud*, he collapsed onto the thick carpet on the floor.

chunks.chineseText:
夏兮风艰难地从地毯上爬起来：“秦琅，你都不知道给我喂点恢复体力的药吗？”

秦琅从卧室门口探出半个身子，又把半个身子收了回去。

夏兮风：“……”

他吃了一把乱七八糟不知道对不对症的恢复体力的药，奔出门殴打秦琅。

看秦琅这反应，就知道秦琅不是忘记，而是故意的！

“你居然还拍照？给我删掉！”

“秦狗，不准跑！”

正努力满满为老是丢下猫猫自己出门的主人做爱心佳肴的猫大猫二，悄悄地从窗户处探出猫猫头。

“真热闹，真好，喵。”

“是的，喵。”

……

一天假变成两天假，夏兮风看着戴蒙的脸上堆满了谄笑：“我能解释！”

戴蒙惊恐地捂住耳朵：“闭嘴！我不想听你们的房中密事！”

夏兮风的谄笑崩裂。他举起了新打造的狼牙棒法杖。

戴蒙单手握拳，放在嘴前干咳一声：“说正事说正事。猫猫探子打探到异化的森林深处，有许多怪物集结。我推测，血月夜怪物就会攻城。”

夏兮风冷哼了一声，跟着转移话题：“是那天。三日后的夜晚。”

这个世界的银月没有完全被血月吞噬，即使进入末世，银月和血月居然还能在夜里分庭抗礼。

末世的夜空，银月和血月与血月刚现世的时候一样，仍旧是你盈我缺，交替映空。

在银月消失，血月满月的那一夜，仍旧是怪物力量最强大的一夜，也将是怪物攻城的那一夜。

恰巧，这也是游戏中怪物攻城的时间。

游戏中的末世早就不见银月，但血月也有圆缺。怪物仍旧在血月满月那夜对地上人们生存的堡垒发起总攻。

末世来临时损失的人口没有计数。这一夜被攻击的城池损失的人口有统计。

一夜之后，所有城池的总人口减少七成。

大部分玩游戏的玩家感受不到游戏中NPC的悲惨，只嘻嘻哈哈说游戏运营一口气干掉七成人口，就是想为游戏中不想做太多无关NPC而打补丁。

现在游戏厂商“省建模”的调侃，成了夏兮风即将面对的现实。

戴蒙苦笑：“你真镇定。”

他双手放在额头上，身体后仰靠在椅子上：“我每天不埋头繁重的工作，根本难以入睡。”

夏兮风惊讶：“你沉迷工作，难道不是因为你喜欢工作？”

戴蒙：“……”他放下双手，坐直身体，瞪着夏兮风，目光幽幽。

夏兮风讪笑着退后一步，东张西望找秦琅当障碍物。

但这只狗，永远会给他上演何为大难当头各自飞，早不知道什么时候就不见了。

“算了，等守城成功后再骂你，现在没心情。”戴蒙有气无力道，“你怎么能这么轻松，教教我如何调整心态。”

夏兮风见警报解决，挪动到戴蒙身边，小心翼翼道：“真的不生气了？”

戴蒙叹气：“没力气生气。”

夏兮风拍了拍戴蒙的肩膀：“我这么轻松，是因为末世终于来了啊。”

戴蒙眼睛瞪圆：“啊？”

夏兮风笑道：“在末世来之前，我每天都挺紧张。我不知道即将到来的末世是什么模样，外神的谋划到了什么地步。”

末世之前，外神已经谋划了不知道多少年，阴谋隐藏在不知道多深的水底。

夏兮风虽然知道游戏中的末世是什么模样，但他不确定这里的末世和游戏中一样。何况游戏里末世即将胜利，有百万萌新玩家夜以继日肝报废的功劳。

这里是现实，自称萌新的玩家只有两个人，走出末世只能靠梦世界本土居民自己。

夏兮风已经做出了许多改变，可这改变有没有用，靴子一日没落下来，他一日不敢有太乐观的想法。

直到末世到来这一刻，一切尘埃落定。

外神的阴谋在末世降临那一天引爆，所有底牌都已经掀开，双方战力都已经上了战场，剩下的就是见招拆招，直白又粗暴的你死我活。

“不需要思考对方还有多少隐而不发的阴谋，只要干死对方就能结束末世。”夏兮风看向天空的太阳。

希望之日只剩下几块破碎的残片，也仍旧光芒不减。

这个世界里连希望之日都没死透呢，怎么说看不到希望？

“这样啊。”戴蒙隐约知道一点夏兮风的本事，试探地问道，“你认为我们会赢吗？”

夏兮风道：“谁知道呢，但我知道，我不想外神活。”

戴蒙沉默了一会儿，失笑道：“你说得对。只要干死对方就好。”

即使神灵也不能无限制地增殖“生命”，所有非自然的增殖，都要消耗祂们自己的神力。

只要扛过这一波怪潮，祂们就不能再组织一场全世界范围内的袭击。

“我想我今天能睡个好觉了。”戴蒙长舒了一口气，心头阴霾一扫而空。

作者有话要说：

二更合一。

夏兮风从小到大一直认为，秦琅有心理问题，都是别人念出来的，是外部原因。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 99: Two Chapters in One (Part 3)

Xia Xifeng struggled to climb up from the carpet. "Qin Lang, didn't you even think to feed me some stamina recovery potions?"

Qin Lang poked half his body out of the bedroom doorway, then pulled it right back in.

Xia Xifeng: "..."

He swallowed a handful of random stamina recovery pills, not even knowing if they were the right fit, and dashed out the door to beat up Qin Lang.

Seeing Qin Lang's reaction, he knew Qin Lang hadn't forgotten—he had done it on purpose!

"You actually took a photo? Delete it!"

"Qin Dog, don't you run!"

Mao Da and Mao Er, who were full of effort preparing a loving meal for their master who always left his cats behind to go out, quietly poked their cat heads out from the window.

"So lively. How nice, meow."

"Indeed, meow."

...

A one-day vacation turned into a two-day vacation. Xia Xifeng looked at Damon, his face plastered with a sycophantic smile. "I can explain!"

Damon covered his ears in horror. "Shut up! I don't want to hear about your bedroom secrets!"

Xia Xifeng's sycophantic smile shattered. He raised his newly crafted spiked mace staff.

Damon made a fist with one hand, cleared his throat in front of his mouth, and said, "Business, let's talk business. The cat scouts have discovered that deep within the mutated forest, a vast number of monsters are gathering. I surmise that the monsters will besiege the city on the night of the blood moon."

Xia Xifeng snorted coldly, following his lead to change the subject. "It is that day. Three nights from now."

The silver moon of this world had not been completely swallowed by the blood moon. Even after entering the end times, the silver moon and the blood moon could still hold their ground against each other in the night sky.

In the apocalyptic night sky, the silver moon and the blood moon behaved just as they had when the blood moon first appeared, still waxing and waning in turn, taking turns to illuminate the sky.

On the night when the silver moon vanished and the blood moon was full, it would still be the night when the monsters' power was at its peak, and it would also be the night they besieged the city.

Coincidentally, this was also the timing of the monster siege in the game.

In the game's apocalypse, the silver moon had long since vanished, but the blood moon still had its phases. The monsters would still launch a general offensive against the bastions of human survival on the night of the full blood moon.

The population lost when the apocalypse arrived had not been counted. However, there were statistics for the population lost in the cities attacked on this night.

After a single night, the total population of all cities was reduced by seventy percent.

Most players playing the game couldn't feel the tragedy of the NPCs. They only joked around, saying that the game operators wiped out seventy percent of the population in one go just to patch out the need to render too many irrelevant NPCs.

Now, the joke about the game developers "saving on modeling" had become the reality Xia Xifeng was about to face.

Damon smiled bitterly. "You're so calm."

He placed his hands on his forehead and leaned back in his chair. "If I don't bury myself in heavy work every day, I can hardly fall asleep at all."

Xia Xifeng was surprised. "You're addicted to work? I thought it was because you liked working?"

Damon: "..." He lowered his hands, sat up straight, and stared at Xia Xifeng with a dark, brooding gaze.

Xia Xifeng retreated a step with a sheepish laugh, looking around for Qin Lang to use as a shield.

But that dog would always show him the true meaning of "each flying their own way when disaster strikes," having vanished to who-knows-where long ago.

"Forget it, I'll scold you after we successfully defend the city. I'm not in the mood right now," Damon said weakly. "How can you be so relaxed? Teach me how to adjust my mindset."

Seeing that the alarm had passed, Xia Xifeng nudged closer to Damon and asked cautiously, "Are you really not angry anymore?"

Damon sighed. "I don't have the energy to be angry."

Xia Xifeng patted Damon's shoulder. "I'm this relaxed because the apocalypse has finally arrived."

Damon's eyes widened. "Huh?"

Xia Xifeng smiled. "Before the apocalypse came, I was quite tense every day. I didn't know what the impending apocalypse would look like, or how far the Outer Gods' schemes had progressed."

Before the end times, the Outer Gods had been plotting for who knew how many years, their conspiracies hidden deep beneath the surface.

Although Xia Xifeng knew what the apocalypse looked like in the game, he couldn't be sure if the apocalypse here would be identical. Moreover, the impending victory in the game's apocalypse was achieved thanks to the efforts of millions of newbie players grinding day and night.

This was reality. There were only two players who claimed to be newbies, and escaping the apocalypse could only rely on the native residents of the Dream World themselves.

Xia Xifeng had already made many changes, but whether these changes would be useful... until the other shoe dropped, he didn't dare to harbor overly optimistic thoughts.

Until the moment the apocalypse arrived, and the dust finally settled.

The Outer Gods' conspiracies had detonated on the day the apocalypse descended. All their cards were on the table, and the combat forces of both sides had taken the field. What remained was simply responding to their moves—a straightforward, brutal struggle of life and death.

"There's no need to think about how many hidden conspiracies the enemy still has in reserve. As long as we kill them, we can end the apocalypse." Xia Xifeng looked up at the sun in the sky.

Only a few shattered fragments of the Sun of Hope remained, yet its light was still undiminished.

In this world, even the Sun of Hope hadn't completely died out. How could anyone say there was no hope?

"I see." Damon vaguely knew a bit of Xia Xifeng's capabilities, and he asked tentatively, "Do you think we will win?"

Xia Xifeng said, "Who knows? But I do know that I don't want the Outer Gods to live."

Damon fell silent for a moment, then burst into laughter. "You're right. As long as we kill them, that's all that matters."

Even gods could not multiply "life" indefinitely; all unnatural proliferation required them to consume their own divine power.

As long as they survived this wave of monsters, the Outer Gods wouldn't be able to organize another worldwide attack.

"I think I can get a good night's sleep today." Damon let out a long breath, the gloom in his heart swept away.

***

*Author's Note:*

Two chapters in one.

From childhood to adulthood, Xia Xifeng had always believed that any psychological issues Qin Lang had were entirely nagged into him by others—they were purely external causes.

chunks.chineseText:
第100章 二更合一

戴蒙会有的心理问题，其他人肯定也会有。

夏兮风决定，在战前先对城里的人进行心理辅导。

他所说的心理辅导，不是战前动员，而是将真相告知城民。

戴蒙本来是反对的。

他认为普通人心理太脆弱，不能承受太沉重的真相。如果夏兮风将真相告知普通人，城里肯定会混乱。

夏兮风却不这么想。

“不要小瞧人们的求生欲。”夏兮风道，“看见世界大变的模样，有脑子的人都能猜到如今有多绝望。一无所知地步入绝境，已经够绝望。直到真相，他们心底才会生出希望。”

秦琅一直很理性，常看法与夏兮风相悖。这次他站在夏兮风这一边。

只有知道敌人没有丝毫怜悯心，投降只能死亡，甚至连死亡都是奢望，灵魂都可能不能归于死亡的怀抱，那还绝望什么？

他们必须赢。只要能赢，他们的灵魂至少能进入死亡之神的怀抱。

夏兮风和秦琅的家乡，曾经面临亡国灭种的危机。虽这场危机算不上世界末日那么大的事件，但对于这个国家而言，就是如同末世一般了。

麻木的百姓曾经也以为那只是一场普普通通的军阀混战，谁赢了跟着谁就成。

直到一场一场的屠杀，让他们知道了这场战争的真相，直到不能投降，不能输。全民战争才是唯一的出路。

两人坚信，梦世界也一定一样。

如果《奇域幻想》中描述的真的是梦世界的现实，那梦世界的人们一定与《奇域幻想》中的本土NPC一样，有一棵能与华夏玩家共鸣的心。

他们不会屈服于绝望，只会抗争。

“有两个半神坐镇，希望城不可能沦陷，正好在希望城尝试。”夏兮风道，“如果我和秦琅是正确的，其他城池再跟着学。”

戴蒙退让：“行，你们是城主，你们说了算。你的意思是，想让城民自己抵御怪物吗？”

夏兮风点头：“等有需要我和秦琅出手的怪物时，我们再出手。你也一样。这是战争。”

戴蒙嘴唇动了动，最终什么都没说，只是点头同意。

战争就是这样。

兵对兵，将对将，王对王。不能将能轻易杀死小兵，王能轻易杀死将，就用不对等的棋子和人兑子。

戴蒙苦笑：“你居然比我更适应末世。”

夏兮风摇头：“我只是嘴强王者。”

他当然不懂打仗，只是知道游戏中的攻城战中，普通怪物削弱得差不多后会有精英怪，精英怪后会有boss怪，boss怪后会出现破防的外神投影。

别看他的小伙伴们都是传说，但放眼整个世界，传说职阶的人不多，至少不能一个城镇一个。

外神投影，没有传说职阶的战士攻击，连血皮都蹭不破。他和秦琅要迅速杀掉外神投影，然后去支援其他城镇，帮他们杀掉外神投影，保住更多的城池。

即使他和秦琅不会力竭，为了在最短的时间杀死外神投影，他们也需要严格管理力量消耗，不能被小怪耗掉力气。

戴蒙道：“反正你们是城主，就听你们的了。”

甩掉责任，一身轻松。戴蒙吃好睡好，只负责完成夏兮风和秦琅给的任务。

夏兮风很快把真相写出来，张贴到城里各个地方。

太阳花山谷的半身人们是太阳的守护家族，几乎人人都知道真相。神战发生了这么多年，稍稍敏锐一点的人，也都猜到了大部分真相。

所谓“不知道真相”，只是没有人告诉他们，他们的猜测是真的。

现在，希望之城的城主张贴告示，告诉所有城民，你们猜测的是真的，最艰难的时刻到来，这场战争我们必须胜利，否则连平静的死亡都是奢求。

除了真相，夏兮风还到处分发早就写好的《末世生存须知》小册子，书店和各类公会都有贩卖末世怪物图鉴。

环境巨变，怎么躲避危险，怎么获取食物和水源，怎么寻找安全的露宿地点……游戏里的资料被夏兮风带了出来，变成人们迅速适应这个世界的食粮。

夏兮风拍拍脑袋。

以前他认为自己记忆力好，现在他怀疑这些游戏资料是系统自带，灌输给他的。

就算他再喜欢研究剧情，也不可能背下这么细致的游戏设定资料吧？哪个玩家会认真看游戏里的求生指导啊？又不是末世生存类的全息游戏。

在他适应神火后，脑袋里的资料更清晰了。这就是传说中的“传承记忆”吗？

公布真相后的结果，比夏兮风预想的还好。

他想过大致上人们应该能振作起来，但初期肯定还是会有人因绝望而逃避。

没想到，城里秩序井然有序，居民踊跃参与守城，要和希望之城共存亡。

好吧，这个其实还是想到过。

夏兮风万万没想到的是，自己和秦琅这两个甩手城主的声望急速提高，瞬间被城民信任，风头盖过了兢兢业业地真·城主戴蒙。

戴蒙倒是惊讶前一点，对夏兮风和秦琅的声望提高一点都不惊讶。

城民身处迷茫，虽然浑浑噩噩的活着，但不知道明天还会有怎样的噩梦。

他们的城主突然告诉他们，这就是最大的噩梦了，之后每一步抗争都是往更好的路走。

迷雾给你们拨开，目标给你们确定，能做的事也全部告知你，末世求生的每一个步骤都和你说得清清楚楚，只需要你照做。对绝望迷惘的人而言，这样的城主与神明无异。

夏兮风笑道：“你的答案能回答我的疑问，也能回答你的疑问啊。”

如果知道真相后发现自己无能为力，那人们确实会陷入更深的绝望。可现在的真相不是这样啊。

敌人可以杀死，规则可以修正，世界可以拯救，反正也不愿意死去，那就活得更有希望一些。

城主不是已经告诉他们末世该怎么活了吗？就算是没有魔力的普通人，拿起武器也能杀掉许多毁掉他们家园的坏东西。

戴蒙看着夏兮风吹着口哨开心地去整理后勤，沉默了许久，许久。

他长长舒了一口气，笑道：“风比我们这些本土居民，更相信我们自己啊。”

有伟力的世界，即使强者不欺辱弱者，也会认为弱者无论身体还是精神都一样脆弱，根本无法面对世界的真相。

夏兮风却认为，拯救世界也需要这些普通人的力量。就算不能上战场，这世界还有许多事能做呢。

戴蒙使劲拍了拍脸颊，热情满满地再次投入繁重的工作。

……

在血色满月，不见银月的那一日白天，怪物已经向各处最重要的城池涌来。

夏兮风激活了城墙的法阵，只留下正门处的空隙。

怪物智商不高，会顺从本能选择最薄弱的地方进攻，所以控制法阵的强弱，就能将怪物集中。

这也是天父的压制。

外神自已经被毁灭的时间逃来，除了祂们自己，没有携带其他造物。祂们的爪牙都要现培养。

因天父的规则压制，祂们在这个世界培养的造物不会成为智慧生物，只能遵循战斗的本能。

Chapter 100: Two Chapters Combined (Part 1)

If Damon was prone to psychological issues, others surely would be as well.

Xia Xifeng decided that before the battle began, he would provide psychological counseling to the people in the city.

The "counseling" he spoke of was not a pre-battle pep talk, but rather the act of revealing the truth to the citizens.

Damon was initially opposed to this.

He believed that the mental fortitude of ordinary people was too fragile to withstand such heavy truths. If Xia Xifeng told them the reality of their situation, the city would surely descend into chaos.

Xia Xifeng, however, did not think so.

"Do not underestimate people's will to survive," Xia Xifeng said. "Having seen the world change so drastically, anyone with a brain can guess how desperate things have become. Walking into a dead end while knowing nothing is already despair enough. Only when they know the truth will hope be born in the depths of their hearts."

Qin Lang had always been rational, often holding views contrary to Xia Xifeng's. This time, however, he stood on Xia Xifeng's side.

If they only knew that the enemy possessed not a shred of mercy, that surrendering meant death—or that even death itself was a luxury, and their souls might not even find rest in the embrace of the God of Death—then what was there left to despair over?

They had to win. As long as they could win, their souls would at least be able to enter the embrace of the God of Death.

The hometown of Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang had once faced a crisis of national extinction. Although that crisis could not be compared to the scale of an apocalypse, for that nation, it was exactly like the end of the world.

The numb populace had once thought it was just an ordinary warlord skirmish, and that whoever won was simply who they would follow.

It wasn't until massacre after massacre occurred that they learned the truth of the war: that they could not surrender, and they could not lose. A total war involving the entire population was the only way out.

Both men firmly believed that the Dream World was the same.

If what was described in *Wonderland Fantasy* was truly the reality of the Dream World, then the people of this world must be like the native NPCs in the game—possessing hearts that could resonate with the players from Huaxia.

They would not yield to despair; they would only fight back.

"With two demigods holding the fort, Hope City cannot fall. It is the perfect place to try this," Xia Xifeng said. "If Qin Lang and I are correct, other cities can follow suit."

Damon conceded, "Fine. You are the City Lords; you make the calls. Do you mean to let the citizens defend against the monsters themselves?"

Xia Xifeng nodded. "When there are monsters that require Qin Lang and me to intervene, we will act. You will do the same. This is war."

Damon’s lips moved, but in the end, he said nothing and simply nodded in agreement.

That is how war works.

Soldiers against soldiers, generals against generals, kings against kings. You cannot use a king to kill a foot soldier, nor a general to kill a pawn; you do not trade unequal pieces.

Damon gave a bitter smile. "You are actually more adapted to the apocalypse than I am."

Xia Xifeng shook his head. "I’m just a keyboard warrior."

Of course, he didn't understand warfare; he only knew that in the game's siege battles, after the ordinary monsters were thinned out, elite monsters would appear, followed by bosses, and finally, the projections of Outer Gods that could break through defenses.

Even though his companions were all Legends, looking at the world as a whole, there were not many people of the Legendary rank—certainly not one for every town.

Without the attacks of Legendary-rank warriors, one couldn't even scratch the surface of an Outer God's projection. He and Qin Lang had to kill these projections quickly and then support other towns, helping them eliminate their own projections to preserve more cities.

Even if he and Qin Lang would not be exhausted, in order to kill the projections in the shortest time possible, they needed to strictly manage their energy consumption and not waste it on small fry.

Damon said, "Anyway, you are the City Lords, so I’ll listen to you."

Shrugging off the responsibility, he felt a weight lifted. Damon ate well and slept well, responsible only for completing the tasks given to him by Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang.

Xia Xifeng quickly wrote down the truth and posted it in various places throughout the city.

The Halflings of Sunflower Valley were the guardian family of the sun, and almost everyone among them knew the truth. After so many years of the War of Gods, those who were even slightly perceptive had already guessed most of the truth.

The so-called "not knowing the truth" was simply that no one had told them their guesses were correct.

Now, the City Lords of Hope City posted notices, telling all citizens: your guesses are true, the most difficult moment has arrived, and we must win this war, otherwise, even a peaceful death will be a luxury.

In addition to the truth, Xia Xifeng distributed pamphlets he had written long ago titled *Essentials for Apocalyptic Survival*, and bookstores and various guilds began selling bestiaries of apocalyptic monsters.

How to avoid danger in a drastically changed environment, how to obtain food and water, how to find safe places to camp... the data from the game was brought out by Xia Xifeng, becoming the sustenance people needed to quickly adapt to this world.

Xia Xifeng patted his head.

He used to think he had a good memory, but now he suspected that this game data was brought by the system and instilled into him.

Even if he loved studying the plot, he couldn't possibly memorize such detailed game settings, right? Which player would seriously read the survival guides in a game? It wasn't like it was a holographic apocalypse survival game.

After he adapted to the Divine Fire, the data in his head became even clearer. Was this the legendary "inherited memory"?

The result of revealing the truth was even better than Xia Xifeng had anticipated.

He had thought that while people would generally be able to pull themselves together, there would certainly be some who would try to escape through despair in the beginning.

Unexpectedly, the city remained orderly, and the residents eagerly participated in the defense, vowing to live and die with Hope City.

Well, he had actually anticipated that part.

What Xia Xifeng never expected was that the reputation of himself and Qin Lang—these two hands-off City Lords—would skyrocket, instantly gaining the trust of the citizens and overshadowing the diligent, true City Lord, Damon.

Damon was surprised by the former, but not at all surprised by the rise in Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang's reputation.

The citizens were living in confusion, existing in a daze, not knowing what kind of nightmare tomorrow would bring.

Their City Lords had suddenly told them that this was the greatest nightmare, and that every step of resistance afterward was a path toward something better.

The fog had been cleared for them, their goals had been set, everything they could do had been explained, and every step of surviving the apocalypse had been spelled out clearly—they only needed to follow instructions. To people lost in despair, such City Lords were no different from gods.

Xia Xifeng laughed. "Your answer can solve my doubts, and it can also solve yours."

If people discovered they were powerless after knowing the truth, they would indeed fall into deeper despair. But the truth wasn't like that now.

The enemy could be killed, the rules could be corrected, and the world could be saved. Since they didn't want to die anyway, they might as well live with more hope.

Hadn't the City Lords already told them how to live through the apocalypse? Even ordinary people without magic could pick up weapons and kill many of the bad things that destroyed their homes.

Damon watched as Xia Xifeng whistled happily while going to organize logistics, and he remained silent for a long, long time.

He let out a long sigh and smiled. "Feng believes in us more than we, the native inhabitants, do ourselves."

In a world with great power, even if the strong do not bully the weak, they still believe the weak are fragile in both body and spirit, unable to face the truth of the world.

Xia Xifeng, however, believed that saving the world also required the strength of these ordinary people. Even if they couldn't go to the battlefield, there were still many things to be done in this world.

Damon slapped his cheeks hard and threw himself back into his heavy workload with renewed enthusiasm.

...

On the day of the Blood-Red Full Moon, when the Silver Moon was nowhere to be seen, the monsters began to surge toward the most important cities.

Xia Xifeng activated the magic arrays on the city walls, leaving only a gap at the main gate.

Monsters did not have high intelligence; they would instinctively choose the weakest point to attack. Therefore, by controlling the strength of the arrays, they could concentrate the monsters.

This was also the suppression of the Heavenly Father.

The Outer Gods had fled from a time that had already been destroyed; they had brought no creations with them other than themselves. Their minions had to be cultivated from scratch.

Due to the suppression of the Heavenly Father's rules, the creatures they cultivated in this world would not become intelligent beings; they could only follow the instinct to fight.

chunks.chineseText:
而祂们引诱的爪牙，会在末世来临时被引爆，即使转化成了怪物，属于智慧生灵的“智慧”，也会变成动物的“聪明”。

祂们需要指挥战斗时，只能投下自己的投影。

繁殖怪物需要神力，投影被杀损失的神力更多，还会消耗神火和神格的力量。这便是外神在末世之初第一次总攻失败后，末世局势趋于稳定，延缓滑向毁灭的理由。

玩家们就参与了这一场战争。

在玩家眼中，大部分惨烈的战争画面都是通过游戏过场动画窥得一斑。在过场动画中，各种游戏中没有出现过的大型魔导武器很是让玩家眼馋。

如今，希望之城的城墙上布满了曾经让玩家眼馋的大型魔导武器，大部分都是出自夏兮风之手。

地面震动，彩色的迷雾从远处涌来。

一群美丽又怪诞的生物欢快地跑来，脸上还带着诡谲的笑容，仿佛荒诞梦境中无害的童话生物。

跑近之后，人们才能看到那群远看美丽的生物上带血的牙齿利爪，刺破外皮的狰狞骨刺，血肉间扭动如蛆虫的血管，和那颠三倒四就像是无知孩童胡乱捏成的五官……令人毛骨悚然。

“开炮。”夏兮风点开系统地图，下达命令。

魔导炮齐齐轰鸣，火光在彩色迷雾中炸开，焦臭的味道弥漫。

彩色雾气被撕裂了一瞬，顷刻又重新聚拢，怪物潮像是丝毫没有受到攻击。

魔导炮持续轰鸣。每一次轰鸣都能撕裂彩色迷雾，每一次都能清空一小片兽潮，但又每一次都会重新被迷雾和怪物填满。

怪物似乎无穷无尽，攻击似乎毫无作用。

但守城的人眼中没有怯懦退缩。

城主早就说了，只要扛过夜晚，当太阳出现的时候，怪物潮就会暂时退去，等到血月再次出现的时候才会出现。

只要守到血色满月变成半月，他们就能扛过攻击。

知道什么时候战争会结束，他们就不会绝望。即使城主的话毫无依据，但只要血色半月没到来，城主的话没有变成谎言，他们就不会退缩。

魔导炮一直没有停止攻击。

夏兮风双目中纯粹的金色替代了瞳孔和眼白：“每次怪物潮遭遇炮火袭击的时候，怪物潮的接近会停滞一到三分钟。怪物的等级略有增加。”

在夏兮风的眼中，这些怪物都如在游戏中一样标注了等级。

通过“鉴定术”，夏兮风清晰地看到，怪物被袭击了几轮之后，补充的怪物等级正在一级一级上升。

这样看上去怪物潮好像在变强，但其实证明怪物潮和游戏中的逻辑一样，怪物池是有上限的，不是真的无限刷怪。当怪物潮的小怪被杀光时，一定会刷出boss，杀掉boss，怪物潮就会提前结束。

也就是说，如果他们这里杀怪杀得够快，他和秦琅便能支援其他城镇。

夏兮风合眼，仰头。

他再睁开眼的时候，站在他身侧的秦琅已经拿出眼药水，给他滋润眼睛。

秦琅一边给夏兮风滴眼药水，一边把夏兮风的观察和分析发给小伙伴，又小伙伴转到神眷者群中，然后再分发给各个势力。

夏兮风使劲眨了眨恢复正常的眼睛，抱怨道：“为什么莱欧他们不把我俩拉进神眷者群？”

莱欧和佩瑞拉已经回答过许多次了。神眷者群是各个神灵用神力编制成的特殊联络方式，与他和夏兮风的系统聊天类似。因为他和夏兮风身上没有本土普通神灵的神眷者印迹，所以不能加群。

夏兮风知道原因，仍旧不断抱怨。秦琅懒得回答。

回答了，夏兮风下次想抱怨时还是会抱怨。

知道猛烈攻击有用后，夏兮风不再吝啬魔晶石，炮火攻击更加猛烈。

黄昏时，太阳即将落山，满月光辉如血雾般笼罩大地，经过炮火拖延的怪物群终于临近了城门。

随着血色月光的落下，面容美丽诡谲的怪物发生变化。它们的身体变得更加庞大，尖牙利爪变得更加狰狞，凶性更加外显，速度和攻击都有所增长。

夏兮风再次使用鉴定术。怪物的等级没变，多了个“血月buff”——这一点也和游戏中一样。

“起！”夏兮风按下触发器，怪物群踩着的地面冒出许多光网，禁锢住怪物的动作，变成“墙”挡住后面的怪物。

魔导炮停止了一瞬，调校后继续发射，炮火在“墙”边炸开。

怪物潮靠近城墙的速度大大减缓，低等级怪物被黏在光网上，不断被炮火收割。

直至夜幕降临。

血色月光更加明亮，完全笼罩了夜晚，怪物攻击更加狂暴，终于要接近城墙。

城门大开。城卫军在骑着类似马匹的陆行兽的骑兵率领下，排成整齐的方阵出城迎战。

城卫军的骑士兵团都是职业者，但步兵方阵都是普通士兵，单打独斗能力不强，只有小队长是高等职业者。小队长全是治疗。

现实战争没有友伤豁免，这也是强者不能过早进入战斗的原因。

夏兮风的“组队”邀请只能针对好友，没有团战敌我标注。如果秦琅下场战斗，光是使用力量的威压都能干扰普通士兵的战斗。

希望之城是一座年轻的城池，但因为有钱，很有钱，非常有钱，勤勤恳恳的戴蒙代理城主加紧训练了一批职业军队。

光网和魔导炮继续攻击。骑士冲锋，如尖刀撕裂逃脱光网和魔导炮拦截的怪物潮。步兵方阵紧随其后，将零散怪物吞噬。

血肉的碰撞正式开始。

夏兮风再次闭上眼睛，如影子般站在他身旁的秦琅再次给他滴眼药水，为他按摩眼睛。

待夏兮风眼睛舒服了些后，他继续观测怪物潮的情况。

当怪物潮的等级增加到精英怪该出现的时候，夏兮风下令，普通士兵退回城中，精英小队出城。

精英小队都是中高等的战斗职业者，每个队伍都配备完整辅助、治疗、近战、远程等职业。

他们冲出城池，每个小队各自为战又互相支援，扑向纸面数据已经很熟悉的怪物。

秦琅早就编纂了怪物图鉴。在怪物潮来临之前，他和夏兮风就整理了怪物潮中会出现的怪物数据，城里连小孩都倒背如流。

看见熟悉的怪物出现，城民都很兴奋。

城主所说的果然是正确的！城主已经料到了一切！我们只要战斗，一定能脱离噩梦！

“今夜恐怕轮不到我出场了。”戴蒙道。

夏兮风摇头：“我烧了这么多钱，就是要逼得今天你也下场。”

戴蒙笑道：“那好，我去热身等着。”

戴蒙离开城墙，回城里清点物资。这么猛烈的攻击，确实烧了好多魔晶石，肉疼啊。

秦琅对夏兮风道：“暂时僵持。你休息一会儿。”

夏兮风没有拒绝：“战局有变就叫醒我。”

夏兮风安置好隔音魔法阵后，闭眼冥想。

秦琅走进魔法阵，把夏兮风抱进怀里：“躺着休息。”

夏兮风嘀咕：“在战场上搂搂抱抱不太好吧？”

虽然这么说，他还是靠在秦琅怀里躺着冥想了。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 100: Two Chapters Combined (Part 2)

The minions they lured would be "detonated" when the apocalypse arrived. Even if they were transformed into monsters, the "intelligence" belonging to sentient beings would be reduced to the "cleverness" of animals.

When they needed to command a battle, they could only cast their own projections.

Breeding monsters required divine power, and having a projection killed resulted in an even greater loss of divine power, as well as the consumption of Divine Fire and Divinity. This was the reason why, after the Outer Gods' first general offensive failed at the beginning of the apocalypse, the situation stabilized and the world's slide toward destruction was delayed.

The players participated in this war.

In the eyes of the players, most of the tragic scenes of war were only glimpsed through game cutscenes. In those cutscenes, various large-scale magitech weapons that had never appeared in the game made the players quite envious.

Now, the walls of Hope City were covered with those large-scale magitech weapons that had once made players drool, most of which were crafted by Xia Xifeng’s own hands.

The ground shook, and colorful mist surged from the distance.

A group of beautiful yet grotesque creatures ran over joyfully, wearing eerie smiles on their faces, as if they were harmless fairy-tale creatures from an absurd dream.

Only when they ran closer could people see the bloody fangs and sharp claws on these creatures that looked beautiful from afar, the hideous bone spurs piercing through their skin, the blood vessels wriggling like maggots between their flesh, and the jumbled facial features that looked like they had been haphazardly molded by an ignorant child... it was hair-raising.

"Fire," Xia Xifeng said, tapping the system map to issue the order.

The magitech cannons roared in unison. Firelight exploded within the colorful mist, and a scorched, foul stench filled the air.

The colorful mist was torn apart for an instant, only to gather again immediately. The monster tide seemed completely unaffected by the attack.

The magitech cannons continued to roar. Every roar tore through the colorful mist, and every time, a small patch of the beast tide was cleared, only to be filled in again by more mist and monsters.

The monsters seemed endless, and the attacks seemed useless.

But there was no cowardice or retreat in the eyes of those defending the city.

The City Lord had said long ago that as long as they held out through the night, the monster tide would temporarily retreat when the sun appeared, and would only return when the Blood Moon appeared again.

As long as they held out until the Blood-Red Full Moon turned into a half-moon, they would survive the attack.

Knowing when the war would end meant they would not fall into despair. Even if the City Lord's words had no basis, as long as the Blood-Red Half-Moon had not arrived, the City Lord’s words had not become lies, and they would not retreat.

The magitech cannons never stopped firing.

In Xia Xifeng's eyes, pure gold replaced his pupils and whites. "Every time the monster tide is hit by artillery fire, their approach stalls for one to three minutes. The level of the monsters has increased slightly."

In Xia Xifeng's eyes, these monsters were labeled with levels just as they were in the game.

Through "Appraisal," Xia Xifeng could clearly see that after the monsters were attacked several rounds, the levels of the incoming monsters were rising, one level at a time.

It looked like the monster tide was getting stronger, but in reality, it proved that the monster tide followed the same logic as the game: there was a cap on the monster pool; it wasn't truly infinite spawning. When the small fry of the monster tide were killed off, a boss would definitely spawn. Kill the boss, and the monster tide would end early.

In other words, if they killed the monsters fast enough here, he and Qin Lang could support other towns.

Xia Xifeng closed his eyes and tilted his head back.

When he opened them again, Qin Lang, standing by his side, had already taken out eye drops to soothe his eyes.

While applying the drops, Qin Lang sent Xia Xifeng's observations and analysis to their companions, who then forwarded them to the group of God-Favored Ones, and from there, they were distributed to various factions.

Xia Xifeng blinked his eyes, which had returned to normal, and complained, "Why won't Leo and the others add us to the God-Favored Ones group?"

Leo and Perilla had already answered this many times. The God-Favored Ones group was a special communication method woven by various gods using divine power, similar to the system chat he and Xia Xifeng used. Because he and Xia Xifeng did not bear the marks of the native, ordinary gods' favor, they could not join the group.

Xia Xifeng knew the reason, yet he continued to complain. Qin Lang was too lazy to answer.

Even if he answered, Xia Xifeng would just complain again next time.

Knowing that the fierce attacks were effective, Xia Xifeng no longer skimped on magic crystals, and the artillery fire became even more intense.

At dusk, as the sun was about to set and the full moon's radiance shrouded the earth like blood mist, the monster group, delayed by the artillery fire, finally approached the city gates.

As the blood-red moonlight fell, the beautiful and eerie-looking monsters changed. Their bodies became larger, their fangs and claws became more hideous, their ferocity became more apparent, and both their speed and attack power increased.

Xia Xifeng used Appraisal again. The monsters' levels hadn't changed, but they had gained a "Blood Moon Buff"—this, too, was just like in the game.

"Rise!" Xia Xifeng pressed the trigger, and many light nets emerged from the ground the monsters were treading on, binding their movements and forming a "wall" to block the monsters behind them.

The magitech cannons stopped for a moment, adjusted, and then continued to fire, the shells exploding near the "wall."

The speed at which the monster tide approached the city walls was greatly slowed. Low-level monsters were stuck on the light nets, constantly being harvested by the artillery fire.

Until night fell completely.

The blood-red moonlight became brighter, fully enveloping the night. The monsters' attacks became more violent, and they were finally about to reach the city walls.

The city gates swung open. The City Guard, led by cavalry riding land-beasts similar to horses, formed neat phalanxes and marched out of the city to meet the enemy.

The cavalry regiments of the City Guard were all professionals, but the infantry phalanxes were all ordinary soldiers. Their individual combat ability was not strong; only the squad leaders were high-level professionals. And all the squad leaders were healers.

In real-world warfare, there was no "friendly fire immunity," which was why the strong could not enter the battle too early.

Xia Xifeng's "party" invitation could only target friends and did not mark enemies or allies in group battles. If Qin Lang entered the fight, the mere pressure of his power would interfere with the combat of the ordinary soldiers.

Hope City was a young city, but because it was rich—very rich, extremely rich—the acting City Lord, the diligent Damon, had stepped up the training of a professional army.

The light nets and magitech cannons continued their assault. The cavalry charged, tearing through the monster tide that had escaped the nets and artillery like a sharp knife. The infantry phalanxes followed closely behind, swallowing up the scattered monsters.

The collision of flesh and blood officially began.

Xia Xifeng closed his eyes again, and Qin Lang, standing beside him like a shadow, once again applied eye drops and massaged his eyes.

After Xia Xifeng's eyes felt more comfortable, he continued to observe the situation of the monster tide.

When the level of the monster tide increased to the point where elite monsters should appear, Xia Xifeng ordered the ordinary soldiers to retreat into the city, and the elite squads to move out.

The elite squads were all mid-to-high-level combat professionals, and each team was fully equipped with support, healing, melee, and ranged roles.

They rushed out of the city, each team fighting independently while supporting one another, pouncing on monsters whose data they were already very familiar with.

Qin Lang had long since compiled a bestiary. Before the monster tide arrived, he and Xia Xifeng had organized the data of the monsters that would appear, and even the children in the city could recite it by heart.

Seeing the familiar monsters appear, the citizens were very excited.

The City Lord was indeed correct! The City Lord had foreseen everything! As long as we fight, we will definitely be able to escape the nightmare!

"I’m afraid it won't be my turn to enter the fray tonight," Damon said.

Xia Xifeng shook his head. "I burned through so much money precisely to force you to enter the fray today."

Damon laughed. "Alright then, I’ll go warm up and wait."

Damon left the city wall and returned to the city to take stock of supplies. Such intense attacks really did burn through a lot of magic crystals; it hurt his heart.

Qin Lang said to Xia Xifeng, "It’s a stalemate for now. Rest for a while."

Xia Xifeng did not refuse. "Wake me up if the battle situation changes."

After Xia Xifeng set up a sound-insulation magic array, he closed his eyes to meditate.

Qin Lang walked into the magic array and pulled Xia Xifeng into his arms. "Lie down and rest."

Xia Xifeng muttered, "Isn't it a bit inappropriate to be cuddling on the battlefield?"

Although he said that, he still leaned into Qin Lang's arms and meditated.

chunks.chineseText:
秦琅挥了挥手，分出一个分/身监视战场。他和夏兮风的身影变得模糊，旁人看不真切：“这样好了。”

夏兮风往秦琅怀里拱了拱，干脆直接睡觉了。

血色满月滑过中天，精英小队不断退回城中休息。

秦琅叫醒了夏兮风。夏兮风观测了怪物潮新的等级后，命令精英小队退回城里，骑士团带领步兵团继续出城攻击。

这次骑士团和步兵团的伤亡增加，但仍旧维持了战线。

时间终于进入了后半夜。

精英小队再次出城，骑士团和步兵团再次退后，但没有退回城里。

当精灵小队与怪物厮杀的时候，骑兵团和步兵团负责解决漏掉的小怪。

战局越发惨烈，但一切有条不紊，完全按照夏兮风和秦琅之前预想的方向进行。

当这批精英小boss怪被杀干净后，血月也如夏兮风和秦琅所想，直接降下了光柱，深红色的月光就像是粘稠的血液，在战场上蔓延。

夏兮风打出了新的信号，所有城卫军全部回城。

“戴蒙，休息够了？”夏兮风转头。

戴蒙活动手腕：“早就够了。”

他飞入战场。城门中又有队伍出城，紧随戴蒙奔向战场。

这些队伍中的人是太阳花山谷的半身人战士，招募的佣兵强者，太阳、银月等神殿的骑士和神官……他们虽然没达到传说，但互相配合，支援戴蒙完全没问题。

血月投影前的boss战，都由他们解决。

如果夏兮风和秦琅没来，这样的配置也是每个城池最终能拿出的最强配置。

粘稠的血色月光将战场的怪物全部融化，血泥融合在一起，几个用言语难以形容其恶心扭曲长相的怪物出现在战场中。

外神侵入梦世界后，低等级怪物已经变得美丽，高等级怪物仍旧恶心，越强大的怪物长得越古怪。

“我们也该热身了。”夏兮风对秦琅道。

秦琅：“嗯。”

如影子般毫无存在感的秦琅，突然出现在了众人视线中。

他其实一直都在，一直没有隐藏身形，但不知道为何，旁人总是忽视了他的存在。明明他也是深受城民爱戴的城主，存在感应该挺强。

夏兮风又整理了一下背包物品位置：“我们是第一次在现实中面对血月投影啊，不知道行不行。”

“不行就死。”秦琅言简意赅，半句安慰人心的话都不肯给夏兮风。

夏兮风轻踹了秦琅一脚：“说点好听的。我紧张。”

秦琅把夏兮风揽住：“祂死我们活。”

夏兮风电投：“这才对。”

两人的身影消失在月色中。

战场中，戴蒙已经摘下了怪物的头颅。

他抬头，看见月光再次降下。

“回去。”他命令身后的战士离开，自己留在了战场上。

夏兮风和秦琅出现在他的身边。

几道光芒在戴蒙的身体上闪烁，他身上的伤口消失，干涸的精神力和魔力重新变得饱满。

“这还是我们第一次并肩作战吧？”戴蒙转头笑道。

夏兮风对戴蒙眨眼：“说不定不是第一次哦。”

戴蒙道：“和‘我’，绝对是第一次。”

“这倒是。”夏兮风点头。游戏中的“戴蒙”，当然不是他的好朋友“戴蒙”。

“放心，有我在，你死不了。”夏兮风想了想，补充道，“只要你不被秒杀。”

戴蒙嘴角抽搐：“你闭嘴吧！”

夏兮风笑道：“我又不是乌鸦嘴。”

秦琅松开夏兮风，向前一步，为夏兮风挡住神灵投影所带来的威压。

夏兮风从秦琅身后探出脑袋：“果然如我所料，当我们刷怪刷得够快，血月就会破例在满月夜提前投影。”

攻城战投影只有一次，按照常理应该在最后一夜投影。这时候的血月投影最为衰弱。攻城战基本只要熬到十五天后，就能成功磨死投影，守住城池。

游戏中大部分城池都是在城里巷战拖住怪物，熬到最后一天与血月投影血战。

不过游戏后期攻城战，玩家的等级已经很高了。那时候玩家的公会城池虽然在游戏中是单独地图，但在设定中也存在梦世界中，是怪物潮攻击的对象。

玩家既要守公会城池，还要守NPC城池，时间就不够了。这时游戏设定，只要玩家在第一天刷够一定数量的怪，血月就会提前按投下神灵投影。

剧情是这么解释的，血月也想在力量最强的时候投影，但梦世界规则不允许。只有积攒足够多的怪物尸体和精魄，血月才能破开限制，在最强大的时候强行投影。

作者有话要说：

二更合一，倒地不起。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 100: Two Chapters Combined (Part 3)

Qin Lang waved his hand, splitting off a clone to monitor the battlefield. His and Xia Xifeng's figures became blurred, making it difficult for others to see them clearly. "This is better."

Xia Xifeng snuggled into Qin Lang's arms and simply fell asleep.

The Blood-Red Full Moon slid across the zenith, and the elite squads constantly retreated into the city to rest.

Qin Lang woke Xia Xifeng up. After Xia Xifeng observed the new levels of the monster tide, he ordered the elite squads to retreat into the city, and the cavalry and infantry regiments continued to move out to attack.

This time, the casualties of the cavalry and infantry regiments increased, but they still maintained the front line.

Time finally entered the second half of the night.

The elite squads moved out of the city again, and the cavalry and infantry regiments retreated again, but they did not retreat back into the city.

While the elite squads fought the monsters, the cavalry and infantry regiments were responsible for cleaning up the stragglers.

The battle became increasingly tragic, but everything was orderly, proceeding exactly in the direction Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang had envisioned.

When this batch of elite "mini-boss" monsters was wiped out, the Blood Moon, just as Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang had expected, directly lowered a pillar of light. The deep crimson moonlight, like viscous blood, spread across the battlefield.

Xia Xifeng signaled a new command, and all City Guards returned to the city.

"Damon, rested enough?" Xia Xifeng turned his head.

Damon flexed his wrists. "Long enough."

He flew into the battlefield. More teams emerged from the city gates, following Damon as they rushed toward the fray.

The people in these teams were Halfling warriors from Sunflower Valley, recruited mercenary powerhouses, and knights and priests from the temples of the Sun, Silver Moon, and others... Although they had not reached the Legendary rank, they coordinated well and had no trouble supporting Damon.

The boss battles before the Blood Moon projection were all handled by them.

If Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang hadn't come, this configuration would have been the strongest setup each city could ultimately field.

The viscous blood-red moonlight melted all the monsters on the battlefield, their blood and mud fusing together. Several monsters, whose disgusting and twisted appearances defied description, appeared on the battlefield.

After the Outer Gods invaded the Dream World, the low-level monsters had become beautiful, but the high-level monsters remained disgusting; the more powerful the monster, the more bizarre it looked.

"It's time for us to warm up too," Xia Xifeng said to Qin Lang.

Qin Lang: "Mm."

Qin Lang, who had been as inconspicuous as a shadow, suddenly appeared in everyone's line of sight.

He had actually been there the whole time, never hiding his figure, but for some reason, others always ignored his presence. Even though he was also a City Lord deeply loved by the citizens, his presence should have been quite strong.

Xia Xifeng rearranged the items in his backpack. "This is our first time facing a Blood Moon projection in reality. I don't know if we can handle it."

"If we can't, we die," Qin Lang said, concise and to the point, refusing to offer even half a word of comfort to Xia Xifeng.

Xia Xifeng gave Qin Lang a light kick. "Say something nice. I'm nervous."

Qin Lang pulled Xia Xifeng close. "If it dies, we live."

Xia Xifeng nodded. "That's more like it."

Their figures vanished into the moonlight.

On the battlefield, Damon had already severed the head of a monster.

He looked up and saw the moonlight descending once more.

"Go back," he ordered the warriors behind him to leave, remaining on the battlefield himself.

Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang appeared beside him.

Several rays of light flickered over Damon's body; the wounds on him vanished, and his depleted mental energy and mana became full once again.

"This is our first time fighting side-by-side, right?" Damon turned and smiled.

Xia Xifeng winked at Damon. "Maybe not the first time."

Damon said, "With 'me,' it is definitely the first time."

"That's true," Xia Xifeng nodded. The "Damon" in the game was, of course, not his good friend "Damon."

"Don't worry, with me here, you won't die," Xia Xifeng thought for a moment and added, "As long as you don't get one-shot."

Damon's mouth twitched. "Shut up!"

Xia Xifeng laughed. "I'm not a jinx."

Qin Lang released Xia Xifeng and stepped forward, blocking the pressure brought by the god's projection for him.

Xia Xifeng poked his head out from behind Qin Lang. "Just as I expected, when we farm monsters fast enough, the Blood Moon will make an exception and project early on the night of the full moon."

There was only one projection per siege battle, which by common logic should occur on the final night. At that time, the Blood Moon projection would be at its weakest. Basically, as long as one could hold out for fifteen days, one could successfully grind the projection down and defend the city.

In the game, most cities would drag out the battle by fighting monsters in the alleys, holding out until the final day for a bloody battle against the Blood Moon projection.

However, in the late-game siege battles, the players' levels were already very high. At that time, although the players' guild cities were separate maps in the game, they existed in the Dream World in the lore and were targets of the monster tide's attacks.

Players had to defend both their guild cities and the NPC cities, so there wasn't enough time. The game lore explained that as long as players killed enough monsters on the first day, the Blood Moon would be forced to cast the god's projection early.

That was the plot explanation: the Blood Moon also wanted to project when it was at its strongest, but the rules of the Dream World did not allow it. Only by accumulating enough monster corpses and essence could the Blood Moon break the restrictions and force a projection when it was at its most powerful.

Two chapters combined, I'm collapsing.

第101章 一章半合一

夏兮风和秦琅不是第一次面对血月投影。

攻城战的神灵投影不一定是血月，比如三大国对战的就是其他神灵的投影。血月只是祂们的合作者，负责协助祂们投影，增强祂们和其爪牙的力量。

不过游戏中新手村绿沙城遇到的投影，确实是血月的。这次希望之城遇到的，也是血月的投影分/身。

血月的对手就是太阳和银月，自然不会选择其他地方。

这次血月投影十分难看，不是他们第一次在矮人梦境中看到的漂亮神灵，而与在假月亮的轮回梦境中见到的恶心肉山差不多。

这说明，血月很看得起希望城，投影的力量很强大。

不过就算进入了末世，血月投影所会的仍旧只有那几招。虽然祂的动作很多，但论力量运用方式，即“大招”就只有秦琅了解的那几种。

秦琅能在还不了解神灵的力量的时候，便在副本与血月投影斗得势均力敌，泰勒等人加入后，他立刻占据了上风，现在他已经熟悉了半神的力量，得到了自我之神和进化之神多番教导，力量今非昔比。

别看戴蒙不是神眷者，他的年龄比莱欧和佩瑞拉大多了，战斗经验也多太多。即使第一次与神灵投影作战，也完全没有拖秦琅后腿，辅助补刀做得十分完美。

夏兮风除了给两人加状态，似乎就没有其他可做的事，可以等着这场守城战宣告胜利了——游戏中神灵投影被杀，神灵被“杀”的“神怨”飘荡，与神灵相关的造物就不敢过来。这就是说，不再有怪物潮攻城，顶多有一些感觉不到“神怨”的弱小怪物游荡，连普通人都能杀死它们。

这个时候，就是普通人出城狩猎，积攒资源的时候。

夏兮风抬头看着血月沉思。

他对秦琅十分信任，此番希望城的守城战在他心中已经宣告胜利。

既然胜利来得很轻松，他便不想让胜利止步于此。

在试炼之地的十年间，他对神火的掌握虽然没有秦琅熟练，但了解了很多神灵知识。系统已经变成了他的辅助。

夏兮风将自己的设想输入系统，让系统模拟可能性，并根据他的预想寻找材料。

他的双眼又变成了纯金色，无数信息在他的双眼中流过。他嘴角紧抿的模样，像极了平时的秦琅。

片刻，血月投影发现秦琅和戴蒙很不好应对，开始发地图炮大招。

攻击难免落在夏兮风面前。

夏兮风一动不动，脑海中继续模拟、计算。

一抹暗影飞速从夏兮风的手腕飞出，一道淡薄的人影飞速击散了朝向夏兮风的所有攻击。夏兮风连防御魔法阵都没激活，此次攻击就被挡了下来。

戴蒙抽空看了夏兮风一眼，对秦琅道：“你守在风身旁的分/身是自动触发？”

秦琅：“不是。”

戴蒙嘴角抽了抽。秦琅都能给分/身寄托意识了？那不和叔父差不多了？半神都这么厉害吗？他好不容易爬上传说，看来还不够啊。

见夏兮风身旁有人守护，戴蒙不再分心，继续帮秦琅在血月投影攻击的缝隙中磨血。

夏兮风则开始动了。

他保持着鉴定术，飞速拿出材料，用神火一一分解之后，色彩缤纷的丝线在半空中缠绕成复杂的花纹。

夏兮风在地上行走，丝线落在了地上，花纹拼凑成了一个极其复杂的魔法阵。

血月投影似乎意识到了什么，向夏兮风攻来。

但祂立刻被秦琅挡住并击飞，反而离夏兮风更远了。即使祂想使用远程攻击，也被戴蒙和守护在夏兮风身旁的影子挡下。

夏兮风继续设置魔法阵，并在其中安置不知道用途的魔导器。

过了近一个小时，夏兮风才停下来，吃下补蓝的药品，闭眼冥想。

他冥想了足足一个小时，才又睁开眼。

夏兮风拿出前几次副本的奖励——太阳、月亮、水、自我、进化、智慧的神明信物。

太阳、月亮和水安放在一套魔法阵中，自我、进化、智慧安放在另一套魔法阵中。自然形成的概念神性和生灵形成的概念神性泾渭分明。

夏兮风拿出一把小匕首，划过自己的手腕。带着神性的血液滴落，如有意识般沿着他之前描绘的阵纹蔓延。

正常人体内不会有这么多血，但夏兮风是半神，所以他的“本体”其实不只是人类这么点大，他的血液可以覆盖整个阵纹。

在血液覆盖了一小片阵纹后，两种神性开始交汇融合，魔法阵徐徐亮起。

正淡漠地与血月投影的秦琅眉头一皱，猛地转头看向夏兮风，双眼中满是怒火。

暗影分/身按住了夏兮风的手。

“都做一半了，你现在阻止，我血白流了。”夏兮风道，“打你的，别管我，等魔法阵做完了，把血月赶进来。”

暗影分/身开口：“夏兮风，你别惹我生气。”

“嗯，我知道你肯定会生气。”夏兮风点头，“那又怎么了？你能拿我怎样？”

夏兮风看着暗影分/身的身影扭曲了一瞬，然后化作雾气回到了他的手腕上，努了努嘴。

如他所说，秦琅最初没发现他的小动作，当他血流了一半的时候，也不能阻止了。

不然血不是白流了？至少也让夏兮风把要做的事做完，让敌人也流更多的血。

不过夏兮风虽然嘴硬，心里还是有点发怵的。

他确实不怕秦琅发怒。秦琅要是生气，他能表现得比秦琅更生气，必须压制住秦琅的气势。

只有一次，秦琅生气的时候他没敢还嘴，秦琅差点和他绝交——他去某个农民工福利幼儿园当志愿者，正好遇到一个渣滓拿着刀进幼儿园报复社会。为了尽快制伏渣滓，他以伤换伤捅了渣滓一道，成功获得了全国见义勇为奖章和锦旗。

别人都认为夏兮风此番受伤情有可原，换个人不会比他更勇敢，也不会比他做得更好，何况他伤的是肩膀，不算严重。

但秦琅知道，夏兮风也清楚秦琅知道，当时的情况没到夏兮风必须以伤换伤的时候，夏兮风也不是一头脑热做出的决定。

小朋友们已经离开操场，保安已经拿着防暴叉赶来，报警电话已经拨出，渣滓身材瘦小力气和速度都不行，夏兮风就算想见义勇为，他身旁还有可以挡刀的板凳，以他的身手，肯定能与渣滓周转到保安和警察到来。

但夏兮风故意肩膀上挨了一刀，就为了捅凶手一刀，迅速解决所有危险，避免一切意外。

秦琅深呼吸了一下，对戴蒙道：“退后。”

戴蒙虽然不明所以，也赶紧退到夏兮风身边。

只是传说职阶的戴蒙与神灵投影作战自不敢分神，他一直盯着血月投影的攻击。等他退出战场的时候，他才发现夏兮风在用血液鼓捣什么。

他眉头狠狠一跳：“你是要把身体的血都流干吗？！”

夏兮风面色苍白：“流不干，我好歹也是个半神，就算这具躯壳没了也死不了。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 101: One and a Half Chapters Combined (Part 1)

This was not the first time Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang had faced a projection of the Blood Moon.

The god projections during a siege were not always the Blood Moon; for instance, the three great empires were currently battling projections of other deities. The Blood Moon was merely their collaborator, responsible for assisting in the manifestation of these projections and bolstering the strength of the gods and their minions.

However, the projection encountered in the novice village of Green Sand City in the game was indeed that of the Blood Moon. The one they faced now at the City of Hope was also a projection/avatar of the Blood Moon.

Since the Blood Moon’s rivals were the Sun and the Silver Moon, it was only natural that it would choose to strike here.

This particular Blood Moon projection looked hideous. It lacked the ethereal beauty of the deity they had first seen in the Dwarf’s Dream; instead, it resembled the disgusting mountain of flesh they had encountered in the False Moon’s cycle of dreams.

This indicated that the Blood Moon held the City of Hope in high regard, manifesting a projection of immense power.

Yet, even in this apocalyptic setting, the Blood Moon projection only possessed the same few techniques it had always used. While its movements were varied, in terms of the application of power—its "ultimate moves"—it only had the few that Qin Lang was already familiar with.

Back when he didn't fully understand the power of gods, Qin Lang had already fought the Blood Moon projection to a stalemate in the dungeon. After Tyler and the others joined, he had immediately gained the upper hand. Now that he was familiar with the power of a demigod and had received extensive guidance from the God of Self and the God of Evolution, his strength was no longer what it once was.

Though Damon was not a god-blessed, he was much older than Leo and Perella, and his combat experience was far superior. Even when fighting a god projection for the first time, he did not drag Qin Lang down in the slightest, providing perfect support and finishing blows.

Aside from casting buffs on the two, Xia Xifeng seemed to have nothing else to do but wait for the siege to be declared a victory. In the game, once a god projection was killed, the "divine resentment" of the "slain" god would dissipate, and creatures associated with that god would no longer dare to approach. This meant the monster tide would cease; at most, some weak creatures that couldn't sense the "divine resentment" would wander about, easily dispatched even by ordinary people.

This was the time for ordinary citizens to leave the city to hunt and gather resources.

Xia Xifeng looked up at the Blood Moon, deep in thought.

He trusted Qin Lang implicitly; in his mind, the defense of the City of Hope was already a victory.

Since victory had come so easily, he didn't want it to stop there.

During his ten years in the Trial Grounds, although his mastery of Divine Fire was not as proficient as Qin Lang’s, he had learned a great deal about divine knowledge. The system had become his assistant.

Xia Xifeng input his hypothesis into the system, letting it simulate the possibilities and search for materials based on his vision.

His eyes turned pure gold, and countless streams of information flowed through them. The way his lips were pressed together looked exactly like Qin Lang’s usual expression.

A moment later, the Blood Moon projection realized that Qin Lang and Damon were difficult to deal with and began unleashing its area-of-effect ultimate moves.

Inevitably, some attacks fell in front of Xia Xifeng.

Xia Xifeng remained motionless, continuing to simulate and calculate in his mind.

A streak of shadow flew rapidly from Xia Xifeng’s wrist, and a faint human silhouette swiftly dispersed all the attacks directed at him. Xia Xifeng hadn't even activated his defensive magic array, yet the attack was blocked.

Damon took a moment to glance at Xia Xifeng and said to Qin Lang, "Is the avatar guarding Feng triggered automatically?"

"No," Qin Lang replied.

Damon’s mouth twitched. Qin Lang could already entrust his consciousness to an avatar? Wasn't that similar to his uncle? Were all demigods this powerful? He had finally reached the Legendary rank, but it seemed it still wasn't enough.

Seeing that Xia Xifeng was guarded, Damon stopped worrying and continued to help Qin Lang chip away at the Blood Moon projection’s health through the gaps in its attacks.

Xia Xifeng began to move.

Maintaining his Appraisal skill, he quickly took out materials, decomposed them one by one with Divine Fire, and colorful threads wound together in mid-air to form complex patterns.

As Xia Xifeng walked across the ground, the threads fell, piecing together an extremely intricate magic array.

The Blood Moon projection seemed to realize something and attacked Xia Xifeng.

But it was immediately blocked and knocked back by Qin Lang, ending up even further away from Xia Xifeng. Even when it tried to use long-range attacks, they were blocked by Damon and the shadow guarding Xia Xifeng.

Xia Xifeng continued to set up the magic array, placing magical devices of unknown purpose within it.

After nearly an hour, Xia Xifeng finally stopped, consumed a mana-replenishing potion, and closed his eyes to meditate.

He meditated for a full hour before opening his eyes again.

Xia Xifeng took out the rewards from the previous dungeons—the divine tokens of the Sun, Moon, Water, Self, Evolution, and Wisdom.

He placed the Sun, Moon, and Water in one magic array, and the Self, Evolution, and Wisdom in another. The divine concepts of nature and the divine concepts formed by living beings were clearly demarcated.

Xia Xifeng took out a small dagger and sliced his wrist. Blood imbued with divinity dripped out, spreading along the array patterns he had drawn as if it had a mind of its own.

A normal human body wouldn't contain this much blood, but Xia Xifeng was a demigod. His "true form" was not limited to the size of a human, so his blood could cover the entire array.

As the blood covered a section of the patterns, the two types of divinity began to intersect and fuse, and the magic array slowly lit up.

Qin Lang, who had been fighting the Blood Moon projection with cold indifference, frowned and snapped his head toward Xia Xifeng, his eyes filled with fury.

The shadow avatar pinned Xia Xifeng’s hand down.

"It's already half-done. If you stop me now, my blood will have been spilled for nothing," Xia Xifeng said. "Go back to fighting; don't worry about me. Once the array is finished, we'll drive the Blood Moon into it."

The shadow avatar spoke: "Xia Xifeng, don't make me angry."

"Yeah, I know you'll definitely be angry," Xia Xifeng nodded. "So what? What are you going to do to me?"

Xia Xifeng watched as the shadow avatar’s figure distorted for a moment before turning into mist and returning to his wrist. He pouted.

As he had said, Qin Lang hadn't noticed his small actions at first, and by the time half the blood was spilled, it was too late to stop him.

Otherwise, wouldn't the blood have been spilled in vain? At the very least, he had to let Xia Xifeng finish what he started, and make the enemy bleed even more.

However, although Xia Xifeng was stubborn, he was still a little nervous inside.

He wasn't afraid of Qin Lang’s anger. If Qin Lang got angry, he could act even angrier; he had to suppress Qin Lang’s momentum.

There was only one time he hadn't dared to talk back when Qin Lang was angry, and Qin Lang had almost cut ties with him—it was when he volunteered at a kindergarten for migrant workers and happened to encounter a piece of scum who brought a knife into the school to take revenge on society. To subdue the scum as quickly as possible, he had traded injury for injury, stabbing the scum and successfully winning a national medal for bravery and a banner.

Everyone thought Xia Xifeng’s injury was justifiable, that no one else would have been braver or done better, and besides, he was only wounded in the shoulder, which wasn't serious.

But Qin Lang knew—and Xia Xifeng knew that Qin Lang knew—that the situation hadn't reached a point where Xia Xifeng *had* to trade injury for injury. Xia Xifeng hadn't acted out of a hot-headed impulse.

The children had already left the playground, the security guards were already coming with riot forks, the police had been called, and the scum was small and lacked strength and speed. Even if Xia Xifeng wanted to be a hero, there were benches nearby he could have used to block the knife. With his skills, he could have stalled the scum until the guards and police arrived.

But Xia Xifeng had intentionally taken a knife to the shoulder just to stab the assailant, quickly resolving the danger and avoiding any accidents.

Qin Lang took a deep breath and said to Damon, "Back off."

Though confused, Damon quickly retreated to Xia Xifeng’s side.

As a Legendary-rank, Damon hadn't dared to lose focus while fighting the god projection, keeping his eyes fixed on its attacks. Only when he withdrew from the battlefield did he notice what Xia Xifeng was doing with his blood.

His brow twitched violently: "Are you trying to drain all the blood from your body?!"

chunks.chineseText:
戴蒙咬牙切齿：“求你别胡说八道！我和琅能赢，用不上你流这么多血！你究竟想干什么！”

他虽然担忧，但不敢组织，担心夏兮风魔法阵画到一半中止会遭遇反噬。

“只是损失一个投影，对血月不痛不痒。”夏兮风仰头看天空，纯金色的眼睛映不出任何风景，只有血色月光覆盖其上，“我想试试用祂的投影为祭品，能不能伤祂个大的。”

戴蒙惊讶：“真的？能行吗？”

夏兮风垂下头，继续描绘魔法阵：“不知道。试试呗，反正就损失点材料和血液。”

戴蒙真想揍人了。

这是损失点？你看看地面上的血，都能组装好几个你了！

即使知道半神已经脱离了人类，血液并不重要，但你放出的是普通的血吗？带神性的血液会伤害你的本源啊！

戴蒙急得原地走了几步，不知道该如何是好。

最终他也只能跺几下脚，给夏兮风当护卫。夏兮风手腕上的影子消失，回到了秦琅的身体中。

秦琅身上腾起雾气，瞬间吞噬了他的身体。

一团看不出形态的黑雾膨胀，狠狠砸向了血月投影那丑恶的巨大肉山身体。

戴蒙目瞪口呆：“那是什么？”

夏兮风一边放血，一边给戴蒙解惑：“秦琅的神灵形态。暂时的，还不稳固。”

戴蒙呆若木鸡：“琅不是人吗？人类登神，神灵形态也应该是人类啊！”

夏兮风道：“他认为这样比较方便。哦，我要强调，我的神灵形态肯定是人类，与秦琅那个不想做人的家伙不一样。”

戴蒙深呼吸。

人类能形成非人类的神体？这可能吗？连他叔父的神灵体也是人类！他只见过自然概念的神灵体不是人类，比如太阳和水神。

秦琅这家伙，真的是人吗？

夏兮风对秦琅的神灵体也很惊讶。

在试炼地，他才知道秦琅被封印在地下的时候那些雾气触须，不仅是秦琅意识海的具现化，也是他的神体的雏形。那些看上去就很疼的封印，是为了固定住秦琅的人类形体，没让秦琅直接变成无意识的邪神。

所以，秦琅“本我”形成的神灵体，还真是那抽象的一大坨。

夏兮风都不好嘲笑蓝色百变怪海神了。自家的审美怎么也这么差？真是丢人。

不过还好，秦琅平时还是维持着人类的壳子，只有释放全部神力的时候才暂时不当人。

所以夏兮风坚信秦琅的神体四舍五入也算人类，只是有点不稳固。

要杀血月投影很简单，但要把血月投影赶进这个一看就有问题的魔法阵，只是“杀死”的力量就不够了。秦琅必须碾压血月投影，且这次碾压肯定会暴露他的力量，让外神更加警惕。

这与他最初和夏兮风商量的只显露传说职阶的力量扮猪吃老虎，等危急时刻好释放全力，多一张底牌的策略完全不一样。

秦琅真的很生气。谁在已经制定好计划，且计划已经开始实行的时候，同伙突然更改计划，都会无比生气。

既然夏兮风准备给血月一下，那秦琅是否隐藏实力都不重要了。

如今还没出现过用投影为祭品伤害神灵本体的情况，夏兮风的突发奇想如果成功，外神都不敢轻易投影了，肯定优先杀掉夏兮风，他还隐藏什么？

秦琅再生气，现在的情况也不适合他与夏兮风吵架，只能一切结束后再和夏兮风算账。

秦琅展露出全部的实力，血月投影发出不敢置信的尖啸，似乎想脱离现在的身体，逃回月亮中。

但已经展现出全力的秦琅，自不可能让祂断尾求生。祂被比祂更像邪神的灰黑触须抓起，拖向充满着梦世界神灵气息的魔法阵。

夏兮风拿着药抹了一下手腕，伤口消失，只有他苍白的脸色证明他做了什么。

“戴蒙，等会儿血月投影如果挣扎得太厉害，有部分肢体离开魔法阵，你把祂挡回去。”夏兮风走到魔法阵边缘。

戴蒙神色复杂地点头：“琅留在魔法阵中，不会受伤吗？”

夏兮风半蹲下，手掌按在魔法阵上：“我的攻击不会伤到秦琅。”

他们和别人不一样，不仅开了友伤豁免，还有“战友”联系，攻击永远对对方无效。

戴蒙道：“你悠着点，如果不成功赶紧说，我们好把血月投影杀了。”

魔法阵在夏兮风手掌下越发明亮，夏兮风笑道：“我知道，放心。”

戴蒙狠狠翻了个白眼。他能放心吗？怎么可能！

秦琅拖着血月投影进入魔法阵。

血月投影即使没有太多神灵的意识，也察觉到了极大的危险。祂疯狂挣扎，部分血肉如触手般往魔法阵外伸展。

戴蒙如夏兮风的吩咐，将所有血月投影的肢体都挡回了魔法阵内。如果不小心切掉了，他还会把血肉抛回去。

魔法阵越来越亮，形成的光柱直冲天空，仿佛要贯穿天空。

魔法阵中的血月投影身上缠上了无数神性的丝线，丝线朝着天空延伸。

原本在天空一侧的血色满月，很反常地朝着魔法阵形成的光柱移动，好像被什么拉扯着。

“有用！”夏兮风刚欢呼，就感到了极大的阻力。

即使血月正在神域和太阳打架，其本源的力量也不是夏兮风这样刚晋升的信任半神能引动的。

魔法阵形成的光柱出现了裂痕。

【秦琅：失败了，别再作死。】

夏兮风扫了一眼秦琅的私聊，冷哼了一声。

他再次拿出匕首，插进了心口，如液体黄金般的心尖血涌出。

【秦琅：夏兮风！】

戴蒙也发出能刺穿耳膜的尖叫。

夏兮风往嘴里塞了一把补血药丸：“别吵，我现在的身体构造和人类不同，补点血就好，死不了。”

心尖血落在魔法阵上，光柱的裂痕弥合。

浑身无力的夏兮风跌坐在地上，对着天空竖起两根中指：“血月，吃你爷爷一刀！”

他的身体开始干瘪，如当初在人类帝都直面血月的莱欧和佩瑞拉一样。

血月终于移动到了魔法阵上空，魔法阵形成的光柱就像利刃，刺进了血月之中。

所有守城的人都发现，攻城怪物力量减弱，怪物形成的速度降低。

正指挥战斗的苏尔不敢置信地仰望天空。

神域之中，阿穆若突然笑了起来，笑得他身边多大一坨海蓝色吓出了尖刺，仿佛海胆一般。

秦琅已经恢复成人类模样，从魔法阵中走出。

戴蒙不断后退，后来干脆飞回城里，阻止想要出城的战士们。

秦琅停在夏兮风身边，居高临下的看着夏兮风。

夏兮风看着秦琅冷得能掉冰渣子的脸色，翻了个身，后脑勺对着秦琅。

看不见，看不见，我什么都看不见。

作者有话要说：

今天只有一章半合一，明天继续努力。

很明显，隔日更时存的稿子已经用完，现在生死时速了，摊手，回归真实的自己。

Chapter 101: One and a Half Chapters Combined (Part 2)

Damon gritted his teeth: "I beg you, stop talking nonsense! Lang and I can win; we don't need you to spill this much blood! What on earth are you trying to do?!"

Though worried, he didn't dare to interfere, fearing that if Xia Xifeng stopped the magic array halfway, he would suffer a backlash.

"Losing just one projection is nothing to the Blood Moon." Xia Xifeng looked up at the sky, his pure golden eyes reflecting nothing but the blood-colored moonlight covering them. "I want to see if I can use its projection as a sacrifice to deal a major blow to its true self."

Damon was astonished: "Really? Can that work?"

Xia Xifeng lowered his head and continued drawing the magic array: "I don't know. Let's try it. Besides, it's just a loss of some materials and blood."

Damon really wanted to punch him.

*Just a loss?* Look at the blood on the ground—it could assemble several of you!

Even knowing that a demigod had transcended humanity and that blood wasn't vital, this wasn't ordinary blood! Blood imbued with divinity would damage his very essence!

Damon paced back and forth in anxiety, not knowing what to do.

In the end, he could only stomp his feet and act as Xia Xifeng’s guard. The shadow on Xia Xifeng’s wrist vanished, returning to Qin Lang’s body.

Mist surged from Qin Lang, instantly swallowing his form.

A mass of black fog with no discernible shape expanded and slammed fiercely into the ugly, massive mountain of flesh that was the Blood Moon projection.

Damon was dumbfounded: "What is that?"

Xia Xifeng, while still bleeding, explained to Damon: "Qin Lang’s divine form. It's temporary and not yet stable."

Damon was stunned: "Isn't Lang human? When humans ascend to godhood, their divine forms should also be human!"

Xia Xifeng said: "He thinks this is more convenient. Oh, I must emphasize, my divine form is definitely human, unlike that guy Qin Lang who doesn't want to be human."

Damon took a deep breath.

Could humans form non-human divine bodies? Was that even possible? Even his uncle’s divine form was human! He had only seen divine forms of natural concepts that weren't human, like the Sun and the Water God.

Was this guy, Qin Lang, really human?

Xia Xifeng was also surprised by Qin Lang’s divine form.

It was only in the Trial Grounds that he learned the fog tentacles Qin Lang had when he was sealed underground were not just a manifestation of his consciousness, but the prototype of his divine body. Those seals, which looked painful, were meant to fix Qin Lang’s human form so he wouldn't turn directly into an unconscious evil god.

So, the divine form formed by Qin Lang’s "true self" really was that abstract blob.

Xia Xifeng didn't even feel like mocking the blue, shapeshifting Sea God anymore. Why was his own aesthetic so poor? It was truly embarrassing.

But fortunately, Qin Lang usually maintained his human shell and only stopped being human when he released his full divine power.

Therefore, Xia Xifeng firmly believed that Qin Lang’s divine body could be rounded up to count as human, just a bit unstable.

Killing the Blood Moon projection was simple, but driving it into this clearly suspicious magic array required more than just the power to "kill." Qin Lang had to crush the projection, and this act of crushing would surely expose his power, making the Outer Gods more vigilant.

This was completely different from the strategy he had initially discussed with Xia Xifeng: to only reveal Legendary-rank power, play the pig to eat the tiger, and save his full power for a critical moment as a trump card.

Qin Lang was truly angry. Anyone would be furious if their partner suddenly changed the plan after it had already been formulated and put into action.

Since Xia Xifeng was prepared to strike at the Blood Moon, it no longer mattered whether Qin Lang hid his strength.

There had never been a case of using a projection as a sacrifice to harm a god’s true body. If Xia Xifeng’s sudden whim succeeded, the Outer Gods wouldn't dare to project themselves easily and would prioritize killing Xia Xifeng. What was there left to hide?

No matter how angry Qin Lang was, the current situation wasn't suitable for arguing with Xia Xifeng; he would have to settle the score after everything was over.

Qin Lang unleashed his full strength. The Blood Moon projection let out an incredulous shriek, seemingly wanting to detach itself from its current body and flee back to the moon.

But Qin Lang, having revealed his full power, would never let it cut off its tail to survive. It was grabbed by gray-black tentacles—even more like an evil god than itself—and dragged toward the magic array filled with the aura of the Dream World’s gods.

Xia Xifeng wiped his wrist with a potion, and the wound vanished, leaving only his pale complexion as proof of what he had done.

"Damon, if the Blood Moon projection struggles too hard later and parts of its limbs leave the magic array, knock them back in." Xia Xifeng walked to the edge of the magic array.

Damon nodded with a complex expression: "If Lang stays in the magic array, won't he be hurt?"

Xia Xifeng half-crouched and pressed his palm onto the magic array: "My attacks won't hurt Qin Lang."

They were different from others; not only did they have friendly-fire immunity, but they also had a "comrade" link, making their attacks forever ineffective against each other.

Damon said: "Be careful. If it doesn't work, tell us immediately so we can kill the projection."

The magic array grew brighter under Xia Xifeng’s palm. Xia Xifeng smiled: "I know, don't worry."

Damon rolled his eyes hard. Could he be at ease? How could he!

Qin Lang dragged the Blood Moon projection into the magic array.

Even without much divine consciousness, the Blood Moon projection sensed immense danger. It struggled frantically, with parts of its flesh stretching out like tentacles toward the outside of the array.

Damon, as instructed by Xia Xifeng, blocked all the projection’s limbs back into the array. If he accidentally cut one off, he would throw the flesh back in.

The magic array grew brighter and brighter, forming a pillar of light that shot straight into the sky, as if to pierce through the heavens.

The Blood Moon projection within the array was entangled by countless threads of divinity, which extended toward the sky.

The blood-red full moon on one side of the sky moved abnormally toward the pillar of light, as if being pulled by something.

"It's working!" Just as Xia Xifeng cheered, he felt immense resistance.

Even though the Blood Moon was busy fighting the Sun in the divine realm, its fundamental power was not something a newly ascended demigod like Xia Xifeng could easily manipulate.

Cracks appeared in the pillar of light formed by the magic array.

[Qin Lang: It failed. Stop courting death.]

Xia Xifeng glanced at Qin Lang’s private message and snorted coldly.

He took out the dagger again and plunged it into his heart, and heart-blood like liquid gold gushed out.

[Qin Lang: Xia Xifeng!]

Damon also let out a scream that could pierce eardrums.

Xia Xifeng stuffed a handful of blood-replenishing pills into his mouth: "Don't make a fuss. My current body structure is different from a human's; just replenish some blood, I won't die."

The heart-blood fell onto the magic array, and the cracks in the pillar of light mended.

Xia Xifeng, drained of all strength, collapsed to the ground and held up two middle fingers to the sky: "Blood Moon, eat your grandpa’s blade!"

His body began to shrivel, just like Leo and Perella when they faced the Blood Moon in the human capital.

The Blood Moon finally moved above the magic array, and the pillar of light formed by the array pierced into it like a sharp blade.

Everyone defending the city noticed that the power of the siege monsters weakened, and the speed at which they were formed decreased.

Su Er, who was commanding the battle, looked up at the sky in disbelief.

In the divine realm, Amu-Ruo suddenly began to laugh, laughing so hard that the large blob of sea-blue beside him sprouted spikes, looking like a sea urchin.

Qin Lang had returned to his human form and walked out of the magic array.

Damon retreated continuously, eventually flying back into the city to stop the warriors who wanted to rush out.

Qin Lang stopped beside Xia Xifeng, looking down at him from above.

Xia Xifeng looked at Qin Lang’s face, which was cold enough to drop ice shards, and rolled over, turning his back to him.

*Can't see, can't see, I can't see anything.*

Author's Note:
Only one and a half chapters combined today, will continue to work hard tomorrow.
Clearly, the drafts saved for the every-other-day update are gone. It's a race against time now. *Shrugs*, returning to my true self.
