第104章 一更

夏兮风总是这么喜欢破坏气氛，哪怕已经困得连呼吸都想停了，也要说出想说的话。

说完之后，夏兮风的脑袋往秦琅胸口一砸，用尽了最后一丝力气。

秦琅垂目盯着夏兮风，被夏兮风那句话噎得半晌没回过神。

夏兮风总是能轻而易举让他郁闷。

什么叫做“我们变成人外”？自己突然行为变态，和夏兮风有什么关系？怎么他们又变成共犯了？

没了所有心情的秦琅，沉默地给两人套上内裤睡衣，搂着还算穿戴整齐的夏兮风滑入了被子里。

听着夏兮风平缓的呼吸声，秦琅睡不着。

他脑袋里重复着曾经重复了许多次的话，自己可能还没成为精神病，但夏兮风真的是神经病。

秦琅深吸了一口气，最终还是与夏兮风的脑回路和解。

他狠狠揪了一下夏兮风的脸颊，虽然不需要，还是闭目睡了。

沉睡后，秦琅也没得到安稳。他梦见了小时候的光景，一些他早就遗忘的黑历史。

再聪明的人也需要时间成长，秦琅小时候还不能将自己的情绪控制自如。

秦琅对比寻常孩童而言太过分的理智和冷漠，让他的父母十分担忧，带着他去医院看病。

得到诊断结果之后，父母没有厌恶他。年轻的小夫妻给了秦琅很多的爱，但这过分的爱也代表着过分的小心翼翼，忐忑不安。

那时候秦琅的父母也不过刚二十出头，即使充满了责任心和爱意，他们也还未成熟到面对一切困难巍然不动的程度。在看到巨大的困难时，他们行动上没有退缩，但心里难免多次生出退缩之意，因精神太紧绷所产生的争吵也不会少。

那真的是一对很好的夫妻，所以他们磕磕绊绊磨合过来，艰难困苦没有让他们的爱情淡去，而是让他们的感情越酿越醇。

但对年幼却过于聪明的秦琅而言，那段家庭濒临支离破碎的回忆牢牢地刻印在他的心上。

他能看出父母的担忧害怕，看出父母曾经数次有放弃他的念头。

他也明白了，自己不是正常人。

生存是所有生灵的本能。幼崽自从母体中诞生后，第一件事就是啼哭来寻求庇佑。

小小的秦琅虽然懂得不多，但聪慧的他很快就摸清了该如何打消别人的敌意，给自己创造安稳的生活环境。

随着年岁的增长，秦琅的书越读越多，有了网络后，他搜索和获得知识更加便捷，天生的聪明逐步变成了智慧。他不需要每天睡觉前费尽心思编第二天的剧本，也能舒适的生活。优秀的心理医生再也窥不见任何他不想透露的心思。

但幼崽成长为善于隐藏的狡猾野兽需要过程，在成长的时间中，秦琅难免会泄露一些与众不同的地方。

再加上家属小院都是熟人，秦琅父母带秦琅去看病的事瞒不过邻里。孩童天真又残忍，惹急了常用秦琅是个精神病来骂人，校园里也免不了有人以此为由头的霸凌。

秦琅的童年色彩本来应该再沉郁一些，可惜的是，他有一位自出生便缠着他的竹马。

“啊？秦叔叔问我们做了什么？”

“是我们做的。很有意思！”

“我们才不是精神病，他们才是坏小孩！”

“谁敢揍我们？一起上！”

小小的夏兮风往前冲，小小的秦琅在后面喊：“小风，给我回来！我们打不过！”

“我们打得过！”

“打不过！回来！”

“不干，他们想打架，我们不能怂！”

“我来想办法。”

“教我教我，阿琅你最聪明啦，肯定有办法，教我嘛，我们一起！”

“嗯嗯嗯……”

反正只是耳边嘈杂，小秦琅本来懒得应对恶意。他对旁人都不上心，别人的恶言恶语在他心里起不了一点涟漪。

但旁边有个“我们我们”的小伙伴，给他增添了无数麻烦。

无论他做出什么和旁人不同的事，夏兮风总说是“我们做的”。他总把那些事当成寻常，坚信与众不同不是问题，是他足够显眼。

嗯，真是一个显眼包。

因为夏兮风太阳光，太自信，说出来的话也总是让人信服，所以渐渐地旁人都被他洗脑，认为秦琅和夏兮风所做的那些不符合孩童性格的事不是问题，而是“很酷”“很显眼”。

秦琅飞速成熟。

他没能感到别人恶意所带来的情绪波动，但感到了深深的羞耻，并不想和夏兮风成为小院里和学校里最厉害的“显眼包”。

你们真是够了！我没有耍酷！没有深邃的思想成熟的灵魂和凌驾世人的智慧！

秦琅：我不是中二病。

夏兮风：不，我们就是。

在夏兮风持续不断的显眼包行为下，他和秦朗在家属小院和学校里的待遇越来越高，越来越受人崇拜，成了孩子头。

秦琅：够了，我不需要。

夏兮风：我们超厉害！！

后来秦琅越来越沉默，越来越木讷，竭尽全力降低自己的存在感。

秦琅再也不想夏兮风在自己做出不理智的行为时喊着“我们”，然后再将其扭曲成奇奇怪怪的东西。

做噩梦的秦琅没忍住颤抖了一下。在他怀里的夏兮风似乎不满意自己的大抱枕颤抖，对着大抱枕咬了一口。

秦琅安静下来，夏兮风继续呼呼大睡。

可怜的秦琅噩梦还没有停。

如果这噩梦有个题目，大概是《我和我的怨种竹马》吧。

可能是头一天的噩梦太长，秦琅居然比夏兮风晚起床。

秦琅睁开眼的时候，夏兮风已经吃完早餐。

他嘲笑秦琅：“我就说，你肯定比我累。同归于尽了吧？”

秦琅：“……”其实他没有累，只是睡过头。

但夏兮风已经坚信秦琅和他同归于尽。以秦琅对夏兮风的了解，无论自己再怎么辩解，夏兮风也只会认为自己是狡辩，只能不说话了。

当然，以秦琅对夏兮风的了解，自己不说话，夏兮风就当自己默认。

所以夏兮风还是赢了。这就是夏兮风的赢学。

明明是自己狠狠折腾了夏兮风，结果秦琅憋屈无比。

他怎么就睡过头了？早知道就不该睡。

“哈哈哈，戴蒙快气疯了。”给睡着的秦琅嘴里塞了个小蛋糕，夏兮风跳到床上，钻进坐起来的秦琅怀里，把秦琅当靠背，“你看你看，他的骂人本事推陈出新了！”

秦琅艰难咽下小蛋糕，暂时不想起床。

他想静一静。

夏兮风嘴里还在叨叨叨个不停，似乎要把这么多天被禁锢在床上堵住嘴的啰嗦都补回来。

夏兮风和秦琅早就决定，等守城战之后就逃跑。

咳，这当然不是他们不喜欢希望之城城主繁重的工作，而是他们在外面游荡，才能精准地寻找任务，快速结束末世。

末世来临后的世界，才是夏兮风和秦琅熟悉的《奇域幻想》。他们的等级也达到玩家“萌新”级别，终于可以尽情施展“玩家”的能力。

所以夏兮风在被秦琅狠狠折腾的时候，最后的理智就是提醒秦琅快把他带走，要做去车上做，别错过逃跑时间。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 104: First Update

Xia Xifeng was always so fond of ruining the mood; even when he was so sleepy that he felt like stopping his own breathing, he still had to say what was on his mind.

After speaking, Xia Xifeng let his head drop against Qin Lang’s chest, using up his very last ounce of strength.

Qin Lang stared down at Xia Xifeng, choked by that sentence for a long while, unable to regain his composure.

Xia Xifeng always found it so easy to leave him feeling stifled.

What did he mean by "we became non-human"? His own sudden perverted behavior—what did that have to do with Xia Xifeng? Why were they accomplices again?

Having lost all desire to do anything else, Qin Lang silently dressed them both in underwear and pajamas, then slid under the covers, cradling the now reasonably dressed Xia Xifeng.

Listening to Xia Xifeng’s steady breathing, Qin Lang couldn't sleep.

His mind repeated thoughts he had gone over many times before: he might not have become a psychopath yet, but Xia Xifeng was definitely a lunatic.

Qin Lang took a deep breath, finally reconciling himself with Xia Xifeng’s unique train of thought.

He gave Xia Xifeng’s cheek a sharp pinch, and though it wasn't necessary, he closed his eyes and drifted off.

Even in sleep, Qin Lang found no peace. He dreamt of scenes from his childhood—dark history he had long since buried.

Even the most brilliant people need time to grow; as a child, Qin Lang couldn't control his emotions with ease.

Qin Lang’s rationality and coldness, which were far too extreme for an ordinary child, deeply worried his parents, who took him to the hospital for an evaluation.

After receiving the diagnosis, his parents didn't loathe him. The young couple gave Qin Lang an abundance of love, but this excessive love also brought with it excessive caution and anxiety.

Back then, Qin Lang’s parents were only in their early twenties. Even with their sense of responsibility and love, they weren't mature enough to remain unshakable in the face of every difficulty. When faced with massive obstacles, they didn't retreat in their actions, but they couldn't help but harbor thoughts of giving up many times. The arguments born from their frayed nerves were frequent.

They were truly a wonderful couple, so they stumbled through the friction, and the hardships didn't dilute their love; instead, it made their bond grow richer and more mellow.

But for the young yet overly intelligent Qin Lang, those memories of a family on the brink of collapse were firmly etched into his heart.

He could see his parents’ worry and fear, and he could see that they had considered abandoning him several times.

He also understood that he was not a normal person.

Survival is the instinct of all living things. From the moment a cub is born from the womb, its first act is to cry out for protection.

Though little Qin Lang didn't understand much, his brilliance allowed him to quickly figure out how to dispel others' hostility and create a stable environment for himself.

As he grew older, Qin Lang read more and more books. After the internet arrived, accessing knowledge became even easier, and his innate cleverness gradually transformed into wisdom. He no longer needed to spend his nights meticulously scripting the next day’s performance to live comfortably. Even the best psychologists could no longer catch a glimpse of any thoughts he didn't want to reveal.

But the process of a cub growing into a cunning beast skilled at concealment takes time. During that growth, Qin Lang inevitably leaked some of his differences.

Furthermore, the residential compound was full of acquaintances, so his parents’ trips to the hospital couldn't be hidden from the neighbors. Children are innocent yet cruel; when provoked, they often used the label "mental patient" to insult him, and bullying in school was inevitable.

Qin Lang’s childhood should have been even more somber, but unfortunately, he had a childhood friend who had clung to him since birth.

"Huh? Uncle Qin is asking what we did?"

"It was us. It was very interesting!"

"We aren't mental patients; they’re the bad kids!"

"Who dares to hit us? Come at us together!"

Little Xia Xifeng would charge forward, while little Qin Lang would shout from behind: "Xiao Feng, come back! We can't win!"

"We can win!"

"We can't! Come back!"

"No way, they want to fight, we can't be cowards!"

"I'll think of a way."

"Teach me, teach me! Ah Lang, you’re the smartest, you definitely have a way, teach me, let’s do it together!"

"Mm, mm, mm..."

In any case, it was just noisy buzzing in his ears; little Qin Lang was too lazy to deal with malice. He didn't care about others, and their vicious words couldn't stir a ripple in his heart.

But having a "we, we" companion by his side added countless troubles.

No matter what he did that was different from others, Xia Xifeng would always say "we did it." He treated those things as normal, firmly believing that being different wasn't a problem—it was just that he was prominent enough.

Yes, a real attention-seeker.

Because Xia Xifeng was so sunny and confident, and the things he said were always convincing, others were gradually brainwashed into believing that the things Qin Lang and Xia Xifeng did—which didn't fit the personality of children—weren't problems, but were "cool" and "eye-catching."

Qin Lang matured rapidly.

He didn't feel the emotional fluctuations caused by others' malice, but he felt deep shame. He didn't want to be the biggest "attention-seeker" in the compound and school alongside Xia Xifeng.

You guys have had enough! I’m not playing it cool! I don't have profound thoughts, a mature soul, or wisdom that transcends the world!

Qin Lang: I am not a chuunibyou.

Xia Xifeng: No, we are.

Under Xia Xifeng’s constant attention-seeking behavior, their status in the compound and school grew higher and higher. They became objects of worship, the leaders of the children.

Qin Lang: Enough, I don't need this.

Xia Xifeng: We are super awesome!!

Later, Qin Lang became more and more silent, more and more wooden, doing his best to lower his presence.

Qin Lang never wanted Xia Xifeng to shout "we" again whenever he did something irrational, only to twist it into something strange.

Dreaming a nightmare, Qin Lang couldn't help but tremble. Xia Xifeng, in his arms, seemed dissatisfied with his giant pillow trembling and took a bite out of it.

Qin Lang quieted down, and Xia Xifeng continued to sleep soundly.

Poor Qin Lang’s nightmare hadn't stopped.

If this nightmare had a title, it would probably be "Me and My Vexing Childhood Friend."

Perhaps because the nightmare the previous night was too long, Qin Lang actually woke up later than Xia Xifeng.

When Qin Lang opened his eyes, Xia Xifeng had already finished breakfast.

He mocked Qin Lang: "I told you, you’d definitely be more tired than me. Mutually assured destruction, right?"

Qin Lang: "..." Actually, he wasn't tired, he had just overslept.

But Xia Xifeng was already convinced that Qin Lang had suffered mutual destruction with him. Based on Qin Lang’s understanding of Xia Xifeng, no matter how he argued, Xia Xifeng would only think he was making excuses, so he could only stay silent.

Of course, based on Qin Lang’s understanding of Xia Xifeng, if he stayed silent, Xia Xifeng would take it as an admission.

So Xia Xifeng won again. This was Xia Xifeng’s "winning logic."

Even though he was the one who had thoroughly worn Xia Xifeng out, Qin Lang felt incredibly stifled.

How did he oversleep? If he had known, he shouldn't have slept at all.

"Hahaha, Damon is about to go crazy." Stuffing a small cupcake into the mouth of the sleepy Qin Lang, Xia Xifeng jumped onto the bed and burrowed into the arms of the sitting Qin Lang, using him as a backrest. "Look, look, his ability to curse is evolving!"

Qin Lang swallowed the cupcake with difficulty, not wanting to get up yet.

He wanted a moment of peace.

Xia Xifeng was still chattering away, as if he wanted to make up for all the babbling he had been blocked from doing while confined to the bed for so many days.

Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang had long ago decided to run away after the city defense battle.

*Cough*, this wasn't because they disliked the heavy workload of the Hope City Lord, but because only by wandering outside could they precisely hunt for missions and quickly end the apocalypse.

The world after the apocalypse was the "Fantasy Domain" that Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang were familiar with. Their levels had reached the "newbie" player tier, and they could finally unleash their "player" abilities to their heart's content.

So, when Xia Xifeng was being thoroughly worn out by Qin Lang, his last bit of reason was to remind Qin Lang to take him away quickly—to do it in the carriage, so they wouldn't miss their chance to escape.

chunks.chineseText:
提醒完后，夏兮风就晕了。

看见夏兮风的提醒，秦琅差点因为气氛被破坏而中止惩罚。

但他思来想去，还是太气了，所以把夏兮风拎到魔导车里“逃跑”后，仍旧继续折腾了几日。

现在沉默的秦琅思考之前的行为，觉得自己的变态行为被夏兮风那么一闹，多了几分谐门色彩。

好像只要和夏兮风混在一起，他就半点没有高智商反社会人格的模样，而是一个正常的、略带谐门的角色。

啊，自己原来还有那种奇怪的人格障碍吗？应该没有。

他怎么可能会有这样高逼格的人格障碍呢？自己不配。

“不过这次你真是把我折腾惨了。”夏兮风调戏完戴蒙后，对秦琅抱怨，“我的男朋友生气起来也太可怕了。”

秦琅死了一半的眼神闪了闪，低头看着躺在自己怀里的夏兮风。

夏兮风完全没觉得自己这句话有什么问题，低下头继续在群里发言，并通知其他没能进群的朋友们，自己已经出门浪了，不日就会伪装身份混到他们身边，吓唬他们好大一跳。

秦琅收回视线，心情复杂。

男朋友……在夏兮风心里，自己的身份已经变了？

他还没想过。

他们稀里糊涂地滚在了一起，稀里糊涂地默认了可以随意滚在一起的生活状态，从未谈情说爱，彼此身份不清不楚，也从未提起过身份是否应该有改变。

秦琅自己没想过，以为夏兮风从来不说，也肯定没想过。

但现在看来，夏兮风不说，是因为他认为不用说。

虽然秦琅仍旧不认为他对夏兮风是爱情，自己审美没那么差，但他思索，自己和夏兮风从滚在一起这十年，确实缺少了些许仪式感。

夏兮风正在四处骚扰熟人，并继续在戴蒙心上扎刀的时候，秦琅调出系统的客服提问页面。

他们的系统很像一个游戏系统，还有专门的客服提问页面，上面写着是自动回复，没有人工客服。平时如果在客服页面提问，客服基本没有回应，有回应也是让他们去翻找系统说明第XX页，非常符合系统人工智障的角色定位。

虽然两人系统共享，但两人和别人聊天的时候，只要不分享出去，他们就看不到对方的系统页面。

秦琅在客服页面打字：【等我和夏兮风完成结束末世的主线任务，可以追加一条奖励吗？我希望您能为我们证婚。】

提问发出后，从未有过“请查找系统说明第XX页”之外的回答的系统客服，很快就有了回应。

【允。】

这个字出现后，系统提问页面所有字迅速消失，就像秦琅没提过问，系统也没回复过，一切都是秦琅眼花似的。

秦琅嘴角勾了勾，把与朋友激情刷屏的夏兮风推到一旁，下床洗漱吃饭。

作者有话要说：

补了点结尾。

秦琅有人格障碍，但夏兮风给他的人格障碍设置了无数障碍。真是天造地设天打雷劈的一对小情侣啊[三花猫头]。
chunks.englishText:
After giving the reminder, Xia Xifeng had passed out.

Seeing Xia Xifeng’s reminder, Qin Lang had almost stopped the punishment because the mood was ruined.

But after thinking it over, he was still too angry, so after hauling Xia Xifeng into the Magitech Carriage to "escape," he continued to wear him out for several more days.

Now, the silent Qin Lang reflected on his previous behavior, feeling that his perverted actions had taken on a somewhat absurd quality because of Xia Xifeng’s antics.

It seemed that as long as he was with Xia Xifeng, he didn't look like a high-IQ sociopath at all, but rather a normal, slightly eccentric character.

Ah, did he actually have that kind of strange personality disorder? Probably not.

How could he possibly have such a high-class personality disorder? He wasn't worthy.

"But you really wore me out this time." After teasing Damon, Xia Xifeng complained to Qin Lang, "My boyfriend is too scary when he gets angry."

Qin Lang’s half-dead eyes flickered as he looked down at Xia Xifeng, who was lying in his arms.

Xia Xifeng didn't think there was anything wrong with that statement at all, lowering his head to continue posting in the group chat, notifying other friends who hadn't joined the group that he was out wandering and would soon disguise his identity to infiltrate their ranks, giving them a huge fright.

Qin Lang withdrew his gaze, his mood complex.

Boyfriend... in Xia Xifeng’s heart, had his status already changed?

He hadn't thought about it.

They had tumbled together in a muddle, defaulted to a lifestyle where they could tumble together whenever they pleased, never having talked about love, their relationship status unclear, and never having brought up whether their status should change.

Qin Lang hadn't thought about it himself, assuming that since Xia Xifeng never said anything, he must not have thought about it either.

But now it seemed that Xia Xifeng didn't speak because he thought it went without saying.

Although Qin Lang still didn't think what he felt for Xia Xifeng was "love"—his aesthetic sense wasn't *that* poor—he pondered that in the ten years they had been tumbling together, they were indeed lacking a bit of ceremony.

While Xia Xifeng was busy harassing acquaintances and continuing to twist the knife in Damon’s heart, Qin Lang pulled up the system’s customer service inquiry page.

Their system was much like a game system, complete with a dedicated customer service inquiry page. It stated that it was an automated response, with no human customer service. Usually, if one asked a question on the page, the system would basically not respond, or if it did, it would tell them to go look up page XX of the system manual—very much in line with the "artificial idiot" role of the system.

Although their systems were shared, when they chatted with others, as long as they didn't share it, they couldn't see each other’s system pages.

Qin Lang typed on the customer service page: [After Xia Xifeng and I complete the main quest to end the apocalypse, can we add an extra reward? I hope you can officiate our wedding.]

After the question was sent, the system customer service, which had never given an answer other than "Please look up page XX of the system manual," responded quickly.

[Granted.]

After this character appeared, all the text on the system inquiry page vanished rapidly, as if Qin Lang had never asked the question, the system had never replied, and everything had just been a hallucination.

Qin Lang’s lips curled up. He pushed Xia Xifeng, who was busy furiously typing away with friends, to the side, and got out of bed to wash up and eat.

Author's Note:
Added a bit of an ending.
Qin Lang has a personality disorder, but Xia Xifeng has set up countless obstacles for his personality disorder. Truly a match made in heaven, a pair of little lovers destined to be struck by lightning [Three-colored cat head].

chunks.chineseText:
第105章 一更

又看见了一次日出。

肯擦拭完长矛，拿着妻子做好的三明治出门巡逻。

世界剧变，外面变成了看不懂的模样，前阵子的怪物发狂真是骇得人头皮发麻。

但无论生活变成什么样，人还是得活，日子还是得照常过。

肯原本是个守路的，现在也在守路。只是除了维护道路的魔法阵，他还要守着屋后面那棵突然出现的小树。

有那种小树的地方，水还能喝，地还能种，人就能活。

屋后面的小树实在是太小，所圈的地也就够他们两口子过，正好成为一个道路维护点。

他们本来打算攒够钱就生一个孩子，调动到城里好好养孩子。现在这状况，他们是不敢想孩子的事了，不希望孩子出生在这么危险的世界。

肯的妻子叫米娅，也是一个很厉害的战士。

他们两口子原本总是一起巡逻。米娅在前阵子的怪物潮中受了伤，腿一瘸一拐，肯便只能自己出门了。

米娅拄着拐杖走到门口，目送丈夫离开：“一定要回来。”

肯对米娅扬了扬手：“当然。”

两人正准备分别，一辆马车停到了他们屋前的道路上。

车门打开，一个火红色头发的年轻男子从车上跳下来。

肯警觉地看着面前的人。

年轻男子对肯微笑道：“我叫杰瑞，是个很厉害的炼金术师，现在正在外游历，能不能借住几天？”

那个自称杰瑞的火红头发男子风风火火说出自己的来意，听得肯更警觉了。

又有一个男子从车上慢悠悠下来。

那个人有一头灰色的头发，眼眸是平平无奇的浅棕色，仔细一看面容应该是英俊的，就是英俊得太普通，移开眼睛就忘记了他长什么样。

但肯看见那个人的第一眼，就浑身起了鸡皮疙瘩，直觉这个人不好惹。

火红色头发的男子为同伴介绍：“他叫汤姆……哎哟！”

“闭嘴！”据说叫汤姆的灰发男子抬手就给了红发男子后脑勺一下。

他拿出一个徽章递给肯：“我们来自银月城，是银月城城主家族的炼金术师。”

肯接过徽章，用斗气激发，看见上面腾起的图案，松了口气，露出了真挚的笑容：“请问尊贵的炼金术师，你们有何贵干？”

红发男子正想开口，被灰发男子抬手捂住嘴。

灰发男子道：“所有炼金术师都在试图研究神树能祛除腐化的原理。”

肯疑惑道：“不是因为神的庇佑吗？”

灰发男子道：“就是研究神的庇佑……”

他话没说完，红发男子掰开了捂着自己嘴的手，哔哔叭叭个不停：“神树就是世界树最后的庇佑，但世界树已经陨落，这点庇佑肯定不足以让我们夺回世界。好好研究世界树的庇佑，争取让神树开花结果，多多扩展咱们的地盘，才能看见夺回世界的希望啊。”

“夺回世界？”肯喃喃道。

红发男子笑道：“对！我们争取在下一代孩子长大之前，把世界改回来。”

肯吸了吸鼻子，虽然那位自称杰瑞的男子的话毫无根据，他还是被打动了。

“请，这边请。”肯对杰瑞和汤姆道，“我陪你们去。有什么需要，尽管说！”

杰瑞的眼神扫过肯身后的长矛，眼睛笑成了两道月牙：“好！不用客气！”

汤姆给杰瑞翻了个白眼。

是主人对你说“不用客气”，不是你这个客人说“不用客气”。有你这么反客为主的吗？

肯没发现杰瑞这话有什么问题。他殷勤地把人带进屋里，为他们布置客房。

米娅一直没说话。作为一名精英弓箭手，她冷静又敏锐，静静地观察这两位来自银月圣城的炼金术师。

炼金术师不是术士，而是擅长制作魔导器的人的尊称。

米娅观察红发杰瑞和灰发汤姆。汤姆腰间挂着一把七弦琴，但气息可不像普普通通的吟游诗人；红发杰瑞没有带武器，但如果他真的是炼金术师，那他的背包里一定有数不清的伤人的玩意儿。

米娅和肯一样，第一眼就看出汤姆很不好惹。如果在他们面前的只有汤姆，她一定会全力警戒。

但杰瑞却给她一种很温暖的感觉，让她放松了警惕心。

不知道是不是那头张扬的红发的缘故，米娅一看杰瑞，就觉得这个人的活泼开朗一定是真实的。

杰瑞很是自来熟。

他很快把行李安放好，并向肯和米娅炫耀自己的马车。

看！这个马车简朴的外表只是伪装！它其实是一辆很厉害的魔导车！

肯连连称赞。米娅看着杰瑞那小孩子般的炫耀表情，也再生不出警惕怀疑之心，十分好笑地要为自称很饿的杰瑞端来早饭。

杰瑞忙道：“我只是开玩笑，其实我吃过了。”

他从背包里拿出奶油蛋糕：“这是我们借住的礼物。”

米娅看了一眼肯。

肯摸了摸鼻子：“好巧，我正好喜欢吃甜的。这留作下午茶如何？”

米娅忍着笑道：“我给你们煮奶茶。”

杰瑞对汤姆挤了挤眼睛。

汤姆假装没看见。

当肯带着两人去观察神树的时候，汤姆才咬牙切齿：“谁是汤姆？”

杰瑞眨了眨眼睛：“你。”

汤姆……秦琅道：“我们最初定的好像不是这个名字？”

夏兮风笑嘻嘻道：“这不是突然忘记了吗？就记得汤姆和杰瑞这两个外文名。”

秦琅真想把夏兮风丢神树下面的湖里去。

夏兮风每次的心血来潮都让自己心头一梗。

还好这里没有人知道汤姆和杰瑞是什么，顶多只认为这两个名字太烂大街。

夏兮风和秦琅来这里，当然不是为了看什么神树。

阿穆若把神树残骸全带了回来，他们有的是研究对象。

两人来这里，是为了“做任务”。

末世来临，《奇域幻想》算是开服了。这个世界来到了夏兮风和秦琅的舒适区。

他们现在从希望之城出发，按照距离远近，准备扫光游戏中和外神有关的主线和支线任务。

这对夫妻在游戏里就有一个大型支线任务，任务最后能获得“神器”。

作为网游，《奇域幻想》最厉害的武器自然是刷副本刷出来的。不过主线和支线任务也会赠送副本同款装备，只是主副词条随机，想要好装备还是得刷副本。

但在设定里，这些任务送的装备就已经是最高等级的神器了。

一对守路的小夫妻，最后居然能牵涉到神器，玩家们做任务的时候真是哭瞎了眼睛——游戏里送的东西越好，剧情越虐。策划可不会白送玩家好东西。

夏兮风和秦琅不是第一次见到这对夫妻。

两人第一次离开“新手村”的时候，就因为在吊死树那里乱晃，引起了守路人夫妻的注意。

夏兮风瞅了一眼肯身后背着的长矛，又对秦琅挤眉弄眼，一副秦琅不回应，他就要一直挤眉弄眼下去的模样。

秦琅只能回了一个“我看见了”的眼神。

肯背着的长矛就是夏兮风当初送的。夏兮风送的另一张长弓，就挂在那对夫妻的小屋墙上。
chunks.englishText:
Another sunrise.

Ken finished wiping down his spear, grabbed the sandwich his wife had made for him, and set off on his patrol.

The world had undergone a drastic upheaval, transforming the outdoors into something utterly unrecognizable. The recent monster frenzy had been truly hair-raising.

Yet no matter what life became, people still had to go on living, taking each day as it came.

Ken had originally been a roadkeeper, and he was still a roadkeeper now. Only, in addition to maintaining the road’s magic array, he also had to guard the small tree that had suddenly appeared behind his house.

Wherever such a small tree grew, the water remained drinkable, the land could still be farmed, and people could survive.

The small tree behind their house was quite small, securing only enough land for the two of them to get by, which conveniently served as a road maintenance post.

They had originally planned to save up enough money to have a child and transfer to the city to raise them properly. In their current situation, however, they didn't dare think about having a child—they didn't want a child to be born into such a dangerous world.

Ken’s wife was named Mia, and she too was a formidable warrior.

The couple used to patrol together all the time. But Mia had been injured in the recent monster tide, leaving her with a limp, so Ken could only go out alone.

Leaning on a crutch, Mia walked to the doorway and watched her husband leave. "Make sure you come back."

Ken raised a hand to Mia. "Of course."

Just as the two were about to part ways, a carriage came to a halt on the road in front of their house.

The door opened, and a fiery red-haired young man leaped down from the carriage.

Ken watched the newcomer warily.

The young man offered Ken a bright smile. "My name is Jerry, a very formidable alchemist. I'm currently traveling abroad. Would it be possible to stay here for a few days?"

The fiery red-haired man who called himself Jerry blurted out his intentions in a whirlwind of words, making Ken grow even more vigilant.

Then, another man slowly descended from the carriage.

This man had grey hair and plain, light brown eyes. A closer look revealed that his features were actually quite handsome—just so ordinarily handsome that one forgot what he looked like the moment they looked away.

Yet the moment Ken laid eyes on him, goosebumps erupted all over his skin. His intuition screamed that this man was extremely dangerous.

The red-haired man introduced his companion: "His name is Tom... Ow!"

"Shut up!" The grey-haired man named Tom raised his hand and smacked the back of the red-haired man's head.

He pulled out a badge and handed it to Ken. "We come from Silvermoon City. We are alchemists belonging to the Silvermoon City Lord's family."

Ken took the badge and activated it with his Dou Qi. Seeing the glowing emblem flare up on its surface, he breathed a sigh of relief and offered a genuine smile. "Respected alchemists, how may I be of service?"

The red-haired man was about to speak, but the grey-haired man promptly clamped a hand over his mouth.

The grey-haired man said, "All alchemists are currently trying to study the principles behind how the Sacred Trees cleanse corruption."

Ken asked in confusion, "Isn't it because of the divine blessing?"

The grey-haired man said, "We are precisely studying the divine blessing..."

Before he could finish, the red-haired man pried the hand off his mouth and babbled incessantly, "The Sacred Tree is the final protection left behind by the World Tree. But since the World Tree has fallen, this tiny bit of protection definitely isn't enough for us to reclaim the world. Only by properly studying the World Tree's protection, striving to make the Sacred Trees flower and bear fruit, and expanding our territory as much as possible can we see any hope of taking back the world!"

"Taking back the world?" Ken muttered to himself.

The red-haired man chuckled. "That's right! We're aiming to change the world back before the next generation of children grows up."

Ken sniffled. Although the words of the man calling himself Jerry lacked any real foundation, he was deeply moved nonetheless.

"Please, right this way," Ken said to Jerry and Tom. "I'll accompany you. If you need anything at all, don't hesitate to ask!"

Jerry's eyes swept across the spear behind Ken's back, curving into two cheerful crescents. "Great! Don't stand on ceremony!"

Tom rolled his eyes at Jerry.

The host was telling *you* "don't stand on ceremony," not you telling the host! Is there anyone who acts like the master of the house more than you?

Ken didn't notice anything wrong with Jerry's words. He enthusiastically led them inside and set up a guest room for them.

Mia remained silent throughout. As an elite archer, she was calm and sharp, quietly observing these two alchemists from Silvermoon Holy City.

Alchemists were not sorcerers; it was a title of respect reserved for those skilled in crafting magic items.

Mia observed red-haired Jerry and grey-haired Tom. A seven-stringed lute hung from Tom's waist, but his aura was nothing like that of an ordinary bard. Red-haired Jerry carried no weapons, but if he truly was an alchemist, his backpack undoubtedly contained countless dangerous devices meant for harm.

Like Ken, Mia could tell at a single glance that Tom was not to be provoked. If only Tom stood before them, she would certainly be on high alert.

Jerry, however, gave her a very warm feeling, causing her to relax her guard.

Perhaps it was due to his flamboyant red hair, but the moment Mia looked at Jerry, she felt that his lively, cheerful demeanor was undoubtedly genuine.

Jerry was remarkably familiar with strangers.

He quickly unpacked his luggage and showed off his carriage to Ken and Mia.

Look! The simple appearance of this carriage is just a disguise! It's actually a very powerful magic-driven vehicle!

Ken praised it repeatedly. Seeing Jerry's childlike expression as he showed off, Mia couldn't muster any suspicion or doubt either. Amused, she offered to bring breakfast for Jerry, who claimed to be starving.

Jerry hurriedly said, "I was just joking. I've actually eaten already."

He pulled out a cream cake from his backpack. "This is a gift for letting us stay."

Mia glanced at Ken.

Ken rubbed his nose. "What a coincidence, I happen to love sweets. How about saving this for afternoon tea?"

Mia suppressed a smile and said, "I'll brew some milk tea for you two."

Jerry winked at Tom.

Tom pretended not to see it.

When Ken led the two out to inspect the Sacred Tree, Tom finally gritted his teeth and whispered, "Who is Tom?"

Jerry blinked. "You are."

Tom... Qin Lang said, "Didn't we agree on different names initially?"

Xia Xifeng giggled. "Didn't I suddenly forget? I could only remember the foreign names Tom and Jerry."

Qin Lang really wanted to throw Xia Xifeng into the lake beneath the Sacred Tree.

Every whim of Xia Xifeng's caused his heart to drop a beat.

Fortunately, no one here knew what Tom and Jerry were, at most thinking the two names were overly common.

Of course, Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang hadn't come here just to look at some Sacred Tree.

Asura had brought back all the remains of the Sacred Tree, giving them plenty of subjects to study.

The two had come here to "do quests."

With the arrival of the apocalypse, *Fantastic Fantasy* could be considered officially launched. This world had entered Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang's comfort zone.

Setting off from the City of Hope, they intended to sweep through all the main and side quests in the game related to outer gods, starting from the nearest ones.

This married couple had a large-scale side quest in the game that ultimately awarded a "Divine Artifact."

As an online game, *Fantastic Fantasy*'s most powerful weapons naturally had to be farmed from dungeons. However, main and side quests also gave weapons identical to dungeon drops, albeit with randomized main and secondary attributes. Players who wanted top-tier equipment still had to farm dungeons.

Yet in the game's lore, the gear given by these quests was already top-tier divine artifacts.

A couple of path-guarding newlyweds turned out to be connected to a divine artifact in the end—players had cried their eyes out while completing this quest in the game. The better the rewards handed out by the game, the more heartbreaking the plot was. The developers certainly wouldn't give players good stuff for free.

This wasn't the first time Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang had met this couple.

When the two first left the "starter village," their wandering near the Hanging Tree had caught the attention of the roadkeeper couple.

Xia Xifeng glanced at the spear strapped to Ken's back, then wiggled his eyebrows at Qin Lang, looking as though he would keep wiggling them forever if Qin Lang didn't respond.

Qin Lang had no choice but to return an "I see it" look.

The spear on Ken's back was the very one Xia Xifeng had gifted him back then. The other longbow Xia Xifeng had gifted hung on the wall of the couple's cottage.

chunks.chineseText:
这两把武器应该给他们提供了很大助力。

【夏兮风：这次我要送给他们更好的武器和装备，绝对不让他们死。】

【秦琅：嗯。】

游戏里做任务是NPC给他们奖励。这两人找任务做，是来给NPC奖励来了。

虽然观察神树只是借口，但夏兮风还是装得很像那么一回事。

首先，他要和秦琅在著名景点拍照打卡留念，并发给所有小伙伴们。

戴蒙又在那里吵闹，说要顺着他们拍的照片，把他们抓回去。

夏兮风嘻嘻哈哈，根本不把戴蒙当回事。

秦琅想，戴蒙一定很后悔有夏兮风这个怨种朋友。他忽视了自己也是戴蒙的怨种朋友。

夏兮风拿出工作台使劲捣鼓。

肯见夏兮风做的事他看不懂，也不愿意离开。

虽然他确认了汤姆和杰瑞的身份，但他也要看着两人，可别碰坏了宝贝神树。即使宝贝神树非常坚硬，连怪物都不来啃，也要以防万一。

夏兮风随便鼓捣了一下，取了一点树下面的泥土，就说自己要闭门查什么数据，把自己关进魔导车里不再出门。肯和米娅夫妻俩给两人布置的客房算是白布置了。

夏兮风一直在魔导车里睡到晚上。米娅煮的下午茶也没喝成。

秦琅没进魔导车。他展现出精英战士的实力，引诱肯和米娅主动请他教导战斗。

虽然秦琅的职业是用琴和双剑，但已经成为半神后，他所有武器都能使用，不再拘泥职业，只是用双短剑更顺手，且有职业属性加成。

那十年间，自我之神教导了秦琅许多战斗知识。十年不间断的战斗，让秦琅终于积攒了足够的战斗经验，而不是只能靠着系统灌输的技能战斗。所以他指导肯和米娅用长矛和弓箭，也是游刃有余。

等夏兮风从魔导车里出来的时候，肯和米娅已经把秦琅当老师尊敬，看着秦琅的眼神里满是敬仰。

夏兮风打着哈欠道：“汤姆，陪我出去走走。”开启任务的时间到了。

这次任务和活动中的吊死树有关系。

玩家开启活动副本，需要在那棵树上齐齐上吊，灵魂进入另一个世界。那棵树原本是维持道路魔法阵的节点之一，在某一日，怪物侵蚀了这个节点，并想以此为基础，炸毁整条道路。守路人夫妻在血色满月夜发现了这件事，留下联络信后，先后进入大树中的异空间探查。

玩家便是在绿沙城接到委托，前来查探许久没有信息送回的肯和米娅夫妻的情况。

作者有话要说：

明天再捉虫，晚安。
chunks.englishText:
These two weapons must have provided them with tremendous assistance.

[Xia Xifeng: This time, I'm going to give them even better weapons and equipment. I definitely won't let them die.]

[Qin Lang: Mm.]

In the game, doing quests meant NPCs gave them rewards. But these two were looking for quests specifically to give rewards *to* the NPCs.

Although observing the Sacred Tree was merely an excuse, Xia Xifeng put on quite a believable act.

First, he and Qin Lang took commemorative photos at the famous landmark and sent them to all their friends.

Damon was causing a fuss in the chat again, threatening to track them down using the photos and drag them back.

Xia Xifeng just laughed, not taking Damon seriously at all.

Qin Lang thought that Damon must deeply regret having a friend like Xia Xifeng. He completely overlooked the fact that he was also Damon's troublesome friend.

Xia Xifeng pulled out his workbench and began tinkering furiously.

Seeing that Xia Xifeng was doing things he couldn't understand, Ken was reluctant to leave.

Even though he had confirmed Tom and Jerry's identities, he still needed to keep an eye on them to ensure they didn't accidentally damage the precious Sacred Tree. Even if the precious Sacred Tree was extremely tough and not even monsters would chew on it, one could never be too careful.

After tinkering randomly for a bit, Xia Xifeng collected some soil from beneath the tree and claimed he needed to lock himself away to look up some data. He shut himself inside the magic vehicle and didn't come out again. The guest room that Ken and Mia had set up for the two went entirely to waste.

Xia Xifeng slept inside the magic vehicle until nightfall, missing out on the afternoon tea Mia had prepared.

Qin Lang didn't enter the magic vehicle. He displayed the skills of an elite warrior, enticing Ken and Mia to voluntarily ask him for combat instruction.

Although Qin Lang's class utilized a lute and dual swords, after becoming a demigod, he could wield all weapons without being bound to any specific class. He simply found dual shortswords more comfortable to use, and they offered class attribute bonuses.

During those ten years, the God of Self had taught Qin Lang a vast amount of combat knowledge. Ten years of uninterrupted battles had finally allowed Qin Lang to accumulate sufficient combat experience, rather than relying solely on skills imparted by the system. Thus, guiding Ken and Mia in using spears and longbows was a breeze for him.

By the time Xia Xifeng emerged from the magic vehicle, Ken and Mia already regarded Qin Lang as their master, their eyes filled with immense respect whenever they looked at him.

Xia Xifeng let out a yawn. "Tom, take a walk with me." It was time to initiate the quest.

This quest was related to the Hanging Tree from the event.

For players to trigger the event dungeon, they needed to hang themselves collectively from that tree, sending their souls into another world. That tree was originally one of the nodes maintaining the road's magic array. One day, monsters corrupted this node and intended to use it as a base to blow up the entire road. The roadkeeper couple discovered this on a night with a blood-red full moon, left a message, and entered the pocket dimension within the tree one after the other to investigate.

The players would then accept the commission in Greensand City to go investigate the situation of Ken and Mia, from whom no information had been returned for a long time.

chunks.chineseText:
第106章 一更

肯和米娅虽然是在血月满月时才发现路标结点出了问题，但这问题其实已经存在很长时间了，只要到了有血色月光照耀的夜晚，就能很容易破开异空间。

血色月光的浓度不够也没问题，夏兮风和秦琅刷副本积攒了许多外神神性，阿穆若偶尔回来的时候还会带一些从外神身上薅下来的材料。夏兮风和苏尔尝试几次后，就做出了能开启外神掌控的异空间的钥匙。

有了钥匙，他们就能神不知鬼不觉地进入外神掌控的异空间，而不是用本土神灵的神性强行开启异空间，引发外神的注视。

夏兮风已经在绿沙城附近找到小型异空间，验证了钥匙的可靠性——自从末世降临，世界各处都可能出现裂缝，冒出各种奇奇怪怪的腐化怪。

在游戏中这个设定的表现就是地图隔一段时间就会刷怪，以免玩家刷完地图怪后没怪可打。

夏兮风来到路标结点所在的大树时，肯又生出警惕：“请问尊敬的炼金术师，您这是要干什么？”

夏兮风没回答，直接将钥匙凑近大树。

大树表面出现空间扭曲现象，吓了肯一跳。

“我通过研究神树，发现这个结点有不对劲的地方。”夏兮风转头看向肯，“这和绿……银月圣城附近出现的会涌出怪物的空间裂缝类似。”

肯惊骇道：“结点已经被破坏了？我每天都有检查！”

“如果是邪神的布置，普通的检查不会暴露祂们的阴谋。”夏兮风道，“你先联系绿沙城，我和汤姆立刻进入裂缝查探。”

肯警惕地握紧长矛。

秦琅翻了个白眼，长叹了一口气：“我们身份不明，只要守路人有一点智商，都不会任由我们乱来！”

夏兮风反驳：“什么叫乱来？我们不是要解决问题吗？”

秦琅道：“他又不认识我们，怎么可能立刻信任我们是要去解决问题？”

夏兮风道：“我不是拿出了银月之城城主的证明了吗？”

秦琅嘴角微抽：“你是真傻还是假傻？只是一个城主证明，也不可能让他将重要干道的节点交给我们。”

肯：“……”

经过一天的相处，他相信这两个人是好人。但如汤姆所说，他确实不能把道路重要节点的安危托付给不认识的人，至少也要先回去打个报告，证实这两人的身份。

他还在想怎么拒绝两人，这两人怎么吵起来了？

肯犹豫道：“听二位的话，二位有其他证据证明身份，以让我支持你们检查这个结点？”

夏兮风掏出一份银月圣城的城主任命书：“我此次出游还有个任务，就是检查道路节点。”

肯摇头：“这份任命书虽然是真的，但我没有接到上面的通知，仍旧不能立刻让两位先生进入节点之中。请二位稍等一天，我会尽快核实此事。”

夏兮风看向秦琅：“等吗？多等一天，戴蒙会不会把我们抓回去？”

秦琅问道：“你拿到任命书的时候，不是说已经让银月城主通知守路人了吗？”

夏兮风挠头：“咦，是吗？可能我以为我说了？”

秦琅：“……”他后悔了，信任夏兮风就是个错误。

他们刚回希望之城就准备逃跑，因为秦琅一直和戴蒙一起工作，所以常把自己关在工作室的夏兮风更容易取得逃跑的道具。

秦琅已经给夏兮风列好了可能会用上的道具，夏兮风拍胸脯说一定能做好，结果还是出了纰漏。

对于夏兮风时不时下线的智商，秦琅真想在他脑袋上敲一个大包。

夏兮风讪讪道：“可能太忙了，忙忘记了。好啦好啦，也不是什么重要的事。”

夏兮风撤掉了伪装，对肯不好意思地笑了笑：“我们曾经见过一面，我相信你还记得我。”

他拿出另一个城主徽章——希望之城的城主徽章。

肯不敢置信地张大嘴：“您……您……”

夏兮风用胳膊肘撞了一下秦琅。

秦琅撤掉伪装：“你不是说要伪装身份？这还有什么意义？”

夏兮风干咳了一声：“这里就只有肯和米娅，我们不伪装也没事，进了城再好好伪装。等完成这件事后，我们好好清理一下伪装的道具，下次绝对不出错！”

秦琅懒得回答。他已经对夏兮风失望了，不会再相信夏兮风。让夏兮风准备伪装的事，就是个错误。之后他会自己来。

肯仍旧不敢置信：“希望城城主？”

夏兮风点头：“应该没人会伪装成我们吧？呃，如果你还不信……”

肯忙道：“我信，我信。”

他不好意思地笑了笑：“可能您忘记了，您这次送的蛋糕和上次一样。我本来只是感到很巧合。”

“哦，对哦。”夏兮风笑道，“就算有人伪装我们，也不会拿出和当初一模一样的蛋糕，因为那是我亲手做的！”

系统批量制作，连上面的奶油都一模一样。

肯惊讶：“您亲自做的？”

夏兮风笑眯眯道：“你的长矛和你妻子的长弓也是我亲自做的。等这件事结束，我再给你们换个更好用的。你先回去通知绿沙城吧，我和琅去裂缝看看。记得和绿沙城说，是汤姆和杰瑞进入了节点。”

肯哭笑不得：“绿沙城知道二位的假名吗？”

夏兮风道：“老师应该能猜到。能使用钥匙的人不多。”

他对肯摆了摆手，靠近秦琅，双手环住秦琅的脖子：“走！”

秦琅深吸了一口气，没好气道：“你完全可以偷偷进入裂缝，不用多此一举。”

夏兮风道：“秦琅，你有没有发现你越来越啰嗦了？啰嗦什么？赶紧进去啊。”

秦琅：“……”

他不是越来越啰嗦，而是从小到大面对夏兮风的时候，哪怕再不想说话，有时候也免不了啰嗦。

秦琅不想再和夏兮风说话。他将夏兮风揽进怀里护住，跳进了裂缝之中。

裂缝合上，路标节点恢复正常。

肯立刻检查节点。

与以前无数次检查一样，这次大树节点也没有任何问题。

他擦了擦额头上的冷汗，感到了事情的棘手。

不过再棘手的事，希望之城两位城主都亲自出手了，应该都能解决。

经过守城战之后，夏兮风和秦琅的威名已经响彻整个荒芜之境，肯当然也听到过。

他又担忧，又惊喜。

肯赶紧跑回家，咧开嘴道：“米娅！米娅！你知道今天的客人的真实身份吗！”

米娅一巴掌打在肯的胳膊上：“我当然知道他们的身份肯定经过了伪装。但既然他们伪装了身份，就是不愿意别人得知他们的真实身份。他们信任你，将真实身份告诉了你，你就该闭上嘴，谁也别说，连我也别说。”

肯立刻从狂喜中冷静下来，板着脸道：“你说得对。”

米娅对丈夫笑了笑：“不过看你这么惊喜，再想想今天的蛋糕，这两位应该就是那两位了。”

肯使劲点头：“就是那两位。”

夫妻二人十分默契，不用直言也明白彼此未言明的话。
chunks.englishText:
Although Ken and Mia had only discovered the problem with the landmark node during the full blood moon, the issue had actually existed for a very long time. As long as it was a night illuminated by the blood-red moonlight, one could easily breach the pocket dimension.

Even if the concentration of blood-red moonlight wasn't enough, it posed no problem. Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang had accumulated plenty of outer god divinity from farming dungeons, and Asura would occasionally bring back materials stripped from outer gods whenever he returned. After a few attempts, Xia Xifeng and Sol had crafted a key capable of opening pocket dimensions controlled by outer gods.

With the key, they could enter outer-god-controlled pocket dimensions without a sound, rather than forcefully opening them using the divinity of native gods, which would draw the outer gods' gaze.

Xia Xifeng had already located a small pocket dimension near Greensand City to verify the key's reliability—ever since the apocalypse arrived, spatial rifts could appear anywhere in the world, spewing out all kinds of bizarre corrupted monsters.

In the game, this setting manifested as the map spawning monsters at regular intervals to prevent players from running out of targets after clearing the area.

When Xia Xifeng reached the large tree where the landmark node was located, Ken once again grew vigilant. "Respected alchemist, may I ask what you are doing?"

Without answering, Xia Xifeng pressed the key directly against the tree.

A spatial distortion appeared on the tree's surface, startling Ken.

"Through studying the Sacred Tree, I discovered something wrong with this node." Xia Xifeng turned to look at Ken. "It's similar to the spatial rifts near Green... Silvermoon Holy City that spew out monsters."

Ken said in horror, "The node has already been compromised? But I check it every day!"

"If it's the handiwork of an evil god, ordinary checks won't expose Their plot," Xia Xifeng said. "Contact Greensand City first. Tom and I will enter the rift immediately to investigate."

Ken gripped his spear tightly, full of caution.

Qin Lang rolled his eyes and let out a long sigh. "Our identities are unknown. As long as a roadkeeper possesses a shred of intelligence, he won't let us act recklessly!"

Xia Xifeng retorted, "What do you mean 'act recklessly'? Aren't we here to solve the problem?"

Qin Lang said, "He doesn't even know us. How could he immediately trust that we're here to solve the problem?"

Xia Xifeng said, "Didn't I produce the proof from the City Lord of Silvermoon City?"

The corner of Qin Lang's mouth twitched slightly. "Are you really dumb or just playing dumb? A mere City Lord's proof wouldn't make him hand over the node of a major arterial road to us."

Ken: "..."

After spending a day together, he believed these two were good people. But just as Tom said, he truly couldn't entrust the safety of a crucial road node to strangers. At the very least, he had to report back first and confirm their identities.

He was still pondering how to decline them when the two of them suddenly started arguing.

Ken said hesitantly, "Listening to you two, do you have other evidence to prove your identities so that I can allow you to inspect this node?"

Xia Xifeng pulled out an appointment document from the City Lord of Silvermoon Holy City. "I have another task on this trip, which is to inspect the road nodes."

Ken shook his head. "Although this appointment letter is real, I haven't received notice from above, so I still cannot let you two enter the node right away. Please wait a day, gentlemen. I will verify this as quickly as possible."

Xia Xifeng looked at Qin Lang. "Shall we wait? If we wait another day, will Damon come grab us back?"

Qin Lang asked, "When you got the appointment letter, didn't you say you already had the City Lord of Silvermoon inform the roadkeepers?"

Xia Xifeng scratched his head. "Huh, is that so? Maybe I just thought I said it?"

Qin Lang: "..." He regretted it now; trusting Xia Xifeng was a mistake.

They had planned to escape the moment they returned to the City of Hope. Because Qin Lang was constantly working with Damon, Xia Xifeng, who often locked himself in his workshop, had an easier time procuring items for their escape.

Qin Lang had compiled a list of tools they might need, and Xia Xifeng had slapped his chest, promising he would get everything ready. Yet a flaw still popped up.

Regarding Xia Xifeng's periodically offline intelligence, Qin Lang truly wanted to knock a giant bump onto his head.

Xia Xifeng laughed bashfully. "Maybe I was too busy and forgot. Alright, alright, it's no big deal."

Xia Xifeng stripped away his disguise and gave Ken an apologetic smile. "We've met once before. I believe you still remember me."

He pulled out another City Lord badge—the badge of the City Lord of the City of Hope.

Ken's mouth fell open in disbelief. "You... You..."

Xia Xifeng nudged Qin Lang with his elbow.

Qin Lang shed his disguise as well. "Didn't you say we needed to disguise our identities? What's the point of this now?"

Xia Xifeng coughed dryly. "It's just Ken and Mia here, so it's fine if we don't disguise ourselves. We can disguise properly after entering the city. Once we finish this matter, we'll thoroughly clean up our disguise tools and definitely won't make a mistake next time!"

Qin Lang couldn't be bothered to reply. He was already disappointed in Xia Xifeng and would never trust him again. Leaving the disguise preparations to Xia Xifeng had been a mistake from the start. He would handle it himself in the future.

Ken was still in disbelief. "The City Lord of Hope?"

Xia Xifeng nodded. "No one would pretend to be us, right? Uh, if you still don't believe it..."

Ken hurriedly said, "I believe you, I believe you!"

He gave an embarrassed laugh. "Perhaps you forgot, but the cake you brought this time is identical to the one from before. At first, I just thought it was a coincidence."

"Oh, right!" Xia Xifeng smiled. "Even if someone disguised themselves as us, they wouldn't bring out a cake identical to the one back then—because I made that with my own hands!"

Batch-produced by the system, down to the cream pattern on top being exactly the same.

Ken was surprised. "You made it yourself?"

Xia Xifeng said with a beaming smile, "Your spear and your wife's longbow were also made by me personally. Once this matter is settled, I'll swap them for even better ones for you. Go back and notify Greensand City first; Lang and I will head into the rift to check things out. Remember to tell Greensand City that Tom and Jerry entered the node."

Ken was between laughter and tears. "Does Greensand City know your pseudonyms?"

Xia Xifeng said, "Teacher should be able to guess. Not many people can use this key."

He waved at Ken, approached Qin Lang, and wrapped his arms around Qin Lang's neck. "Let's go!"

Qin Lang took a deep breath and said grumpily, "You could have snuck into the rift directly without making such a fuss."

Xia Xifeng said, "Qin Lang, haven't you noticed you're getting more and more nagging? What are you nagging about? Hurry up and get in!"

Qin Lang: "..."

It wasn't that he was getting more nagging, but rather that whenever he faced Xia Xifeng, no matter how much he didn't want to speak, he couldn't help being nagged into replying.

Qin Lang didn't want to talk to Xia Xifeng anymore. He pulled Xia Xifeng into his arms to shield him and leaped into the rift.

The rift snapped shut, and the landmark node returned to normal.

Ken immediately inspected the node.

Just like the countless checks he had conducted before, there was nothing wrong with the tree node this time either.

He wiped the cold sweat from his forehead, sensing how tricky the situation was.

However, no matter how tricky things were, with the two City Lords of Hope personally stepping in, everything should be resolvable.

After the city defense war, Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang's legendary names had resounded throughout the entire Desolate Realm. Ken had naturally heard of them as well.

He felt both anxious and overjoyed.

Ken sprinted back home, grinning broadly. "Mia! Mia! Do you know the real identities of today's guests?!"

Mia slapped Ken's arm hard. "Of course I knew their identities were disguised! But since they disguised themselves, it means they didn't want others to know who they really were. They trusted you and revealed their true identities to you, so you should keep your mouth shut and tell no one—not even me!"

Ken instantly cooled down from his wild joy and put on a serious face. "You're right."

Mia smiled at her husband. "Still, seeing how overjoyed you are, and thinking back to today's cake, those two must be *those* two."

Ken nodded vigorously. "They are indeed those two."

The couple shared a tacit understanding, needing no explicit words to comprehend what remained unsaid.

chunks.chineseText:
肯小声道：“杰瑞先生说，蛋糕、长矛和长弓都是他亲自做的。”

米娅捂住差点惊呼出声的嘴。

肯笑道：“我联系绿沙城去了。虽然肯定有大事发生，但有那两位在，一定没有问题。”

米娅点头：“当然。”

能让那两位亲自出手的事一定很严重，但同样，再严重的事到了那两位手中，都一定不是问题。

那可是在守城战中能直接伤到神域中神灵的传说战士啊。

肯急着联系绿沙城，夏兮风和秦琅已经进入了裂缝中。

电脑中的游戏画面变成了“全息景象”，两人仍旧对此感到十分熟悉。

游戏中的任务再跌宕起伏，如果拆解之后，也就是找路、开机关、战斗打怪。

夏兮风对任务副本了如指掌，副本中的腐化怪对秦琅也不值一提，再加上没了守路人小两口的戏份，任务没了剧情内容，这次任务就显得有点无聊了。

整个任务流程，就是夏兮风指哪里，秦琅就打哪里。

秦琅负责杀怪，夏兮风负责指路和开机关。如果不是副本中的景色不太好，他们简直和郊游似的。

夏兮风抱怨道：“在游戏里看见一片枯树林还没什么，现实中看见还真有点阴森。”

秦琅不回答。他只是一个没有感情的杀怪机器。

如以往一样，夏兮风和秦琅说话，可不管秦琅是否回答。他一直叭叭叭个不停，表达自己对这次副本没有好景色的不满，顺便把这个任务流程顺了一遍。

《奇域幻想》中几乎所有有剧情的任务，其剧情起点都在末世前——游戏为了让玩家放心杀怪，安心地站在拯救世界这一面，而不是去给幕后boss找什么凄美的理由，设定外神就是规则和梦世界不兼容，双方无法理解，怪物都没有理智，没有苦衷。

如果玩家要刷的BOSS有凄美的故事，那这个故事一定来自末世之前，是梦世界本土NPC的故事，只是延续到了末世。

这个任务也一样。

《守路人的记事本》这个任务是常规的“调查”任务，玩家在绿沙城接到任务后，先找到守路人的记事本，然后进入裂缝，在裂缝中的异空间继续到处找守路人的记事本残页，一步一步解密真相。

在这个任务中，玩家会先遇到肯，然后与肯一同寻找米娅。

米娅会出现在记事本残页所在的地方。每获得一张残页，玩家不仅能得到下一张残页的地点，获得一点剧情解密，还会看到一段剧情CG。剧情CG是末世来临之前，米娅和肯从相识到结婚的甜蜜故事。

作者有话要说：

晚安。
chunks.englishText:
Ken whispered, "Mr. Jerry said that the cake, the spear, and the longbow were all made by his own hands."

Mia covered her mouth, suppressing what almost became an exclamation of shock.

Ken smiled. "I'll go contact Greensand City now. Even though something major is definitely happening, as long as those two are on it, there won't be any problem."

Mia nodded. "Of course."

Anything requiring those two to personally intervene had to be extremely severe. Yet by the same token, no matter how severe a problem was, in their hands, it would definitely be resolved.

After all, those were legendary warriors who could directly harm gods within their divine domains during the city defense war!

While Ken was rushing to contact Greensand City, Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang had already entered the rift.

The game scenes on a computer screen had turned into a "holographic landscape," yet the two still felt immensely familiar with it.

No matter how full of twists and turns a quest was in the game, once broken down, it was just pathfinding, triggering mechanisms, and fighting monsters.

Xia Xifeng knew the quest dungeon like the back of his hand, and the corrupted monsters inside were trivial to Qin Lang. Coupled with the absence of the roadkeeper couple's storyline drama, the quest lacked narrative content, making this run feel somewhat boring.

The entire quest process boiled down to Qin Lang striking wherever Xia Xifeng pointed.

Qin Lang was in charge of killing monsters, while Xia Xifeng was responsible for guiding the way and unlocking mechanisms. If not for the dreary scenery inside the dungeon, they might as well have been on a pleasant outing.

Xia Xifeng complained, "Seeing a withered forest in a game is one thing, but seeing it in real life is actually pretty spooky."

Qin Lang didn't answer. He was merely an emotionless monster-slaying machine.

As usual, when Xia Xifeng talked to Qin Lang, he never cared whether Qin Lang replied. He babbled on incessantly, expressing his dissatisfaction with the lack of nice scenery in this dungeon, while reviewing the quest flow along the way.

In *Fantastic Fantasy*, almost every quest with a plot had its backstory set before the apocalypse—to allow players to slay monsters with a clear conscience and stand firmly on the side of saving the world, rather than seeking out some tragically beautiful excuse for the mastermind behind the scenes, the game lore established that outer gods were fundamentally incompatible with the rules of the Dream World. Neither side could understand the other; the monsters possessed neither sanity nor tragic motives.

If a boss that players had to farm had a tragically beautiful story, that story definitely originated from before the apocalypse—it belonged to the native NPCs of the Dream World and merely extended into the post-apocalyptic era.

This quest was no exception.

The quest *The Roadkeeper's Journal* was a standard "investigation" quest. After accepting the quest in Greensand City, players would first locate the roadkeeper's journal, then enter the rift and search everywhere in the pocket dimension for missing pages of the journal, uncovering the truth step by step.

In this quest, players would first meet Ken and then join him in searching for Mia.

Mia would appear at the locations where the missing journal pages were hidden. With every page obtained, players would not only get the location of the next page and decipher a bit of the plot, but they would also view a story cutscene. The cutscene depicted the sweet love story of Mia and Ken, from their first meeting to their marriage, before the apocalypse arrived.

chunks.chineseText:
第107章 一更

令人感动的剧情，不需要太多花里胡哨，更不必有多高的立意。

就如肯与米娅的爱情一点都没有惊天动地，写成小说都会被说成太过日常，留不住读者一样。

玩家只是在末世后，看见一对平平凡凡的小夫妻在阳光和鲜花中偶然初遇，在艰苦又刺激的佣兵生活中相知相爱。

他们离开了佣兵团，选择了安稳的生活，想攒下一笔钱，然后搬进城里，生个孩子，一辈子平平常常地过完。

守路人是有轮岗假期的。

他们已经攒够了功勋，在绿沙城买了房子。

每当假期的时候，他们就会穿上最好的衣服，去教会一条街看看教会又在免费送什么，在中央广场上观赏吟游诗人和舞姬的最新作品，最后他们会逛一逛小商店，买一点生活用品回家，再为对方选一份小礼物。

小礼物要包装好，等回到守路人小屋时，他们才会拆开对方的礼物，然后相视会心一笑。

玩家找到了所有守路人记事本残页，也看完了他们平淡的爱情。

在最后一篇残页前，米娅对着肯微笑：“我找到你了。你记起我了吗？”

不是跟着玩家一路走来的肯找到了米娅，记起了米娅，而是米娅说她找到了肯，问肯是否记起了她。

这时玩家才恍然想起一个原本以为不怎么重要的任务细节——是肯先进入裂缝，伤势未愈的米娅为了肯，后进入的裂缝。

肯和米娅都已经死了。肯已经被腐化，这个任务的boss就是肯，米娅已经被腐化的肯杀死。

她的身体虽然死了，灵魂却被肯放过。

但米娅没有回归死神的怀抱，而是拥抱腐化的肯，将肯的灵魂从腐化的身体中推了出来。

她的灵魂因此被撕裂成了碎片，随着破碎的记事本飞到了异空间各处，引导玩家和肯的灵魂的到来。

任务的结局当然是HE。

玩家杀死了没有灵魂的腐化身体，肯和米娅回归了死亡的怀抱。

在末世中，能回归死亡之神怀抱的双死也算HE。——游戏策划

玩家：刀在手，杀策狗！

一段平平淡淡的爱情，一对平平凡凡的夫妻，成为玩家心目中的绝美爱情的代表。

肯和米娅没有来到这个异空间，《守路人的记事本》剧情不会出现了，这个副本便只剩下打怪和找路。

夏兮风录制过副本攻略，并为懒惰的老板们搜刮过无数次这个副本，什么文字解密都可以忽视，直接朝着目的地走就成了。

这个副本背后的外神，是世界树对应的外神，“侵蚀世界壁障的蠕虫”。

世界树将残骸撒下，护住了梦世界的地脉，蠕虫之神也不会什么事都不做。

祂们谋划了那么多年，在梦世界留下无数钉子。结束末世的过程，就是拔钉子的过程。

蠕虫之神便在所有交通干道下面钻洞，利用人类的道路来侵蚀地脉。玩家揭穿这个阴谋，将道路夺回来。

可惜玩家和NPC无法杀掉投奔外神，造成路标节点被外神侵蚀的罪魁祸首，因为罪魁祸首在末世来临那一刻就炸了。

所有帮外神制造末世的人全部在末世来临那一刻便炸了，炸成一团没有意识的腐化血肉，在各个副本中等待玩家的光临。

“收获不少。”夏兮风不断往背包里丢垃圾。所有垃圾都能卖给系统，一个铜板也是钱，积少成多，他不嫌弃，“我还记得你第一次做这个任务的时候，困得睡着了。”

那是他们的冷战在第一次攻城战后结束。主线支线任务接取后都可以共享，一同进行任务。任务开荒也需要战斗力，夏兮风便拉着秦琅这个苦力一起开荒。

两人语音开荒，开着开着，秦琅的角色不动了，夏兮风喊了他很久，才知道他睡着了。

秦琅：“是很困。剧情太多，很无聊。”那时候游戏还没有更新剧情跳过。

夏兮风冷哼道：“那么好的剧情，你还能看困？哦，我想起你那段记忆了。你白天上了一天课，晚上熬夜肝游戏，所以才熬不住了吧？你还骗我，说你白天睡够了，能熬夜。”

秦琅不说话。他想把已经死透了的自我之神拖出来鞭尸。

夏兮风可不知道什么叫见好就收，专踹瘸子瘸了的那条腿。

之前没机会说，现在提起两人第一次合作过副本，夏兮风的话可太多了。

夏兮风：“我说如果你方便，就帮我肝痛苦号的单。你居然还开小号熬夜练技术，你的肝还好吗？头发还尚在吗？你也太爱面子了。”

秦琅：“……”他要去把自我之神的骨灰扬了。

夏兮风一会儿咋咋呼呼地在副本中的特色地点打卡，一会儿哔哔秦琅曾经的死要面子活受罪。

秦琅也看过夏兮风的记忆，但他死活挑不出反驳的话。

不是夏兮风丢脸的事少，而是夏兮风的脸皮够厚，性格够坦荡，不像秦琅要脸。秦琅就算用同等的事嘲讽夏兮风，夏兮风也能仰着他那堪比城墙的脸皮，给秦琅一个“就是我，咋地”的表情。

夏兮风跳到一面墙下，摩挲着墙上的花纹：“嘿，终于看到这个了！”

走过寂寥的枯树林，两人来到仿佛城池废墟的地方。

城池废墟的断垣残壁上雕刻着矮人的文字，这些交通干道下的地下空间，全是矮人挖掘出来的。根据最早的文字记载，已经几百年了。

夏兮风摩挲的花纹，就是矮人王族的纹章。

当玩家解密结束，谜底就指向这里。下一个任务，玩家就会拿着这个花纹拓印去矮人王国。守路人的任务下一环便是去矮人王国。

刻在断墙上的矮人王族纹章少了些壁画，多了几条裂缝形成的花纹，看上去像一个“囍”字。

于是有许多无聊的玩家都会在这里布置玫瑰等装饰品，在副本中演一出拜堂成亲的戏。

在《奇域幻想》中，共死也算HE，所以这个副本是HE的绝美爱情副本，别管它多阴森，都成为情侣玩家的拍照打卡地点。

虽然那是夏兮风开荒之后的事，但在夏兮风拉着秦琅开荒的时候，就发现了这面墙上的花纹很是奇特。

当时夏兮风在这附近使劲找机关，寻找有没有遗漏的线索。秦琅则悄悄地睡着了。

听着耳机那边传来的秦琅浅浅的呼吸声，看着秦琅那个正好站在“囍”字下面的游戏角色，夏兮风恶向胆边生，当即对秦琅的角色恶作剧。

“秦琅，你醒不醒啊？你还醒不醒啊？你不醒，你的清白就被我玷污了哦。”

“嘿嘿，不醒是吧？你也不想你的角色上游戏论坛八一八吧？”

“啧，居然真的不醒。那就别怪我啰。”

夏兮风在秦琅的游戏角色身边摆满喜庆的装饰品，对秦琅的角色做出“拥抱”“亲吻”等动作，并拍照留存，全部打包发给秦琅。

秦琅还在睡，夏兮风怎么吵他都没醒。

于是夏兮风的恶作剧升级，上游戏论坛、贴吧发表了“情侣圣地”的帖子，将截图全放了上去。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 107: First Update (Part 1)

A touching storyline doesn't need too many bells and whistles, nor does it require some grand, lofty theme.

Just like the love between Ken and Mia, which wasn't earth-shattering in the slightest. If written as a novel, it would be criticized as too mundane to keep readers.

Players simply saw, in the post-apocalyptic world, an ordinary young couple meeting by chance amidst sunshine and flowers, and falling in love through the hardships and thrills of mercenary life.

They left the mercenary group, choosing a stable life. They wanted to save up some money, move into the city, have a child, and live out their lives in quiet normalcy.

Roadkeepers had rotational leave.

They had saved up enough merit to buy a house in Green Sand City.

Whenever they had time off, they would put on their best clothes, head to Church Street to see what freebies the church was giving away, watch the latest performances of bards and dancers in the central plaza, and finally browse the small shops to buy some household necessities and pick out a small gift for each other.

The small gifts had to be beautifully wrapped. Only when they returned to the Roadkeeper's cabin would they unwrap each other's presents and share a knowing, heartfelt smile.

Players found all the torn pages of the Roadkeeper's journal and read through their quiet, ordinary love story.

Before the final torn page, Mia smiled at Ken: "I found you. Do you remember me?"

It wasn't Ken, who had traveled all this way with the player, who found Mia and remembered her. It was Mia who said she had found Ken, asking if he remembered her.

Only then did players suddenly recall a quest detail they had previously thought insignificant—Ken had entered the rift first, and Mia, her injuries still unhealed, had entered after him for his sake.

Both Ken and Mia were already dead. Ken had been corrupted; the boss of this quest was Ken himself, and Mia had been killed by the corrupted Ken.

Though her body was dead, her soul was spared by Ken.

But Mia did not return to the embrace of the God of Death. Instead, she embraced the corrupted Ken, pushing Ken's soul out of his corrupted body.

Because of this, her soul was torn into fragments, scattering to various corners of the pocket dimension along with the torn pages of the journal, guiding the arrival of the player and Ken's soul.

The ending of the quest was, of course, a Happy Ending (HE).

The players killed the soulless, corrupted body, and Ken and Mia returned to the embrace of death.

*In a post-apocalyptic world, a double death where both can return to the embrace of the God of Death is also considered a Happy Ending. — Game Designer*

Players: *Grab your blades, slaughter the devs!*

A plain, simple love story, an ordinary couple, became the ultimate representation of beautiful love in the minds of the players.

Since Ken and Mia hadn't come to this pocket dimension, the storyline of the "Roadkeeper's Journal" wouldn't trigger. This dungeon was now reduced to just killing monsters and finding the way.

Xia Xifeng had recorded dungeon guides and cleared this dungeon countless times for lazy bosses. He could completely ignore any text puzzles and head straight for the destination.

The Outer God behind this dungeon was the counterpart to the World Tree: "The Worm that Erodes the World Barrier."

The World Tree had scattered its remains to protect the ley lines of the Dream World, and the Worm God wouldn't just sit idly by.

They had plotted for so many years, leaving countless stakes in the Dream World. The process of ending the apocalypse was the process of pulling out these stakes.

The Worm God bored tunnels beneath all the main transportation routes, using human roads to erode the ley lines. The players' job was to expose this conspiracy and reclaim the roads.

Unfortunately, players and NPCs couldn't kill the main culprit who had defected to the Outer God and caused the road sign nodes to be eroded, because the culprit had exploded the very moment the apocalypse arrived.

Everyone who helped the Outer Gods bring about the apocalypse exploded the moment it began, turning into mindless masses of corrupted flesh, waiting in various dungeons for the players to visit.

"Quite a harvest." Xia Xifeng kept tossing junk into his inventory. All junk could be sold to the system. A copper coin was still money, and small amounts added up; he wasn't picky. "I still remember the first time you did this quest, you were so tired you fell asleep."

That was when their cold war ended after the first siege battle. Main and side quests could be shared once accepted, allowing them to proceed together. Clearing new dungeons also required combat power, so Xia Xifeng had dragged Qin Lang along as labor.

The two of them were on voice chat while clearing the dungeon. As they went, Qin Lang's character stopped moving. Xia Xifeng called out to him for a long time before realizing he had fallen asleep.

Qin Lang: "I was very tired. There was too much dialogue, it was boring." Back then, the game hadn't updated to allow skipping cutscenes yet.

Xia Xifeng snorted. "Such a great storyline, and you actually fell asleep watching it? Oh, I remember your memory of that. You had classes all day, and then stayed up all night grinding the game, which is why you couldn't hold out, right? And you even lied to me, saying you got enough sleep during the day and could pull an all-nighter."

Qin Lang remained silent. He wanted to drag out the long-dead God of Ego and whip his corpse.

Xia Xifeng didn't know the meaning of quitting while ahead; he specialized in kicking a man while he was down.

He hadn't had the chance to bring it up before, but now that their first dungeon co-op was mentioned, Xia Xifeng had endless things to say.

Xia Xifeng: "I said if it was convenient, you could help me boost some pain accounts. To think you actually made an alt to stay up late and practice your skills. How is your liver doing? Do you still have hair? You care way too much about saving face."

Qin Lang: "..." He was going to scatter the God of Ego's ashes.

One moment, Xia Xifeng was noisily taking screenshots at scenic spots in the dungeon, and the next, he was nagging about how Qin Lang used to suffer just to save face.

Qin Lang had also seen Xia Xifeng's memories, but he couldn't find a single thing to throw back in his face.

It wasn't that Xia Xifeng had fewer embarrassing moments, but rather that Xia Xifeng was incredibly thick-skinned and open-natured, unlike Qin Lang, who cared about his dignity. Even if Qin Lang mocked Xia Xifeng with something equivalent, Xia Xifeng would just puff out his chest with a face as thick as a city wall and give Qin Lang a look that said, "Yeah, that was me, so what?"

Xia Xifeng jumped down to a wall, tracing the patterns on it. "Hey, I finally found this!"

Passing through the lonely, withered forest, the two arrived at what looked like the ruins of a city.

The broken walls and debris of the ruined city were carved with Dwarven script. These underground spaces beneath the main roads had all been excavated by dwarves. According to the earliest written records, it had been hundreds of years.

The pattern Xia Xifeng was tracing was the crest of the Dwarven royal family.

Once the players finished decrypting, the answer would point here. For the next quest, players would take a rubbing of this pattern to the Dwarven Kingdom. The next step of the Roadkeeper's quest was to go to the Dwarven Kingdom.

The Dwarven royal crest carved on the broken wall was missing some of its original murals, but had a few extra cracks forming a pattern that looked like the character "囍" (Double Happiness).

Thus, many bored players would set up roses and other decorations here to stage a wedding ceremony inside the dungeon.

In *Strange Realms Fantasy*, dying together was also considered a Happy Ending, so this dungeon became known as the ultimate romantic dungeon with a Happy Ending. No matter how gloomy it was, it became a popular photo-taking spot for player couples.

Although that happened after Xia Xifeng's initial run, back when he was dragging Qin Lang along to clear it, he had already noticed that the pattern on this wall was very peculiar.

At the time, Xia Xifeng was searching frantically for mechanisms nearby, looking for any missed clues. Qin Lang, on the other hand, had quietly fallen asleep.

Hearing Qin Lang's soft breathing through his headphones and seeing Qin Lang's game character standing right under the "Double Happiness" character, a wicked idea popped into Xia Xifeng's head. He immediately began playing pranks on Qin Lang's character.

"Qin Lang, are you waking up? Are you waking up? If you don't wake up, I'm going to ruin your innocence."

"Heheh, not waking up, huh? You wouldn't want your character to be gossiped about on the game forums, would you?"

"Tsk, you're really not waking up. Don't blame me then."

Xia Xifeng surrounded Qin Lang's character with festive decorations, made his own character perform actions like "hug" and "kiss" toward Qin Lang's character, took screenshots, and packaged them all to send to Qin Lang.

Qin Lang was still asleep; no matter how much noise Xia Xifeng made, he didn't wake up.

So Xia Xifeng escalated his prank. He went to the game forums and Tieba to post a thread titled "The Holy Land for Couples," uploading all the screenshots.

是的，副本变成情侣圣地是夏兮风开荒之后发生的事，是夏兮风干的。

等秦琅醒来发现夏兮风的恶作剧后，表现得云淡风轻，完全没当回事，但夏兮风从秦琅的记忆看到，当时秦琅的表情特别丰富，特别有趣。

俗称，被雷到了。哈哈哈哈！

夏兮风单手把着秦琅的肩膀：“我还以为你真的没被我恶作剧成功呢。”

秦琅眉头一挑，反手将夏兮风按在了墙上。

夏兮风也眉头一挑：“怎么？想恶作剧回来？”

秦琅的手掌扣在夏兮风的后颈处，垂目看着夏兮风：“对。”

夏兮风笑着勾住秦琅的脖子，主动亲了上去。

恶作剧是不可能成功的，因为夏兮风会顺着杆子往上爬，半点不害羞。

他不仅不害羞，还截图发给了朋友。

正忙得昏天暗地的朋友们：“？？？”

过分了过分了，你们不在希望之城忙灾后重建，居然还秀起恩爱了？

谁要看你们接吻啊！说好的你们是去扫除外神的隐患了呢！

【夏兮风：我们确实在扫除外神隐患啊，只是碰巧遇到情侣拍照圣地而已。】

他将这个副本的剧情告诉了朋友们，让朋友们忙上加忙，痛苦地派出不多的人手排查各地路标。

【莱欧：但这和你发你和琅亲亲的画面有什么关系？

佩瑞拉：你不是不承认你们是情侣吗？

戴蒙：他们不是情侣，是夫夫。

夏兮风：别污蔑我和秦琅的清白，我和秦琅没结婚。

莱欧：打完仗结婚？

夏兮风：呸呸呸，立什么旗帜呢！】

秦琅有点心虚地收回视线。

他刚刚立下了打完仗就回老家结婚的旗帜，并且还是对着这个世界的创世神立的。

立旗帜什么的是封建迷信，我们不信这个。

夏兮风一只手牵着秦琅的手，一只手在虚空点点点，明明他只需要用意念在系统里聊天，根本不需要点来点去。

怪物不断地扑来，秦琅需要随时清怪，夏兮风还禁锢了他一只手，加大了他打怪的难度。

以矮人为主，其他动物为辅的腐烂尸体拼成的怪物越来越多，密密麻麻如潮水般涌来，好像一场小型怪物潮。

夏兮风的视线一直落在聊天页面，半点没留心过危险。

血腥和腐朽的臭味被夏兮风制造的“超级清洁防护罩魔导器”隔绝，他们的身周甚至有隐约的花香——这个味道是可以更改的，还有青草、大海、麦田等气味可供选择。

他牵着秦琅的手，仿佛走在安全的花田中。

作者有话要说：

晚安。

Chapter 107: First Update (Part 2)

Yes, the dungeon becoming a holy land for couples was something that happened after Xia Xifeng cleared it—it was entirely his doing.

When Qin Lang woke up and discovered Xia Xifeng's prank, he acted completely unfazed, as if it were nothing. But from Qin Lang's memories, Xia Xifeng saw that Qin Lang's expression at the time had been incredibly rich and amusing.

In common terms, he was utterly dumbfounded. Hahaha!

Xia Xifeng put an arm around Qin Lang's shoulder. "And here I thought my prank didn't work on you."

Qin Lang raised an eyebrow, reaching back to pin Xia Xifeng against the wall.

Xia Xifeng raised an eyebrow too. "What? Want to prank me back?"

Qin Lang's palm cupped the back of Xia Xifeng's neck, looking down at him. "Yes."

Xia Xifeng laughed, wrapping his arms around Qin Lang's neck, and proactively leaned in for a kiss.

A prank was never going to succeed, because Xia Xifeng would always take a mile if given an inch, without a shred of shyness.

Not only was he not shy, but he even took a screenshot and sent it to his friends.

His friends, who were busy out of their minds: "???"

This is too much, way too much! You guys aren't in the City of Hope helping with post-disaster reconstruction, and instead, you're flaunting your relationship?

Who wants to watch you two kiss! Didn't you say you were going to clear out the hidden threats of the Outer Gods!

[Xia Xifeng: We *are* clearing out the Outer Gods' hidden threats. We just happened to run into a scenic photo spot for couples.]

He shared the dungeon's storyline with his friends, making them even busier as they painfully dispatched their limited manpower to inspect road signs everywhere.

*Yes, I am doing official business.* Xia Xifeng was completely righteous.

[Leo: But what does that have to do with you sending pictures of you and Lang kissing?

Perilla: Didn't you refuse to admit you two are a couple?

Damon: They aren't a couple, they're husbands.

Xia Xifeng: Don't slander our innocence. Qin Lang and I aren't married.

Leo: Getting married after the war?

Xia Xifeng: Pfft, don't go raising death flags!]

Qin Lang guiltily averted his gaze.

He had just raised the flag of "returning to his hometown to get married after the war," and he had raised it right in front of this world's Creator God.

*Raising flags is just superstition. We don't believe in that.*

Xia Xifeng held Qin Lang's hand with one hand while tapping away in the air with the other. Even though he only needed to use his mind to chat in the system, he still insisted on tapping around.

Monsters kept lunging at them. Qin Lang had to clear them out at any moment, and with Xia Xifeng pinning down one of his hands, the difficulty of fighting was greatly increased.

The monsters—stitched together from rotting corpses, primarily dwarves and supplemented by other animals—grew more numerous, surging forward like a minor monster tide.

Xia Xifeng's gaze remained fixed on the chat interface, paying absolutely no attention to the danger.

The stench of blood and decay was blocked by the "Super Cleansing Shield Magic Tool" Xia Xifeng had crafted. There was even a faint scent of flowers around them—this scent could be customized, with options like fresh grass, the ocean, or wheat fields.

Holding Qin Lang's hand, it was as if they were strolling through a safe field of flowers.

***

The author has something to say:

Good night.

第108章 一更

肯联系了绿沙城之后，就一直守在大树处。

整整一夜后，天光微亮，大树处重新出现了空间破开的涟漪，一个大大的包裹从涟漪处掉了出来。

肯打开包裹后，里面有一张弓和一柄长矛，还有一封简短的信。

“这个节点已经修复，我和汤姆去其他地方旅行了，再会！~”

肯看着长弓和长矛，舒了一口气。

他抱着长弓和长矛往回跑，告诉米娅这个好消息。

他就说，有希望之城的城主在，什么难题都能解决。

肯和米娅开开心心地试用着新的武器。小夫妻俩只当这次“偶遇”是人生的惊喜。他们并不知道，两人与同死的HE擦肩而过。

当支援的人到达时，“杰瑞”和“汤姆”都不见了踪影。

戴蒙听闻此事后，冷笑了一声。

他就知道肯定逮不住这两人，所以没有亲自过来。

外神爪牙？就是对面是外神投影，一个夜晚也足够两人解决问题了。

……

矮人王都，黑铁城。

即使刚经历了怪物攻城，黑铁城中仍旧热闹非凡，有许多旅人往来。

危险意味着更多的机遇，原本较为排外的黑铁城也放开了居住者的限制。

各种公会都挂着永远接不完的任务，完成任务就有积分。只要拥有足够的积分，任何种族的人都能在黑铁城落户。

黑铁城的各项福利也和积分有关。积分可以兑换任何金钱、物品，甚至可以请锻造大师为其量身定制武器。

这个任务制度在末世来临前就已经完善。当末世到来时，各个政权很快就切换了适合末世的制度，没有造成太大混乱。

缴纳物资也能获得积分。只要有积分，在末世享受末世前的奢侈生活也不是问题。

在黑铁城最好的宾馆里，秦琅被从窗外透入的阳光晃了一下，睁开了眼睛。

他低头看着怀里。经过一夜缠绵，他和夏兮风都不着寸缕。

夏兮风还在睡，手脚都缠在秦琅身上，把秦琅当成了大型抱枕。

自从两人滚上床单后，夏兮风任由秦琅折腾，秦琅也不能再拒绝成为夏兮风的大型抱枕了。

秦琅睡不好？半神可以不睡觉，只要夏兮风睡得好就成。

从此以后，再也没有人嫌弃夏兮风睡相不好了，夏兮风可以理直气壮地让睡相更不好。

秦琅掀开被子，准备下床洗漱。

夏兮风白皙的肌肤露了出来，完美无瑕，一点红痕都没有。

秦琅眼神暗了暗。

半神的恢复力太强，夏兮风的恢复力在半神中都排名前列。无论昨夜他在夏兮风身上留下再多痕迹，早晨起来，所有记号都会消失。

被子被掀开，夏兮风抖了抖，表情惺忪地睁开眼：“唔？”

他的视线和秦琅对上。

夏兮风愣了愣，道：“你这什么表情？怎么满脸不爽？难道我睡着时狠狠踹了你一脚。”

秦琅收回视线：“没有。起床，已经和矮人王约好今天见面。”

夏兮风顺着秦琅刚才的视线低头：“你该不会是在气这个吧？”

不等秦琅反应，夏兮风继续道：“你嘬的印子大概两三个小时就会消失。不高兴的话，你每隔两三个小时补一次？”

秦琅：“……”

秦琅套上衣服下床洗漱。

夏兮风对着秦琅勾手：“别害羞啊。”

秦琅“啪嗒”一声关上洗浴间的门。

夏兮风的话从门外传来：“哎呀，秦琅怎么突然有了傲娇属性？恶心心。”

秦琅：“……”他开始反省。他就不该对夏兮风有那种心思。

今天的秦琅仍旧在怀疑自己的审美。

夏兮风再次击溃了秦琅，打着哈欠在被窝里赖床，非要磨蹭到秦琅洗漱完，把他从被窝里提溜出来，才能去洗漱。

两人享用了最贵的早餐，慢悠悠朝王宫走去。

路上行人匆匆，为了维持生计，各个种族的人都在第一时间奔向立有任务板的地方，寻找今天他们可以做的任务。

行人太多，为免走散，夏兮风抓住秦琅的手，在秦琅手心勾了勾：“有点在游戏里的感觉了。”

秦琅：“游戏里没有这么多NPC。”

夏兮风摇头：“谁和你说NPC了？你看那些NPC像不像抢任务的玩家？”

秦琅想了想，还真是。

黑铁城树立的任务板就是玩家接任务的地方。这个积分制度，完全就和《奇域幻想》的任务系统差不多。

夏兮风晃了晃脑袋：“末世到来，我们的生活节奏却好像变慢了。”

秦琅：“嗯。”

没有了“末日降临”这个时间死线，他们确实没有了紧迫感。

《奇域幻想》的主线任务就是外神和本土NPC各种大型攻防战。夏兮风和秦琅不需要主动去“接任务”，他们都会参与。

至于支线任务，世界各个角落里的悲剧太多了，他们只捡影响比较大的任务接。这些任务在游戏里没有时间限制，所以他们也不知道什么时候去，才能阻止悲剧，所以反而没有紧迫感了。

反正每做一个任务，世界就变好一分。

两人仍旧化名“杰瑞”和“汤姆”，以银月圣城炼金术师和他的伙伴的身份，带着各种介绍信面见矮人王。

秦琅本想改一个名字，但夏兮风装智障说他会记混，秦琅便只能忍了。

不然夏兮风下次说他记不住，又胡编两个更奇怪的名字怎么办？

这次因为准备充分，矮人王虽然身受重伤，但性命还在。他的脾气比末世前好了许多，傲气磨平了不少。

矮人王在末世前很喜欢争权夺利，力图把矮人王国变成矮人帝国，但志大才疏。

末世都到来了，矮人王只想带领矮人们熬过这个末世，没精力争权夺利，所以整个人的智商和情商都变得正常了。

看见手持银月圣城介绍信的人求见，矮人王立刻约定了时间，没有端着架子。

夏兮风这次没有暴露身份，而是以银月圣城游历的炼金术师的身份，将路标的事告知了矮人王，并将异空间的王族徽记拓印和关于异空间来历的资料都交给了矮人王。

“守路人”后续的任务，夏兮风就不打算和秦琅单独做了。

他只开启了任务，就把任务交给相关的人，让他们去完成任务。

绿沙城已经知道了路标出问题，将消息告知了其他城主和国王。矮人王自然也已经知道了路标的事。

得知帮助蠕虫之神挖地道的是自家先祖，矮人王露出了疲惫的神情：“信仰锻造之神不好吗？怎么会有王族信仰来历不明的邪神？”

夏兮风给矮人王解惑：“他们是自身锻造天赋不行的矮人，再努力也不能成为天才。锻造之神不会给予他们不属于他们的天赋，邪神承诺可以。”

矮人王问道：“他们的愿望实现了吗？”

夏兮风摇头：“邪神都是只承诺不兑现的。他们的灵魂和身体都已经腐化，被禁锢在他们打造的异空间内。”

矮人王叹气：“这就是贪婪。谢谢你们的告知，矮人会接回先祖，洗涤先祖的罪孽。”
