第116章 一更

夏兮风拿出一大匣子药瓶。

龙神疑惑道：“做多了？”

夏兮风摇头，拿出另一个药剂瓶子：“这里面装着你要求的药。但你的诅咒解除后，不需要恢复神力和修复神体的药品吗？”

夏兮风举着匣子：“应有尽有。”

在游戏中，龙神手撕外神后就陷入虚弱中，直到游戏大结局才出来参战。他必不能让龙神下线这么长时间。

多多吃药，赶紧爬起来打架！

早在封闭式训练的十年间，夏兮风就做了一大堆的药，并成功把药剂浓缩成了药丸。

秦琅在和自我之神打架的时候，夏兮风就往秦琅的人物面板上砸药。

经验不足打不过？我用药磨死你！这十年，夏兮风做得最多的就是补充神力和疗伤的药，全是神话品质，把秦琅养得极好。否则秦琅哪那么容易凝结神体？夏兮风在床上遭遇的人外刺激，都是他自己喂出来的。

龙神捏着小药瓶，闻了一口药香，惊讶极了：“你都能做神药了？”

夏兮风道：“我都点燃神火了，会做神药不是很正常吗？”

龙神哭笑不得：“谁告诉你能点燃神火，就能做神药？神灵受伤不是伤在血肉上。”

神灵的身体里流淌的不是血液，是概念和规则，这便是神力。血肉不过是它们具现化出来的模样。因此补充凡体血肉的药物对神灵无效。

神灵了解自己的身体，祂们知道怎么让自己更快痊愈，但如果想要治疗另一位神灵，就要掌握普适性地补充神力的规则。

打造神器也是这样。锻造之神能为其他神灵打造神器，而其他神灵打造的神器顶多赐给力量属性和自己相似的半神，其他神灵用不了。

拿在手上的神器尚且如此，更别提入口的药物了。在神界，唯一能制作出所有神灵都能服用的药物的神灵，便是生命之神。

龙神打量夏兮风：“你有天父的赐福，制作神话之下的东西都轻而易举。但正因为赐福太强大，你应该缺少学习的机会。”

夏兮风不解：“为什么会缺少？每次用制作台……用赐福制作物品的时候，知识都会在我脑海里流过，多流几次，不就会了？”

我脑海里又不是光滑的，中间好歹有点沟壑能截留点知识吧？

龙神的神情更加古怪。

除非打上印迹，否则单纯的灌输和在耳边念了一遍知识没区别。而打上印迹后，就绝对不可能领会创造的规则，制作神话级别的物品。

夏兮风已经能炼制出神话级别的药剂，显然天父的灌输知识就是在他耳边念了一遍。多听老师讲课就能听懂？要是这么容易，人人都能成为神灵了。

创造的天赋，可比战斗的天赋可怕多了。天父究竟从哪骗来的宝贝？

龙神晃了晃药瓶，药丸叮当响：“怎么是固体的？”

夏兮风道：“省体积。我一直很奇怪，为什么你们等级较高的药品都是药剂？为什么不做成更好服用的药丸药片？”

龙神无奈道：“因为生命最初的来源是水啊，这是规则！只有做成水的模样，才能容纳更多的生命规则！”

夏兮风再次不解：“是吗？我怎么没感觉？”

龙神倒了一颗药丸进嘴里。药丸化作一股暖流融入了祂的体内，祂体内的钝痛感立刻被抚平了不少。效果很好，确实是神话品级。

夏兮风见龙神吃了有效，把匣子放在了小短腿小矮龙面前：“先恢复一点体力，再解除诅咒。解除诅咒后，把这些药吃了。”

夏兮风给龙神开了个单子，让龙神按照顺序吃药。

龙神没有再多问，夏兮风让祂吃什么药，祂就吃什么药。

塞入口即化的药丸确实比喝药剂方便，龙神一边吃药，还能一边说话：“你之前拿的东西可不够付这些药的费用。这个世界的东西你大概不缺，等会儿我带你去另一个宝库，挑挑另一个世界的药材。”

“好。”夏兮风心道，我就说你这个宝库里怎么没有天外的东西，原来不止一个宝库啊。

龙神道：“只是药材不够你给的药物的价值。你有什么想问的？我用‘信息’来付费。你说你被自我之神训练过，应该知道对神灵而言，‘信息’才最为重要。”

夏兮风知道龙神是想指点他，但他有其他想问的。

指点嘛，难道他求到老师那里，老师还说不动龙神指点他？再说了，天父正在通过系统指点他和秦琅，龙神的指导不是必要的。比起指导，他更愿意满足自己的好奇心。

夏兮风问道：“师祖，你说你去过外神的世界。你知道外神世界为什么毁灭，祂们又为什么会选中我们的世界？既然祂们都能逃离自己的世界，逃向规则能兼容的同一个创世神创造的世界不行吗？难道那个创世神只创造了一个世界？”

龙神的眼睛瞪圆：“你居然问这个？”

夏兮风疑惑：“这个不能问？”

龙神摇头：“不是不能问。你才刚点燃神火，都好奇另一个世界了？”

夏兮风道：“我不是好奇另一个世界，是好奇这场战争的源头。虽然这场战争必须打，我也不会因为敌人背后可能有的悲惨故事而手下留情，但好歹要知道为什么打吧？别人的教训，就是我们的经验。”

他犹豫了一下，小声问道：“该不会是追着你过来的吧？”

龙神摇头：“两个世界在创世神的维度中是邻居，不需要我带路。”

祂在超脱者中是小年轻，也就只能去隔壁的世界逛逛。

既然厉害的小辈选择了“故事”当报酬，龙神按照之前的承诺，将夏兮风想听的“故事”告诉了他。

龙神确实知道隔壁世界的事。

“我去外神的世界旅游时，祂们的世界还很健康。”龙神道，“祂们的世界不是正常消亡。”

龙神笑了一下。祂那张幼龙脸，居然也能笑出几分凉薄的意味：“天父没有及时防御，也是因为隔壁世界很健康，且没有外敌入侵的迹象。这样的世界，不该这时候消亡。谁能瞬间毁灭健康的世界？只有祂们自己的创世神啊。”

夏兮风深吸了一口气：“什么？！祂们的创世神不是非常善良的创世神吗？祂入侵我们世界的原因，不是因为祂舍不得造物吗？”

虽然游戏设定里没说，但玩家是这么猜测的。因为游戏设定集里，阐明创世神不会受世界毁灭影响。既然创世神不受世界毁灭影响，祂非要带着一家子会随着世界毁灭而死亡的神灵和另一个创世神干仗，不是为了“孩子们”，还能是什么原因？

龙神再次失笑：“如你刚才所说，同一个创世神创造的世界能容纳这群难民神。隔壁创世神，是一位老牌创世神，创造的可不止那一个世界。相反，天父才是只创造了一个世界的新手创世神，所以天父必须保住这个世界。创世神的行为，不能用简单的感情来评价，就像凡人无法评价神灵的行为一样。”

龙神还有很多药需要吃，时间很长，可以讲述很长的故事。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 116 (Part 1)

Xia Xifeng pulled out a large case filled with medicine vials.

The Dragon God asked in confusion, "Did you make too many?"

Xia Xifeng shook his head and produced another potion bottle. "This one contains the potion you asked for. But after your curse is lifted, won't you need medicines to restore your divine power and repair your divine body?"

Xia Xifeng held up the case. "I have everything you could possibly need."

In the game, after the Dragon God tore the Outer Gods apart with his bare hands, he fell into a weakened state and didn't return to fight until the final climax. Xia Xifeng was determined not to let the Dragon God stay sidelined for so long this time.

Gulp down the pills and hurry up to get back in the fight!

Back during his ten years of closed-door training, Xia Xifeng had crafted a massive quantity of medicines and successfully concentrated the liquid potions into pills.

When Qin Lang was fighting the God of Self, Xia Xifeng had spammed potions endlessly onto Qin Lang's character panel.

Lacking experience and unable to win? I'll grind you down with sheer alchemy! Over those ten years, what Xia Xifeng had crafted most were divine power restoration and healing medicines—all of Mythic quality—which had nurtured Qin Lang extraordinarily well. Otherwise, how could Qin Lang have condensed a divine body so easily? All the non-human excitement Xia Xifeng endured in bed had been fed into existence by his own hands.

The Dragon God pinched a small vial, took a whiff of the medicinal fragrance, and was utterly astonished. "You can already craft divine medicine?"

Xia Xifeng replied, "I've already ignited my Divine Flame. Isn't it completely normal that I can make divine medicine?"

The Dragon God didn't know whether to laugh or cry. "Who told you that igniting a Divine Flame means you can craft divine medicine? A deity's injuries aren't inflicted on mortal flesh and blood."

What flows inside a deity's body isn't blood, but concepts and laws—which is divine power. Flesh and blood are merely its manifested form. Thus, medicines designed to replenish mortal flesh are useless against deities.

Deities understand their own bodies and know how to heal themselves faster. However, if one wishes to heal another deity, one must master the laws governing universal divine power replenishment.

Forging divine artifacts works the same way. The God of Forging can forge divine artifacts for other deities, whereas artifacts forged by other deities can at best be bestowed upon demigods with power attributes similar to their own—other deities wouldn't be able to use them.

If even handheld artifacts are like this, let alone medicines meant to be ingested. In the Divine Realm, the only deity capable of crafting medicine that every god can take is the God of Life.

The Dragon God appraised Xia Xifeng. "You possess the Heavenly Father's blessing, making it effortless to craft anything below Mythic rank. But precisely because the blessing is so powerful, you should be lacking in opportunities to actually learn."

Xia Xifeng was puzzled. "Why would I lack them? Every time I use the crafting table... I mean, use the blessing to craft an item, knowledge flows through my mind. After flowing through a few times, wouldn't I just learn it?"

*It's not like my brain is completely smooth; there ought to be at least a few folds in there to trap some knowledge, right?*

The Dragon God's expression turned even stranger.

Unless an imprint was branded onto the soul, simple indoctrination was no different from having knowledge read aloud in one's ear. Yet once branded with an imprint, it became absolutely impossible to comprehend the laws of creation or craft Mythic-tier items.

Xia Xifeng was already able to refine Mythic-tier potions, meaning the Heavenly Father's knowledge transfer was literally just reading it aloud in his ear. Understanding just from listening to a teacher's lecture a few times? If it were that easy, everyone would be a deity.

A talent for creation was far more terrifying than a talent for combat. Where on earth did the Heavenly Father scam such a treasure from?

The Dragon God shook the vial, and the pills clinked inside. "Why are they solid?"

Xia Xifeng said, "To save space. I've always wondered why all your high-tier medicines are liquid potions. Why not make them into pills or tablets that are easier to swallow?"

The Dragon God said helplessly, "Because the original source of life is water! That is a fundamental law! Only by shaping them like water can they hold more laws of life!"

Xia Xifeng was once again bewildered. "Really? How come I didn't feel that at all?"

The Dragon God poured a pill into his mouth. The pill melted into a warm current that flowed into his body, instantly soothing much of the dull ache inside him. The effect was superb—it was indeed of Mythic rank.

Seeing that it worked on the Dragon God, Xia Xifeng placed the box in front of the short-legged, stubby dragon. "Restore some stamina first, then lift the curse. After lifting the curse, eat all these medicines."

Xia Xifeng wrote a prescription list for the Dragon God, instructing him to take the medicines in sequence.

The Dragon God asked no further questions; whatever pill Xia Xifeng told him to take, he swallowed.

Popping melt-in-the-mouth pills was indeed far more convenient than drinking liquid potions. As the Dragon God ate, he could even keep talking: "The things you took earlier aren't enough to pay for all these medicines. You probably aren't lacking items from this world, so later I'll take you to another treasury to pick out herbs from another world."

"Alright," Xia Xifeng thought to himself. *I was wondering why there weren't any otherworldly items in this vault—turns out he has more than one.*

The Dragon God continued, "However, herbs alone aren't enough to match the value of the medicine you provided. Is there anything you wish to ask? I shall pay you with 'information'. You mentioned you were trained by the God of Self, so you should know that to deities, 'information' is what matters most."

Xia Xifeng knew the Dragon God intended to give him guidance, but he had other questions he wanted to ask.

*As for guidance—if I go beg my teacher, could my teacher not persuade the Dragon God to guide me? Besides, the Heavenly Father is already guiding Qin Lang and me through the system, so the Dragon God's instruction isn't strictly necessary. Compared to being tutored, I'd rather satisfy my curiosity.*

Xia Xifeng asked, "Grandmaster, you mentioned you've visited the world of the Outer Gods. Do you know why their world collapsed, and why they chose our world? Since they could escape their own world, couldn't they flee to another world created by the same Creator God whose laws were compatible? Did that Creator God really only create a single world?"

The Dragon God's eyes widened. "You're actually asking about *this*?"

Xia Xifeng was puzzled. "Is this off-limits?"

The Dragon God shook his head. "It's not that you can't ask. You've only just ignited your Divine Flame, and you're already curious about another world?"

Xia Xifeng said, "I'm not curious about the other world itself; I'm curious about the root cause of this war. Although this war is unavoidable and I won't show mercy just because the enemies might have tragic backstories, shouldn't we at least know *why* we are fighting? Other people's lessons are our experience."

He hesitated for a moment, then whispered, "It wasn't... following you here, was it?"

The Dragon God shook his head. "In the dimension of the Creator Gods, the two worlds are neighbors. They didn't need me to lead the way."

Among Transcendent Beings, he was still a youngster, capable only of taking a stroll in the neighboring world.

Since this impressive junior had chosen a "story" as his reward, the Dragon God fulfilled his promise and recounted the tale Xia Xifeng wanted to hear.

The Dragon God indeed knew about what had happened in the neighboring world.

"When I visited the world of the Outer Gods, their world was still very healthy," the Dragon God said. "Their world did not perish naturally."

The Dragon God smiled slightly. Even on his juvenile dragon face, that smile managed to project a hint of cold detachment. "The reason the Heavenly Father failed to set up defenses in time was also because the neighboring world was healthy and showed no signs of external invasion. Such a world shouldn't have perished at that time. Who could instantly destroy a healthy world? Only their own Creator God."

Xia Xifeng took a sharp breath. "What?! Isn't their Creator God supposed to be exceptionally benevolent? Wasn't the reason he invaded our world because he couldn't bear to lose his creations?"

Although the game lore didn't explicitly state it, that was how players speculated. The game's setting book clarified that Creator Gods are unaffected by the destruction of a world. Since the Creator God was immune to world destruction, why would he insist on dragging a whole family of deities—who would die if their world perished—into a war with another Creator God, if not for his "children"?

The Dragon God chuckled again. "As you said earlier, worlds created by the same Creator God can accommodate these refugee deities. Their Creator God is a veteran Creator God who created far more than just that one world. On the contrary, the Heavenly Father is a novice Creator God who has created only one world, which is why he must protect it at all costs. The actions of a Creator God cannot be judged by simple mortal emotions, just as mortals cannot judge the actions of deities."

The Dragon God still had many medicines to take, and with plenty of time, he could tell a very long story.

弱小的神灵也会死亡。达到了神灵力量的极限，也就是与天地同寿。

这天地，不是说一颗星球、一片大陆，而是包含了许多“天地”的宏观的世界。

但世界也会消亡，只有达到超脱者的层次，才不会受到出生世界的影响。

超脱者的下一步，就是在混沌之中创造出规则完备的世界。当这个世界出现了超脱者，祂便晋升到了下一个层次，成为真正的创世神。

创世神还有下一步，这就不是龙神能知道的境界了。祂只知道创世神要再晋升，就要创造无数个世界，掌握和观察无数的规则。

天父在祂超脱的时候曾指点祂，只要创世神创造的世界中出现足够多的超脱者，便能进入下一个层次。但不是所有创世神都会选择这么平庸的修炼方式，就像人类和神灵都有不同的性格一样。

毁掉自己的世界会让创世神受伤，但只是毁掉一个没有超脱者的小世界，吞掉另一个新生创世神拥有超脱者的世界，那这就算赚了。

“就算没毁掉，在战争中，祂也能夺走足够多的‘规则之力’。只要祂夺得的比耗费的多，这场战争就是赚的。”龙神道，“发起战争是最粗暴，也最容易失败的方式。因为祂瞧不起天父，才会带着腐朽的世界撞过来，直接与天父开战。若祂谨慎一点，应该派探子悄悄潜入别的创世神的世界，以夺走气运的方式缓慢毁掉世界的根基。”

龙神举了几个例子，夏兮风听得很耳熟。

什么恋爱攻略系统，让本来能成为超脱者的天之骄子们全部拜倒在没有任何优点的攻略者脚下，把原本能供出超脱者的资源给了一无是处的攻略者，导致该世界本该有的超脱者夭折，甚至资源直接被攻略者送给隔壁……

夏兮风瞠目结舌：“这不就是典型的蝗虫式无限流吗？！”

龙神问道：“蝗虫式无限流？那是什么？”

夏兮风举了几个他们世界小说的例子。

龙神尾巴拍打了一下地面，乐道：“我知道你来自哪里了。原来你来自信息汇聚之地啊。嘿！原来我们家创世神抱上了这么粗的大腿！这场战争我们赢定了！”

“信息汇聚之地？”夏兮风又听到一个不懂的名词。

龙神道：“信息汇聚之地，你可以想象为数个创世神世界的信息交汇点。许多世界的信息在那个世界纠缠，以灵感的方式进入生灵的梦境中，形成你所看到的‘故事’。”

信息汇聚之地的规则十分混乱，个体很难进化，基本会选择以外物晋升的方式，令整个文明层次一同提升。

但极端的压制下还能冒出头的苗子，天赋就强大到基本不中途死亡，就铁定能超脱。拥有信息交汇地的创世神，便会“出租”自家的好苗子，让好苗子去别家创世神的世界打工。如果打工的好苗子能成为超脱者，好处五五分成。

龙神咂巴着嘴羡慕道：“能在信息交汇地创世的大能力者，是真的富啊，根本不缺超脱者带来的规则之力。不过在信息交汇处创世极难，守住这个世界就更难，祂们也是有实力才这么富裕啊。”

夏兮风满头问号。你说的那个富，是指劳务输出赚来的富裕吗？

他本来只想听一个小八卦，结果被炸了个大的。

这就是他和秦琅穿越的真相？！

夏兮风听故事的时候，实时转播给秦琅。

【夏兮风：老秦老秦，听到没？我们穿越的真相居然是劳务派遣！！！】

秦琅脚一滑，差点被噩兆尸龙的骨刺捅个对穿。

作者有话要说：

更新晚了，抱歉。吃完晚饭小睡了一会儿，不小心睡着了。爬起来写一章，再继续睡。明天不会熬夜了，看来晚饭后不能躺啊，一躺下铁定睡着。

碎碎念：

以后涉及力量层次较高世界穿越的设定都是这个，“劳务派遣”。

信息汇聚之地的创世神是老读者们的老熟人，即所有初始皮肤是熊猫的系统的“主神”，抠脚熊猫神。

其实不知道这个也没关系，只是我设定了而已。这样只是说明穿越没有阴谋，系统智能的主神是熊猫的系统都是好的系统，以免读者阴谋论，完善了世界观和逻辑而已，便于我自己创作。

之后如果要写主角对抗坏系统，坏攻略者的故事，坏人就是其他创世神派来的。

最后提一句，这本的番外一共有三篇，“过去的竹马时光”，“如果暑假都没回家”，“如果暑假只有夏兮风回家”。if线结局都是HE，小情侣仍旧锁死，大家放心观看。我就算写if，也绝对不虐我家主角。

Chapter 116 (Part 2)

Weak deities could also die. Reaching the limit of a deity's power merely meant enjoying a lifespan equal to heaven and earth.

And "heaven and earth" here did not refer to a single planet or continent, but a macroscopic realm encompassing countless such domains.

Yet even worlds eventually perish; only upon attaining the level of a Transcendent Being could one remain unaffected by the fate of their world of origin.

The next step for a Transcendent Being was to create a world with complete laws out of the primordial chaos. Once that world birthed its own Transcendent Being, the creator would ascend to the next level and become a true Creator God.

There were further steps beyond Creator God, but that belonged to a realm beyond the Dragon God's knowledge. He only knew that for a Creator God to advance further, they had to create countless worlds, mastering and observing infinite laws.

When the Dragon God transcended, the Heavenly Father had instructed him that as long as enough Transcendent Beings emerged from the worlds created by a Creator God, that Creator God could enter the next realm. However, not all Creator Gods chose such a conventional method of cultivation, just as humans and deities all possessed different personalities.

Destroying one's own world would injure a Creator God, but if it meant sacrificing a minor world devoid of Transcendent Beings to devour a world belonging to a novice Creator God—a world that already possessed Transcendent Beings—then it was a net profit.

"Even if the target world isn't completely destroyed, he can still seize a vast amount of 'law power' during the war. As long as he takes more than he spends, the war is a lucrative endeavor," the Dragon God explained. "Initiating war is the most crude and failure-prone method. It was only because he looked down on the Heavenly Father that he rammed his decaying world right into ours to wage direct war. Had he been more cautious, he would have sent infiltrators to sneak into another Creator God's world, slowly eroding its foundation by stealing its world fortune."

The Dragon God gave a few examples, which sounded startlingly familiar to Xia Xifeng.

Things like "Romance Target Systems," forcing proud prodigies—who could have become Transcendent Beings—to bow at the feet of talentless hosts, funneling resources that could have nurtured Transcendents into useless conquerors, causing the world's potential Transcendent Beings to perish in the cradle, or even having those resources funneled straight to neighboring realms...

Xia Xifeng was flabbergasted. "Isn't that just classic locust-style Unlimited Flow?!"

The Dragon God asked, "Locust-style Unlimited Flow? What's that?"

Xia Xifeng cited a few examples from novels back in their world.

The Dragon God slapped his tail against the ground and chuckled joyfully. "I know where you came from now! So you're from a Nexus of Information! Ha! Turns out our Creator God snagged such a thick thigh to cling to! We're guaranteed to win this war!"

"Nexus of Information?" Xia Xifeng heard another term he didn't recognize.

The Dragon God explained, "A Nexus of Information can be imagined as an intersection of information from multiple Creator Gods' worlds. Information from countless worlds intertwines there, entering the dreams of living beings as inspiration and taking the form of the 'stories' you read."

The laws within a Nexus of Information were chaotic, making individual evolution extremely difficult. Generally, civilizations there advanced by relying on external technology or magic, raising the entire civilization's tier collectively.

However, any prodigy capable of standing out under such extreme suppression possessed talents so terrifying that, barring an untimely death, they were guaranteed to achieve Transcendence. A Creator God possessing a Nexus of Information would "lease out" their top prodigies to work in other Creator Gods' worlds. If the dispatched worker managed to become a Transcendent Being, the profits were split fifty-fifty.

The Dragon God smacked his lips in envy. "Mighty beings capable of creating worlds at a Nexus of Information are truly filthy rich. They're never short on the law power brought by Transcendents. But creating a world at an information nexus is brutally difficult, and defending it is even harder. They're only that wealthy because they have the sheer power to back it up."

Xia Xifeng was filled with question marks. *By 'wealthy,' do you mean rich from exporting labor?!*

He had only wanted to hear a tiny piece of gossip, but ended up hit with a megaton bomb.

Was *this* the real truth behind his and Qin Lang's transmigrations?!

As Xia Xifeng listened to the story, he broadcasted it to Qin Lang in real-time.

[Xia Xifeng: Old Qin, Old Qin, did you hear that? The truth behind our transmigration is actually dispatched labor!!!]

Qin Lang's foot slipped, nearly getting run through by a bone spur of the Omen Corpse Dragon.

***

**Author's Note:**

Sorry for the late update. I took a short nap after dinner and accidentally fell asleep. Dragged myself up to write a chapter, and now back to sleep. I won't stay up late tomorrow. Looks like I shouldn't lie down after dinner; I'm guaranteed to pass out.

**Ramblings:**

From now on, all transmigration tropes involving higher-tier worlds in my stories will follow this exact setting: "Dispatched Labor."

The Creator God of the Nexus of Information is an old acquaintance of my longtime readers—namely, the "Main God" behind all systems whose default skin is a panda: the barefoot panda god.

Actually, it doesn't matter if you don't know this; it's just a lore setting I came up with. It's meant to clarify that there are no dark conspiracies behind their transmigration, and that all system spirits under the panda Main God are good systems. It prevents readers from falling down rabbit holes of dark theories while fleshing out the worldbuilding and internal logic for my own convenience.

In the future, if I write stories where the protagonists fight bad systems or toxic host-conquerors, those villains are sent over by other Creator Gods.

Lastly, a quick mention: this book will have three side stories in total: "Childhood Sweetheart Days in the Past," "If Neither Came Home for Summer Vacation," and "If Only Xia Xifeng Came Home for Summer Vacation." All IF-line endings are HE (Happy Endings), and our little couple remains forever bound together, so please rest assured! Even if I write IF scenarios, I will absolutely never abuse my protagonists.

第117章 一更

夏兮风见秦琅的血掉了一大截，心惊胆战地给秦琅狂砸药，把秦琅的血线提上了安全线。

他擦了擦急出来的冷汗，再不敢骚扰秦琅。

龙神无语：“你急什么？那点伤死不了。”

夏兮风瞥了龙神一眼：“不是所有人都和你一样皮糙肉厚，秦琅很脆的。”

秦琅只是一个脆皮刺客！

龙神更加无语。那一瞬间，他幻视了自家好叛逆的好大儿。

不愧是好大儿的弟子，真是和好大儿令人无语的程度一模一样。

夏兮风观察了一会儿，见秦琅的血线没有再蹦极，才继续和吃药的龙神聊天：“你说外神的世界是祂们的创世神自己毁的，祂们知道这件事吗？”

龙神讥笑：“知道又如何？祂们想要活下去，只能吞下这个世界。”

夏兮风道：“难道就没有谁想要推翻那个创世神？反正都不一定能活下去，在创世神脸上吐口唾沫也算出了口气。”

反正如果是他，就算吐唾沫都做不到，他也要竖着中指骂那个创世神，一直骂到自己死亡为止。

龙神再次讥笑道：“可能有吧。但来到我们世界的外神，都是跟随祂们创世神的。”

夏兮风看向噩兆尸龙：“祂也是吗？你说你对祂是真爱，虽然我不相信种龙的真爱，但你都是种龙了，不应该因为脸就说什么真爱。”

龙神不认为夏兮风说祂“种龙”是在骂祂。他只是和好大儿、好大儿的弟子感情观、择偶观不同。

听夏兮风这么说，祂还认为夏兮风挺了解祂，心情不错：“祂刚来这个世界的时候还清醒着，不知道灭世的真相。我告诉祂真相后，祂确实显出了反抗的意思。”

龙神伸出自己一只小短手，上面还缠绕着诅咒：“祂想尝试，能不能不彻底毁掉我们世界，也能让祂的子民融入我们世界。”

夏兮风眼皮子跳了跳：“你配合祂的尝试了？”

龙神叹气：“如果能成功，我就突破瓶颈，可以尝试创造第一个世界了。”

夏兮风沉默。

半晌，他冷冷开口：“巨龙一族知道他们受到的诅咒，是你和外神共同的尝试吗？”

龙神笑了笑，没正面回答：“巨龙本来不会受到会危及性命的诅咒，不过尝试失败后，祂偷袭了我，才导致诅咒增强。不过我也有后手，祂违反誓约，什么打算都会落空。等我杀了祂，祂身上的诅咒就会落到祂们的创世神身上。”

夏兮风再次沉默良久。

智慧之神和进化之神进入外神阵营当卧底的时候，他们的信徒和神眷者都被外神污染，末世到来的时候死了大半；自我之神研究外神的时候，纵容外神在深渊扩张；再加上一个和“真爱”互相算计，把巨龙一族当代价的龙神，也不会再让他惊讶了。

如龙神评价外神一样，巨龙一族知道又如何？

神战之下，神灵自身都是棋子，还在乎别的棋子的感受吗？

龙神知道夏兮风虽然力量层次上去了，但还太年幼，思维还是纯粹的凡人，没必要和他争论什么对错。

祂不再聊这个，继续吃药：“等秦琅打累了和我说一声，要引爆诅咒，得我亲自动手。”

夏兮风嘴角抽搐：“你不是要去神界偷袭其他外神吗？”

龙神往嘴里丢药丸，和吃零食似的：“去啊，你叫我一声，我回来收尾。”

祂话音刚落，夏兮风的系统里就弹出了好友提示。

就如当初在海神殿打黑泥怪的时候，海神和希望之日加入了群聊一样，系统里出现了一个只有他、秦琅、龙神的小群。

夏兮风皱紧眉头：“你能影响系统？”

“系统？天父的赐福叫这个？祂没事做的时候该不会蹲在你们世界看小说吧？”龙神毫不留情地嘲笑天父，“我好歹是个超脱者，稍微拨动一下你身上天父留下的规则之力还是没问题的。放心，我也就能通过你身上那玩意儿直接联系你而已，做不了其他。你身上除了天父的规则之力，还有另一道创世神的防护。”

夏兮风自言自语：“我们的创世神还给劳务派遣工加了保险？是个良心资本家啊。”

夏兮风瞅了一眼秦琅的状态。好像现在战斗不是很激烈？他还是没忍住，把自己的感慨分享给了秦琅。

【秦琅：嗯。】

夏兮风嘴角上弯。看吧，他就知道，连秦琅都忍不住想吐槽了。

被告知了太多事，夏兮风需要一点时间消化满肚子的吐槽，不再和龙神聊天了。

龙神也乐得清静，使劲往嘴里塞药。

祂的神力恢复一些之后，喝下了解除诅咒的药剂。

龙神伸了个懒腰，伸出爪子划拉了一下。

噩兆尸龙一声惨叫，身体被切割开，被突然出现的空间裂缝吞掉了一小截。

“巨龙还是得练练手，免得失了锐气。”龙神送了一小截噩兆尸龙去巨龙国度。

神体被切割后，会自动变成小一点的神灵。龙神就是给下界送了个大怪，让巨龙去拼命。

夏兮风虽然不忍，但没有出言阻止龙神。

龙神要巨龙一族自己出力解决危机，趁着心中悲愤未消练兵。不这样做，在巨龙正式踏上抵抗外神的战场时，损失会更惨重。

“好了，我去偷袭了。”龙神将剩下的药丸塞进随身的储物空间里，准备一边打架一边吃。

“等等，帮忙送点东西。”夏兮风递给龙神一个神话级别的空间魔导器，“既然你吃了有用，其他神灵吃了也会有用。虽然老师让阿穆若先生带了很多药，疗伤和补充神力的药不嫌多。”

阿穆若先生虽然能意识在本体和分/身中交换，但没空回来补充物资。龙神正好送个快递。

“居然还能炼制神器？锻造之神如果能活到神战结束，肯定会骚扰你。”龙神接过空间魔导器，展开袖珍的小翅膀，划开了空间飞了进去。

没事可干的夏兮风拎着法杖，去帮秦琅的忙。

秦琅见夏兮风过来，变回人形，好和夏兮风配合。

秦琅：“再用自残的法阵，就把你丢回绿沙城。”

夏兮风心虚道：“不会不会，怎么会呢？”他还真想用外神的真身试验一下之前刺杀血月的法阵。

秦琅不信夏兮风，多分了一缕意识在夏兮风手腕上的分/身上。

夏兮风手腕上的雾气腾起，变成一个小小的秦琅，飞到夏兮风的肩膀上坐着。

夏兮风：“……”不是说不喜欢分成小人吗？为了监督我，至于吗？

他想了想，也分了个小人钻秦琅头发里。

秦琅：“？”

夏兮风振振有词：“他可以给你加油打气！”

秦琅：“……”在我耳边制造噪音，加大我战斗的难度吗？

夏兮风知道秦琅在腹诽什么。他才不管呢，秦琅监督他，他也要监督秦琅。

……

绿沙城。

苏尔正计算着修复道路的资源，突然心头一阵悸动。

他放下笔，刚抬头看向窗外，躺在他肩膀上沉睡的小阿穆若就睁开了眼：“龙神来了。没去打外神，先给了我一尾巴。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 117 (Part 1)

Seeing Qin Lang's health bar plunge drastically, Xia Xifeng spammed potions in a panic, pulling Qin Lang's health back up into the safe zone.

Wiping away his cold sweat, he dared not distract Qin Lang any longer.

The Dragon God was speechless. "What's the rush? A minor injury like that won't kill him."

Xia Xifeng shot the Dragon God a glare. "Not everyone is as thick-skinned and tough as you. Qin Lang is very squishy!"

Qin Lang was just a fragile assassin!

The Dragon God felt even more speechless. For a brief moment, he hallucinated the image of his rebellious, unfilial son.

*As expected of my unfilial son's disciple—he's exasperating in the exact same way.*

Xia Xifeng watched for a bit. Seeing that Qin Lang's health wasn't bungee jumping anymore, he resumed chatting with the pill-munching Dragon God. "You said the Outer Gods' world was destroyed by their own Creator God. Do they know about this?"

The Dragon God sneered, "What if they knew? If they want to survive, swallowing our world is their only option."

Xia Xifeng said, "Isn't there anyone who wants to overthrow that Creator God? Since survival isn't guaranteed anyway, spitting in the Creator God's face would at least vent some frustration."

If it were him, even if he couldn't spit in the deity's face, he would raise his middle fingers and curse that Creator God all the way until the moment he died.

The Dragon God sneered again. "Perhaps there were. But the Outer Gods who came to our world are all followers of their Creator God."

Xia Xifeng looked over at the Omen Corpse Dragon. "Is he one too? You said he was your true love—though I don't believe in a stud dragon's 'true love'—since you're a stud dragon, you shouldn't be spouting nonsense about 'true love' just because of a face."

The Dragon God didn't take Xia Xifeng's comment about being a "stud dragon" as an insult. They simply held different views on romance and partner selection from his unfilial son and his disciple.

Hearing Xia Xifeng say this, he actually felt Xia Xifeng understood him quite well, putting him in a decent mood. "When he first arrived in this world, he was still sane and didn't know the truth about the world's destruction. After I revealed the truth to him, he indeed showed signs of wanting to resist."

The Dragon God extended one of his short front paws, which was still wrapped in curse energy. "He wanted to try whether he could let his people integrate into our world without completely destroying it."

Xia Xifeng's eyelids twitched. "And you cooperated with his experiment?"

The Dragon God sighed, "If it had succeeded, I would have broken through my bottleneck and been able to attempt creating my very first world."

Xia Xifeng fell silent.

After a long pause, he spoke coldly, "Does the Dragon race know that the curse they suffer from was the result of a joint experiment between you and an Outer God?"

The Dragon God chuckled, avoiding a direct answer. "Dragons wouldn't normally suffer from a curse that threatens their lives. However, after the experiment failed, he ambushed me, causing the curse to intensify. But I had my own contingencies—he broke his oath, so all his plans are doomed to fail. Once I kill him, the curse on him will transfer directly onto their Creator God."

Xia Xifeng fell silent again for a long time.

When the God of Wisdom and the God of Evolution went undercover in the Outer Gods' camp, their believers and divine favors were corrupted, leading to the deaths of over half of them when the apocalypse struck; when the God of Self studied the Outer Gods, he indulged their expansion in the Abyss; and now, adding a Dragon God who plotted against his "true love" and used the entire Dragon race as collateral—nothing could surprise Xia Xifeng anymore.

Just as the Dragon God had evaluated the Outer Gods: so what if the Dragons knew?

In a war of gods, even the deities themselves were mere pawns. Who would care about the feelings of other chess pieces?

The Dragon God knew that although Xia Xifeng's power level had ascended, he was still far too young and thought like a pure mortal. There was no need to argue about right or wrong with him.

He stopped discussing the topic and continued swallowing pills. "Let me know when Qin Lang gets tired of fighting. Triggering the curse explosion requires my personal touch."

The corner of Xia Xifeng's mouth twitched. "Aren't you going to the Divine Realm to ambush other Outer Gods?"

The Dragon God popped pills into his mouth like snacks. "I am. Just call me, and I'll pop back to wrap things up."

The moment his words landed, a friend prompt popped up in Xia Xifeng's system.

Just like back in the Sea God's Temple when they fought the black mud monster and the Sea God and Hopeful Sun joined the group chat, a small group containing only himself, Qin Lang, and the Dragon God appeared in the system.

Xia Xifeng frowned deeply. "You can affect the system?"

"System? That's what you call the Heavenly Father's blessing? When he has nothing to do, is he crouching in your world reading webnovels?" The Dragon God mocked the Heavenly Father mercilessly. "I am a Transcendent Being after all; tweaking the law power left on you by the Heavenly Father is no problem. Don't worry, I can only use that thing on you to contact you directly and nothing else. Besides the Heavenly Father's law power, you also have protection from another Creator God on your body."

Xia Xifeng muttered to himself, "Our Creator God even bought insurance for dispatched labor workers? What a conscientious capitalist."

Xia Xifeng glanced at Qin Lang's status. It seemed the combat wasn't too intense right now? He still couldn't resist sharing his revelation with Qin Lang.

[Qin Lang: Yeah.]

The corners of Xia Xifeng's lips curled up. *See, I knew even Qin Lang couldn't resist wanting to snark about it.*

Having been bombarded with so much information, Xia Xifeng needed time to digest his overwhelming urge to snark, so he stopped talking to the Dragon God.

The Dragon God was happy to have some peace and quiet as he vigorously stuffed pills into his mouth.

Once his divine power recovered a bit, he drank the potion to lift the curse.

The Dragon God stretched lazily and swiped a claw.

The Omen Corpse Dragon let out a miserable shriek as its body was sliced open, a small section swallowed up by a suddenly appearing spatial rift.

"The dragons still need some practice, lest they lose their edge." The Dragon God sent a slice of the Omen Corpse Dragon off to the Dragon Realm.

After a divine body was severed, it would automatically form a smaller deity. The Dragon God had essentially dropped a mega boss onto the realm below, forcing the dragons to fight for their lives.

Although Xia Xifeng felt a bit sympathetic, he didn't speak up to stop the Dragon God.

The Dragon God wanted the Dragon race to rely on their own strength to solve their crisis, using their unvented grief and indignation to train their troops. If they didn't do this, when the Dragons officially stepped onto the battlefield against the Outer Gods, their casualties would be far worse.

"Alright, I'm off to ambush." The Dragon God stuffed the remaining pills into his dimensional storage, intending to munch on them while fighting.

"Wait, help me deliver something." Xia Xifeng handed the Dragon God a Mythic-rank spatial magic tool. "Since they worked on you, they'll work on other deities too. Even though Master had Mr. Amuro carry a lot of medicine, one can never have too many healing and divine power recovery pills."

Although Mr. Amuro could swap his consciousness between his main body and avatars, he had no time to return and replenish supplies. The Dragon God made a perfect courier.

"You can even craft divine artifacts? If the God of Forging survives until the end of this war, he'll definitely badger you relentlessly." Taking the spatial magic tool, the Dragon God unfolded his miniature wings, tore open space, and flew inside.

With nothing left to do, Xia Xifeng held his staff and went over to assist Qin Lang.

Seeing Xia Xifeng approach, Qin Lang shifted back into human form to coordinate better with him.

Qin Lang said, "If you use that self-harming magic array again, I'm throwing you back to Green Sand City."

Xia Xifeng said sheepishly, "No way, no way! How could I?" He had actually been planning to test the array he used against the Blood Moon on an Outer God's true body.

Qin Lang didn't trust Xia Xifeng and diverted another strand of consciousness onto the avatar resting on Xia Xifeng's wrist.

The mist around Xia Xifeng's wrist curled upward, transforming into a mini Qin Lang that flew up and sat on Xia Xifeng's shoulder.

Xia Xifeng: "..." *Didn't you say you hated splitting into mini avatars? Is it really necessary to go this far just to supervise me?*

He thought for a moment, then split off a mini avatar of his own and shoved it into Qin Lang's hair.

Qin Lang: "?"

Xia Xifeng declared self-righteously, "He's there to cheer you on!"

Qin Lang: "..." *By creating noise right next to my ear and turning up the battle difficulty for me?*

Xia Xifeng knew what Qin Lang was grumbling about internally. He didn't care—if Qin Lang was going to supervise him, he was going to supervise Qin Lang right back.

...

Green Sand City.

Su Er was calculating the resources needed to repair the roads when his heart suddenly throbbed with trepidation.

He put down his pen, and just as he raised his head to look out the window, the tiny Amuro sleeping on his shoulder opened his eyes: "The Dragon God has arrived. Instead of attacking the Outer Gods, he gave me a slap with his tail first."

chunks.chineseText:
正欣喜的苏尔脸色一沉。

阿穆若告完状后才说正事：“祂恢复得挺好，说是小风的功劳。小风让祂带了很多药来。那些药丸挺有意思。”

苏尔这才脸色稍缓：“我本想找机会给你送一点，小风自己找到办法了。”

阿穆若：“龙神说，小风和琅是从信息交汇地来的，你可以放心了。”

苏尔微笑道：“果然是这样。”

信息交汇地的创世神口碑很好，他不用担心夏兮风和秦琅回家的事了。

阿穆若：“龙神即使还很虚弱，实力也比一般神灵强大。祂加入战斗后，战争很快就会结束……苏尔，祂又误伤了我。我想祂可能不是误伤。”

苏尔的微笑立刻消失：“告诉祂，再胡来，我就把祂的宝库都烧了。”

阿穆若：“好。”

小阿穆若闭上眼，意识离开分/身。

苏尔捏了捏眉间。

他也想当个孝顺的儿子，但老父亲总是逼他不孝。

苏尔得知龙神出现时，其他神眷者也得到了各自神灵的通知——巨龙即将加入战场，战争局势向梦世界本土一方倾斜。

离末世降临不到一年的时间，战争转折点都到了？做好了长期艰苦战争准备的神眷者们很是不敢相信。

各国领导者立刻公布这个好消息，各族士气大振。最为激进的精灵们召开会议，要商讨如何攻入神界，给世界树报仇了。

因为本土神灵和外神在神域里激烈作战，空间规则受到极大破坏。虽然神灵还不能降临地面，但凡人却可以进入神域了。

没有大量玩家出现，梦世界扭转末世的速度仍旧十分迅速。

不过这迅速，也是以年来计算。外神太难杀，夏兮风和秦琅磨了失去理智的噩兆尸龙两年的血，才通知龙神回来收人头。

夏兮风唏嘘：“打了两年的架，居然感觉时间一瞬间就过去了。太神奇了，我的时间观念居然发生了如此大的改变！”

秦琅本想说，他们不是磨血，是破坏和侵蚀噩兆尸龙的规则之力。

他刚张开嘴，就想起夏兮风的啰嗦，赶紧把嘴闭上，免得给夏兮风可以啰嗦的话题。

刚高强度打完一仗，秦琅身心俱疲，不想再被夏兮风噪音骚扰。

他们刚通知龙神，龙神就划破空间回来。

祂回来时，是一副很英俊的人类的模样。看祂五官，确实能看出和苏尔是亲生父子。

龙神杀死噩兆尸龙的时候，脸上带着几分虚伪的悲悯。

夏兮风没有看龙神表演不存在的深情，小声对秦琅道：“听说苏尔老师是龙神自己一个神生的，好神奇。”

秦琅：“我想神灵生出孩子，不是你想的那种人类的生法。”

夏兮风：“就是很神奇。你要不要试试？”

秦琅猛地扭头：“？？？”

夏兮风后退几步：“我嘴瓢了，没真的让你试。别生气别生气……哎哟！”

夏兮风没躲过秦琅的闷棍敲击，捂着额头正喊疼，突然听到系统提示。

他还没听清楚系统提示什么，眼前一花，身边环境立刻一变。

夏兮风瞪大眼睛，说出了曾经说出好多次的话：“啊？这是给我弄哪来啦？！秦琅呢？！”

他东张西望。

“你是谁，为什么能直接出现在我的神域中？”一个清冷的声音在夏兮风耳边响起。

夏兮风回头朝着声音的方向看过去，看到一个极美的神灵正在沐浴。

他立刻捂住双眼：“啊啊啊，我也不知道，我不是故意偷看你洗澡！”

夏兮风捂眼睛的时候，瞟了一眼系统面板。

系统标注出了面前神灵的“神名”。

是中立的黄名，“神名”为……噩兆尸龙？！！！

作者有话要说：

七夕节快乐。

只要作息乱了一天，后续就很难调整了，白天总是撑不住想睡觉。明天要在外面过七夕节不能睡觉，希望能把作息调整回来。
chunks.englishText:
Su Er, who had been feeling pleased, saw his expression darken.

After Mu Ruo finished lodging the complaint, he finally got to the point: "He is recovering quite well. He says it's all thanks to Xiao Feng. Xiao Feng had him bring a lot of medicine. Those pills are actually quite interesting."

Only then did Su Er’s expression soften slightly: "I had intended to find an opportunity to send some to you, but Xiao Feng found a way on his own."

Mu Ruo added, "The Dragon God says that Xiao Feng and Lang came from the Information Convergence Zone, so you can rest easy."

Su Er smiled. "As I expected."

The Creator God of the Information Convergence Zone had an excellent reputation; he no longer needed to worry about Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang returning home.

Mu Ruo continued, "Even though the Dragon God is still weak, his strength is greater than that of an average deity. Once he joins the battle, the war will end soon... Su Er, he accidentally injured me again. I suspect it wasn't an accident."

Su Er’s smile vanished instantly. "Tell him that if he keeps acting out, I will burn his entire treasury to the ground."

"Understood," Mu Ruo replied.

Little Mu Ruo closed his eyes, and his consciousness withdrew from the avatar.

Su Er pinched the bridge of his nose.

He wanted to be a filial son, but his old father always forced him to be otherwise.

When news of the Dragon God’s appearance reached Su Er, the other God-favored ones also received notifications from their respective deities—the Great Dragon was about to join the battlefield, and the tide of war was shifting in favor of the Dream World's natives.

With less than a year left before the apocalypse, the turning point of the war had already arrived? The God-favored ones, who had prepared themselves for a long and arduous conflict, found it hard to believe.

Leaders of various nations immediately announced the good news, and the morale of all races soared. The most radical among them, the Elves, convened a meeting to discuss how to invade the Divine Realm and avenge the World Tree.

Because the native gods and the Outer Gods were locked in fierce combat within the Divine Domain, the spatial laws had been severely damaged. Although the gods still could not descend to the mortal realm, mortals were now able to enter the Divine Domain.

Even without a massive influx of players, the Dream World’s speed in reversing the apocalypse was still remarkably rapid.

However, this "rapid" progress was still measured in years. The Outer Gods were too difficult to kill; Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang spent two years grinding down the health of the mindless Omen Corpse Dragon before finally signaling the Dragon God to return and deliver the finishing blow.

Xia Xifeng sighed with emotion: "After fighting for two years, it feels like time just flashed by. It’s so magical! My perception of time has changed so drastically!"

Qin Lang had wanted to say that they weren't "grinding health," but rather destroying and eroding the Omen Corpse Dragon’s laws.

He opened his mouth, but remembering Xia Xifeng’s tendency to ramble, he quickly shut it, lest he give Xia Xifeng another topic to drone on about.

Having just finished a high-intensity battle, Qin Lang was physically and mentally exhausted; he didn't want to be harassed by Xia Xifeng’s noise.

No sooner had they notified the Dragon God than he tore through space and returned.

He appeared in the form of a very handsome human. Looking at his features, one could indeed see that he and Su Er were father and son.

When the Dragon God killed the Omen Corpse Dragon, his face bore a look of hypocritical compassion.

Xia Xifeng didn't bother watching the Dragon God perform his non-existent sentimentality and whispered to Qin Lang: "I heard Teacher Su Er was born from the Dragon God alone. How magical."

Qin Lang replied, "I suspect that when gods give birth, it isn't the way humans do it, as you're imagining."

Xia Xifeng: "It’s just very magical. Do you want to try it?"

Qin Lang snapped his head around: "???"

Xia Xifeng stepped back a few paces: "I had a slip of the tongue, I didn't really mean for you to try. Don't be angry, don't be angry... Ouch!"

Xia Xifeng failed to dodge Qin Lang’s blunt strike. He was clutching his forehead and crying out in pain when he suddenly heard a system notification.

Before he could clearly hear what the system was saying, his vision blurred, and the environment around him changed instantly.

Xia Xifeng’s eyes widened, and he uttered the words he had said many times before: "Ah? Where did this bring me?! Where is Qin Lang?!"

He looked around in all directions.

"Who are you, and how are you able to appear directly within my Divine Domain?" A cold, clear voice rang in Xia Xifeng’s ears.

Xia Xifeng turned toward the sound and saw an incredibly beautiful deity bathing.

He immediately covered his eyes: "Ahhh, I don't know either! I didn't mean to peek at you bathing!"

As Xia Xifeng covered his eyes, he glanced at the system panel.

The system had marked the "Divine Name" of the deity before him.

It was a neutral yellow name, and the "Divine Name" was... Omen Corpse Dragon?!!!

***

Author's Note:
Happy Qixi Festival.
Once your sleep schedule is ruined for a day, it's very hard to adjust back; I always feel exhausted and want to sleep during the day. I have to be out tomorrow for Qixi and can't sleep, so I hope I can fix my sleep schedule then.

chunks.chineseText:
第118章 一更

夏兮风还来不及为系统标注的“神名”惊讶，就看到了更惊悚的事——他的系统似乎半废了。

他的等级上划了一条杠，后面跟着一个鲜红色的“1级”；

装备已经卸除，回到了背包里，连花大力气炼制的时装也一样，只剩下最初的粗布裤衩；

背包全部锁定，不仅不能取出物品，甚至连背包本身都废掉了，连新存入物品都不行；

聊天面板也变成了灰色，别说秦琅，他连系统的自动客服都不能联系……

他又看了一眼技能面板，原本已经全部点亮的技能树上缠绕着锁链，自研物品面板也无法打开。技能面板上额外出现了另一条技能线，从1级到100级，每个级别都有能制作的东西。

这一条技能线不像之前那样分成种植、挖矿、采集、烹饪、制药、制造等详细的类别，只是解锁能制作的物品。每一个级别解锁的物品不到十个，100级解锁的物品也只是传说。

面板和属性都“废”了，连背包都不能用，夏兮风整个人都懵掉了。

他赶紧查看任务面板。

【诅咒生效。触发特殊任务《背叛的悲歌》。】

【世界天道刚有懵懂意识，灾难突然降临。造物主是否有资格毁灭造物？造物是否有资格怨恨造物主？这场灾难和抗争，究竟是谁对谁的背叛？】

【本任务为生存任务。玩家的面板锁定，替换为符合新世界的临时面板。请玩家存活到世界毁灭那一刻。】

系统文字突然扭曲，仿佛活了起来。

文字扭曲，纠缠，如无数条扭曲的细蛇，看得人头皮发麻。

墨迹之蛇缠绕，组成大大小小歪斜颤动的新的文字。

【■■■邀请局外之人见证这一场背叛的悲歌@#￥%乱码@#￥%花屏@#￥%&*】

“呲”的一声，仿佛屏幕短路似的，任务面板熄灭。

夏兮风深吸一口气。

啊这，不会吧不会吧？我难道穿越到外神的世界了？！外神的世界不是已经毁在祂们的创世神手中了吗？怎么还能穿越的？

谁发布的这个任务？这么厉害的吗？连别的创世神已经毁灭的世界都能进入？

不过规则不兼容，我看到的外神难道不是一坨恶心的马赛克吗？怎么还能见到正常形态的外神世界？

等等……夏兮风意识到了一个以前没有想过的问题。

不同的创世神世界规则不兼容，那他所在的世界也不是天父创造的世界啊，梦世界在他眼中怎么会是正常的？是因为天父主动向他们的创世神开放了自己的世界吗？还是说只偷渡一两个人，不用在意大规模的规则兼容性？

龙神曾经说过，大部分创世神偷偷破坏其他创世神的世界时，会采取偷渡“破坏者”温水煮青蛙的方式。那些破坏者既然能够按照被称为剧情的“命运”夺走气运之子的气运，他们眼中的世界肯定也是正常的。

那他到其他创世神的世界后视野仍旧正常，也不意外了。

在夏兮风发呆的时候，顶着“噩兆尸龙”这个与形象完全不搭神名的绝美神灵已经从浴池里走了出来。

祂身披一层轻纱，如金丝般的长发垂地，神体看不出男女，美丽已经超越了性别，让不在意别人外表的夏兮风都看得一愣。

不过他也就是一愣而已。对方容貌带给自己的惊讶程度，没有对方的神名来得厉害。

其实都成为神灵了，给自己捏个完全完美的壳子再容易不过。这位神灵的美丽不仅仅是外形。虽然夏兮风的神体和神火被封印，身体仿佛最初穿越一般笨重，他眼界还在，能看出这位神灵的美丽是基于规则的美丽，即祂“本形”便是如此，不是后天“整容”。

夏兮风想，怪不得龙神那头种龙会对祂念念不忘。

金发神灵如寒月般清冷美丽的面容上露出一丝讶异。

祂能看出，面前之人有没见过的神赐祝福，但也只是肉体凡胎，是个纯粹的凡人。连同层次的神灵都会被祂的美丽震撼失神，寻常凡人见到祂没有收敛神力的真身的第一眼就会被祂深深吸引，意识溃散。

这位凡人竟然只是露出了欣赏的神色，意志力比神灵还强大吗？

这个世界曾经有外来者降临。他们接受的是来自神皇赐予的祝福，每个人都会在世界掀起不小浪潮，有的人还走到了被赐予神果的位置。

金发神灵略一思索，心想面前这凡人可能也是同样的来历。

神皇已经沉睡许久。祂没有得到神皇接待外来者的谕令。但许多外来者都是在一无所知的情况下被投放在下界，祂们不是每一次都会得到谕令。

虽然这个外来者直接出现在自己眼前奇怪了些，但神皇突然想出一个新的点子也是有可能的。

金发神灵对面前的人没有敌意，反而感到很亲切。神灵相信自己的直觉，面前的凡人是友非敌。再加上除了神皇，不可能有谁能在自己毫无察觉的情况下偷渡一个凡人到自己面前，金发神灵已经确定面前凡人就是神皇赐福，即将在下界引领新的浪潮的幸运儿。

“不用担心，是神指引你来到这里。”金发神灵看似冷冰冰地，意外地温和好说话。夏兮风穿着短裤偷看（夏兮风：并没有！）祂洗澡，祂都没生气。

夏兮风不好意思地挠了挠头，随口演戏道：“神的指引？那神想让我干什么啊？还有，我为什么只有一条短裤？我的同伴又去哪里了。我就下河玩了一会儿水，怎么就到这里了？”

“神会在你迷惘的时候指点迷雾。你应该得到了神的恩赐。”金发神灵没有询问夏兮风得到了什么恩赐。恩赐者刚来此地，心里肯定充满警惕。祂与恩赐者是友非敌，尽力不让恩赐者紧张。

金发神灵安抚了夏兮风几句后，邀请夏兮风去神殿暂住。

“或许你的同伴也在我的神域里，我帮你寻回他。”金发神灵语气冰冷，说出的内容则很温柔，“等寻到你的同伴，我便会送你下界。有神灵的恩赐，你一定能在下界过得很好。不用担心。”

“谢谢。”夏兮风看着一直披着轻纱，不肯好好穿衣服的金发神灵，很是不自在。自己是背包锁了，没办法好好穿衣服，这神什么毛病啊，为什么就披着一层纱？

夏兮风有什么想法都写在脸上。金发神灵看出了他的想法，冰冷的表情一僵，假装自然地挥了一下手，轻纱漫卷，换上了一身花纹繁复的长袍。

祂不是故意不穿衣服，只是习惯独居，忘记了。

不过这凡人不仅没被自己的美貌迷惑，还计较自己穿着不得体。金发神灵有些恼羞，又对夏兮风更加欣赏。

祂第一次询问了凡人的姓名。

夏兮风回答后，询问“恩人”的名字。在这个世界，祂肯定不叫“噩兆尸龙”。

金发神灵神秘地一笑：“你下界之后，自然会知道我的名讳。”

夏兮风心道，这个神灵是说祂的信仰很广泛，信徒很多，到处都有神殿吧？
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 118: Part 1

Before Xia Xifeng could even be surprised by the "Divine Name" marked by the system, he saw something even more horrifying—his system seemed to be half-broken.

A line had been struck through his level, followed by a bright red "Level 1";

His equipment had been unequipped and returned to his inventory, even the fashion items he had spent great effort to craft were gone, leaving him with only his original coarse cloth boxers;

His inventory was completely locked; not only could he not retrieve items, but the inventory itself was essentially disabled, unable to even store new items;

The chat panel had turned gray. Forget about contacting Qin Lang; he couldn't even reach the system’s automated customer service...

He checked his skill panel again. The skill tree, which had previously been fully lit up, was now bound by chains, and the self-researched item panel could not be opened. An additional skill line had appeared on the panel, ranging from Level 1 to Level 100, with craftable items at every level.

This skill line wasn't divided into detailed categories like planting, mining, gathering, cooking, alchemy, or manufacturing as before; it simply unlocked craftable items. Each level unlocked fewer than ten items, and even the items unlocked at Level 100 were merely legendary.

With his panels and attributes "ruined" and even his inventory unusable, Xia Xifeng was completely bewildered.

He hurriedly checked the quest panel.

【Curse activated. Triggering special quest: "Elegy of Betrayal."】

【The World’s Heavenly Dao had just gained a budding consciousness when disaster suddenly struck. Does the Creator have the right to destroy their creation? Does the creation have the right to resent the Creator? In this disaster and struggle, whose betrayal is it, really?】

【This is a survival quest. The player's panel is locked and replaced with a temporary panel suited to the new world. Please survive until the moment the world is destroyed.】

The system text suddenly distorted, as if it had come to life.

The characters twisted and entangled like countless writhing, thin snakes, making one’s scalp tingle.

The ink-snakes coiled together, forming new, crooked, and trembling characters of various sizes.

【■■■ invites an outsider to witness this elegy of betrayal @#￥% garbled text @#￥% screen glitch @#￥%&*】

With a "crack," as if a screen had short-circuited, the quest panel went dark.

Xia Xifeng took a deep breath.

Oh, come on, no way, right? Did I transmigrate into the world of an Outer God?! Didn't the Outer Gods' world already get destroyed by their own Creator God? How could I have transmigrated here?

Who issued this quest? Is it that powerful? Can it even enter a world already destroyed by another Creator God?

But if the rules are incompatible, shouldn't the Outer Gods I see be a blob of disgusting pixels? How can I see an Outer God’s world in its normal form?

Wait... Xia Xifeng realized a question he hadn't thought of before.

If the rules of different Creator Gods' worlds are incompatible, then the world he was in wasn't created by the Heavenly Father either. Why did the Dream World look normal to him? Was it because the Heavenly Father voluntarily opened his world to their Creator God? Or does smuggling in one or two people not require worrying about large-scale rule compatibility?

The Dragon God once said that most Creator Gods, when secretly destroying another’s world, would adopt a "boiling a frog in warm water" approach by smuggling in "destroyers." Since those destroyers could seize the destiny of the Child of Destiny according to what was called "fate" (the plot), the world in their eyes must also be normal.

So, it wasn't surprising that his vision remained normal after arriving in another Creator God’s world.

While Xia Xifeng was dazed, the breathtakingly beautiful deity, bearing the divine name "Omen Corpse Dragon"—which was completely at odds with his image—had already walked out of the bath.

He was draped in a layer of sheer gauze, his golden, silk-like hair trailing to the ground. His divine form was neither clearly male nor female; his beauty transcended gender, leaving even Xia Xifeng, who usually didn't care about others' appearances, stunned.

However, he was only stunned for a moment. The surprise brought by the other’s beauty was nothing compared to his divine name.

In truth, once one becomes a deity, crafting a perfect shell for oneself is easy. This deity’s beauty wasn't just in his appearance. Although Xia Xifeng’s divine body and divine fire were sealed, making his body feel as clumsy as when he first transmigrated, his discernment remained. He could tell that this deity’s beauty was based on the beauty of the laws themselves—meaning his "true form" was naturally like this, not the result of later "plastic surgery."

Xia Xifeng thought, *No wonder that breeding dragon, the Dragon God, couldn't stop thinking about him.*

A trace of surprise appeared on the golden-haired deity’s cold, moon-like, beautiful face.

He could see that the person before him had a divine blessing he hadn't seen before, but he was merely a mortal of flesh and blood. Even deities of the same level would be stunned and lose their composure by his beauty; ordinary mortals would have their consciousness collapse the moment they saw his true form without restrained divine power.

Yet, this mortal only showed a look of appreciation. Was his willpower even stronger than a deity’s?

Outsiders had descended into this world before. They received blessings bestowed by the God Emperor, and each one would stir up quite a wave in the world; some even reached the position of being granted divine fruit.

The golden-haired deity pondered slightly, thinking that this mortal before him might have the same origin.

The God Emperor had been asleep for a long time. He hadn't received an edict from the God Emperor regarding the reception of outsiders. But many outsiders were dropped into the lower realms without knowing anything; they didn't receive an edict every time.

Although it was strange that this outsider appeared directly before him, it was possible that the God Emperor had suddenly come up with a new idea.

The golden-haired deity felt no hostility toward the person in front of him; on the contrary, he felt a sense of familiarity. Deities trust their intuition, and the mortal before him was a friend, not a foe. Furthermore, besides the God Emperor, no one could smuggle a mortal into his presence without him noticing. The golden-haired deity had already concluded that the mortal before him was a lucky soul blessed by the God Emperor, destined to lead a new wave in the lower realm.

"Do not worry, it was the God who guided you here." The golden-haired deity, who seemed cold, was unexpectedly gentle and easy to talk to. Xia Xifeng had peeked at him bathing while wearing only boxers (Xia Xifeng: *I did not!*), and he hadn't even been angry.

Xia Xifeng scratched his head in embarrassment and improvised: "The God's guidance? Then what does the God want me to do? Also, why am I only wearing boxers? Where did my companion go? I just went down to the river to play in the water for a bit, how did I end up here?"

"The God will guide you through the fog when you are lost. You should have received the God's grace." The golden-haired deity didn't ask what grace Xia Xifeng had received. The blessed one had just arrived and must be full of vigilance. He was a friend, not a foe, and he tried his best not to make the blessed one nervous.

After comforting Xia Xifeng a few times, the golden-haired deity invited him to stay temporarily in the temple.

"Perhaps your companion is also in my Divine Domain; I will help you find him." The golden-haired deity’s tone was cold, but the content was very gentle. "Once I find your companion, I will send you to the lower realm. With the God's grace, you will surely live well in the lower realm. Do not worry."

"Thank you." Xia Xifeng looked at the golden-haired deity, who kept wearing sheer gauze and refused to dress properly, feeling very uncomfortable. His own inventory was locked, so he couldn't dress properly, but what was wrong with this god? Why was he just wearing a layer of gauze?

Xia Xifeng wore his thoughts on his face. The golden-haired deity noticed his expression, his cold face stiffened, and he pretended to wave his hand naturally. The gauze swirled, and he changed into a robe with intricate patterns.

He hadn't intentionally not worn clothes; he was just used to living alone and had forgotten.

However, this mortal was not only not bewitched by his beauty but was also concerned about his improper attire. The golden-haired deity felt a bit annoyed, yet he appreciated Xia Xifeng even more.

For the first time, he asked for the mortal’s name.

After Xia Xifeng answered, he asked for his "benefactor’s" name. In this world, he certainly wouldn't be called "Omen Corpse Dragon."

The golden-haired deity smiled mysteriously: "After you descend to the lower realm, you will naturally know my name."

Xia Xifeng thought to himself, *Does this deity mean his faith is widespread, he has many believers, and there are temples everywhere?*

chunks.chineseText:
夏兮风其实心里很警惕，可警惕也没用，没漂亮版本的噩兆尸龙帮忙，他找不到秦琅。

金发神灵没有骗夏兮风。祂唤来神使安排夏兮风住宿后，就放开神识，在神域寻找夏兮风的同伴。

很可惜，夏兮风的同伴没有在祂的神域中。

当夏兮风得知这件事后，如遭雷劈。

他的面板锁了，秦琅的面板肯定也锁了。自己好歹还有削弱版的生活技能傍身，秦琅没吃没穿要怎么活啊！

夏兮风的镇定立刻没了，眼泪一滚就落了下来：“请、请把我放回下界。说不定我的同伴正在下界等我。”

脱离神域，说不定系统的通讯功能会恢复。再者秦琅也接了要在下界生存的系统任务，一定会去下界。

可下界那么大，他要怎么找秦琅啊！

夏兮风一想到秦琅现在神体被封印，会冷会饿，却只剩下一条短裤，就担忧得止不住眼泪。

金发神灵安慰道：“有神灵的赐福，你的同伴一定无事。我会帮你寻找你的同伴。等找到你的同伴，我就送他过来。”

金发神灵递给夏兮风一个黄宝石手镯。手镯不仅有很大的储物空间，还能在每个月第一日的正午，通过祭祀与祂短暂沟通。

金发神灵透露了自己神灵的身份，但夏兮风只顾着哭，没有陪着金发神灵演一出凡人遇神的戏。

金发神灵无奈地继续安抚夏兮风，送给夏兮风华服和食物，教导夏兮风如何使用手镯。

祂还为夏兮风赐下自己的祝福，让夏兮风无惧黑暗的恐惧，在最深的黑暗中都能视物，并能豁免十分之一的黑暗属性攻击。

夏兮风的身体太弱小，且已经有了神皇的赐福，祂只能给这么简单的赐福。

“无事的，无事的，我很快就能为你寻到你的同伴。”金发神灵犹豫了一下，第一次伸手抚摸了凡人的头顶。

不知道为什么，祂对面前的人很有好感，仿佛这个人做了什么有恩于自己的事。

神灵强烈的直觉一般都是正确的。金发神灵猜测，或许这位恩赐者成长后，会帮助自己吧。

即使是未来的恩情，金发神灵有恩必报，对夏兮风更多了几分亲近。

夏兮风未来能帮助祂，肯定会成为祂的同伴，祂便不会用对待凡人的态度对待夏兮风。

……

秦琅将系统面板翻来覆去看了许多遍。

无法联系到夏兮风。

“喂喂，你哑巴吗？就算有神皇的赐福，你也只是个凡人，对神灵怎么一点尊重都没有！”黑发神灵气急败坏道。

秦琅瞥了一眼雌雄莫辨的黑发神灵。

虽然神灵没有性别很正常，这个神灵脑袋有病，身体一会儿男一会儿女，胸口不断起伏，无缝切换，声音也忽男忽女。

“尊敬的黑暗之神，请送我下界。我的同伴应该在下界。”秦琅不知道夏兮风在哪，但既然他不在黑暗神域，无论夏兮风在下界还是在其他神域，就不能在这里浪费时间。

“我和光明神约定过，只能投放神使去魔界。你这么弱，确定能在魔界活下来？”黑暗之神虽然刚刚才气急败坏，但意外地胸怀广大，没打算为难秦琅。

秦琅扫了一眼自己的简易版本技能面板：“能。”

黑暗之神：“我觉得不能。算了，我送你去黑暗教堂，给你一个安全的住的地方。”

秦琅很有礼貌地谢过了黑暗之神。

黑暗之神摸了摸下巴。

祂平时脾气没那么好。秦琅明明是个凡人，身上却有自己的神果气息。但祂一观察，气息立刻就消失了，仿佛是自己的错觉。

祂都这么强大了，肯定不会有错觉。难道秦琅未来会得到祂的神果？但这神果气息中没有自己的怨恨诅咒……难道秦琅以后是自己的继任者？

黑暗之神点了点头。一定是这样！

“我的继任者，要不要先封个黑暗圣子呢？”黑暗之神嘀嘀咕咕，在自己库藏里找了找，找到一个没有佩戴等级要求的黑宝石手镯。

秦琅离开时，祂把手镯送给了秦琅。手镯不仅是空间储物道具，秦琅只要在一个月最后一天的子夜向祂祈祷，就能与祂暂时沟通。

“我会帮你寻人，作为回报，你要快点变强，扬我黑暗圣子的名声！”黑暗之神叮嘱。

秦琅：“……是。”虽然不知道自己为什么成了黑暗圣子，只要能快点跑路就行。

作者有话要说：

[狗头]
chunks.englishText:
Xia Xifeng was actually very vigilant, but vigilance was useless; without the help of the beautiful version of the Omen Corpse Dragon, he couldn't find Qin Lang.

The golden-haired deity did not lie to Xia Xifeng. After summoning a divine messenger to arrange accommodation for him, he released his divine sense to search for Xia Xifeng’s companion within his Divine Domain.

Unfortunately, Xia Xifeng’s companion was not in his Divine Domain.

When Xia Xifeng learned of this, he felt as if he had been struck by lightning.

His panel was locked, so Qin Lang’s panel must be locked too. He at least had a weakened version of his life skills to fall back on, but how was Qin Lang supposed to survive without food or clothes!

Xia Xifeng’s composure vanished instantly, and tears welled up and fell: "Please, please send me back to the lower realm. Maybe my companion is waiting for me down there."

Once he left the Divine Domain, perhaps the system’s communication function would recover. Besides, Qin Lang had also accepted the system quest to survive in the lower realm, so he would definitely go there.

But the lower realm was so vast; how was he supposed to find Qin Lang!

The moment Xia Xifeng thought of Qin Lang with his divine body sealed, cold and hungry, left with only a pair of boxers, he couldn't stop his tears.

The golden-haired deity comforted him: "With the God's blessing, your companion will surely be fine. I will help you search for him. Once I find your companion, I will send him to you."

The golden-haired deity handed Xia Xifeng a yellow gemstone bracelet. The bracelet not only had a large storage space but also allowed him to communicate briefly with him through sacrifice at noon on the first day of every month.

The golden-haired deity revealed his identity as a god, but Xia Xifeng was too busy crying to play along with the "mortal meets god" act.

The golden-haired deity helplessly continued to comfort Xia Xifeng, gifting him fine clothes and food, and teaching him how to use the bracelet.

He also bestowed his own blessing upon Xia Xifeng, allowing him to be fearless of the darkness, to see in the deepest gloom, and to be immune to one-tenth of dark-attribute attacks.

Xia Xifeng’s body was too weak and already had the God Emperor’s blessing; he could only give such a simple blessing.

"It is fine, it is fine, I will find your companion for you soon." The golden-haired deity hesitated for a moment, then reached out to pat the mortal’s head for the first time.

For some reason, he felt a strong affinity for the person before him, as if this person had done him some great favor.

A deity’s strong intuition is usually correct. The golden-haired deity guessed that perhaps this blessed one would help him after he grew up.

Even if it were a future favor, the golden-haired deity believed in repaying kindness, and he felt a bit more closeness toward Xia Xifeng.

Since Xia Xifeng could help him in the future, he would surely become his companion, so he would not treat Xia Xifeng with the attitude he held toward ordinary mortals.

...

Qin Lang looked at his system panel over and over again.

He could not contact Xia Xifeng.

"Hey, hey, are you mute? Even with the God Emperor’s blessing, you are just a mortal; how can you have so little respect for a deity!" the black-haired deity said, exasperated.

Qin Lang glanced at the black-haired deity, whose gender was indistinguishable.

Although it was normal for deities to have no gender, this deity was mentally ill; his body switched between male and female, his chest rose and fell, switching seamlessly, and his voice fluctuated between male and female.

"Respected God of Darkness, please send me to the lower realm. My companion should be there." Qin Lang didn't know where Xia Xifeng was, but since he wasn't in the Dark Divine Domain, he couldn't waste time here, whether Xia Xifeng was in the lower realm or another Divine Domain.

"I have an agreement with the God of Light; I can only send divine messengers to the Demon Realm. You are so weak; are you sure you can survive in the Demon Realm?" Although the God of Darkness had just been exasperated, he was unexpectedly broad-minded and didn't intend to make things difficult for Qin Lang.

Qin Lang glanced at his simplified skill panel: "I can."

The God of Darkness: "I don't think you can. Forget it, I'll send you to the Dark Cathedral and give you a safe place to live."

Qin Lang thanked the God of Darkness very politely.

The God of Darkness stroked his chin.

He didn't usually have such a good temper. Qin Lang was clearly a mortal, yet he carried the aura of his own divine fruit. But when he observed closely, the aura vanished instantly, as if it were his own hallucination.

He was so powerful; surely he couldn't be having hallucinations. Could it be that Qin Lang would obtain his divine fruit in the future? But there was no resentment or curse of his own in this divine fruit aura... Could Qin Lang be his successor?

The God of Darkness nodded. That must be it!

"My successor, should I appoint you as a Dark Saint Son first?" The God of Darkness muttered to himself, searching through his treasury until he found a black gemstone bracelet that had no level requirements.

When Qin Lang left, he gave him the bracelet. The bracelet was not only a spatial storage item, but Qin Lang could also communicate with him temporarily by praying to him at midnight on the last day of every month.

"I will help you find your person. In return, you must become strong quickly and spread the fame of my Dark Saint Son!" the God of Darkness urged.

Qin Lang: "...Yes." Although he didn't know why he had become a Dark Saint Son, as long as he could get away quickly, it was fine.

***

第119章 一更

夏兮风下界的时候，金发神灵很是担忧地叮嘱了夏兮风许多事，并细细给他挑选了一个民风古朴的小城镇当落脚点。

夏兮风离开神界时，回头看了金发神灵一眼。

冷冰冰的金发神灵以为夏兮风还在忐忑，对他露出一个安抚的微笑。

冰雪消融，春光乍暖，如桃花浮水般的微笑。

夏兮风收起视线，脑海里浮现出噩兆尸龙的模样，和巨龙一族的惨状。

他说过很多次不关心加害者背后的惨事，系统却让他亲眼看一遍加害者的生活。这是为什么？

天父肯定不是善心泛滥到外神身上。系统任务背后必有其他缘由。

等见到秦琅再思考吧。

夏兮风的手指拂过系统面板。

他不仅联系不到秦琅，连秦琅的面板都看不到了。上次和秦琅分别，好歹还能看到秦琅的状态。

夏兮风落地时，一位穿着朴素灰袍的神父已经等候多时。

他对夏兮风慈祥地笑了笑，表情中没有对夏兮风是神亲自叮嘱关照的恩赐者的惶恐和讨好。

夏兮风对他的第一印象很好。

神父名为约翰，不知道是真名还是假名。约翰神父是一位隐居的苦修士，在一个名为“轻风”的小镇上掌管着只有他一个人的小教堂。

轻风镇是一位骑士男爵世袭的领土。虽然约翰神父看似寒酸，但和领主的关系非常好。他已经为夏兮风办好了身份。夏兮风新身份的名字为“夏”，是约翰神父收养的孤儿，父母是轻风镇土生土长的居民。

恰巧，轻风镇的领主也是黑发黑眼，虽然是黑长卷，夏兮风也可以勉强假称是他的远亲。

约翰神父道：“埃德尔男爵是一位很优秀的光明骑士，也是一位很好的领主。你可以放心在这里生活。”

埃德尔男爵本来想亲自接待这位神的恩赐者，但约翰神父以神的指示拒绝了。

神只是指引迷途的羔羊，不想给羔羊太多束缚。

埃德尔男爵也是一位虔诚的信仰者，自然要遵循神的指示，便没有来结识夏兮风。

夏兮风看着教堂里的神像，知道了噩兆尸龙的神名——光明。

这个世界也是典型的西幻世界，甚至比梦世界那种夹杂了奇奇怪怪元素的西幻世界更加传统和简单，是很普通的中世纪西方剑与魔法的世界，魔导技术很不发达，不仅没有民用，连武器都没有太大发展。

梦世界好一点的装备都自带buff，这里更好的剑只是更锋利、更坚硬，更好的法杖只是能容纳更多魔力。

这里也没有太多种族。凡间的生灵只有人类和魔族，他们的主神就是光明神和黑暗神。人类和魔族生存在不同的大陆，人类称魔族大陆为魔界，两个种族时常有争斗。

这个世界还有其他神灵。只有黑暗和光明神灵自诞生起就天生敌对。黑暗神常往凡间投影，自封魔王。这时候光明神就会选拔勇者，前往讨伐魔王。

夏兮风想了想，觉得这个套路不算西方奇幻，而是日式奇幻吧？

不管这个世界的底层世界观如何，这个小镇还是很淳朴的。虽然中世纪的科技水平差了点，晚上得点煤油灯和蜡烛照明，生活很不方便，夏兮风在热情的居民帮助下，很快就融入了小镇。

他向约翰神父借了点钱，买下了一个废弃的农场，在镇子安了家。

夏兮风虽然很担忧秦琅，但知道自己没有战斗力，也不知道秦琅在哪，与其无头苍蝇似的乱窜，不如在这里打响名气，让秦琅来寻他。他赚多了钱，也能花钱雇用佣兵寻找秦琅。

而且系统的临时技能里，等级高了能制作通讯器和地图。他直觉这是他找到秦琅的线索。

“由奢入俭难啊。”夏兮风看着荒芜的农场，满心萧瑟。

这里说是个农场，其实就是一大片荒地，连拆掉的建筑物遗留的木材石材都早就被人捡光了，什么都要自己建造。

他和秦琅刚到梦世界就遇见了莱欧，很快就抱上苏尔老师粗壮的龙大腿，从此不愁资源。没想到他都点燃神火了，还要从头开始捡垃圾。

夏兮风苦着脸捡石头。

石材一块，石材两块，石材三块……石材十块。

夏兮风再苦着脸捡树枝。

木材一根，木材两根，木材三根……木材十根。

夏兮风合成简陋工作台，然后继续捡石头和树枝，在工作台合成石斧、石镐、石镰刀，用的材料都是二十块石材和二十根木材。

工具齐备后，夏兮风扛着石斧哐哐哐砍枯树，三斧头砍倒一棵枯树，枯树无论大小都掉落五十根木材。

凑齐三百根木材后，夏兮风找到了一片空地，铺设木地板，木墙壁，木房顶，安装木门和木窗。

木材用完了，夏兮风继续砍树，砍完树继续像搭建积木一样搭建木头房子。

或许是夏兮风本质上还是神体的缘故，临时技能使用的时候不需要耗费体力，夏兮风可以一直工作。

搭建好一个俗称火柴盒的简易小木屋后，今晚上住的地方有了，夏兮风拿着镰刀割野草。

干草加一，干草继续加一……干草一百，加上五十根木材，夏兮风合成了看着像个草窝的简陋木床。

“还好约翰神父送了食物和水。”夏兮风坐在草窝木床上啃着三明治，喝着凉白开，泪流满面，“我都这么苦了，阿琅风餐露宿，不知道苦成什么样。”

他一想到秦琅就难过，连称呼都不自觉地变了。

填饱肚子，夏兮风拍拍脸，继续干活。

只有系统制作的工具能使用技能，种田用的种子也一样。

割草的时候有概率掉落种子，一级的石头镰刀只能掉落白萝卜和圆白菜两种种子。

割草时掉落种子的概率大概是十比一。夏兮风割了几百份干草，清理出了一大片空地，用锄头翻了，播种上白萝卜和圆白菜各十份。

系统田地里的白萝卜和圆白菜只需要五天就能收获，夏兮风就可以去城里卖菜了。

他种好萝卜白菜，浇完水，抹了一把脸。

系统商城页面也灰了，只能在现实中卖东西，不知道萝卜白菜在城里卖不卖得掉。

种完地后，夏兮风又做了木头浴桶，加水就能自动加热到适合的温度。

疲惫地泡了个澡，换上约翰神父送的旧衣服，夏兮风躺在干草窝里。虽然很担心秦琅，但一天繁重的工作还是让他很快入睡。

入睡前，他思索明天的工作。

明天他继续捡垃圾砍木头砸石头割野草清理地面，搜集的材料就留着不做东西了。

按照今天的经验增长，明天再捡半天垃圾，他就能升到二级。大石头有概率砸出铜块，二级就能制造青铜工具和矿洞罗盘，找矿洞下矿了。

不知道这个矿洞罗盘怎么用，不会让他和别人抢矿吧？

夏兮风悲伤地闭上双眼，为明天的自己默哀。

……

魔界中，黑暗骑士罗兰看着高高的尸堆，和坐在尸堆旁看书的俊美男子，一时无言。

Chapter 119: First Update

When Xia Xifeng descended to the lower realm, the golden-haired deity was filled with concern, offering him many instructions and carefully selecting a small town with simple, rustic customs as his landing point.

As Xia Xifeng left the God Realm, he glanced back at the golden-haired deity once.

The cold, golden-haired deity, thinking Xia Xifeng was still anxious, offered him a reassuring smile.

It was a smile like spring warmth melting ice and snow, like peach blossoms floating on water.

Xia Xifeng withdrew his gaze, the image of the Omen Corpse Dragon and the tragic state of the Dragon race surfacing in his mind.

He had said many times that he didn't care about the tragedies behind the perpetrators, yet the System had forced him to witness the lives of the perpetrators firsthand. Why?

The Heavenly Father certainly wouldn't be so overflowing with benevolence toward an Outer God. There must be another reason behind the System's mission.

*I'll think about it once I see Qin Lang,* he decided.

Xia Xifeng’s fingers brushed over the System panel.

Not only could he not contact Qin Lang, but he could no longer even see Qin Lang’s status panel. When they had parted ways last time, he could at least still see Qin Lang’s condition.

When Xia Xifeng landed, a priest wearing a simple gray robe had already been waiting for a long time.

He smiled kindly at Xia Xifeng, his expression devoid of the fear or obsequiousness one might expect toward a "gifted one" personally entrusted by a god.

Xia Xifeng’s first impression of him was quite good.

The priest’s name was John, though it was unclear if it was his real name or an alias. Father John was a reclusive ascetic who managed a tiny chapel—with only himself as the congregation—in a small town called "Light Breeze."

Light Breeze Town was the hereditary territory of a knight-baron. Although Father John appeared impoverished, he had an excellent relationship with the lord. He had already prepared an identity for Xia Xifeng. His new name was "Xia," an orphan adopted by Father John, whose parents were native residents of Light Breeze Town.

Coincidentally, the lord of Light Breeze Town also had black hair and black eyes; although his hair was long and curly, Xia Xifeng could barely pass as a distant relative.

Father John said, "Baron Edel is an excellent Knight of Light and a very good lord. You can live here with peace of mind."

Baron Edel had originally wanted to personally receive this "gifted one" of the gods, but Father John had declined on the grounds of divine instruction.

The gods only guide lost lambs; they do not wish to place too many constraints upon them.

Baron Edel was also a devout believer and naturally followed the divine instructions, so he did not come to meet Xia Xifeng.

Looking at the statue in the chapel, Xia Xifeng learned the divine name of the Omen Corpse Dragon: "Light."

This world was a typical Western fantasy setting—even more traditional and simple than the Dream World, which had been mixed with all sorts of strange elements. It was a mundane medieval world of swords and magic. Magitech was underdeveloped; not only was there no civilian application, but even weaponry hadn't seen much advancement.

In the Dream World, decent equipment came with buffs, but here, a better sword was simply sharper and harder, and a better staff simply held more mana.

There weren't many races here either. The mortal beings consisted only of humans and demons. Their primary deities were the God of Light and the God of Darkness. Humans and demons lived on different continents; humans called the demon continent the "Demon Realm," and the two races were often at war.

There were other deities in this world, but only the gods of Darkness and Light had been natural enemies since their birth. The God of Darkness often projected into the mortal realm, crowning himself the Demon King. At such times, the God of Light would select a hero to go and subjugate the Demon King.

Xia Xifeng mused that this trope didn't feel like Western fantasy, but rather Japanese-style fantasy.

Regardless of the underlying worldview, the town was very rustic. Although the medieval technology level was lacking—requiring kerosene lamps and candles for light at night, making life quite inconvenient—Xia Xifeng quickly integrated into the town with the help of the enthusiastic residents.

He borrowed some money from Father John, bought an abandoned farm, and settled down.

Though Xia Xifeng was deeply worried about Qin Lang, he knew he lacked combat power and had no idea where Qin Lang was. Rather than running around like a headless chicken, it was better to make a name for himself here so that Qin Lang could find him. If he earned enough money, he could hire mercenaries to search for Qin Lang.

Moreover, among the System's temporary skills, higher levels allowed for the crafting of communicators and maps. He had a hunch that this was the clue to finding Qin Lang.

"It is easy to go from luxury to frugality, but hard to go from frugality to luxury," Xia Xifeng sighed, looking at the desolate farm.

It was called a farm, but in reality, it was just a large patch of wasteland. Even the wood and stone from the demolished buildings had long been scavenged by others; he had to build everything himself.

When he and Qin Lang first arrived in the Dream World, they met Leo and quickly latched onto Teacher Suer’s sturdy dragon thigh, never worrying about resources again. He hadn't expected that even after igniting his divine fire, he would have to start from scratch, scavenging for trash.

Xia Xifeng picked up stones with a bitter face.

One stone, two stones, three stones... ten stones.

Xia Xifeng then picked up tree branches with a bitter face.

One piece of wood, two pieces of wood, three pieces of wood... ten pieces of wood.

Xia Xifeng synthesized a crude workbench, then continued to scavenge for stones and branches, using the workbench to craft a stone axe, stone pickaxe, and stone sickle, each requiring twenty stones and twenty pieces of wood.

With tools in hand, Xia Xifeng shouldered the stone axe and *thwack-thwack-thwacked* at a dead tree. It took three swings to fell it, and regardless of size, each dead tree dropped fifty pieces of wood.

After gathering three hundred pieces of wood, Xia Xifeng found an open space, laid down wooden flooring, erected wooden walls and a roof, and installed a wooden door and windows.

When the wood ran out, he went back to chopping trees, then continued building the wooden house like stacking blocks.

Perhaps because his essence was still a divine body, he didn't consume stamina when using the temporary skills, allowing him to work continuously.

After building a simple wooden shack—commonly known as a "matchbox"—he had a place to sleep for the night. Xia Xifeng then took his sickle to cut wild grass.

Hay plus one, hay plus one... one hundred hay, plus fifty pieces of wood, and Xia Xifeng synthesized a crude wooden bed that looked like a bird's nest.

"At least Father John provided food and water," Xia Xifeng sat on the hay-filled wooden bed, gnawing on a sandwich and drinking cool boiled water, tears streaming down his face. "I'm already suffering this much; I wonder how much Ah Lang is suffering while sleeping in the open."

The mere thought of Qin Lang made him sad, his form of address changing unconsciously.

After filling his stomach, Xia Xifeng patted his face and continued working.

Only tools crafted by the System could utilize skills, and the same applied to farming seeds.

There was a chance to drop seeds while cutting grass. A level-one stone sickle could only drop radish and cabbage seeds.

The probability of dropping seeds while cutting grass was about one in ten. Xia Xifeng cut several hundred portions of hay, cleared a large open space, tilled it with a hoe, and planted ten portions each of radishes and cabbages.

The radishes and cabbages in the System plot only needed five days to harvest, and then Xia Xifeng could go to town to sell them.

He finished planting and watering, then wiped his face.

The System mall page was grayed out; he could only sell things in reality. He didn't know if radishes and cabbages would even sell in town.

After finishing the farm work, Xia Xifeng made a wooden bathtub that would automatically heat water to a suitable temperature.

Exhausted, he took a bath, changed into the old clothes Father John had given him, and lay down in the hay nest. Although he was very worried about Qin Lang, the heavy day of work made him fall asleep quickly.

Before drifting off, he pondered his work for tomorrow.

Tomorrow, he would continue scavenging, chopping wood, smashing stones, cutting grass, and clearing the ground, but he would save the materials instead of crafting items.

Based on today's experience growth, another half-day of scavenging tomorrow would be enough to reach level two. Large stones had a chance to yield copper, and at level two, he could craft bronze tools and a mine compass to go mining.

He wondered how this mine compass worked. It wouldn't make him fight others for mines, would it?

Xia Xifeng closed his eyes sorrowfully, observing a moment of silence for his tomorrow-self.

...

In the Demon Realm, the Dark Knight Roland looked at the high pile of corpses and the handsome man sitting beside the pile reading a book, speechless for a moment.

chunks.chineseText:
罗兰是黑暗神殿的惩戒骑士团成员，虽然他身上没有职位，但深受黑暗教皇信任。

教皇突然唤来他，让他保护一位贵族的安全。他将跟随在这位贵族左右，不干涉贵族的行为，任由贵族去往哪里，直到贵族让他离开。

罗兰本不想做这种漫长又无聊的任务，但教皇亲自下令，他也无可奈何。

当刚见到那位名为“秦”的年轻贵族时，罗兰除了秦那张脸，对秦没有丝毫好感。

秦太弱了，身上几乎没有斗气也没有魔力，平凡得连城里最纨绔的子弟都不如，仿佛城郊随处可见的农人。

秦甚至连铁制的武器都拿不动，只能拿木头做的短剑，十分可笑。

罗兰的轻视，只持续了半日。

秦问他可食用的弱小魔物屠宰场在哪里。罗兰以为他购买新鲜的肉类，谁知道，秦在屠宰场杀了半日的火兔。

火兔，一种可以喷火的小型魔物，皮毛可以做衣服，肉可以食用，没有魔晶。

这种弱小的魔物，罗兰一个眼神都能把它瞪死。

但他不会去瞪。

他更不会一整个下午都在疯狂杀兔子，面无表情地杀兔子，毫无情绪波动地杀兔子。

罗兰：“……”我们魔族和人族只是种族不同，不是品德不同。我们的道德观是一样的！你这嗜杀的模样，根本就是精神有问题吧！

罗兰心惊胆战地看着秦和屠宰场老板讨价还价，要了一大笔屠宰费，说明天再来。

老板颤抖着送走了秦，那眼神绝对是不想秦再来，但秦拿出了教皇的命令。

罗兰：“……”感觉我们黑暗神殿的风评受害了。

为了不让秦吓到可怜的魔界居民，罗兰带秦去了野外弱小魔物的聚集地，并帮秦聚怪，让秦杀个够。

他很好奇，秦到底想干什么？只是想发泄杀欲吗？

秦好像确实只是发泄杀欲。他总会杀许多魔物，然后把魔物堆好，让自己去收拾卖钱。

罗兰：“……”我堂堂骑士……

可是教皇有命令，一个优秀的骑士必须听从命令，所以罗兰只能听命令。

他忍不住道：“如果您缺钱，我可以送给您。”

秦回答他：“只有我自己狩猎的魔物卖的钱，我才能用。”

罗兰：“？”虽然听不懂，但好像挺有原则的样子？

秦琅点好技能，向系统商店购买了新的武器和装备。

系统商店只卖不回收，除了武器和装备什么都没有，并且武器和装备全是只有基础属性的白板。

由奢入俭难。他想念夏兮风给他准备的99件神级装备。

“可以换个地方了。”秦琅合上书，报了自己现在能刷的魔物，让罗兰寻找下一个刷怪地点。

罗兰应下，看向秦琅手中的书。

这位疑似精神有问题的年轻贵族总是在看介绍神灵的书，仿佛虔诚的神学者。

作者有话要说：

[裂开]这作息又要完蛋了。

Chapter 119: First Update (Part 2)

Roland was a member of the Punitive Knight Order of the Dark Temple. Although he held no official rank, he was deeply trusted by the Dark Pope.

The Pope had suddenly summoned him and ordered him to protect the safety of a young noble. He was to follow this noble, not interfere with his actions, and allow him to go wherever he pleased until the noble dismissed him.

Roland had no desire for such a long and boring mission, but since the Pope had personally ordered it, he had no choice.

When he first met the young noble named "Qin," Roland had not a shred of good impression of him, save for his face.

Qin was too weak. He possessed almost no Dou Qi or magic power, appearing more ordinary than even the most debauched sons in the city, looking like a peasant one might see anywhere on the outskirts.

Qin couldn't even lift an iron weapon, forced to use a short sword made of wood—it was laughable.

Roland’s disdain lasted only half a day.

Qin asked him where the slaughterhouse for edible, weak magical beasts was. Roland assumed he was buying fresh meat, but who knew that Qin would spend half a day in the slaughterhouse killing Fire Rabbits.

Fire Rabbits were small magical beasts that could breathe fire. Their fur could be used for clothing, their meat was edible, and they had no magic crystals.

Such weak magical beasts could be killed by a single glare from Roland.

But he wouldn't glare at them.

And he certainly wouldn't spend an entire afternoon frantically killing rabbits, expressionless, without a single ripple of emotion.

Roland: "..." We demons and humans are just different races, not different in morality. Our moral values are the same! Your bloodthirsty appearance is clearly a sign of a mental problem!

Roland watched in trepidation as Qin haggled with the slaughterhouse owner, demanding a large sum for the slaughtering fee, and saying he would return tomorrow.

The owner trembled as he sent Qin away, his eyes clearly wishing Qin would never return, but Qin had produced the Pope’s order.

Roland: "..." I feel like the reputation of our Dark Temple is being tarnished.

To prevent Qin from scaring the poor residents of the Demon Realm, Roland took Qin to a gathering place for weak magical beasts in the wild and helped him herd the monsters so Qin could kill to his heart's content.

He was very curious: what exactly did Qin want to do? Was he just venting a bloodlust?

It seemed Qin really was just venting. He would always kill many magical beasts and then stack them up, leaving Roland to clean them up and sell them for money.

Roland: "..." I am a dignified knight...

But the Pope had given an order, and an excellent knight must obey orders, so Roland had no choice but to listen.

He couldn't help but say, "If you are short on money, I can give you some."

Qin replied, "I can only use the money earned from the magical beasts I hunt myself."

Roland: "?" Although I don't understand, it sounds like he has principles?

Qin Lang finished allocating his skill points and purchased new weapons and equipment from the System store.

The System store only sold items and did not buy them back. Aside from weapons and equipment, there was nothing else, and all the gear was "white-tier" with only base stats.

It is easy to go from luxury to frugality, but hard to go from frugality to luxury. He missed the 99 god-tier items Xia Xifeng had prepared for him.

"We can change locations now." Qin Lang closed his book, reported the magical beasts he could currently farm, and asked Roland to find the next location.

Roland agreed, glancing at the book in Qin Lang’s hand.

This young noble, suspected of having mental issues, was always reading books about deities, as if he were a devout theologian.

Author's Note:
[Cracking] This sleep schedule is going to be ruined again.
