chunks.chineseText:
第124章 一更

夏兮风睁开眼睛的时候，背靠着秦琅，被秦琅抱在怀里，浑身酸疼。

他唏嘘了一下，好久没有感受到腰酸背疼了。这个新身体不行啊。

他动了一下，背后拥抱着他的人也动了一下，身体内某部位传来难以描述的拉扯感，让他脸色一黑。

夏兮风扭头看着下巴搁在他肩膀上的秦琅：“洗了澡你怎么又进去了？”

他记得被秦琅抱去洗澡的时候，明明已经分开了！

秦琅懒洋洋道：“温暖。”

夏兮风：“……”信不信我睡相不好给拧了！

夏兮风想从秦琅怀里离开，被秦琅死死禁锢在怀里，扭来扭去体内感觉更明显，赶紧停下。

可惜已经晚了，身体酸疼加重。

在秦琅还想再来一次时，被夏兮风双手推脸：“等回去随便你做多久，现在我撑不住了！”

秦琅将脸埋在夏兮风的颈间，遮住眼底的不满足。

最初他和夏兮风神魂相交实属意外，以为再不愿陷入没有隐私的尴尬境地。

不知道从什么时候开始，两人习惯性在欢好的时候神魂交缠。虽然他们可以不去看对方的记忆，但只要想看，就可以随时翻阅。对方的一切都向自己敞开。

已经习惯神魂交缠，只是简单的肌肤亲昵，已经不能满足秦琅。即使夏兮风把日记本交给他，他还是不满足。

越是肌肤相亲，越只是身体的欢愉，他就越不满足，恨不得将夏兮风揉进身体里。

如果是在梦世界，他确实可以将夏兮风完全揉进身体里，从神魂到血肉完全交缠，没有一丝缝隙。

没见到的时候还能忍受，等见面时他才发现，自己的忍耐力并没有想象得那么好。

秦琅不由想，在原本的世界中，他以为一切都在掌握中，自己的理智足够压制偏执。

他真的能压制吗？真的能容忍夏兮风离开，容忍夏兮风将特殊对待转移到其他人身上吗？

怀抱着夏兮风，秦琅不确定了。

或许他只是自以为是，自欺欺人罢了。从生出危机感，试图推开夏兮风开始，他可能就已经没有救了。

“只要一直在一起，我什么事你不知道？不用翻看神魂里的记忆你也知道。”夏兮风扒拉着颈间的毛绒绒大脑袋，嘴角压不住上弯。

秦琅平时装高冷，撒娇起来特别可爱。

不能笑不能笑，笑了他恼羞成怒，就不会无意间撒娇了。秦琅就是太爱面子，太喜欢端着。

秦琅轻咬了一下夏兮风的耳垂。

无论他想什么，夏兮风总是能一眼看穿，让他怀疑他和夏兮风的智商差距是不是假的。

“这下可以看系统更新了吧？”夏兮风催促。系统更新后他一直没看，心痒痒的，十分不舒服。

“唉……”秦琅轻叹了一口气，对夏兮风总是破坏气氛而略有不满，“不累了？”

夏兮风道：“累也要看，不看睡不着。”

秦琅意有所指：“我可以让你很快睡着。”

夏兮风扯了扯秦琅的头发：“不做了！说不做就不做！”

秦琅遗憾地松开夏兮风，和夏兮风并肩平躺在床上，一起研究系统更新。

系统原本的“战友”功能解锁了一部分。他们能共享背包、地图、经验、装备，技能也有了更新。

秦琅的系统更新很简单，只是增加了战斗力而已，不须多提。

夏兮风多了“自创”菜单。他可以运用这个世界的材料，自己研究出东西。自创的东西得到系统认可之后，可以“献祭”给系统，解锁更多技能，增加系统背包格数。

解锁的技能中除了夏兮风被锁定的例如“跑得更快”“百毒不侵”“无掉落伤害”等生存技能外，还能解锁学院面板。

学院面板是如同希望之城面板一样的经营板块，如同常见的模拟经营游戏一样。夏兮风可以在学院面板里管理他即将建造的新学院，根据学生面板适时调整课程。

学院面板中有一项重要指标为“世界影响力”。

这次系统终于出了“主线任务”。

本来他们需要待到世界毁灭才能返回，现在只要“世界影响力”进度条满了就能回去。

简单来说，系统与在梦世界一样，仍旧是以夏兮风为主做任务，秦琅负责辅助和当保镖。

夏兮风没多想，秦琅在学院板块上点了一下：“系统猜不到你的想法，而是以你的举动来制定任务。这个主线任务可能另有原因。”

夏兮风：“嗯。”

秦琅：“？”

夏兮风：“？”

秦琅：“然后？”

夏兮风：“不是该你说然后吗？”

秦琅深呼吸了一下，道：“我是让你思考。”

夏兮风用肩头撞了撞秦琅的肩头：“懒得思考。你都思考出答案了，我还思考什么。你聪明的脑袋瓜子能不能用一用？别老是无脑战斗爽。”

秦琅气乐了。你不思考，还是我的问题了？他只是不喜欢走剧情和与陌生人打交道，什么时候没思考了？希望之城那么大一摊子事，难道不是自己在管理？夏兮风就只负责研究生产！

虽然之后什么都丢给戴蒙了。

秦琅心虚了一秒。

看见秦琅突如其来的心虚表情，夏兮风秒懂，也跟着心虚了一秒。

啊，戴蒙，不愧是玩家在新手村最好的兄弟，所有玩家的白月光朱砂痣，竖起大拇指！

两人交换了一个心虚的眼神，继续研究系统。

夏兮风懒得思考，秦琅就直接说了。

他猜测，夏兮风建立学院，推广魔导科技，引领世界文明发展，对这个世界的创世神可能真的有影响。

当世界影响力进度条满的时候，就是敌对创世神察觉到他们，系统必须把他们接走的时候。否则系统完全可以让他们多搞事几年，引发更大的浪潮。

夏兮风将“儿女强大了，父母就不能轻易左右儿女性命”的想法告诉了秦琅。秦琅认可夏兮风的想法。

任务的更新，或许是系统对他们想法的回应。

“我们的目标就是在世界毁灭前肝满进度条！”夏兮风懂了，“世界什么时候毁灭，你有头绪吗？”

秦琅：“创世神不能直接攻击自己的世界。祂肯定在这个世界的底层逻辑上埋下了隐患，可以随时引爆。在有神的世界，所有规则，包括用于引爆世界的规则，都一定会成为神灵。”

秦琅问黑暗教会要神学书籍，不只是寻找夏兮风可能会降落的神域。

他听到龙神对世界危机的解密后，心里就有了这个猜测。

那位象征着世界毁灭的外神肯定会来到梦世界。只要知道那位外神的原型和诞生的时间，就可以推测出世界毁灭的时间。

秦琅：“象征世界毁灭的外神，到了梦世界也可能是毁灭梦世界本土规则的重要武器。我们或许能在这个世界找到破解的方法。”

夏兮风夸赞：“你脑子动起来就是好使，但你怎么就是不动呢？”

秦琅：“？”好端端地聊天，你非得损我吗？

秦琅本来想对夏兮风温柔点，但夏兮风根本不给他机会。
chunks.englishText:
### Chapter 124: Update One

When Xia Xifeng opened his eyes, he was pressed against Qin Lang’s back, held tightly in his arms, his whole body aching.

He sighed softly; it had been a long time since he’d felt this kind of lower-back soreness. This new body was just not up to the task.

He shifted slightly, and the person holding him from behind moved as well. A sudden, indescribable tugging sensation from deep within his body made his face darken.

Xia Xifeng turned his head to look at Qin Lang, whose chin was resting on his shoulder: "We already showered, why did you go back in?"

He clearly remembered that they had separated when Qin Lang carried him to the bath!

Qin Lang replied lazily: "It was warm."

Xia Xifeng: "..." *Don't tempt me to give you a good pinch for my poor sleeping posture!*

Xia Xifeng tried to pull away from Qin Lang’s embrace, but was held fast. The wiggling only made the sensation inside him more pronounced, so he quickly stopped.

Unfortunately, it was already too late; the soreness deepened.

Just as Qin Lang seemed ready to go for another round, Xia Xifeng pushed against his face with both hands: "You can do whatever you want when we get back, but I can't take it right now!"

Qin Lang buried his face in the crook of Xia Xifeng’s neck, hiding the dissatisfaction in his eyes.

At first, their souls intertwining had been an accident, and he had vowed never again to fall into such a vulnerable state of zero privacy.

He didn't know when it started, but they had become habituated to mingling their souls during intimacy. Although they could choose not to look at each other’s memories, they could flip through them at any moment if they wished. Everything the other was, was laid bare.

Having grown accustomed to this soul-merging, mere physical intimacy was no longer enough for Qin Lang. Even with Xia Xifeng giving him his journals, it wasn't enough.

The more they were physically close, the more he felt the limitation of pure physical pleasure, and the more he grew unsatisfied, wanting nothing more than to knead Xia Xifeng into his own flesh.

If they were in the Dream World, he could truly knead Xia Xifeng into his being—fused from soul to flesh, without a single gap.

When they were apart, he could endure it, but once reunited, he realized his restraint wasn't nearly as strong as he’d imagined.

Qin Lang couldn't help but wonder: in their original world, he had assumed everything was under control, that his rationality was enough to suppress his paranoia.

Could he really suppress it? Could he really tolerate Xia Xifeng leaving, or tolerate Xia Xifeng shifting his special attention to someone else?

Holding Xia Xifeng, Qin Lang was no longer certain.

Perhaps he had only been arrogant, deceiving himself. From the moment he felt a sense of crisis and tried to push Xia Xifeng away, he might have already been beyond saving.

"As long as we're always together, what could you possibly not know about me? You don't need to dig through my memories to know," Xia Xifeng said, tousling the fluffy head at his neck, the corners of his mouth curling up uncontrollably.

Qin Lang usually put on a cold, aloof front, but when he acted spoiled, he was especially cute.

*Can't laugh, mustn't laugh,* he told himself. If he laughed, Qin Lang would get embarrassed and angry, and then he’d never be unintentionally cute again. Qin Lang was just too obsessed with his image, too fond of putting on airs.

Qin Lang nipped gently at Xia Xifeng’s earlobe.

No matter what he was thinking, Xia Xifeng could always see right through him, making him doubt if the intelligence gap between them was even real.

"Can we check the system update now?" Xia Xifeng urged. He hadn't checked it since the update, and it was itching at his mind, making him extremely restless.

"Sigh..." Qin Lang let out a soft sigh, slightly annoyed that Xia Xifeng always ruined the mood. "Aren't you tired?"

Xia Xifeng replied: "I'm tired, but I still have to look. I won't be able to sleep if I don't."

Qin Lang implied meaningfully: "I can make you fall asleep very quickly."

Xia Xifeng tugged on Qin Lang’s hair: "No more! I said no more, so no more!"

With a look of regret, Qin Lang released Xia Xifeng, lying flat on his back beside him so they could examine the system update together.

The original "Comrade-in-Arms" feature had been partially unlocked. They could share inventories, maps, experience, and equipment, and their skills had also been updated.

Qin Lang’s update was simple—it merely increased his combat power, which didn't require much elaboration.

Xia Xifeng, however, gained a "Self-Creation" menu. He could use materials from this world to research and develop items. Once an item was recognized by the system, he could "sacrifice" it to unlock more skills and expand his system inventory slots.

Among the unlocked skills, besides his locked survival skills—like "Faster Sprinting," "Poison Immunity," and "No Fall Damage"—he could now unlock an "Academy Panel."

The Academy Panel was a management sector similar to the Hope City panel, much like a typical simulation game. Xia Xifeng could manage his soon-to-be-built academy from it, adjusting curricula based on the student panels.

One crucial metric in the Academy Panel was "World Influence."

Finally, the system had issued a "Main Quest."

Originally, they had to stay until the world was destroyed to return; now, they could leave as soon as the "World Influence" progress bar was full.

In short, the system functioned just like in the Dream World: Xia Xifeng remained the primary quest-taker, while Qin Lang served as the assistant and bodyguard.

Xia Xifeng didn't think much of it, but Qin Lang tapped on the Academy section: "The system doesn't guess your intentions; it formulates quests based on your actions. There might be another reason for this main quest."

Xia Xifeng: "Hmm."

Qin Lang: "?"

Xia Xifeng: "?"

Qin Lang: "And?"

Xia Xifeng: "Isn't it your turn to say 'and'?"

Qin Lang took a deep breath and said: "I was telling *you* to think."

Xia Xifeng bumped his shoulder against Qin Lang’s: "Too lazy to think. You’ve already thought of the answer, so what’s left for me to think about? Can you use that clever brain of yours for something other than brainless combat satisfaction?"

Qin Lang was so angry he laughed. *You don't want to think, and yet it's my fault?* He just didn't like following plots or dealing with strangers—when had he ever stopped thinking? Wasn't it him managing the massive undertaking of Hope City? Xia Xifeng only focused on research and production!

...Though he did dump everything onto Damon afterward.

Qin Lang felt a flicker of guilt.

Seeing Qin Lang’s sudden expression of guilt, Xia Xifeng understood in a heartbeat and felt a flicker of guilt himself.

*Ah, Damon—truly the best bro a player could have in a newbie village, the 'white moonlight and red mole' of all players—thumbs up!*

The two exchanged a guilty glance and went back to studying the system.

Since Xia Xifeng was too lazy to think, Qin Lang spoke directly.

He speculated that by establishing the academy, popularizing magitech, and leading the world's civilization, Xia Xifeng might truly be having an impact on the Creator of this world.

The moment the World Influence progress bar hit maximum, the hostile Creator would notice them, and the system would be forced to pull them out. Otherwise, the system could have let them stir up trouble for years, creating even larger waves.

Xia Xifeng shared his theory: "Once children grow strong, their parents can no longer easily control their fate." Qin Lang agreed with his logic.

The update to the quest was perhaps the system’s response to their new way of thinking.

"Our goal is to grind the progress bar full before the world is destroyed!" Xia Xifeng realized. "Do you have any idea when the world will end?"

Qin Lang: "A Creator cannot directly attack their own world. They must have planted a 'hidden danger' in the foundational logic of this world that can be triggered at any time. In a world with gods, all rules—including those used to detonate the world—eventually evolve into divine entities."

Qin Lang hadn't asked the Church of Darkness for theological books just to find the divine realm where Xia Xifeng might have landed.

After hearing the Dragon God’s revelation about the world crisis, he’d had this suspicion all along.

The Outer God symbolizing the world’s destruction would surely arrive in the Dream World. As long as they knew the archetype and birth time of that god, they could predict the time of the world's destruction.

Qin Lang: "The Outer God symbolizing world destruction might also be an important weapon for shattering the native rules of the Dream World. Perhaps we can find a way to crack it in this world."

Xia Xifeng praised him: "Your brain is so useful when you actually use it. Why do you insist on just acting without thinking otherwise?"

Qin Lang: "?" *We're having a perfectly good conversation—do you really have to insult me?*

Qin Lang originally wanted to be gentle with Xia Xifeng, but Xia Xifeng simply wouldn't give him the chance.

chunks.chineseText:
秦琅：“哦，我不动脑子不是因为你吗？我怕和你生殖隔离。”

夏兮风没反应过来：“啊？”

秦琅翻身，趁着夏兮风没反应过来，背对着夏兮风睡觉。

夏兮风以为秦琅累了。他正好也累了，便闭上眼。

等他快睡着的时候，猛地睁开眼，狠踹了枕边人一脚：“你骂我笨的和你不是一个物种？！”

“噗……”秦琅故意没忍住笑。

夏兮风气得拧他。

秦琅继续笑：“现在才反应过来，你说你是不是智商低？”

夏兮风把背对着自己的秦琅扒拉过来，狠狠扯秦琅的脸。

屋外，约翰神父和埃德尔男爵已经离开。

原本和夏兮风一起住屋里的光明小兽和黑暗小兽坐在门前，面面相觑。

黑暗小兽：“我们总不能在屋外睡觉吧？”

光明小兽：“唉……”

黑暗小兽：“太过分了！夏兮风是不是完全忘记我们了！”

光明小兽：“嗯。”

黑暗小兽：“别拦着我，我要去砸窗户！”

光明小兽抱住黑暗小兽的尾巴不撒手。

黑暗小兽：“啊啊啊啊气死我了！”

光明小兽：“唉。”

屋内，因为腰酸背疼不敌秦琅，无奈停战继续睡觉的夏兮风在睡着前，又猛地惊醒。

夏兮风：“唉，秦琅，我好像忘记了什么。”

秦琅：“睡觉，明天想。”

夏兮风：“也对，既然想不起来，应该不是什么重要的事。”

他往秦琅肩膀上一靠，安心地睡了。

半夜，外面下起淅淅沥沥的小雨，是最好的催眠白噪音。

呼……呼……呼……

“哐！”

“哗啦！”

夏兮风和秦琅同时被巨大的噪声惊醒。

秦琅一秒换装，从床上翻身跃下。

夏兮风也赶紧换装跟上。

两人到了客厅，看见一只双眼在黑夜中闪烁着诡异光芒的小兽，举着一个巨大的锤子，从屋外使劲砸窗户。

窗户玻璃已经被砸碎。

夏兮风打开屋内魔法灯，黑暗小兽还在砸窗户，光明小兽飞在他身后撑着伞，表情特别可怜。

光明小兽：“下雨了，我想回家睡觉。”

夏兮风：“……”

他想起自己忘记了什么。平时光明小兽和黑暗小兽都在屋里睡觉，他没有在屋外给祂们搭窝！

秦琅看向夏兮风：“你和他们一起睡？”

夏兮风：“啊……嗯……不，等等，你连这个醋都要吃吗？祂们只是毛绒绒！”

黑暗小兽和光明小兽从窗户大洞里钻进来，不管气氛突然紧张的两人，去寻自己的窝睡觉了。

夏兮风是睡不着了。

再腰酸背痛也睡不着了。

他得修窗户，还得安抚某个莫名其妙吃醋的家伙。

那只是毛绒绒而已！

作者有话要说：

一般的醋是不吃的，但那是投影，不是普通毛绒绒。
chunks.englishText:
Qin Lang: "Oh, the reason I don't use my brain isn't because of you? I'm afraid of reproductive isolation."

Xia Xifeng didn't catch it at first: "Huh?"

Qin Lang rolled over, taking advantage of Xia Xifeng's lack of reaction to turn his back and go to sleep.

Xia Xifeng assumed Qin Lang was tired. He happened to be exhausted himself, so he closed his eyes.

Just as he was drifting off to sleep, his eyes snapped open, and he gave the person beside him a fierce kick: "Are you calling me so stupid that I'm not even the same species as you?!"

"Pfft..." Qin Lang intentionally failed to hold back a laugh.

Xia Xifeng was so angry he pinched him.

Qin Lang continued to laugh: "Only just realized it now? Tell me, isn't your IQ a bit low?"

Xia Xifeng yanked the back-turned Qin Lang around and pulled hard on his face.

Outside the house, Father John and Baron Edel had already departed.

The Light Beast and Dark Beast, who usually lived in the room with Xia Xifeng, sat in front of the door, looking at each other.

Dark Beast: "We can't just sleep outside, can we?"

Light Beast: "Sigh..."

Dark Beast: "This is too much! Has Xia Xifeng completely forgotten about us?!"

Light Beast: "Mm."

Dark Beast: "Don't stop me, I'm going to smash the window!"

The Light Beast grabbed the Dark Beast's tail and wouldn't let go.

Dark Beast: "Ahhhhh, I'm so mad!"

Light Beast: "Sigh."

Inside, Xia Xifeng, who had been forced to call a truce and go back to sleep because his aching back and waist were no match for Qin Lang, suddenly jolted awake again just as he was about to doze off.

Xia Xifeng: "Sigh, Qin Lang, I think I forgot something."

Qin Lang: "Go to sleep, think about it tomorrow."

Xia Xifeng: "That's true. If I can't remember it, it probably isn't anything important."

He leaned against Qin Lang's shoulder and fell asleep peacefully.

In the middle of the night, a light, drizzling rain began to fall outside—the perfect hypnotic white noise.

*Whoosh... whoosh... whoosh...*

*CRASH!*

*CLATTER!*

Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang were both jolted awake by the deafening noise.

Qin Lang changed into his gear in a second and vaulted off the bed.

Xia Xifeng hurriedly did the same and followed.

When the two reached the living room, they saw a small beast with eyes glowing with an eerie light in the darkness, wielding a massive hammer and smashing away at the window from outside.

The window glass had already been shattered.

Xia Xifeng turned on the indoor magic lamp. The Dark Beast was still hammering at the window, while the Light Beast hovered behind it, holding an umbrella with a pitiful expression.

Light Beast: "It's raining, I want to go home and sleep."

Xia Xifeng: "..."

He remembered what he had forgotten. Usually, the Light Beast and Dark Beast slept inside the room; he hadn't built them a nest outside!

Qin Lang looked at Xia Xifeng: "You sleep with them?"

Xia Xifeng: "Ah... um... no, wait, are you really jealous of this too? They're just fluffy creatures!"

The Dark Beast and Light Beast crawled through the large hole in the window, ignoring the suddenly tense atmosphere between the two men, and went off to find their beds.

Xia Xifeng couldn't sleep anymore.

No matter how much his back and waist ached, he couldn't fall back asleep.

He had to fix the window, and he had to appease a certain someone who was inexplicably jealous.

They were just fluffy creatures, for heaven's sake!

Author's note:
He doesn't usually get jealous, but those are projections, not just ordinary fluffy creatures.

chunks.chineseText:
第125章 一更

第二天，夏兮风在秦琅的威胁下，先把房子扩建了。

他一边嘀咕着“那只是毛绒绒”，一边呼哧呼哧地盖房子。

光明小兽在一旁欲言又止。黑暗小兽高兴地在半空中飞着翻跟头，说了一大堆要求。

夏兮风好脾气地“嗯嗯啊啊”，能完成的都完成了，完不成的先记着，以后给屋子升级。

光明小兽犹豫了一下，也飞到夏兮风面前提要求。

黑暗神都提要求了，身为光明神不提点要求，好像这间屋子就变成黑暗神殿，自己成寄住的了。

秦琅抱着手臂旁观。

他除了旁观也做不了其他事，但夏兮风还是生气了，让秦琅滚出去刷怪，自己好吃经验。

正好埃德尔男爵和约翰神父一大早就来了，秦琅自我介绍后，就询问他们俩附近哪里有怪兽巢穴，或者强盗窝点也行。

埃德尔男爵惊讶：“你俩居然能一大早就起床？”

秦琅：“……”

埃德尔男爵干咳了两声：“刚回来就要离开吗？不在家里休息几天？”

正在改造房子的夏兮风凑上来：“休息什么？我都在干活，他不准休息，赶紧给我刷怪去！”

埃德尔男爵心道，难道是情侣生活不和谐，惹夏兮风生气了？

他怜悯地拍了拍秦琅的肩膀：“我正好要带兵去山里剿灭怪兽，开辟新的商道。你跟着我去。就是路途有点远，可能需要个几天。夏，刚见面就分别，你不会伤心？”

夏兮风疑惑：“晚上就能回来，伤什么心？”

埃德尔男爵：“晚上？”

金角马悠悠哉哉地路过。夏兮风顺手拿起一根萝卜递到金角马嘴里。

约翰神父：“金角马不吃萝卜，只吃拥有光明气息的香草。”

他话音未落，金角马就张开嘴把萝卜嘎吱嘎吱啃了，并用脑袋蹭了蹭夏兮风，还想再吃一根。

约翰神父：“……”金角马什么时候这么好养了？

别说约翰神父，光明小兽都很惊讶。

夏兮风拿出一堆自己收获的蔬菜，金角马全都能吃。

吃饱之后，它还露出很遗憾的神情，似乎垂涎得很。

约翰神父不敢置信。这些蔬菜他也吃过，和普通的蔬菜没区别啊。

“乖宝宝，辛苦你了。等传送卷轴做出来，你就不会太累了。”夏兮风胡噜胡噜金角马的耳朵。

金角马享受地低头让夏兮风胡噜。

约翰神父怀疑这不是真正的金角马，伸手也去摸金角马的耳朵。

金角马=皿=！！

约翰神父迅速缩回差点被咬的手。

夏兮风无奈道：“别学我啊，我对家里的动物有特殊的亲和力。”

系统更新后，他就冒出了一大堆生活技能，别说寻常的种地挖矿钓鱼，什么走路吃饭抚摸动物都有经验和技能条。

他在梦世界好不容易肝满了所有技能条，现在又得重肝。

开了新地图就要开新号吗？这是游戏必须重开新档的DLC吗？悟了悟了。

约翰神父做出祈祷的手势：“不愧是我主的恩赐者。”

光明小兽轻轻摇头。我不是，我没有，不是我的。

黑暗小兽可不管什么恩赐不恩赐，催促夏兮风赶紧给祂布置房子。

埃德尔男爵和约翰神父本来是来试探秦琅，没想到秦琅被夏兮风扫地出门。

埃德尔男爵观察秦琅。嗯，表情很平静，脾气很好，一点都不危险的样子。

难道昨天是错觉？

埃德尔男爵带兵开辟商道，路上会花费不少的时间。秦琅本想让埃德尔男爵帮他标注地图，他自己去。但见到埃德尔男爵表面上很热情，内心对他有警惕，秦琅便懒得多言了。

他什么都没带。埃德尔男爵以为他要和自己一起吃饭。

谁知道到了饭点，秦琅便从空间背包里拿出热腾腾的饭菜，三荤两素一汤，还有饭后水果和甜点，看上去仿佛是刚做的。

秦琅：“一起吃吗？”

埃德尔男爵震惊：“你还在储物魔导器里放饭菜？”

秦琅：“嗯。”虽然他确实偶尔会放，但这次不是。这是夏兮风刚做好的。

夏兮风做完饭就塞进背包，秦琅立刻拿出来。等秦琅吃完，就把脏盘子塞回去，夏兮风洗碗。

【夏兮风：你就不能给我洗了再塞回来吗！】

【秦琅：没热水没洗涤剂。回来洗。】

两人又可以私聊了。一路上夏兮风啰嗦个没完，秦琅偶尔应个单音节敷衍一下。

如果是梦世界的同伴，一看就知道秦琅在和夏兮风聊天。这里还没有便携式远程联络魔导器，埃德尔只以为秦琅在走神。

他很好奇秦琅在思索什么，绞尽脑汁套秦琅的话。

秦琅一边用单音节应付夏兮风，一边用单音节应付埃德尔，完全不掩饰自己的敷衍。

埃德尔男爵很是无奈。不过他也松了口气。虽然秦琅不爱和人交流，但聊天都很礼貌地回了，是个很正常的孤僻的人，不像坏人。果然他之前感受到的危险是错觉吗？

就当埃德尔男爵这么想的时候，他们来到了怪物巢穴。

秦琅扫了一眼地图上的红点，让埃德尔男爵先驻扎在外围，他进去看看。

埃德尔男爵正好想看看秦琅的本事，便同意了。不过他要求和秦琅一同前去查探，两个人好互相照应。

秦琅：“好，但请男爵不要动手。”

“叫什么男爵？太生疏了，和夏一样叫我一声埃德尔叔叔。”埃德尔男爵爽朗道，“行，让我看看你的本事。”

秦琅对称呼不在意，说改口就改口，半点不推辞。

埃德尔男爵对秦琅的好感又多了几分。之前果然是错……错……嗯？

埃德尔男爵看着面前堆积如山的怪兽尸体，眼珠子都快瞪出来。

这么快就杀光了？杀就杀，你怎么还堆起来了？！

秦琅问道：“埃德尔叔叔，你需要怪兽素材吗？”

埃德尔男爵：“啊……需要……”

秦琅：“五五分如何？”

埃德尔男爵懵懵道：“你杀的，不用……”

秦琅：“我分给你们一半，你们别出手，帮我聚怪。”

埃德尔男爵擦了擦眼睛：“你……是不是比之前强大了一点？”

他好歹也是个隐居的传说剑士，一眼就看出秦琅的实力增长。

秦琅点头：“我需要战斗经验。”

埃德尔男爵为了进一步观察秦琅，同意了秦琅的请求。

很快，他的心情就和已经回到黑暗神殿的黑暗骑士罗兰一样了。

他见到秦琅越杀越强，好像能从杀戮中夺取力量，仿佛天生为杀戮而生的怪物。

这样可怕的杀戮，秦琅会不会被杀戮蒙蔽了内心理智，真的变成只会杀戮的怪物？

秦琅停下了刷怪。他让埃德尔男爵带人来分怪物尸体。

埃德尔男爵见秦琅把怪物尸体都塞进了储物魔导器，再次震惊：“你的储物魔导器到底有多大？”

秦琅：“不太大。我的储物魔导器的空间和夏兮风共通，我送回农场了。”

埃德尔男爵：“？？？”还有这么神奇的储物魔导器吗？

秦琅：“是神送的。”
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 125: First Update

The next day, under the threat of Qin Lang, Xia Xifeng first expanded the house.

He muttered, "It’s just fluffy," while huffing and puffing as he built the house.

The little Light Beast stood to the side, looking like it wanted to say something but holding back. The little Dark Beast was happily doing somersaults in mid-air, rattling off a long list of demands.

Xia Xifeng replied with good-natured "uh-huhs" and "yeps," fulfilling what he could and making a mental note of the rest to upgrade the house later.

The little Light Beast hesitated for a moment before flying in front of Xia Xifeng to make its own requests.

Since the Dark God had made demands, if the Light God didn't ask for anything, it would seem as if this house had become a Dark Temple and it was merely a guest.

Qin Lang stood with his arms crossed, watching from the sidelines.

There was nothing else he could do besides watch, but Xia Xifeng still got annoyed and told Qin Lang to get out and grind monsters so he could gain experience.

As it happened, Baron Edel and Father John arrived early in the morning. After Qin Lang introduced himself, he asked them where the nearest monster nests or bandit dens were.

Baron Edel was surprised: "You two are actually awake this early?"

Qin Lang: "..."

Baron Edel coughed twice: "Leaving as soon as you've returned? Not staying home to rest for a few days?"

Xia Xifeng, who was in the middle of renovating the house, chimed in: "Rest for what? I’m here doing all the work, and he’s not allowed to rest! Go on, get out there and grind monsters for me!"

Baron Edel thought to himself, *Could it be that their life as a couple is disharmonious, and he’s angry at Qin Lang?*

He patted Qin Lang on the shoulder with pity: "I happen to be taking troops into the mountains to clear out monsters and open up a new trade route. You can come with me. It’s a bit of a long journey, might take a few days. Xia, won't you be sad to part just after meeting?"

Xia Xifeng was puzzled: "I can come back at night, why would I be sad?"

Baron Edel: "At night?"

A Golden-Horned Horse wandered by leisurely. Xia Xifeng casually picked up a radish and fed it to the horse.

Father John: "Golden-Horned Horses don't eat radishes; they only eat herbs infused with the aura of light."

Before he could finish his sentence, the Golden-Horned Horse opened its mouth and crunched the radish, then rubbed its head against Xia Xifeng, clearly wanting another one.

Father John: "..." *Since when were Golden-Horned Horses so easy to feed?*

Not to mention Father John, even the little Light Beast was astonished.

Xia Xifeng took out a pile of vegetables he had harvested, and the Golden-Horned Horse ate them all.

After it was full, it even looked regretful, as if it were still craving more.

Father John couldn't believe it. He had eaten these vegetables too, and they were no different from ordinary ones.

"Good baby, you've worked hard. Once the teleportation scroll is made, you won't be so tired." Xia Xifeng stroked the Golden-Horned Horse's ears.

The horse lowered its head contentedly, letting Xia Xifeng pet it.

Father John suspected this wasn't a real Golden-Horned Horse, so he reached out to touch its ears too.

Golden-Horned Horse =皿=!!

Father John quickly retracted his hand, which had nearly been bitten off.

Xia Xifeng said helplessly: "Don't copy me. I have a special affinity for the animals at home."

After the system update, a bunch of life skills had popped up. Not to mention ordinary farming, mining, and fishing, even walking, eating, and petting animals now had experience bars and skill levels.

He had finally maxed out all his skill bars in the Dream World, and now he had to grind them all over again.

*Does opening a new map mean I have to start a new character? Is this a DLC where the game forces you to start a new save file? I get it now, I get it.*

Father John made a prayer gesture: "As expected of the blessed one of my Lord."

The little Light Beast shook its head gently. *I am not, I did not, that is not mine.*

The little Dark Beast didn't care about blessings; it just urged Xia Xifeng to hurry up and decorate its house.

Baron Edel and Father John had originally come to test Qin Lang, never expecting him to be kicked out of the house by Xia Xifeng.

Baron Edel observed Qin Lang. *Hmm, expression is very calm, temperament is very good, doesn't look dangerous at all.*

*Was yesterday just an illusion?*

Baron Edel led his troops to open the trade route, which would take a lot of time on the road. Qin Lang had wanted to ask the Baron to mark the map so he could go alone, but seeing that the Baron was superficially enthusiastic while inwardly wary, Qin Lang couldn't be bothered to say much.

He didn't bring anything. Baron Edel assumed he would be eating with them.

Who knew that when mealtime arrived, Qin Lang would take hot, steaming food out of his spatial backpack—three meat dishes, two vegetable dishes, a soup, plus fruit and dessert for after the meal, all looking as if they had just been cooked.

Qin Lang: "Want to eat together?"

Baron Edel was shocked: "You keep meals in your spatial magic storage?"

Qin Lang: "Yeah." Although he did occasionally store food, this time wasn't one of those. This was just cooked by Xia Xifeng.

Xia Xifeng would cook, stuff it into the backpack, and Qin Lang would immediately take it out. Once Qin Lang finished eating, he would stuff the dirty dishes back in, and Xia Xifeng would wash them.

[Xia Xifeng: Can't you wash them for me before stuffing them back in!]

[Qin Lang: No hot water, no detergent. I'll wash them when I get back.]

The two could private message again. Along the way, Xia Xifeng chattered endlessly, and Qin Lang occasionally responded with a monosyllable to brush him off.

If they were companions from the Dream World, they would know at a glance that Qin Lang was chatting with Xia Xifeng. Here, there were no portable long-distance communication magic devices, so Edel just thought Qin Lang was distracted.

He was very curious about what Qin Lang was pondering and racked his brain to fish for information.

Qin Lang responded to Xia Xifeng with monosyllables while doing the same to Edel, not bothering to hide his perfunctoriness.

Baron Edel was very helpless. However, he was also relieved. Although Qin Lang didn't like to communicate, he replied politely to every chat; he was just a normal, reclusive person, not a bad guy. *Was the danger I felt before really just an illusion?*

Just as Baron Edel was thinking this, they arrived at the monster nest.

Qin Lang glanced at the red dots on the map and asked Baron Edel to station his men on the perimeter while he went in to take a look.

Baron Edel happened to want to see Qin Lang's skills, so he agreed. However, he requested to go in with Qin Lang to investigate so they could look out for each other.

Qin Lang: "Fine, but please don't intervene, Baron."

"What Baron? Too distant. Call me Uncle Edel, just like Xia does," Baron Edel said heartily. "Alright, let me see what you can do."

Qin Lang didn't care about the address; he changed it as requested without the slightest hesitation.

Baron Edel's favor for Qin Lang increased a bit more. *It really was an illu... illu... hmm?*

Baron Edel looked at the mountain of monster corpses in front of him, his eyes nearly popping out of their sockets.

*Killed them all so fast? And fine, you killed them, but why did you stack them up?!*

Qin Lang asked: "Uncle Edel, do you need monster materials?"

Baron Edel: "Ah... yes, I do..."

Qin Lang: "How about a fifty-fifty split?"

Baron Edel said dazedly: "You killed them, no need..."

Qin Lang: "I'll give you half. Just don't intervene, and help me gather the monsters."

Baron Edel wiped his eyes: "Are you... a bit stronger than before?"

He was, after all, a reclusive legendary swordsman; he could see at a glance that Qin Lang's strength had grown.

Qin Lang nodded: "I need combat experience."

To further observe Qin Lang, Baron Edel agreed to his request.

Soon, his mood became the same as Roland, the Dark Knight who had already returned to the Dark Temple.

He saw Qin Lang getting stronger the more he killed, as if he could seize power from the slaughter, like a monster born for killing.

*With such terrifying slaughter, will Qin Lang be blinded by the killing and truly become a monster that only knows how to kill?*

Qin Lang stopped grinding. He asked Baron Edel to bring his men to divide the monster corpses.

Seeing Qin Lang stuff all the monster corpses into his spatial magic storage, Baron Edel was shocked again: "Just how big is your spatial magic storage?"

Qin Lang: "Not too big. My storage space is shared with Xia Xifeng's; I sent them back to the farm."

Baron Edel: "???" *Is there such a magical storage device?*

Qin Lang: "It was a gift from a god."

chunks.chineseText:
埃德尔男爵了然。神器啊，那怪不得了。

秦琅看了一眼天色：“今天就刷到这。我先回去了，明天再来。”

埃德尔男爵：“回？”

秦琅给了埃德尔男爵一个卷轴：“这是定位卷轴。明天你出发的时候把卷轴打开，我就会传送过来。金角马你帮我喂着。”

说完，秦琅撕开另一个卷轴，消失在埃德尔男爵眼前。

埃德尔男爵：“？”怎么回事？人呢？传送魔法？但传送魔法怎么可能只需要一个魔法卷轴？？

秦琅回到了农场，夏兮风正在熬怪物大骨头汤。

今天得到了许多不同怪物鲜肉，夏兮风准备涮火锅。

“去洗澡，一身血腥气，臭死了。”夏兮风嫌弃道。

秦琅换了衣服，帮夏兮风端碗。

光明小兽和黑暗小兽正在用小爪子练习筷子。他们对秦琅的突然出现一点也不惊讶。

被邀请来吃火锅的约翰神父很惊讶。

他白天见到夏兮风不断把新鲜的怪物尸体从储物魔导器里拖出来，就够惊讶了。这还能用神赐予的奇迹来解释。

之后夏兮风突然叫了一声“经验够了，升级！”，然后就埋头画了几个有空间气息的卷轴。传、传送卷轴？传送魔法阵只用魔法卷轴就能启动？！

秦琅用传送卷轴传送回来吃晚饭，第二天又用传送卷轴传回去继续刷怪。

约翰神父的慈祥表情都崩裂了。

光明神殿和黑暗神殿都有传送阵。传送阵要用大量魔晶石，并且至少两位传说魔法师才能启动。只有在百年光暗战争的时候，魔法阵才会开启。

而秦琅，他用传送卷轴早出晚归。

甚至到了出门的第三天，秦琅还会回来吃午饭，睡午觉。

约翰神父从来没见过这么廉价的传送卷轴。

夏兮风安慰世界观快崩了的约翰神父：“这个传送卷轴是特殊的，只有我和秦琅能用。”

约翰神父松了口气：“原来如此。”

夏兮风道：“等我再升几级，才会制作普适性的传送卷轴，到时候我教你！别馋了，你也能有！”

约翰神父：“……”

夏兮风感慨：“这个世界的空间壁障很薄弱，比梦……其他世界更好传送。虽然传送魔法阵还是需要很多能量，但传送战士、魔法师还是能每天启动一次吧。稍微大的城市也用得起。”

要致富，先修路。这个世界能普及重要城市之间的传送魔法阵，还怕发展不起来？

光明神和黑暗神高坐在神座之上，都若有所思。

黑暗神当即划开空间，来到了光明神的神座前：“他们究竟是什么来历？我俩都不会传说战士和魔法师就能用的便携传送魔法。”

光明神沉默了一会儿，竖起食指，放在嘴唇前：“我想，最好不要问，不要追根溯源。”

黑暗神道：“你相信他们？”

光明神反问道：“你呢？”

两位神灵沉默了良久。黑暗神最先开口：“他们没有坦白，也没有对我们隐瞒。他们应该来自世界之外，但并不是超脱者。”

光明神望向遥远的虚空。

随着夏兮风的气息增强，与世界规则融合越来越深，光明神已经窥见了些许真相。

祂从夏兮风的气息中，窥见了自己的疯狂和破灭。

“我相信他。”光明神道。

黑暗神嘴角扯了扯：“行，你都相信他，我也敢。”

祂闭上双眼，神情悲恸。

祂从秦琅日益强大的气息中，也窥见了自己的破灭。

祂曾经以为，秦琅是自己的继任者，但似乎不是呢。

农场里，夏兮风高喊：“来吃火锅了！”

光明小兽和黑暗小兽回过神，朝着夏兮风飞去，被夏兮风抱在怀里蹭了蹭。

黑暗神回到了祂的神座。

光明神闭上了双眼。

两位神灵在神座上沉睡，将更多的意识投入了投影中。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 125: First Update (Part 2)

Baron Edel understood. *A divine artifact, no wonder.*

Qin Lang glanced at the sky: "That's it for today's grinding. I'm heading back, I'll come again tomorrow."

Baron Edel: "Back?"

Qin Lang gave Baron Edel a scroll: "This is a positioning scroll. When you set off tomorrow, open it, and I will teleport over. Please help me feed the Golden-Horned Horse."

After saying this, Qin Lang tore open another scroll and disappeared before Baron Edel's eyes.

Baron Edel: "?" *What's going on? Where is he? Teleportation magic? But how can teleportation magic only require a magic scroll??*

Qin Lang returned to the farm, where Xia Xifeng was simmering a pot of monster bone soup.

They had received a lot of fresh monster meat today, and Xia Xifeng was preparing to have hotpot.

"Go take a shower, you reek of blood, it's disgusting," Xia Xifeng said with disdain.

Qin Lang changed his clothes and helped Xia Xifeng carry the bowls.

The little Light Beast and the little Dark Beast were practicing using chopsticks with their tiny claws. They weren't surprised at all by Qin Lang's sudden appearance.

Father John, who had been invited to eat hotpot, was very surprised.

He had been surprised enough during the day seeing Xia Xifeng constantly pulling fresh monster corpses out of his spatial storage. That could be explained by the miracles granted by the gods.

Then, Xia Xifeng suddenly shouted, "Experience is enough, level up!", and then buried his head in drawing a few scrolls with a spatial aura. *Teleportation... teleportation scrolls? Teleportation magic arrays can be activated with just a magic scroll?!*

Qin Lang used a teleportation scroll to come back for dinner, and the next day used another to teleport back to continue grinding monsters.

Father John's benevolent expression crumbled.

Both the Light Temple and the Dark Temple had teleportation arrays. Teleportation arrays required a massive amount of magic crystals and at least two legendary mages to activate. They were only opened during the century-long Light-Dark War.

And Qin Lang, he used teleportation scrolls to leave early and return late.

By the third day of going out, Qin Lang even came back for lunch and a nap.

Father John had never seen such cheap teleportation scrolls.

Xia Xifeng comforted Father John, whose worldview was collapsing: "This teleportation scroll is special; only Qin Lang and I can use it."

Father John breathed a sigh of relief: "So that's how it is."

Xia Xifeng said: "Once I level up a few more times, I'll be able to make universal teleportation scrolls. I'll teach you then! Don't be envious, you can have them too!"

Father John: "..."

Xia Xifeng sighed: "The spatial barrier of this world is very weak, easier to teleport through than the Dream... other worlds. Although teleportation magic arrays still require a lot of energy, teleporting warriors and mages once a day should be possible. Even moderately sized cities can afford it."

*If you want to get rich, build roads first.* If this world could popularize teleportation magic arrays between important cities, would it still worry about not developing?

The Light God and the Dark God sat high on their thrones, both lost in thought.

The Dark God immediately tore through space and arrived before the Light God's throne: "What is their origin? Neither of us can create portable teleportation magic that legendary warriors and mages can use."

The Light God was silent for a while, then raised a finger to his lips: "I think it is best not to ask, not to trace the source."

The Dark God said: "Do you trust them?"

The Light God countered: "And you?"

The two gods were silent for a long time. The Dark God spoke first: "They have not been honest with us, but they have not hidden anything either. They likely come from outside the world, but they are not transcendents."

The Light God looked toward the distant void.

As Xia Xifeng's aura grew stronger and merged deeper with the world's rules, the Light God had caught a glimpse of the truth.

From Xia Xifeng's aura, he caught a glimpse of his own madness and destruction.

"I trust him," the Light God said.

The Dark God curled his lip: "Fine, if you trust him, I dare to as well."

He closed his eyes, his expression sorrowful.

From Qin Lang's increasingly powerful aura, he also caught a glimpse of his own destruction.

He had once thought Qin Lang was his successor, but it seemed he was not.

On the farm, Xia Xifeng shouted: "Come eat hotpot!"

The little Light Beast and the little Dark Beast snapped out of their thoughts and flew toward Xia Xifeng, rubbing against him as he held them.

The Dark God returned to his throne.

The Light God closed his eyes.

The two gods fell asleep on their thrones, projecting more of their consciousness into their avatars.

chunks.chineseText:
第126章 一章半合一

和秦琅会合后，夏兮风的日子就过得轻松不少。

众所周知，种田游戏全靠自己敲石头砍木头会肝得吐血，这时候你想养肝，不是去投靠风灵月影宗门或者CE宗门，就是去寻一个游戏好友联机。

在能打怪的种田游戏中，前期刷怪经验往往比种地做东西高许多，当解锁批量制作的时候才会反超。

每天一大早，夏兮风喂饱秦琅后，就把秦琅一脚踹出门“打猎”，收获一大堆材料和经验。

有秦琅刷经验，夏兮风就不用每天把生活技能全部练一遍了。等人物等级上升，他自由分配技能点就成。

种地暂时够用就好，夏兮风先决定把逃命技能点高。

走路技能点高了能跑得跟瞬移似的，攀爬技能点高了不仅攀爬高处如履平地还能减免掉落伤害，游泳技能点高了在任何液体里都不需要呼吸……还有什么抗毒的，抗着抗着就全异常免疫。

光明小兽和黑暗小兽看着夏兮风体内的规则一天比一天完善，明明还是凡人，居然变得跟神灵似的，都瞠目结舌。

祂们总算知道为什么夏兮风走路吃饭甚至睡觉都算“练技能”。他明明是通过所有日常行为，将自身和此世规则融合，让此世规则认可他为世界土生土长的子民。

看上去夏兮风在“练技能”，实际上世界只是将规则告知夏兮风，相当于给夏兮风一个不会回答疑问的随身老师，让夏兮风自学。夏兮风恐怖的创造能力都是自己练。

夏兮风如此，秦琅肯定也一样。

两位神灵的心安定下来。

黑暗小兽凑光明小兽耳边说悄悄话：“死在他们这样的天之骄子手中，我俩也不亏了。”

光明小兽无语地看了黑暗小兽一眼。虽然祂自己也很豁达，但黑暗神这已经不能叫豁达，该叫没心没肺了。

不用花时间在刷经验上，夏兮风就能空出时间写教材了。

秦琅白天刷怪，晚上帮夏兮风审稿。

夏兮风教人还是有点天赋的，写出来的教材像模像样。秦琅帮他审过之后，交给光明小兽和黑暗小兽再审一次。两位神灵说可以了，他们再给约翰神父和埃德尔男爵看。

黑暗小兽又不高兴了。

“我不管！凭什么我们魔族要落后你们人族！”黑暗小兽咬住光明小兽的耳朵。

光明小兽头顶着一只咬头黑暗小兽联系光明教皇，讨论怎么让魔族偷渡进光明圣地。

约翰神父这才知道，这只呆呆的白色小兽是光明神投影。

他正在信仰崩溃时，猜到那只癫癫的黑色小兽是黑暗神投影，瞬间信仰就巩固了。

有对比就有幸福。不管怎么说，至少咱神比黑暗神好啊。

“对神灵的信仰和神灵的人格有什么关系？”夏兮风嘴欠，“我们那旮旯神灵的神眷者都看不起神灵的人格！”

约翰神父：“？？？”

埃德尔男爵捧着自己的络腮胡子大脸：“怎么可能！”

光明小兽想起曾经见过的外神，道：“确实有可能。”

黑暗小兽也想起那个问祂睡不睡的外神，道：“被看不起是祂活该。”

夏兮风也想起光明神和黑暗神认识龙神，觉得很丢脸。

被光明神和黑暗神嫌弃的种龙神是他师祖，是他亲亲师父的亲爹。

老师死活不肯说自己的出身，一定是因为很嫌弃龙神。

约翰神父和埃德尔男爵深受打击。

怎么可能？神灵怎么能被凡人嫌弃？

夏兮风道：“你们都是有资格成神的，难道没人嫌弃过你们的性格？”

约翰神父和埃德尔男爵沉思后恍然。他们居然没有想过这件事！

见两人呆愣，夏兮风疑惑道：“说来你们世界的历史也不短了，应该有凡人成神了吧？为什么你们会这么惊讶？”

梦世界智慧生灵诞生后的神灵虽然也是概念神，但很多神灵都是凡人点燃神火再凝聚神格，比如各个种族的“祖神”，以及各种技艺的概念神，比如锻造之神。

梦世界的超脱者龙神其实也算凡“人”登神。看祂的神名就知道了，祂超脱之后归还神格神位，自身的“概念”就只是“巨龙”这个种族而已。

一般世界刚创造的时候“概念”都很少，随着生灵族群发展，概念越来越多，神灵也越来越多。这个世界应该有很多后来神才是。

“哐当”一声，正在旁边看神学书偷懒的秦琅猛地站起来，椅子往后倒下。

夏兮风扭头看秦琅，速度过快，捂着脖子惨叫。

秦琅：“……”

他只好先去给夏兮风按摩脖子。

夏兮风偏着脖子：“嘶……你干什么呢？”

秦琅不想说话。

他找了许久世界毁灭的线索，看了那么多神学书，和真相一直隔着一层雾。夏兮风什么都没想，随口一句话，就把那层雾给破了。

从童年时开始，秦琅千思百虑时常抵不过夏兮风灵机一动，让秦琅时常思索，自己的智商是不是假的。

他长大后，知道了脑子跳脱和智商无关，但有时候还是会为自己千辛万苦找解决方法，而夏兮风灵机一动直接解决而挫败。

这时候，他往往会给夏兮风出一道数学题，听夏兮风大喊“我不会！”。

夏兮风多了解秦琅啊。他看秦琅那臭臭的表情，就知道秦琅又在“求解”的时候被自己口瓢截胡了。

夏兮风无奈道：“我说过好多次了，你的郁闷毫无道理。你是从我的话里得到了灵感，不是我给出了答案好吗？你看现在我一头雾水，你不说，我都不知道你得出了什么答案。”

秦琅沉默地为夏兮风按捏脖子。

夏兮风翻白眼。

秦琅在他面前特别小气。理是这个理，气还是要气。明明对外人就不这样。

唉，秦琅有时候那莫名其妙的胜负欲啊。

黑暗小兽往秦琅脸上飞，被秦琅单手挡住：“你想到什么了？”

秦琅：“没什么。”

黑暗小兽还想问，光明小兽拉了一下黑暗小兽的尾巴。

黑暗小兽焦急地闭上嘴。

约翰神父和埃德尔男爵还在状态外，夏兮风已经转移话题，说起学院招生的事。

既然魔族能偷渡来，那魔族改头换面进来当学生也是可以的嘛。到时候魔界那边再建立一个学院，人类这边也可以去增长见识。

魔族和人族如果不突破传说，寿命都在一百岁以内。百年一次两边神灵故意放水的光暗大战，没有给两族造成不可调解的血海深仇。如果不是光和暗必须对立，光暗元素无法相融，必有此消彼长，两族根本可以没仇。

光明神和黑暗神都认为可行，光明教皇和黑暗教皇视频（魔晶石投影）开会，焦头烂额。

从光暗大战变成勇者斗魔王开始，双方教皇就时常偷偷碰面。自家神灵突发奇想一张嘴，两位教皇就带着教会高层跑断腿。普通的民众不知道，如果要论“通敌”，两边教皇第一个被砍头。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 126: One and a Half Chapters Combined (Part 1)

After reuniting with Qin Lang, Xia Xifeng's life became much easier.

It is well known that in farming games, relying solely on yourself to mine stones and chop wood will make you grind until you cough up blood. At this point, if you want to "save your liver," you either join the "Feng Ling Yue Ying" sect or the "CE" sect, or you find a game friend to play in co-op.

In farming games where you can fight monsters, the experience from grinding monsters in the early stages is often much higher than farming or crafting, only being surpassed once mass production is unlocked.

Every morning, after feeding Qin Lang, Xia Xifeng would kick him out the door to "hunt," reaping a pile of materials and experience.

With Qin Lang grinding for experience, Xia Xifeng didn't have to practice all his life skills every day. Once his character level rose, he could just distribute his skill points freely.

Farming was enough for now, so Xia Xifeng decided to prioritize his survival skills.

With high walking skills, he could run like a teleport; with high climbing skills, he could traverse heights as if walking on flat ground and reduce fall damage; with high swimming skills, he didn't need to breathe in any liquid... and then there were poison resistance skills—after resisting enough, he would eventually become immune to all status ailments.

The little Light Beast and the little Dark Beast watched as the rules within Xia Xifeng became more complete day by day. Even though he was still a mortal, he was becoming like a god, and they were both stunned.

They finally understood why Xia Xifeng's walking, eating, and even sleeping counted as "practicing skills." He was clearly using all his daily activities to merge himself with the rules of this world, making the world's rules recognize him as a native-born citizen.

It looked like Xia Xifeng was "practicing skills," but in reality, the world was just informing Xia Xifeng of its rules, acting like a personal tutor that wouldn't answer questions, letting Xia Xifeng teach himself. Xia Xifeng's terrifying creative ability was all self-taught.

If Xia Xifeng was like this, Qin Lang must be the same.

The two gods' hearts finally settled.

The little Dark Beast whispered into the little Light Beast's ear: "Dying at the hands of such heaven-favored geniuses, we wouldn't be losing out."

The little Light Beast looked at the little Dark Beast speechlessly. Although it was also open-minded, the Dark God's attitude couldn't be called open-minded; it should be called heartless.

Without having to spend time grinding experience, Xia Xifeng had time to write textbooks.

Qin Lang would grind monsters during the day and help Xia Xifeng proofread at night.

Xia Xifeng actually had some talent for teaching, and the textbooks he wrote were quite decent. After Qin Lang reviewed them, they were handed to the little Light Beast and the little Dark Beast for another review. Once the two gods said they were fine, they were shown to Father John and Baron Edel.

The little Dark Beast was unhappy again.

"I don't care! Why should our Demon race fall behind your Human race!" The little Dark Beast bit the little Light Beast's ear.

The little Light Beast, with the little Dark Beast biting its head, contacted the Light Pope to discuss how to let the Demon race sneak into the Light Holy Land.

Only then did Father John realize that this dazed white little beast was a projection of the Light God.

He had been in the midst of a crisis of faith, but upon guessing that the crazy black little beast was a projection of the Dark God, his faith was instantly solidified.

*Happiness comes from comparison. No matter what, at least our god is better than the Dark God.*

"What does faith in a god have to do with the god's personality?" Xia Xifeng said cheekily. "Where we come from, the believers of the gods look down on the gods' personalities!"

Father John: "???"

Baron Edel held his bearded face: "How is that possible!"

The little Light Beast remembered the outer gods it had seen before and said: "It is indeed possible."

The little Dark Beast also remembered the outer god who had asked if it wanted to sleep, and said: "It deserves to be looked down upon."

Xia Xifeng also remembered that the Light God and the Dark God knew the Dragon God and felt it was very embarrassing.

The Dragon God, who was looked down upon by the Light God and the Dark God, was his grand-teacher, the biological father of his dear teacher.

His teacher refused to talk about his origins, surely because he looked down on the Dragon God.

Father John and Baron Edel were deeply shaken.

*How could this be? How could a god be looked down upon by mortals?*

Xia Xifeng said: "You are all qualified to become gods; has no one ever looked down on your personalities?"

Father John and Baron Edel pondered and suddenly realized. *They had never even thought about this!*

Seeing them stunned, Xia Xifeng asked suspiciously: "Come to think of it, your world's history isn't short; there should have been mortals who became gods, right? Why are you so surprised?"

Although the gods born after the birth of intelligent life in the Dream World were also conceptual gods, many were mortals who ignited their divine fire and condensed their godhood, such as the "ancestor gods" of various races and conceptual gods of various crafts, like the God of Forging.

The Dragon God, a transcendent of the Dream World, could also be considered a mortal who ascended to godhood. You could tell from his divine name; after he transcended, he returned his godhood and divine position, and his own "concept" was just the race of "Dragons."

Generally, when a world is first created, there are very few "concepts," but as the races develop, there are more and more concepts and more and more gods. This world should have many later-generation gods.

*Clang!* Qin Lang, who was slacking off by reading a theology book, stood up abruptly, his chair falling backward.

Xia Xifeng turned his head to look at Qin Lang, but the movement was too fast, and he clutched his neck, screaming.

Qin Lang: "..."

He had no choice but to go over and massage Xia Xifeng's neck.

Xia Xifeng tilted his neck: "Sss... what are you doing?"

Qin Lang didn't want to speak.

He had been looking for clues about the world's destruction for a long time, reading so many theology books, always separated from the truth by a layer of fog. Xia Xifeng hadn't been thinking about anything, yet with a casual remark, he had broken through that layer of fog.

Since childhood, Qin Lang's careful deliberations were often no match for Xia Xifeng's flashes of inspiration, which often made Qin Lang wonder if his own intelligence was fake.

After he grew up, he knew that having a flighty mind had nothing to do with intelligence, but sometimes he still felt frustrated that he had struggled so hard to find a solution, while Xia Xifeng solved it with a single flash of inspiration.

At times like this, he would often give Xia Xifeng a math problem and listen to Xia Xifeng shout, "I can't do it!"

Xia Xifeng knew Qin Lang too well. Seeing Qin Lang's sour expression, he knew that Qin Lang had been intercepted by his own slip of the tongue while "solving" a problem.

Xia Xifeng said helplessly: "I've said it many times, your frustration is completely unreasonable. You got inspiration from my words, I didn't give you the answer, okay? Look, I'm confused now; if you don't tell me, I don't even know what answer you arrived at."

Qin Lang silently massaged Xia Xifeng's neck.

Xia Xifeng rolled his eyes.

Qin Lang was especially petty in front of him. The logic was sound, but he still had to be annoyed. He clearly wasn't like this with outsiders.

*Sigh, Qin Lang's inexplicable competitive spirit sometimes.*

The little Dark Beast flew toward Qin Lang's face, but Qin Lang blocked it with one hand: "What did you think of?"

Qin Lang: "Nothing."

The little Dark Beast wanted to ask more, but the little Light Beast pulled its tail.

The little Dark Beast anxiously shut its mouth.

Father John and Baron Edel were still out of it, but Xia Xifeng had already changed the subject, talking about academy recruitment.

Since the Demon race could sneak in, it was fine for them to change their appearance and come in as students. When the time came, they could establish an academy in the Demon Realm, and the humans could go there to broaden their horizons.

If the Demon race and the Human race didn't break through to the legendary level, their lifespans were all under a hundred years. The Light-Dark War, which happened once every hundred years and was intentionally eased by the gods on both sides, had not caused irreconcilable blood feuds between the two races. If it weren't for the fact that light and dark had to be opposites and their elements could not merge, the two races could have had no enmity at all.

Both the Light God and the Dark God thought it was feasible, and the Light Pope and Dark Pope were holding a video conference (magic crystal projection), looking frazzled.

Since the Light-Dark War had turned into "Heroes fighting the Demon King," the popes of both sides often met secretly. Whenever their own gods had a whim, the two popes would run their legs off with the church's high-level officials. Ordinary people didn't know, but if it came to "colluding with the enemy," the popes on both sides would be the first to be beheaded.

chunks.chineseText:
等入了夜，农场只剩下两人两神后，秦琅问道：“你们改变光暗大战的形式，是不是从遇见外神后开始？”

光明神和黑暗神没有回答。祂们知道有些问题不能直接回答，但可以用眼神暗示。

秦琅继续问道：“生灵发展后新出现的‘概念’，是不是全部归于光暗的概念之下？所有的新神，顶多能成为你们的属神。”

光明神和黑暗神先是一愣，然后皱眉若有所思。

夏兮风看向秦琅：“有什么问题吗？”

秦琅没说话。他拿出一块今天夏兮风烤的饼干，用食指夹住。然后他又拿出两块小铁块放在饼干两边。铁块刚放上去，饼干就咔嚓一声断掉。

“光暗极端地不相容。”秦琅道，“你们应该已经察觉了不对劲，才会改变。”

光明神和黑暗神再次沉默不语。

夏兮风问道：“创世神不能创造只有死路的世界，否则就会遭遇世界意识的严重反噬。既然你们已经知道了问题，应该能寻找到解决方法？”

见到光明神和黑暗神似乎知情，夏兮风知道结局已经注定，还是心存侥幸。

光明神和黑暗神仍旧没说话。

秦琅看了两位神灵投影一眼：“光暗同时超脱。”

光明神和黑暗神看向秦琅的眼神很复杂，有敬佩，也有郁闷。

祂们想了很久才想出来的结论，秦琅怎么看看书就发现了？就算秦琅智商再高，也不可能比神灵更高。神灵和凡人根本没办法比。

秦琅知道祂们很惊讶。自己倒不是因为智商比神灵还高，只是从结果倒推原因。

梦世界的创世主对自己创造的世界是友善的。已知梦世界是天父创造的第一个世界，天父肯定方方面面都要考虑，争取第一个世界就能有超脱者。

秦琅在梦世界学习了许久，已经点燃神火。梦世界概念所属的神灵，最重要的一点就是“均衡”。

神灵们虽然也有属神，但属神确实是祂们主概念之下包含的子概念。只要是“大集合”的概念，都有相应主神。如果实在是不好细分，那宁可小概念都有单独的主神，也不要大杂烩。

除了自己兼任的马甲，大部分神灵其实没有真正的属神。祂们的力量有大有小，位格有高有低，但都彼此独立。

只要分得够细，某个神稍微强一点，也不会影响大局。当初天父担忧太阳的信仰太大了，连太阳都造了两个。

习惯了梦世界的神灵划分，秦琅看到这个世界的神学的时候，心里就隐隐约约有别扭感。

直到夏兮风一句“之后的神灵都去哪了”，点破了秦琅心中的迷雾。

这个世界所有的概念都融入光暗中，而光暗元素不相容。

世界文明发展程度越高，光暗承担的概念就越重，相连处就越容易折断。“神皇”看似给了世界“解决”的方法——光暗大战，同时削弱光暗的力量，减弱世界的压力。

但世界不发展，完全承担了世界所有规则的光暗神灵就不可能超脱，光暗相连处就算受到的压力小了，但也是持续不断地受到压力，世界相当于慢性死亡。

光暗本来吞不下那么多有矛盾之处的规则，再加上神的“人格之心”贪婪，肯定有神灵想要夺取光暗这两个高高在上的主神的位置。当“神皇”需要使用“武器”的时候，一点挑拨就能引爆这个世界。

这个挑拨，可能就是世界隐患本身。

“如果光明和黑暗被分食，主神鲸落，会不会惠及万物？”高天之上，光明神幽幽开口，“我曾这么想过。”

黑暗神答道：“不能。我们已经和世界联系太深，我们的死亡，等于世界的崩溃。但得知世界步入慢性死亡，肯定会有神灵想放手一搏。凡人成神，本就是逆天而行，祂们个个都是赌徒。”

当光明神和黑暗神背负的世界规则越多，祂们就越接近世界本身，怎么会不知道世界的隐患？

夏兮风听懂了。

龙神曾说，越是先天神灵越不容易超脱。虽然祂们天生力量强大，但力量来自于世界本身，受世界约束大。

这个世界唯一的自救方式就是光明神和黑暗神超脱，属神自然会成为主神，世界规则变得均衡。

但光明神和黑暗神背负了太多规则，超脱几乎不可能；为了不让世界过早破灭，祂们要压制世界发展，其他人也很难拥有足够的资源修炼到超脱的境界。

或许这个世界拥有足够长的时间，能找到其他救世办法。但这个“危机”是世界的创世神给的，“神皇”不会给世界寻找答案的时间。

两人两神静默不言。

光明神和黑暗神之间隐约察觉到了世界的危机，但祂们身在局中，看不清全貌，只本能地认为必须减弱光暗的仇恨，弥合光暗的裂痕。

直到夏兮风和秦琅身携祂们已经破灭的气息来到这个世界。

直到秦琅分析这个世界的隐患，隐患的前提是“如果创世神要创造一个毁灭后不会有太大反噬的世界”。

局外人带着棋局全貌进入棋局，棋盘上的棋子才知道自己在什么位置，什么时候会被吃掉。

“不要说了。”光明神道，“知道这些就够了。再说下去，神便可以听见了。”

黑暗神狠狠翻了个白眼，身体男男女女变换得更快了。

“嗯。不说了。”夏兮风把光明小兽和黑暗小兽抱过来捏捏，“我们不说话，只做事。光明和黑暗都来我的学校读书，也算一种光暗融合吧？”

夏兮风想，只要世界的生机越大，敌对创世神受到的反噬肯定就越重。

秦琅也这么想。他明白了系统任务的真意。

敌对创世神使用这个世界当武器也需要“时机”。如果那个“时机”到了的时候，这个世界的生机很强，只要光明和黑暗的神灵撑得住，没被世界“掰碎”，那么敌对创世神强行灭世，会受到极大反噬。

敌对创世神肯定有监控这个世界的生机。当世界生机发展到一定阶段，祂可能就会直接插手，将自己和夏兮风驱逐出世界。

神灵直接插手凡间，其投影可以被凡人英雄杀死；创世神的投影“神皇”，按照规则也可以被这个世界的神灵杀死。

就算只死一个投影，也能伤到本尊。

如莱欧和佩瑞拉当时做的一样，给血月比个中指，也比什么都不做强。

而且死一个投影的伤势，可能就会成为两方创世神斗争的转折。

晚上，秦琅难得大度，让光明小兽和黑暗小兽和他们一起睡。

两只小兽分别占据夏兮风一边位置。黑暗小兽把秦琅踹下了床。

大度的秦琅：“……”

他搬来被褥，在卧室打地铺。

不和已死之神计较:）。

chunks.englishText:
Once night fell and only the two humans and two deities remained on the farm, Qin Lang asked, "Did the two of you change the nature of the Light-Dark War starting from the moment you encountered the Outer Gods?"

The God of Light and the God of Darkness did not answer. They knew some questions could not be answered directly, but they could offer hints through their gazes.

Qin Lang continued, "Do all the 'concepts' that emerged after the development of living beings fall under the umbrella of Light and Darkness? Are all new gods, at best, merely subordinate deities to you?"

The God of Light and the God of Darkness were stunned for a moment, then frowned, lost in thought.

Xia Xifeng looked at Qin Lang. "Is there a problem with that?"

Qin Lang didn't speak. He took out a cookie Xia Xifeng had baked that day, holding it between his index finger and thumb. Then, he placed two small iron blocks on either side of the cookie. As soon as the iron blocks touched it, the cookie snapped with a crisp *crack*.

"Light and Darkness are fundamentally incompatible," Qin Lang said. "You must have already sensed that something was wrong, which is why you changed."

The God of Light and the God of Darkness remained silent once more.

Xia Xifeng asked, "A Creator God cannot create a world that leads only to a dead end; otherwise, they would face severe backlash from the world's consciousness. Since you have already identified the problem, shouldn't you be able to find a solution?"

Seeing that the God of Light and the God of Darkness seemed to be in the know, Xia Xifeng realized the ending was already set, yet he still clung to a sliver of hope.

The two deities still said nothing.

Qin Lang glanced at the two divine projections. "Light and Darkness must transcend simultaneously."

The looks the God of Light and the God of Darkness gave Qin Lang were complex—filled with both admiration and frustration.

It had taken them ages to reach that conclusion; how had Qin Lang discovered it just by reading books? Even if Qin Lang’s intelligence was high, it shouldn't surpass that of a deity. Deities and mortals were simply not on the same level.

Qin Lang knew they were surprised. It wasn't that his intelligence exceeded that of the gods, but rather that he was deducing the cause from the result.

The Creator of the Dream World was benevolent toward the world He created. Knowing the Dream World was the first world created by the Heavenly Father, the Father must have considered every aspect, striving to ensure that the first world would produce transcendents.

Qin Lang had studied in the Dream World for a long time and had already ignited his divine fire. The most important aspect of the deities belonging to the Dream World's concepts was "equilibrium."

Although those deities had subordinate gods, those subordinates were indeed sub-concepts contained within their primary concepts. As long as it was a "grand collection" of concepts, there was a corresponding main deity. If a concept was too difficult to subdivide, they would rather have individual main deities for smaller concepts than a chaotic hodgepodge.

Aside from the avatars they personally held, most deities didn't actually have true subordinate gods. Their powers varied in strength and their status in rank, but they were all independent of one another.

As long as things were divided finely enough, even if one god was slightly stronger, it wouldn't affect the overall situation. Back then, the Heavenly Father had worried that the sun’s faith was too great, so He had even created two suns.

Accustomed to the divine classification of the Dream World, Qin Lang had felt a vague sense of discomfort when he first saw the theology of this world.

It wasn't until Xia Xifeng’s remark, "Where did the later gods go?", that the fog in Qin Lang’s mind cleared.

All the concepts in this world were integrated into Light and Darkness, yet the elements of Light and Darkness were incompatible.

The more developed the world's civilization became, the heavier the concepts Light and Darkness had to bear, and the easier it was for the connection between them to snap. The "God Emperor" seemingly gave the world a "solution"—the Light-Dark War—to simultaneously weaken the power of Light and Darkness and reduce the pressure on the world.

But if the world didn't develop, the Light and Dark deities, who bore all the world's rules, could never transcend. Even if the pressure at the intersection of Light and Darkness was reduced, it was still a constant, lingering strain. The world was essentially suffering from a terminal illness.

Light and Darkness could not swallow so many contradictory rules to begin with, and coupled with the greed of the gods' "human hearts," there were bound to be deities who wanted to seize the positions of the two supreme main gods. When the "God Emperor" needed to use a "weapon," a single provocation could detonate this world.

That provocation might be the world's own inherent hidden danger.

"If Light and Darkness are consumed, and the main gods fall like whales in the ocean, will it benefit all things?" High above, the God of Light spoke softly. "I have thought of this before."

The God of Darkness replied, "It cannot. We are already too deeply connected to the world; our death would equal the collapse of the world. But knowing the world is entering a slow death, there will surely be deities who want to take a gamble. Mortals becoming gods is already an act of defying heaven; they are all gamblers."

The more world rules the God of Light and the God of Darkness bore, the closer they were to the world itself—how could they not know the world's hidden dangers?

Xia Xifeng understood.

The Dragon God had once said that the more innate a deity was, the harder it was to transcend. Although they were born with great power, that power came from the world itself and was heavily constrained by it.

The only way for this world to save itself was for the God of Light and the God of Darkness to transcend. The subordinate gods would naturally become main gods, and the world's rules would reach equilibrium.

But the God of Light and the God of Darkness bore too many rules; transcendence was almost impossible. To prevent the world from perishing prematurely, they had to suppress the world's development, making it difficult for others to possess enough resources to cultivate to the realm of transcendence.

Perhaps this world had enough time to find other ways to save itself. But this "crisis" was given by the world's Creator; the "God Emperor" would not give the world time to find the answer.

The two humans and two deities remained silent.

The God of Light and the God of Darkness had vaguely sensed the world's crisis, but being trapped within the game, they couldn't see the full picture. They only instinctively believed they had to reduce the hatred between Light and Darkness and bridge the rift between them.

That was until Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang arrived in this world, carrying the scent of their own shattered worlds.

Until Qin Lang analyzed the hidden dangers of this world, with the premise being "if a Creator God wanted to create a world that wouldn't suffer too much backlash after its destruction."

Outsiders bringing the full picture of the chessboard into the game allowed the pieces on the board to finally realize where they stood and when they would be captured.

"Say no more," the God of Light said. "Knowing this is enough. If you say any more, the Gods might hear."

The God of Darkness rolled their eyes fiercely, their body shifting between male and female forms even faster.

"Fine. No more," Xia Xifeng said, picking up the little Light beast and the little Dark beast to squeeze them. "We won't talk, we'll just act. Both Light and Darkness coming to my school to study—that counts as a kind of fusion, right?"

Xia Xifeng thought that the more vitality the world possessed, the heavier the backlash the hostile Creator God would receive.

Qin Lang thought the same. He understood the true meaning of the system mission.

The hostile Creator God needed "timing" to use this world as a weapon. If, when that "timing" arrived, the world's vitality was strong, and as long as the Light and Dark deities could hold on without being "broken" by the world, then the hostile Creator God would suffer a massive backlash for forcibly destroying the world.

The hostile Creator God was surely monitoring the world's vitality. Once the world's vitality reached a certain stage, He might intervene directly and expel him and Xia Xifeng from the world.

When a deity intervenes directly in the mortal realm, their projection can be killed by mortal heroes; the Creator God's projection, the "God Emperor," could, according to the rules, also be killed by the gods of this world.

Even if only one projection died, it could still wound the true body.

Just as Leo and Perella had done back then, giving the Blood Moon the middle finger was better than doing nothing at all.

Moreover, the injury from losing one projection might become the turning point in the struggle between the two Creator Gods.

That night, Qin Lang was uncharacteristically generous, allowing the little Light beast and the little Dark beast to sleep with them.

The two little beasts occupied the space on either side of Xia Xifeng. The little Dark beast kicked Qin Lang off the bed.

The generous Qin Lang: "..."

He brought over his bedding and made a floor bed in the bedroom.

I won't argue with dead gods :).

chunks.chineseText:
第127章 一章

黑暗小兽只捣乱了一个夜晚，第二天就回自己的小窝睡去了。

祂倒是想继续捣乱，但光明小兽抓住了祂的尾巴，把祂拖出屋。

“尾巴要断啦！”

“活该。”

“你居然说活该，你还是不是光明神！”

“和我是不是光明神有什么关系？”

约翰神父早上准时拜访，看着你挠我一爪子，我给你一巴掌的光明神和黑暗神大战，表情很是萧瑟。

埃德尔男爵倒是接受了光明神和黑暗神这个画风。

圣典中没写神灵的性格，那神灵为什么不能是这个性格？

“夏和秦呢？”

“秦琅把小风关屋里了，估计明天才会出来。”

约翰神父不明所以，埃德尔男爵表情猥琐。

光明小兽叹气，黑暗小兽捧腹大笑。

光明小兽很担心夏兮风。黑暗神捣乱，秦琅可以把黑暗神的投影当沙包捶，欺负无辜的夏兮风干什么？

第二天，夏兮风虽然不断揉腰，但满脸餍足，半点没有被欺负的样子。光明小兽把劝说秦琅的话咽了下去。

算了，他们很般配，旁的人还是闭嘴吧。

这些小事暂且放一边。

讨论完世界毁灭之后，夏兮风和秦琅就当这件事没发生过，不再提起。

夏兮风继续琢磨要上什么课，秦琅每天继续早出晚归刷经验。

光明神和黑暗神也像是“忘记”了似的，黑暗小兽每天还是没心没肺地打闹，光明小兽仍旧每天呆呆的。

光明教皇和黑暗教皇终于搞出一套遮掩气息的“校服”，首批学员到位，第一批学员只有两百人，光暗各一百人。

这一百人都是光明教会和黑暗教会的年轻天才。他们学会了之后，将承担起学员教师的重责。

秦琅的老熟人，年轻的黑暗骑士罗兰就在其列。

夏兮风一如既往地自来熟。他笑着拍着罗兰的肩膀：“谢谢你照顾我家老秦了，来，这是礼物。”

罗兰看着夏兮风递过来的一篮子小蛋糕小面包，本来想推辞一下。

他刚一张嘴，一只毛绒绒的黑色小兽一头栽进篮子里。

罗兰：“？？？”

黑色小兽抬起头，满脸蛋糕屑：“你会把美味的点心敬献给你的主，对吧？”

罗兰：“啊？对……”对什么？

“我收到了你的敬献。”黑色小兽抢了篮子就跑。

罗兰：“！”

中途飞出一只白色毛绒绒小兽，抢回篮子并撞飞了黑色小兽。

白色小兽将篮子还给罗兰。

罗兰：“……谢谢？”

白色小兽语气平静道：“不客气。”

黑色小兽飞了回来。光明和黑暗再次开启大战。

夏兮风继续自来熟地搭着罗兰的肩膀：“小心点，别又被你家神抢了。”

罗兰深呼吸：“我家神？！”

夏兮风道：“小黑是你家黑暗神投影，小白是光明神投影。”

罗兰使劲深呼吸，几乎晕厥。

学院的首批学生都是最虔诚的信徒，才敢钻神皇“光暗不相容”的空子，教皇自然提前告知他们，神灵在学院里有投影。

可以直接觐见神灵？

信徒再不反对光明和黑暗一起办学院。

罗兰来之前猜了许多伟大的黑暗神会投影的模样。他把圣典都快翻烂了。

现在，黑暗神的投影抢了他的甜点，光明神的投影帮他抢了回来。他还对光明神说了一声谢谢。

罗兰终于认清了这个现实，大跨步要去追随黑暗神，被夏兮风拦下。

“吃多了甜点对身体不好。别惯着祂。”夏兮风随口胡扯。

神灵的投影吃什么都不会生病，但黑暗神的食量太大，夏兮风可不想让祂胡吃海喝，浪费食物。

罗兰遗憾地停下脚步。

有一位光明骑士疑惑道：“我主和黑暗似乎……”

夏兮风替他补完话：“似乎关系不错？那不是理所当然吗？你们和魔族又有什么仇恨？不都是为了大战而大战。”

所有战争的源头都是利益之争。可为了给世界埋下隐患，神皇让这个世界光暗完全不相容，所以人类和魔族要晋级所需要的珍稀资源完全不同。文明又没发展起来，人口还很少。黑暗界和光明界都地广人稀，人均资源占比极高，根本没到争夺资源的时候。

或许将来他们文明发展了，人口增加了，光暗或者光与暗的内部都会为争夺资源而打仗，但在那之前的战争，确实是强行为了打仗而打仗，只是神皇规定的“战争游戏”。

凡间没有战争冲突，神皇规定他们必须打仗；神界倒是神灵多，神位少得可怜，战争一触即发。

光明骑士眉头紧锁。

夏兮风道：“我想你虔诚地信仰光明神，不是因为祂是光明神，而是祂符合你的信仰吧？”

光明骑士道：“你这是什么意思？”

夏兮风道：“我的意思是，如果光明神哪天疯了，每天要吃一百个童男童女，你还信仰祂吗？”

光明骑士愤怒道：“你这是渎神！”

夏兮风笑道：“对吧？如果光明神真的变成这样，就是光明神渎神。我们要肃清光明神，换个符合光明教义的光明神。”

光明骑士听到夏兮风的狂妄之语，气得胸口闷疼，说不出话来。

当光明骑士要找夏兮风决斗的时候，打完一架的光明小兽和黑暗小兽飞了过来。

夏兮风一胳膊抱一只，施施然走了。

已经知道白色小兽和黑色小兽是神灵投影的光明骑士：“……”

光明教皇走了过来，不仅没有安慰可怜的骑士，还在那说风凉话：“显然，我们的主认为夏阁下是正确的。”

黑暗教皇叹气：“谁想打仗？谁都不想。”

光明教皇频频点头：“是啊。”

罗兰对老对头道：“如果你的主质疑神皇，你是支持神皇还是支持你的主？”

光明骑士立刻道：“我只信仰光明神！”

罗兰没好气道：“那不就对了？你动摇什么？”

光明骑士：“……我没动摇。”

罗兰冷哼了一声，拿起被黑暗小兽啃过一口的蛋糕，美滋滋地吃了起来。

那可是我主啃过的蛋糕！

光明骑士眼含羡慕。

他更羡慕那位神秘的农场主。那位神秘的农场主居然正在和他的主蹭蹭脸蛋！

在学院剪彩典礼上，光明和黑暗的信徒灼灼的目光，仿佛要把夏兮风身上烧出无数个洞。

夏兮风乐得露出了牙花子。

他就喜欢看别人对他羡慕嫉妒恨，又拿他无可奈何的模样，哈哈哈哈。

秦琅缩在阴影里，不去掺和夏兮风拉仇恨的行为。

他扫了一眼在场的光明和黑暗信徒。

嗯，光明教会和黑暗教会的年轻传说战士、魔法师，是不是全都来了？他一个都打不过。

先躲了。

就算已经滚在了一起睡觉，当夏兮风没有性命之危的时候，秦琅仍旧是能躲多少麻烦就躲多少麻烦，把夏兮风护在身前的行为永远不会动摇。

夏兮风拉完仇恨，就向众人展示学院即将教导什么。

他卡着农作物成熟的时间走过农田，麦田跟随他的步伐挂上了金黄色的麦穗；
chunks.englishText:
The little Dark beast only caused trouble for one night; the next day, it went back to sleep in its own little nest.

It wanted to keep causing trouble, but the little Light beast grabbed its tail and dragged it out of the room.

"My tail is going to break!"

"Serves you right."

"You actually said 'serves you right'? Are you still the God of Light?"

"What does that have to do with whether I am the God of Light?"

Father John visited on time that morning, watching the God of Light and the God of Darkness engage in a war of "you scratch me, I slap you," his expression quite desolate.

Baron Edel, however, had accepted this style of the God of Light and the God of Darkness.

The scriptures didn't record the personalities of the gods, so why couldn't the gods have these personalities?

"Where are Xia and Qin?"

"Qin Lang locked Little Feng in the room; he probably won't come out until tomorrow."

Father John was confused, while Baron Edel had a lewd expression.

The little Light beast sighed, and the little Dark beast laughed until it doubled over.

The little Light beast was very worried about Xia Xifeng. When the God of Darkness caused trouble, Qin Lang could use the Dark God's projection as a punching bag, but why bully the innocent Xia Xifeng?

The next day, although Xia Xifeng kept rubbing his waist, he looked completely satisfied, not at all like someone who had been bullied. The little Light beast swallowed the words it had intended to use to persuade Qin Lang.

Forget it. They were a perfect match; others should just keep their mouths shut.

These trivial matters were set aside for now.

After discussing the destruction of the world, Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang acted as if it had never happened and did not mention it again.

Xia Xifeng continued to ponder what classes to teach, while Qin Lang continued to go out early and return late every day to "grind experience."

The God of Light and the God of Darkness also seemed to have "forgotten." The little Dark beast still played around mindlessly every day, and the little Light beast remained as dazed as ever.

The Pope of Light and the Pope of Darkness finally produced a set of "school uniforms" that could conceal their aura. The first batch of students arrived—two hundred in total, one hundred from Light and one hundred from Darkness.

These hundred people were all young geniuses from the Church of Light and the Church of Darkness. Once they learned, they would shoulder the heavy responsibility of being student teachers.

Qin Lang's old acquaintance, the young Dark Knight Roland, was among them.

Xia Xifeng was as familiar as ever. He smiled and patted Roland on the shoulder. "Thanks for taking care of my old Qin. Here, this is a gift."

Roland looked at the basket of small cakes and breads Xia Xifeng handed over, initially wanting to decline.

The moment he opened his mouth, a fluffy little black beast dove headfirst into the basket.

Roland: "???"

The little black beast lifted its head, face covered in cake crumbs. "You would offer delicious snacks to your Lord, right?"

Roland: "Ah? Ye..." Yes to what?

"I have received your offering." The little black beast grabbed the basket and ran.

Roland: "!"

Midway, a fluffy white little beast flew out, snatched the basket back, and knocked the black beast away.

The white little beast returned the basket to Roland.

Roland: "...Thank you?"

The white little beast said calmly, "You're welcome."

The black little beast flew back. Light and Darkness began their war once again.

Xia Xifeng continued to familiarly drape his arm over Roland's shoulder. "Be careful, don't let your god snatch it again."

Roland took a deep breath. "My god?!"

Xia Xifeng said, "Little Black is your Dark God's projection, and Little White is the Light God's projection."

Roland took a deep, heavy breath, nearly fainting.

The first batch of students at the academy were the most devout believers, which was why they dared to exploit the loophole of the God Emperor's "Light and Darkness are incompatible." The Popes had naturally informed them in advance that the gods had projections in the academy.

They could meet the gods directly?

The believers no longer opposed Light and Darkness running an academy together.

Before coming, Roland had guessed what the great Dark God's projection would look like. He had nearly worn out his scriptures.

Now, the Dark God's projection had snatched his dessert, and the Light God's projection had helped him snatch it back. He had even said "thank you" to the God of Light.

Roland finally recognized the reality and strode off to follow the Dark God, only to be stopped by Xia Xifeng.

"Eating too many sweets is bad for your health. Don't spoil Him." Xia Xifeng spouted nonsense.

A god's projection wouldn't get sick from eating anything, but the Dark God's appetite was too large, and Xia Xifeng didn't want Him to gorge himself and waste food.

Roland stopped with regret.

A Light Knight asked in confusion, "My Lord and Darkness seem..."

Xia Xifeng finished the sentence for him: "Seem to have a good relationship? Isn't that a matter of course? What grudge do you have against the Demon race? Isn't it all just war for the sake of war?"

The root of all war was a struggle for interests. But to bury hidden dangers in the world, the God Emperor made Light and Darkness in this world completely incompatible, so the rare resources needed for humans and demons to advance were completely different. Civilization hadn't developed, and the population was still small. Both the Dark Realm and the Light Realm were vast and sparsely populated; the per capita resource share was extremely high, and it was nowhere near the time to fight over resources.

Perhaps in the future, when their civilization developed and the population increased, Light and Darkness—or even internal factions within Light or Darkness—would fight over resources. But the wars before that were indeed wars for the sake of war, merely a "war game" prescribed by the God Emperor.

There were no military conflicts in the mortal realm, yet the God Emperor mandated that they must fight; the Divine Realm, on the other hand, had many gods but pitifully few divine positions, so war was always on the brink of breaking out.

The Light Knight frowned tightly.

Xia Xifeng said, "I think you believe in the God of Light devoutly, not because He is the God of Light, but because He aligns with your faith, right?"

The Light Knight said, "What do you mean by that?"

Xia Xifeng said, "I mean, if the God of Light went crazy one day and wanted to eat a hundred young boys and girls every day, would you still believe in Him?"

The Light Knight said angrily, "That is blasphemy!"

Xia Xifeng smiled. "Right? If the God of Light really became like that, then it would be the God of Light who is blaspheming. We should purge the God of Light and replace Him with a God of Light who aligns with the doctrines of Light."

Hearing Xia Xifeng's arrogant words, the Light Knight felt a dull pain in his chest, unable to speak.

When the Light Knight was about to challenge Xia Xifeng to a duel, the little Light beast and the little Dark beast, having finished their fight, flew over.

Xia Xifeng hugged one in each arm and strolled away.

The Light Knight, who already knew the white and black beasts were divine projections: "..."

The Pope of Light walked over, and instead of comforting the poor knight, he spoke sarcastically: "Clearly, our Lord believes that Lord Xia is correct."

The Pope of Darkness sighed. "Who wants to fight? No one does."

The Pope of Light nodded repeatedly. "Indeed."

Roland said to his old rival, "If your Lord questions the God Emperor, do you support the God Emperor or your Lord?"

The Light Knight immediately said, "I only believe in the God of Light!"

Roland said irritably, "Then that's it, isn't it? Why are you wavering?"

The Light Knight: "...I'm not wavering."

Roland snorted, picked up the cake that the little Dark beast had taken a bite out of, and ate it happily.

That was the cake my Lord had bitten!

The Light Knight’s eyes were filled with envy.

He was even more envious of that mysterious farm owner. That mysterious farm owner was actually rubbing cheeks with his Lord!

At the academy's ribbon-cutting ceremony, the burning gazes of the Light and Dark believers seemed as if they wanted to burn countless holes in Xia Xifeng.

Xia Xifeng was so happy his gums were showing.

He just loved seeing others filled with envy, jealousy, and hatred toward him, yet unable to do anything about it. Hahahaha.

Qin Lang shrank into the shadows, not getting involved in Xia Xifeng's behavior of attracting hatred.

He scanned the Light and Dark believers present.

Hmm, were all the young legendary warriors and mages from the Churches of Light and Darkness here? He couldn't beat a single one of them.

Better hide.

Even though they were already sleeping together, as long as Xia Xifeng wasn't in mortal danger, Qin Lang would always avoid as much trouble as possible, though his behavior of shielding Xia Xifeng would never waver.

After finishing his provocation, Xia Xifeng showed everyone what the academy was about to teach.

He walked across the farmland, timing it with the ripening of the crops; the wheat fields hung with golden ears of grain as he passed.

他早就准备好了材料，现场进行盖房子教学，高耸入云的藏书塔在他双手舞动下屹立；

他挥舞着其实没什么用处，只是用来装饰的魔杖，无数把刀剑堆积如山……

夏兮风一口气秀完技能，把长长的魔杖往地上一拄：“魔力和斗气都严格区分光暗属性，不能共存，但只是打一把刀剑，盖一座房子，种一亩麦子……能有什么光暗属性？”

他扫视了一眼被他的演出震撼到的传说职阶们：“我要传播的知识，不是杀人的知识，是活人的知识。无关光暗，都能学！”

轰隆一声，只有神灵听得见的声音如同雷鸣。

光明神和黑暗神同时出手，遮蔽了规则的动荡。

只要神皇的目光没有直接注视着这个世界，祂们联合在一起就等于这个世界的意识，能够将世界信息封锁在世界壁障之内。

夏兮风说出这句话的时候，他感到自己身上的枷锁松了一瞬。

秦琅的气势飞速攀升，瞬间进入传说。

他和夏兮风早就点燃了神火，因为世界规则压制才“从零重新开始”。

创世神一无所知，祂创造的世界却承认了夏兮风。

这是不是证明，世界被创造出来之后就是独立的个体，它并不是创世神的玩具和傀儡？

夏兮风的双眼泛起金色，虽然只是短短的一瞬，但他与高天之上的光暗神灵，与光暗神灵所代表的世界意识进行了短暂的对视。

夏兮风收回目光，神情淡漠，如同神灵。

他看到了世界前方无路可走。

但是世界还能选择如何落幕。

“好了，我已经展示过了，接下来选课！”夏兮风拍拍手，“农业、土木业、制造业……总有一款适合你们！”

只要使用魔力和斗气，都必须和光暗挂钩。但不好意思，我来自无灵气无魔力的世界。

全文明的进步，需要什么魔气斗气？隔壁梦世界的清洁能源魔晶石虽然分属性，但使用者不需要分属性啊。

你烧煤烧石油，难道还要自身是煤炭属性石油属性吗？

【系统技能树更新，“鉴定技能”本土化成功。】

【玩家鉴定后的“知识”，能够通过“抄写”功能，让系统抄写成书籍。】

【护道者玩家可使用“抄写”功能，帮助先知玩家“抄写”鉴定后的“知识”。请玩家尽情地传播知识吧！】

【&%*￥#花屏*#@**￥%￥%】

文字一个一个地冒出来，在虚空中伸胳膊蹬腿，扭成了一团难看的墨渍，一滴一滴落下，如同乌黑的血。

秦琅从阴影中走出，站在了夏兮风身边。

阴影在秦琅脚下轻轻摇曳，无数细小的触须随风招展。

He had long since prepared the materials and taught a lesson on house construction on the spot; a towering library pagoda stood tall under the movement of his hands.

He waved a magic wand that was actually useless and only for decoration, and countless swords and blades piled up like a mountain...

Xia Xifeng finished showing off his skills in one breath and planted the long magic wand into the ground. "Both magic power and Dou Qi are strictly divided into Light and Dark attributes and cannot coexist, but if you're just forging a sword, building a house, or planting a mu of wheat... what Light or Dark attributes could those possibly have?"

He scanned the legendary-rankers who were stunned by his performance. "The knowledge I want to spread is not the knowledge of killing, but the knowledge of living. It has nothing to do with Light or Darkness—everyone can learn it!"

A rumble, a sound only the gods could hear, echoed like thunder.

The God of Light and the God of Darkness acted simultaneously, shielding the turbulence of the rules.

As long as the God Emperor's gaze was not directly fixed on this world, their union was equivalent to the world's consciousness, capable of sealing the world's information within the world's barrier.

When Xia Xifeng said those words, he felt the shackles on his body loosen for an instant.

Qin Lang's momentum climbed rapidly, instantly entering the legendary realm.

He and Xia Xifeng had long since ignited their divine fire, only "starting over from zero" because of the suppression of the world's rules.

The Creator God knew nothing, yet the world He created had acknowledged Xia Xifeng.

Did this not prove that once a world was created, it was an independent individual, and not a toy or puppet of the Creator God?

Xia Xifeng's eyes glowed with gold. Although it was only for a brief moment, he had a fleeting eye contact with the Light and Dark deities high above, and with the world consciousness represented by those deities.

Xia Xifeng withdrew his gaze, his expression indifferent, like a god.

He saw that there was no way forward for the world.

But the world could still choose how to end.

"Alright, I've shown you enough. Now, choose your classes!" Xia Xifeng clapped his hands. "Agriculture, civil engineering, manufacturing... there's always one that suits you!"

As long as one used magic power or Dou Qi, it had to be linked to Light or Darkness. But sorry, I come from a world without spiritual energy or magic.

What kind of magic or Dou Qi does the progress of an entire civilization need? The clean energy magic crystals from the neighboring Dream World might be divided by attributes, but the users don't need to be.

When you burn coal or oil, do you need to have a "coal attribute" or an "oil attribute" yourself?

第128章 一更

一个消息很快传遍了整个世界——有一座不限制入学者身份的学院建立，只要是能通过入学考试的人都能进入学院免费学习。

稍稍大一点的国度都开设了学院，招收贵族和少部分天资极高的平民学生。这些学院无一例外都以教导提升实力为主。

这个不限制入学者身份的新学院不一样。它教授的知识范围之广，让人诧异“这也能进学院”？

学院没有取名，被称为“无名学院”。进入无名学院之后，先统一学习一年包含所有科目的基础学科。一年后，学生根据自己的喜好以及成绩进行分科。

在学院里，上到政治经济，下到种田造东西，只要你想学，只要你考试合格，都能在学院里免费学习。学生学习成绩优秀，完成学院布置的任务，通过导师设置的考验……还能得到在外界也难得一见的珍稀资源，更别提在大势力面前露脸，获得一个好前程的可能性。

有贵族质疑学院，也有人怀疑这个学院不符合光明神的教义，背后似乎和黑暗神有关。

后来证明，这个学院确实和黑暗神有关——它很快在魔界也开设了分院，两个学院中间还有传送阵相连。

虽然光明神殿和黑暗神殿都表示对此一无所知，教皇更是一副“好震惊”的表情，但两所学院都在光明和黑暗的圣地，老师全是不承认自己是教会年轻强者的教会年轻强者，各国贵族品出点味了。这个学院莫不是光明神和黑暗神的授意？

贵族会学历史。他们从故纸堆中得知，原本的光暗大战不是现在这样只和勇者、魔王有关的小型战争，而是全世界陷入战火的真正的不死不休的大战。

似乎光明神和黑暗神达成了什么协议，不想再让两族优秀人才被百年一次的战火焚尽，才搞出了这么一场比较敷衍，名为战争，实际上是比试的“光暗大战”。

这之后，两族的优秀人才增多，年轻的强者如雨后的蘑菇一样一朵一朵地冒了出来，繁荣的城镇和国家也增加了。

光明神和黑暗神虽然因为属性不合注定为敌，但祂们对各自的子民都是真心爱护。两位神灵见人类和魔族恢复了元气，想教授两族更多的知识，让两族变得更加繁荣，也不难理解。

贵族们还知道，世界上不止光暗两位神灵。或许有不透露姓名的第三位神灵出面，才能建立这所学院。因为教授的知识会增加两族的实力，所以必须不偏不倚，两族都要开设分院。

世上聪明人很多。两位教皇半遮半掩，很快聪明人都上钩了，不需要他们宣传，各个国家都送来自家的天才来碰碰运气，顺带进一步打探消息。

不管他们原本抱有怎样的目的，只要在这所学院上学，他们就别想再有其他心思了。

无他，学习真是太难了。

瞧不起种田和造东西？那你知道为什么田会种成这样，造东西的材料聚合在一起的原理吗？

数理化生，世界基石。你什么都不会，还想突破传说，点燃神火？你以为神灵就只是打架厉害吗？

敲黑板，万事万物的规则都由神灵掌握，换句话说，要成神必须掌握规则。你以为这个学院是教导你种地造东西吗？错了！这个学院教授的是成神的知识！

什么？学不懂数理化？

没关系，自然科学不懂，这里还有人文科学呢。

人类文化文明的起源，社会形态的变迁，人与人关系的底层逻辑……以前你们贵族学的那些商学政治学都是皮毛，我们要透过现象看本质。

这些本质，背后都是一个个神灵！

学生们悟了。

这个学院的背后果然是伟大的神灵，祂们是想培养更多的神灵！

每个学得头昏脑胀的学生，在看着那座只要有学分就可以无限借阅的藏书塔时，目光都充满了敬畏。

这个世界，书籍是很难得的。即使贵族学院会教授知识，但也只是教授最浅显、最基本的知识，如果想要更进一步学习，必须拜师。就算是王族，也要认几个老师，学习那几个老师背后的学派知识。而且就算拜师，顶尖的法术也是不一定教给你的。秘籍更是连血缘亲人都不一定得见的不传之秘。

在这座藏书塔，只要你想学，什么都能学。

因此，许多传说战士、传说法师曾来找过学院的麻烦。

他们来学院交涉后，发现学院连食堂大爷大妈都是传说强者，气势就弱了一半。

光明教皇和黑暗教皇，你们还说学院和教会无关？你们都快把传说强者全塞进来了，当我们瞎啊？！

光明教会和黑暗教会只管着自己的教皇国。对于世界其他地方的事，除了涉及光暗大战，其他一律不管，也不传教。

这个世界的元素都要和光暗属性沾边，光明神和黑暗神都不需要传播信仰，有的是人信仰。何况强大到光明神和黑暗神这个地步，信仰对祂们的实力也没帮助了。祂们爱人，纯粹是因为爱。

因为光明神和黑暗神对各自的子民都很慈爱，所以哪怕可能打不过教会的传说强者，其他来找茬的传说强者还是想胡搅蛮缠一下。还有人纠集一帮学子学徒在藏书塔闹事，说藏书塔里有他们学派的秘籍，必须焚毁。

当他们刚闹起来的时候，有人从藏书塔的台阶拾级而下。那人每走一步，塔中压力就多一分。当他走到塔底的时候，除了传说强者，所有人都死死贴在地面无法动弹。

“秦学院长。”学院的老师们没有感受到任何压力。他们恭敬地向来人鞠躬。

在两年前，他们曾经对这个年轻人有质疑，有轻视。如今，他们只剩下敬畏。

秦琅扫了闹事的传说魔法师一眼，那位传说魔法师呼吸一滞，身后的影子失去了形状，变成了一团不断扭动的黑影。

观察力很好的传说战士、魔法师们汗毛倒竖，能感知到的一切都在向他们报警。面前这个人很危险，非常危险，赶紧远离！

“要闹出去闹，吵到他了。”秦琅的眉间皱起淡淡的纹路，十分不耐烦道，“如果你们无法解决，告诉我，我来。”

秦琅的目光落在思维已经被自己封闭的传说魔法师身上。一秒，两秒……十秒，他解开了束缚。

那位传说魔法师直挺挺地倒在地上。

他不断大喘气，身上的汗水瞬间打湿了衣服，神情全是恐惧，大张的嘴里发出“赫赫”的声音，竟一句话也说不出来。

“滚。”秦琅淡淡道。

那位传说魔法师连滚带爬，四肢并用爬出了塔，半点尊严也无。他带来的那些徒子徒孙都被他丢在了身后。

“抱歉，我们立刻解决。”见秦琅没有下杀手，罗兰松了口气，“是我们疏忽，让人打扰了夏学院长冥想。”

秦琅得了罗兰的承诺后，转身回塔顶。

塔底压力随之消失。倒在地上的人全部昏迷不醒，嘴角溢血。

一位前来查探的传说魔族战士，也是最大的魔族国家的国王，以及罗兰他爹。他声音颤抖：“那是谁？”
