第131章 正文完结

文明的发展本不该由神灵亲自插手，知识的获取应该靠人类自己完成。

只有人类引领人类的发展，人类文明才是有源之水，有根之木，有地基的高楼大厦。

夏兮风直接引出世界本源的知识，是揠苗助长，饮鸩止渴。飞速发展的世界完全依托夏兮风，当夏兮风离开，或者世界的知识被获取耗尽，文明就会立刻停滞。人类不可能去探索世界之外的知识，文明也就不可能升等。

更可怕的是，文明的发展不仅仅是技术的发展，精神文化也得同步发展。

夏兮风的揠苗助长，就是让这个世界的凡人们小孩抡大锤。目前有光明神和黑暗神直接下场帮凡人们扶住锤子，社会才没有陷入动荡。

但如果神灵干涉凡人太多，相当于把婴孩装进坚固的摇篮里，婴孩无法凭借自己离开摇篮，学会走路。文明的虚假繁荣一定会停滞，世界进入慢性死亡。

换成任何一个健康发展的世界，夏兮风都不会做这等天打雷劈的坏事。如果他敢这么做，世界意识一定会攻击他。

可这个世界在命运中已经死了，那饮鸩止渴，揠苗助长也没关系了。

饮鸩止渴便不会在该渴死的时候死掉，揠苗助长哪怕长成空心树也比幼苗倒下时压得砍树人更疼。

夏兮风和秦琅进入世界本源的时候，哪怕有光明神和黑暗神联手为他们屏蔽气机，创世神也该发现这个世界的异常了。

但世界认可夏兮风和秦琅，创世神要驱逐夏兮风和秦琅，就只能亲自下场，以神皇的身份击杀夏兮风和秦琅。

神灵的时间流速和凡人不一样。创世神的“立刻”，在凡间就可能是几十上百年。

夏兮风和秦琅醒来的间隔越来越长，地面上好像按了倍速键。

宽广的道路瞬间铺就，道路上奔跑的车辆从畜力拉的马车，变得越来越奇怪；古朴的小城拆了建建了拆，房屋越来越精致；只有飞禽和飞行魔兽的天空中多了机器轰鸣声，与地面上的机器轰鸣声交相呼应……

山林越来越少，城镇越来越多，人类和魔族领地的界线逐渐模糊。

不知道从何时起，一些人类和魔族混在了一起，光和暗再不像以前那般黑白分明——对于魔力不强的普通人而言，因原本就很难使用魔法和斗气，使用机器却不需要魔力和斗气，属性便失去了意义。他们选择居住地不再以属性为前提，而是流向生活成本更低的地方。

从阶层上来说，这群混居者是最底层，他们创造的价值也是最低的。但阶层是个金字塔，这群在许多人眼中没有价值的混居者，数量却是最多的。

这群混居者形成了混沌的灰色，朦朦胧胧像是肮脏的雾气，席卷整个大陆。纯粹的光明和黑暗上出现了灰斑，像是难看的癣。

这种病症映现在了光明神和黑暗神的神体上。祂们完美的神体上出现了瘢痕，连象征纯粹美丽的光明神的容貌上都有了瑕疵。

祂们“生病”了。

夏兮风又在很长一段沉睡后醒来，看着掉毛的白色小兽和黑色小兽捧脸尖叫。

他叮铃哐啷掏出一大堆锅碗瓢盆、珍稀食材，给白色小兽和黑色小兽补身体。

黑色小兽抱着小短手使劲点头。是的，祂就是缺了夏兮风给祂做好吃的，营养不良了。夏兮风还不快补偿祂！

白色小兽不好意思地摸了摸掉毛的地方，拿出小扫帚扫毛。

夏兮风唠唠叨叨地拉着秦琅准备大餐。

秦琅捂住耳朵，看眼神已经是死了好一会儿了。

因抄书时被迫少说了很多话，夏兮风每次醒来时都要补上很多句话。

但夏兮风的被迫少说话只是对别人，他和秦琅神魂相融，随时都在秦琅脑海里絮絮叨叨，秦琅从未少听过他的啰嗦。

夏兮风从会说话起，就是这么吵，还专门对着秦琅的耳朵吵。

秦琅已经反省过很多次，自己究竟哪里想不开，才会和夏兮风纠缠在一起。

好像他出生后就和夏兮风一个摇篮？

好吧，是他出生的错。

晚上睡觉时，夏兮风和两只毛绒绒挤在一起。黑色小兽故意推夏兮风的脸，把夏兮风的脸都推歪了。

秦琅抱着被子去隔壁睡。

第二天起床，秦琅低头一看，自己被子里长出了一只夏兮风，夏兮风怀里还抱着两只毛绒绒。

光明神和黑暗神联手屏蔽了秦琅的感知，再加上秦琅对夏兮风本就不设防，让夏兮风偷袭成功。

他深深叹了一口气，捏起夏兮风的脸颊肉，把装睡的夏兮风掐醒。

夏兮风睁开眼，对秦琅讨好笑。

他怀里两只毛绒绒也睁大了水汪汪的眼睛。

秦琅：“……”你们两个神脑子有病吗？夏兮风说什么你们都照做？

“扑哧……”夏兮风把脸埋在秦琅颈间偷笑。

秦琅揉着夏兮风的后脑勺，那凶神恶煞的样子，仿佛要掀开夏兮风的头盖骨。

黑色小兽停止恶意卖萌，在枕头上笑得打滚。

白色小兽不好意思地挠了挠耳朵，转过身用尾巴对着秦琅。

运用光明和黑暗元素的人数急速减少，光明和黑暗的神域边缘崩裂成飞沙，裂痕蔓延到神座。

高坐在神座之上的最伟大的神明，迎来了属神的全面反叛。

神域的战火却没有蔓延到地面上。

文明仍旧蓬勃发展，许多古早的神灵被遗忘，人类开始探寻世界的每一个角落，试图用凡人的语言解释神灵。

光与暗的界线越发模糊，灰色的癣面积越来越大。

无名学院屹立在世界之上，左右世界政权更替，也影响高天之上的神灵之战。

而在藏书塔的顶楼，只有饭菜甜点飘香。

神界战得正酣，光明神和黑暗神的投影还在陪着夏兮风惹秦琅生气。

夏兮风做了一个超级大的蛋糕，大得可以把他自己装进去。

他试图扑进蛋糕里，被秦琅抓住后衣领。

秦琅抓住了夏兮风，就没能抓住黑色小兽。

黑色小兽如炮弹一般砸进蛋糕里，居然没把蛋糕砸塌。

祂钻进蛋糕里，又从蛋糕里吃到蛋糕外。

白色小兽拿着刀叉目瞪口呆，第一次发怒暴揍浑身都是奶油的黑色小兽。

夏兮风往后一倒，倒在秦琅身上捧腹大笑。

秦琅看着面前一片和乐融融，仰头看向透明穹顶外的天空。

空间剧烈动荡，世界意识在悲鸣。

在命运中已经杀死了这个世界的创世神“神皇”，即将降临。

今天丰盛的大餐和高大的蛋糕塔，是告别的宴会。

吃完大餐，夏兮风帮白色小兽和黑色小兽洗完澡。他牵着秦琅的手，走出了塔外。

约翰神父已经成了光明教皇，而黑暗教皇是秦琅的老熟人，黑暗骑士罗兰。

时间过去了许多年，但两人仍旧是中年人的模样——他们已经点燃神火，却没有攀登神界，去祈求神果。

“好久不见！”夏兮风仍旧是朝气蓬勃的青年人模样。他对着老熟人招招手。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 131: Main Story Conclusion (Part 1)

The development of civilization should not be directly interfered with by gods; the acquisition of knowledge should be achieved by humans themselves.

Only when humans lead their own development is human civilization like water from a source, a tree with roots, and a skyscraper with a solid foundation.

Xia Xifeng directly drawing out the knowledge of the world's origin was like pulling on seedlings to help them grow—it was drinking poison to quench thirst. A rapidly developing world relying entirely on Xia Xifeng meant that when he left, or when the world's knowledge was exhausted, civilization would immediately stagnate. Humans would be unable to explore knowledge beyond the world, and civilization would be unable to ascend.

Even more terrifyingly, the development of civilization is not just the development of technology; spiritual and cultural aspects must also develop in tandem.

Xia Xifeng’s "pulling on seedlings" was akin to letting toddlers swing heavy hammers. Currently, with the God of Light and the God of Darkness personally stepping in to steady the hammers for the mortals, society had not fallen into turmoil.

But if gods interfere too much with mortals, it is equivalent to placing infants in a sturdy cradle; the infants cannot leave the cradle on their own and learn to walk. The false prosperity of civilization would inevitably stagnate, and the world would enter a state of chronic death.

In any healthy, developing world, Xia Xifeng would never commit such a heinous act. If he dared to do so, the world's consciousness would surely attack him.

But this world was already dead in its destiny, so drinking poison to quench thirst or pulling on seedlings didn't matter anymore.

Drinking poison meant it wouldn't die when it was supposed to, and pulling on seedlings meant that even if it grew into a hollow tree, it would still hurt less than the tree falling on the woodcutter when it was just a sapling.

When Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang entered the world's origin, even with the God of Light and the God of Darkness joining forces to mask their presence, the Creator should have discovered the anomaly in this world.

But the world accepted Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang. For the Creator to expel them, he would have to step in personally, descending as the God Emperor to strike them down.

The flow of time for gods is different from that of mortals. The Creator's "immediately" could be decades or even centuries in the mortal realm.

The intervals between Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang waking up grew longer and longer, as if the world were running on fast-forward.

Wide roads were paved in an instant; the vehicles running on them changed from horse-drawn carriages to increasingly strange contraptions; ancient small towns were demolished and rebuilt, with houses becoming more and more refined; the sky, once only for birds and flying magical beasts, was now filled with the roar of machines, echoing the mechanical roar on the ground...

Forests dwindled, towns multiplied, and the boundaries between human and demon territories gradually blurred.

At some point, humans and demons began to mingle. Light and darkness were no longer as black and white as before—for ordinary people without strong magic, since they already found it difficult to use magic or Dou Qi, and machines required neither, attributes lost their meaning. They no longer chose where to live based on attributes, but flowed toward places with lower costs of living.

In terms of social strata, these mingled groups were at the very bottom, and the value they created was the lowest. But the social structure is a pyramid, and these mingled people, who many viewed as having no value, were the most numerous.

They formed a chaotic gray, hazy like dirty fog, sweeping across the entire continent. Gray spots appeared on the pure light and darkness, like ugly ringworm.

This "disease" was reflected on the divine bodies of the God of Light and the God of Darkness. Scars appeared on their perfect divine bodies; even the appearance of the God of Light, who symbolized pure beauty, had flaws.

They were "sick."

Xia Xifeng woke up after another long slumber, watching the shedding white beast and the black beast holding their faces and screaming.

He clattered and banged as he pulled out a pile of pots, pans, and rare ingredients to nourish the white and black beasts.

The black beast hugged its short arms and nodded vigorously. Yes, it was precisely because it lacked the delicious food Xia Xifeng made that it was malnourished. Xia Xifeng had better compensate it!

The white beast touched the spot where it was shedding fur in embarrassment and took out a small broom to sweep it up.

Xia Xifeng chattered away as he pulled Qin Lang to prepare a grand feast.

Qin Lang covered his ears, his eyes already looking as if he had been dead for a while.

Because he was forced to speak less while copying books, Xia Xifeng had to make up for it every time he woke up.

But Xia Xifeng’s forced silence only applied to others; his soul was fused with Qin Lang’s, and he was chattering in Qin Lang’s mind at all times. Qin Lang had never heard a word less of his nagging.

Ever since he could talk, Xia Xifeng had been this noisy, and he specifically directed his noise into Qin Lang’s ears.

Qin Lang had reflected many times on what exactly had possessed him to get entangled with Xia Xifeng.

It seemed he had been in the same cradle as Xia Xifeng since he was born?

Fine, it was the fault of his birth.

When sleeping at night, Xia Xifeng squeezed in with the two furry creatures. The black beast deliberately pushed Xia Xifeng’s face, pushing it out of shape.

Qin Lang took the quilt and went to sleep in the next room.

The next morning, when Qin Lang woke up and looked down, a Xia Xifeng had grown inside his quilt, and Xia Xifeng was holding the two furry creatures in his arms.

The God of Light and the God of Darkness had joined forces to shield Qin Lang’s perception, and combined with the fact that Qin Lang never guarded against Xia Xifeng, the sneak attack had succeeded.

He sighed deeply, pinched Xia Xifeng’s cheek, and pinched the feigning-asleep Xia Xifeng awake.

Xia Xifeng opened his eyes and gave Qin Lang a fawning smile.

The two furry creatures in his arms also opened their wide, watery eyes.

Qin Lang: "..." Are you two gods mentally ill? You do whatever Xia Xifeng says?

"Pfft..." Xia Xifeng buried his face in Qin Lang’s neck and snickered.

Qin Lang rubbed the back of Xia Xifeng’s head, his fierce expression looking as if he were about to pry open Xia Xifeng’s skull.

The black beast stopped its malicious cuteness and rolled around laughing on the pillow.

The white beast scratched its ears in embarrassment and turned around, presenting its tail to Qin Lang.

The number of people using light and dark elements decreased rapidly, and the edges of the divine realms of Light and Darkness cracked into flying sand, the fissures spreading to the divine thrones.

The greatest gods, sitting high on their thrones, faced a full-scale rebellion from their subordinate gods.

Yet, the flames of war in the divine realm did not spread to the ground.

Civilization continued to flourish, many ancient gods were forgotten, and humans began to explore every corner of the world, attempting to explain the gods in the language of mortals.

The boundary between light and dark became increasingly blurred, and the area of the gray ringworm grew larger.

The Nameless Academy stood above the world, influencing the changes in world regimes and the war of the gods high above.

And on the top floor of the library tower, only the aroma of food and desserts drifted.

The divine realm was locked in fierce battle, while the projections of the God of Light and the God of Darkness were still keeping Xia Xifeng company, annoying Qin Lang.

Xia Xifeng had made a super-sized cake, big enough to fit himself inside.

He tried to pounce into the cake, only to be grabbed by the back of his collar by Qin Lang.

Qin Lang caught Xia Xifeng, but he couldn't catch the black beast.

The black beast slammed into the cake like a cannonball, yet it didn't collapse the cake.

It burrowed into the cake, eating its way from the inside out.

The white beast stood there with a knife and fork, dumbfounded, before finally getting angry and beating the cream-covered black beast.

Xia Xifeng fell backward, collapsing onto Qin Lang, clutching his stomach in laughter.

Qin Lang watched the harmony before him and looked up at the sky outside the transparent dome.

Space rippled violently, and the world consciousness was wailing.

The Creator, the "God Emperor" who had already killed this world in its destiny, was about to descend.

Today’s grand feast and the towering cake were a farewell banquet.

After finishing the meal, Xia Xifeng helped the white and black beasts bathe. He took Qin Lang’s hand and walked out of the tower.

Father John had become the Pope of Light, while the Dark Pope was an old acquaintance of Qin Lang, the Dark Knight Roland.

Many years had passed, but both still appeared as middle-aged men—they had ignited their divine fires, but had not ascended to the divine realm to seek the divine fruit.

"Long time no see!" Xia Xifeng was still the vibrant young man he had always been. He waved at his old acquaintances.

chunks.chineseText:
白色小兽坐在夏兮风的头顶。黑色小兽在满脸冷漠的秦琅头顶做窝。

约翰神父的笑容仍旧很慈祥：“好久不见。”

罗兰恭敬地鞠躬：“谢谢。”

“不用客气。”夏兮风笑着望向天空。他感觉到了充满威压的注视。那注视仿佛能压断世界的脊梁。

秦琅将头顶的黑色小兽摘下，递给罗兰。

白色小兽自己飞到了约翰神父的怀里。

【灭世的序章，从光明神和黑暗神被分食开始。】

一如已经注定的命运所言。

光明神和黑暗神被群神分食，只剩下最初最纯粹的光明和黑暗概念不可剥夺，但祂们已经如瘫痪的人，不能动弹。

群神正在弹冠相庆，天崩地裂。

神皇降临，带领不愿死去的神灵离开。

有德的神灵能登上方舟。方舟是光明和黑暗已经与世界意识融合的神躯。

即，已死的世界本身。

神灵是很难死的。融入了世界意识的光明和黑暗已经是半步超脱，祂们成为方舟，也相当于登上了方舟，一同来到了梦世界，造成梦世界灭世之灾。

之后，便是另一个世界的故事了。

夏兮风的双目中流淌着黄金的颜色，如太阳在双眼中灼烧。

他注视着这个世界的命运线，借着世界壁障的保护，直视着创世的神灵。

神皇降临，其力量是这个世界能承受的极限，即无限接近超脱。

祂伸出手指，要将胆敢进入祂的世界的外来虫子碾死。

光明和黑暗化为利箭，试图偷袭神皇。神皇轻描淡写地一挥手，便挥退了所有攻击。

这时，地面亮起无数光点。

神皇无视凡人的僭越。

凡人怎能伤害神灵？

“哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！”身体崩裂的黑暗神畅快大笑。

光明神抚摸着腐烂的半张脸，自诞生起第一次笑得如此灿烂肆意。

凡俗的光芒灼伤了神皇的手指，一滴神血落下。

神血飘到夏兮风和秦琅面前。

夏兮风和秦琅瞬间化作神体，银色的漩涡和黑色的漩涡融合在一起，吸入了神血，变成了一枚灰蒙蒙的巨卵。

神皇眉头轻皱，一掌拍向巨卵。

地面再次亮起无数光点。与此同时，神域也亮起无数光点。

神皇终于露出惊愕神情，反手防御住来自神域的袭击。

从古至今点燃神火的神灵身披战甲，如云般站在光和暗的身后，仿佛无限延伸的阴影。

“就算我们反叛，你也要带着我们去碰撞隔壁的世界，不能彻底杀死我们。”神灵们的声音层层叠叠，叠加成巨浪，“反正我们无论做什么，命运都已经注定，不如张狂一次。”

光明神和黑暗神往后仰倒，神灵坠落，概念被身后的属神撕成了碎片，只余下最初最纯粹的光明和黑暗。

祂们只剩下一具瘫痪的神躯。

世界的摇篮裂开一条缝，脆弱的婴孩对着摇篮之外伸出手。

分食了世界本源的神灵扑向了神皇，在神皇身上划出细细的伤痕，从伤痕处吮吸神血，如蚂蟥一般脆弱又恶心。

摇篮裂开，里面的婴孩只剩下一口气，身上都生了蛆。

祂还在坚定不移地往外爬，爬向摇篮之外。

灰色的巨卵不断律动，如世界的心脏。

世界本源正在注入外来者的身体。

祂不会与外来者融合，只是单纯成为外来者的力量。

“秦琅，我俩是劳务派遣，命运不写在世界之内，对吧？”

“嗯。”

“我们受到了梦世界的世界意识认可，可以在梦世界成神超脱，超脱后梦世界和原本世界的好处五五分，对吧？”

“嗯。”

“那这个世界的意识也认可我们了，我俩可不可以在这个世界超脱？啊，我知道超脱没那么容易啦。我的意思是，不需要真正超脱，只是在世界命运中印下‘可以超脱的种子选手出现’的烙印，有没有可行性？”

“烙印成功之前，神皇会阻止。”

“嘻嘻，如果神皇阻止不了，祂就只能用创世神的权柄，将你我驱逐出世界，那祂亲自下场，反噬就更重啰。试试呗，反正也就损失一具神躯。天父和咱家创世神在我们灵魂上留下了印迹，我们的本体在沉睡中。就算祂杀了我们，我俩也就是重伤而已。”

“伤势可能让我们以后超脱无望。”

“啧，你在意这个？”

秦琅想了想，确实不在意。

即使不能超脱，神灵的寿命也足够漫长。他和夏兮风本来只有短短不到百年时间相伴，现在寿命漫长到难以想象，他确实没有更进一步的执念。

夏兮风轻笑道：“再说了，如果为了超脱就苟命，失去了冲劲，怕是才会真正地难以超脱。我们可以被保送成神，但超脱之路，理应不会再有大家长为我们遮风避雨。”

秦琅转头，与牵着他的手的夏兮风对视。

他眼眸微垂，又重新抬起，与夏兮风对视的双眼中，浮现出罕见的清晰明朗的笑意。

这一瞬，秦琅一直戴在脸上的木讷碎裂，用以自我约束的冷漠坚冰消融。

夏兮风怔怔地看着秦琅那连他也很少见到的鲜活模样。

秦琅转身，将夏兮风环抱在怀里，轻轻吻了一下夏兮风的眼睛。

夏兮风不自知，但秦琅能看见。

这是他曾经以为的，他所爱的是夏兮风对他的偏爱，他所痴迷的是夏兮风对他的痴迷。

“好。”秦琅道，“别怕，我一直在。”

夏兮风犟嘴：“我主动提起的提议，怎么可能怕！”

秦琅：“那别抖。”

夏兮风：“……”

他头一低，撞在秦琅的下巴上：“呃……是有点怕。我怕很疼。”

秦琅的温柔瞬间化成了冷笑：“你怕疼？你怕疼还拿刀往自己身上扎？！”

夏兮风不高兴道：“那都多久前的事了，家庭生活和睦的秘诀就是别翻旧账！”

秦琅把夏兮风气人的脸按在自己胸口。

在外面看，他们的神体变成了一枚巨卵。

在巨卵“中央”，两人是拥抱着的人形。

夏兮风的神体凝实后重新化作人形很正常，秦琅的神体居然也是人的模样。

或许是不久之后，或许是很久之后，两人快忘记时间流逝时，莫大的恐怖笼罩住他们。

神魂破碎的疼痛太过剧烈，剧烈到时间都仿佛变慢了。

伤势直接作用在神魂上，灵魂没有生物体的疼痛保护机制，连痛得晕厥都是奢望。

夏兮风能清楚地感觉到自己是如何被碾碎。

但他心里没有恐惧，理智半点没有因疼痛而动摇。

“系统”包裹住夏兮风和秦琅几乎完全融合在一起的一点真灵，遁入了世界壁垒裂缝之外的混沌虚空。

离开之前，夏兮风用尽最后的力量，还向秦琅借了一把手，用他和秦琅的骨灰，在地上给神皇画了个凸。

……

“夏……”

夏兮风睁开眼睛，被一声轻呼唤醒。

龙皇刚碾碎了噩兆尸龙。

神灵濒死的怨气铺天盖地，吹得他神魂隐隐作痛。

夏兮风还在恍惚时，肩膀被揽住。
chunks.englishText:
A small white beast sat atop Xia Xifeng’s head. A small black beast nested on the head of the expressionless Qin Lang.

Father John’s smile remained as benevolent as ever: "Long time no see."

Roland bowed respectfully: "Thank you."

"Don't mention it." Xia Xifeng smiled as he looked toward the sky. He could feel a gaze filled with immense pressure—a gaze that seemed capable of snapping the very spine of the world.

Qin Lang plucked the small black beast from his head and handed it to Roland.

The small white beast flew into Father John’s arms of its own accord.

[The prologue of the world's destruction began with the Light God and the Dark God being carved up and devoured.]

Just as the destined fate had foretold.

The Light God and the Dark God were consumed by the pantheon of gods, leaving behind only the most primal and pure concepts of Light and Darkness, which could not be stripped away. Yet, they were now like paralyzed beings, unable to move.

As the gods celebrated their triumph, the heavens crumbled and the earth split asunder.

The God Emperor descended, leading those deities who refused to perish away from the ruin.

Virtuous gods were permitted to board the Ark. The Ark was the divine body of Light and Darkness, now fused with the consciousness of the world.

In other words, it was the dead world itself.

Gods are difficult to kill. Having merged with the world’s consciousness, Light and Darkness were already at the threshold of transcendence. By becoming the Ark, they had effectively boarded it, arriving together in the Dream World and precipitating the catastrophe of its destruction.

What followed was a story for another world.

Golden light flowed within Xia Xifeng’s eyes, burning like the sun.

He stared at the threads of fate in this world, using the protection of the world barrier to look directly at the Creator God.

The God Emperor had descended, his power at the absolute limit of what this world could withstand—infinitely close to transcendence.

He extended a finger, intending to crush the foreign insects that dared to enter his world.

Light and Darkness transformed into arrows, attempting a sneak attack on the God Emperor. With a casual wave of his hand, the God Emperor brushed away all attacks.

At this moment, countless points of light ignited on the ground.

The God Emperor ignored the presumption of mortals.

How could mortals possibly harm a god?

"Hahahahahaha!" The Dark God, his body crumbling, laughed heartily.

The Light God caressed his rotting half-face, smiling more brilliantly and wantonly than he ever had since his birth.

The mundane light scorched the God Emperor’s finger, and a single drop of divine blood fell.

The divine blood drifted before Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang.

Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang instantly transformed into divine bodies; the silver vortex and the black vortex merged, absorbing the divine blood and becoming a massive, gray-hued egg.

The God Emperor frowned slightly and struck the giant egg with his palm.

Countless points of light lit up on the ground once more. Simultaneously, countless points of light ignited within the Divine Realm.

The God Emperor finally revealed a look of astonishment, turning his hand to defend against the assault coming from the Divine Realm.

Gods who had ignited their divine flames since ancient times stood in armor, like clouds behind Light and Darkness, appearing as infinitely extending shadows.

"Even if we rebel, you must take us with you to collide with the neighboring world; you cannot kill us completely." The voices of the gods layered over one another, stacking into a giant wave. "Since our fate is sealed regardless of what we do, we might as well be reckless for once."

The Light God and the Dark God tilted backward. As the gods fell, their concepts were torn to shreds by the subordinate gods behind them, leaving only the most primal and pure Light and Darkness.

They were left with nothing but a paralyzed divine shell.

The world’s cradle cracked open, and a fragile infant reached a hand out beyond the cradle.

The gods who had devoured the world’s essence lunged at the God Emperor, carving thin wounds into his body and sucking the divine blood from them—fragile and disgusting, like leeches.

The cradle split, and the infant inside, left with only a final breath, was covered in maggots.

Yet, it continued to crawl with unwavering determination, crawling out beyond the cradle.

The gray giant egg pulsed rhythmically, like the heart of a world.

The world’s essence was being injected into the bodies of the outsiders.

It would not merge with the outsiders; it would simply become their power.

"Qin Lang, we are labor dispatchers. Our fate isn't written within this world, right?"

"Yes."

"We have been recognized by the consciousness of the Dream World, so we can become gods and transcend within it. After transcendence, the benefits are split fifty-fifty between the Dream World and our original world, right?"

"Yes."

"Then, since this world’s consciousness has also recognized us, can we transcend in this world too? Ah, I know transcendence isn't that easy. I mean, we don't need to truly transcend; is it feasible to just leave a mark in the world’s fate that says 'a seed candidate capable of transcendence has appeared'?"

"Before the mark is successful, the God Emperor will stop us."

"Heehee, if the God Emperor can't stop us, he will have to use the authority of the Creator God to expel us from the world. If he intervenes personally, the backlash will be even heavier. Let's try it. At worst, we lose a divine body. The Heavenly Father and our own Creator God have left imprints on our souls; our true bodies are in slumber. Even if he kills us, we will only be severely injured."

"The injuries might leave us with no hope of future transcendence."

"Tsk, do you care about that?"

Qin Lang thought for a moment. He truly didn't.

Even without transcendence, a god's lifespan is long enough. He and Xia Xifeng were originally only meant to have less than a hundred years together. Now that their lifespans were unimaginably long, he truly had no obsession with going any further.

Xia Xifeng chuckled softly: "Besides, if we play it safe just to transcend and lose our drive, I fear that would be when transcendence truly becomes impossible. We can be 'recommended' to become gods, but on the path of transcendence, there shouldn't be any 'parents' left to shield us from the wind and rain."

Qin Lang turned his head to meet the gaze of Xia Xifeng, who was holding his hand.

He lowered his eyes, then raised them again. In the eyes meeting Xia Xifeng’s, a rare, clear, and bright smile emerged.

In that instant, the wooden mask Qin Lang had always worn shattered, and the cold ice he used to restrain himself melted away.

Xia Xifeng stared blankly at the vibrant, lively expression on Qin Lang that even he rarely saw.

Qin Lang turned, pulled Xia Xifeng into his arms, and kissed his eyes gently.

Xia Xifeng didn't realize it, but Qin Lang could see.

This was what he had once thought: that what he loved was Xia Xifeng’s favoritism toward him, and what he was obsessed with was Xia Xifeng’s obsession with him.

"Alright," Qin Lang said. "Don't be afraid. I'm always here."

Xia Xifeng retorted: "I’m the one who proposed it, how could I be afraid!"

Qin Lang: "Then stop shaking."

Xia Xifeng: "..."

He lowered his head and bumped it against Qin Lang’s chin: "Ugh... I am a little afraid. I’m afraid it will hurt."

Qin Lang’s tenderness instantly turned into a cold sneer: "You’re afraid of pain? You’re afraid of pain, yet you stab yourself with a knife?!"

Xia Xifeng said unhappily: "That was ages ago! The secret to a harmonious family life is not to bring up old scores!"

Qin Lang pressed Xia Xifeng’s infuriating face against his chest.

From the outside, their divine bodies had become a giant egg.

At the "center" of the egg, the two were in a humanoid embrace.

It was normal for Xia Xifeng’s divine body to solidify back into human form, but it was surprising that Qin Lang’s divine body was also in human shape.

Perhaps it was a short time later, or perhaps a long time later, as the two began to lose track of the passage of time, a great terror enveloped them.

The pain of their divine souls shattering was too intense—so intense that time itself seemed to slow down.

The injuries acted directly upon their divine souls. The soul lacks the pain-protection mechanisms of a biological body, so even fainting from the pain was a luxury.

Xia Xifeng could clearly feel how he was being crushed.

Yet, there was no fear in his heart; his reason was not shaken in the slightest by the pain.

The "System" wrapped around the sliver of true spirit—where Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang were almost completely fused—and escaped into the chaotic void beyond the cracks in the world barrier.

Before leaving, Xia Xifeng used his last bit of strength to borrow a hand from Qin Lang, and with their ashes, he drew a "convex" symbol on the ground for the God Emperor.

...

"Xia..."

Xia Xifeng opened his eyes, awakened by a soft call.

The Dragon Emperor had just crushed the Omen Corpse Dragon.

The dying resentment of the gods was overwhelming, blowing against him until his divine soul ached faintly.

While Xia Xifeng was still in a daze, his shoulder was held.

chunks.chineseText:
他侧头看去，秦琅与他并肩而立，支撑着他的身体。

夏兮风道：“老秦，你怎么有点站不稳啊？”

秦琅：“你说呢？不记得了？痛失忆了？”

夏兮风使劲晃了晃脑袋，深吸一口气：“师祖等等！我来收尾！”

龙神正准备焚尽噩兆尸龙的残骸，动作突然停滞。

祂困惑地回头，看着拖着秦琅扑过来的夏兮风皱眉道：“时空乱了一瞬。有人拨动了命运。你们干了什么？”

夏兮风没回答。他认真地问道：“师祖，你不会真的趁火打劫，把隔壁光明神睡了？”

龙神瞪圆眼睛：“什么叫趁火打劫？祂自愿的！其实也不是真睡，只是神魂融合了一下试试……”

夏兮风一拳揍在了龙神瞪圆的眼窝上。秦琅帮他禁锢了龙神的动作，虽然只有不到千分之一秒的时间，夏兮风这一拳也揍得又狠又准。

龙神捂着眼睛：“等等，你怎么能说出祂的真正神名？祂的世界已经毁灭，连见过祂的我都说不出祂的神名！”

“不告诉你。”夏兮风甩了甩手。龙神太硬了，他不知道有没有把龙神打疼，自己的手反正是很疼了。

夏兮风对着噩兆尸龙的残骸伸出手：“你在呼唤我对吗？我们成功，是不是？”

外神的神体残骸湮灭成飞灰。神灵死亡的怨气朝着飞灰聚拢。神怨和残骸灰烬融合后凝结成浑浊的结晶，飞到了夏兮风的手中。

【掉落“噩兆尸龙的悲鸣”：祂是已经毁灭的世界的亡灵。祂连亡灵都不是。】

【因为亡灵也“存在”，而毁灭的世界“不存在”。】

神怨安安静静，如同不存在。

龙神放下捂眼睛的手，眼圈有点肿。夏兮风那一拳还真把他打疼了。

“真奇怪。祂应该变成没有理智的怪物，怎么还能控制怨气？”龙神看了一眼神怨晶体，又好奇地看向夏兮风和秦琅。

刚才夏兮风和秦朗的气息突然消失，应该是天父拉他们“做任务”去了。他们做什么……

“你们的气息怎么变得这么虚弱？连神火都要熄灭了！”龙神惊讶道。天父拉先知和护道者做任务，不是都用他们的神魂投影，不会伤害本体吗？

“没事。死不了。”夏兮风从秦琅的装备栏取出自我神格。

秦琅从背后拥住夏兮风，融入了夏兮风的身体中。

两簇神火融为一体。夏兮风打了个响指，指间迸发火焰。

他把自我神格和神怨结晶一抛。神火落在自我神格和神怨结晶上滋滋作响。

龙神刚想说，外神的神格没有那么容易被炼化，连祂这个超脱者都做不到，自我神格和神怨结晶已经化成了一团黏稠的液体。

龙神差点咬了舌头。

“小风……”

“夏兮风！”

“小琅……”

“秦琅大笨蛋！”

夏兮风嘴角上弯。夏兮风体内的秦琅嘴角下撇。

“我们成功了……”“我们成功啦！”

神火中，小小的白色毛绒绒和黑色毛绒绒的身影一闪而过，黏稠的液体猛然塌缩。夏兮风摊开手掌，一枚薄薄的半透明晶片落在了夏兮风的掌心。

夏兮风的眼睛一合一张，双目被黄金色覆盖。

无数材料从他的背包里飞出，被神火熔炼成细丝，细丝缠绕成巨大的造物。

“老秦啊，加把劲，火力不够。”夏兮风嚷嚷。

龙神回过神，阻止道：“要做什么也不急于这一时啊！你们俩的神体都要破碎了！”

因为不知道夏兮风和秦琅在做什么，祂只能口头阻止，不敢动作。

夏兮风当然是不听的。

神火骤然增大，笼罩住了巨大的造物。造物的体积越来越小，最后缩小成两个巴掌大。

龙神揉了揉眼睛。

经常旅游，见多识广的祂没看错吧？这是个……微型光脑？

夏兮风把晶片往光脑接口处一插，光脑屏幕“滋滋”花屏，传出断断续续的声音。

“这里……”

“这里是……”

“……艾德文图拉。”

光脑的图像逐渐清晰，身穿黑金色长袍，头戴冠冕的中年男人看着屏幕外的人。

“这里是艾德文图拉。”

“我是艾德文图拉黑暗神殿教皇罗兰。”

“我们的创世神皇决定灭世。我们无法阻拦，只能留下世界最后的信息。”

“这枚晶片中有艾德文图拉所有种族的文明遗产。”

罗兰移开身体。

他的身后，创世神降下神威，抹掉了一枚正脉动着，似乎即将破壳而出的巨卵。

“请您见证，被创世神毁灭的艾德文图拉。”

【掉落物“艾德文图拉世界的墓碑”。】

【我们已死。】

【但我们存在。】

【墓碑即是存在的证明。】

……

比高天更高，比深渊更深，英雄的传说从不曾传颂，连伟大的神灵都不能窥见的世界之外，物质和精神的规则都无法描述的混沌虚空中，愤怒的咆哮声连地面上的凡人都能听到。

他们虽然听不清那怒嚎的语言，但能感受到声音中的怒气。

有一位伟大的存在发怒了。

祂的怒气成为了实质的威压，震慑得地面上没有开启灵智，只有趋利避害本能的怪物们都匍匐在地面，不敢抬头。

有灵智的人类却不愿意低头。他们抬起了脆弱的头颅，看向他们看不见的远方。

一声轻蔑哼笑声后，笼罩在梦世界上的恐怖威压骤然一空。

血月碎裂，银月如盘；

神树开花，花瓣飘落如雨，融入地面；

黑水褪去，碧蓝的海波中，手持利器的海族战士正在踏浪冲锋；

人族皇帝圣灵附体，撕开空间，军队在他身后集结，等候皇帝出征的命令；

精灵族圣地的圣泉干涸，曾经的圣地守卫一队接一队跳入圣泉底部的幽洞中；

矮人王踏入了地底岩浆，挥舞着斧头冲在最前面，矮人贤者们推着魔导炮在后面追；

深渊魔气如云，优雅的魔王们手持圣典《自我之神传记（夏兮风著）》，正进行战前动员……

莱欧和佩瑞拉手拉手，看着变大了一圈的希望之日泪流满面，哽咽大哭。

苏尔靠在阿穆若肩头，面白如纸，双眼泣血，笑容却异常灿烂。

“我看见……祂的心脏上扎上了一柄名为‘艾德文图拉’的复仇短剑。”

“哈哈哈哈哈，毁灭世界的神灵，一定会被世界毁灭，果然会被世界毁灭！”

“天父要赢了。”

阿穆若为苏尔擦拭窥伺不该窥伺的战争而流的血泪。

苏尔扬起染血的脸：“外神来自创世神的庇佑没了。阿穆若，去把祂们都杀了，让亡灵安息。”

“嗯。”阿穆若道，“稍等，我很快就回来。”

世界气机颤动。

正在给瘫在地上，已经分开躺尸的夏兮风和秦琅塞药的龙神惊讶看向远方。

啊，不是，我们的世界这么年轻，都有第二个超脱者了？！这合理吗？！！

天父是不是运气太过好了？怪不得惹隔壁创世神妒忌呢！
chunks.englishText:
He turned his head to look; Qin Lang stood shoulder-to-shoulder with him, supporting his body.

Xia Xifeng said: "Old Qin, why do you look a bit unsteady?"

Qin Lang: "What do you think? Don't remember? Did you get amnesia from the pain?"

Xia Xifeng shook his head vigorously and took a deep breath: "Grandmaster, wait! Let me finish this!"

The Dragon God was preparing to incinerate the remains of the Omen Corpse Dragon when his movements suddenly stalled.

He turned back in confusion, frowning as he looked at Xia Xifeng, who was dragging Qin Lang toward him: "Space-time was disordered for a moment. Someone manipulated fate. What did you two do?"

Xia Xifeng didn't answer. He asked earnestly: "Grandmaster, you wouldn't really take advantage of someone in distress and sleep with the Light God from next door, would you?"

The Dragon God’s eyes widened: "What do you mean 'take advantage'? He was willing! Actually, it wasn't really sleeping together, just fusing our divine souls to test it out..."

Xia Xifeng punched the Dragon God right in his widened eye socket. Qin Lang helped him restrain the Dragon God’s movements; although it lasted less than a thousandth of a second, Xia Xifeng’s punch was fierce and accurate.

The Dragon God covered his eye: "Wait, how can you say his true divine name? His world has been destroyed; even I, who have met him, cannot speak his divine name!"

"Not telling you." Xia Xifeng shook his hand. The Dragon God was too hard; he didn't know if he had hurt the Dragon God, but his own hand certainly hurt a lot.

Xia Xifeng reached out toward the remains of the Omen Corpse Dragon: "You are calling to me, aren't you? We succeeded, right?"

The remains of the Outer God’s divine body disintegrated into fly ash. The resentment of the dying god gathered toward the ash. After the divine resentment and the ash of the remains fused, they condensed into a murky crystal, which flew into Xia Xifeng’s hand.

[Dropped "Lament of the Omen Corpse Dragon": He is an undead of a destroyed world. He isn't even an undead.]

[Because the undead still "exist," while a destroyed world "does not exist."]

The divine resentment was quiet, as if it didn't exist.

The Dragon God lowered his hand, his eye socket slightly swollen. Xia Xifeng’s punch had actually hurt him.

"How strange. He should have turned into a mindless monster; how can he still control his resentment?" The Dragon God glanced at the crystal of divine resentment, then looked curiously at Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang.

Just now, Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang’s auras suddenly vanished; it must have been the Heavenly Father pulling them away to "do a mission." What did they do...

"Why have your auras become so weak? Your divine flames are about to go out!" the Dragon God exclaimed in surprise. When the Heavenly Father pulls prophets and guardians to do missions, doesn't he usually use their divine soul projections? It shouldn't hurt their true bodies, right?

"It's fine. We won't die." Xia Xifeng took his Self-Godhead from Qin Lang’s equipment slot.

Qin Lang embraced Xia Xifeng from behind, merging into Xia Xifeng’s body.

The two clusters of divine flames fused into one. Xia Xifeng snapped his fingers, and flames burst from his fingertips.

He tossed the Self-Godhead and the crystal of divine resentment into the air. The divine flames sizzled as they landed on them.

The Dragon God was about to say that an Outer God’s godhead isn't so easily refined—even he, a transcendent, couldn't do it—when the Self-Godhead and the crystal of divine resentment had already melted into a viscous liquid.

The Dragon God nearly bit his tongue.

"Little Feng..."

"Xia Xifeng!"

"Little Lang..."

"Qin Lang, you big idiot!"

The corners of Xia Xifeng’s mouth curled up. The Qin Lang inside Xia Xifeng’s body curled his mouth down.

"We succeeded..." "We succeeded!"

In the divine flames, small white fluffy and black fluffy figures flashed by, and the viscous liquid suddenly collapsed. Xia Xifeng opened his palm, and a thin, translucent chip landed on it.

Xia Xifeng’s eyes blinked, and his pupils were covered in golden color.

Countless materials flew out from his backpack, melted into fine threads by the divine flames, and the threads wound into a massive creation.

"Old Qin, put some effort into it, the firepower isn't enough." Xia Xifeng shouted.

The Dragon God came to his senses and tried to stop them: "Whatever you're doing, there's no rush! Both of your divine bodies are about to shatter!"

Because he didn't know what Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang were doing, he could only stop them verbally, not daring to act.

Xia Xifeng, of course, didn't listen.

The divine flames surged, enveloping the massive creation. Its volume shrank smaller and smaller, finally reducing to the size of two palms.

The Dragon God rubbed his eyes.

He traveled often and was well-informed, but he couldn't have seen that wrong, could he? This is a... micro-light computer?

Xia Xifeng plugged the chip into the light computer’s interface. The screen flickered with static, emitting an intermittent sound.

"Here..."

"This is..."

"...Adventura."

The image on the screen gradually cleared. A middle-aged man in black-and-gold robes and a crown looked at the people outside the screen.

"This is Adventura."

"I am Roland, Pope of the Dark Temple of Adventura."

"Our Creator God Emperor has decided to destroy the world. We cannot stop him; we can only leave behind the world’s final message."

"This chip contains the civilization heritage of all races in Adventura."

Roland moved aside.

Behind him, the Creator God descended with divine might, erasing a giant egg that was pulsing, seemingly about to hatch.

"Please bear witness to Adventura, destroyed by the Creator God."

[Dropped item "Tombstone of the Adventura World."]

[We are dead.]

[But we exist.]

[The tombstone is the proof of existence.]

...

Higher than the high heavens, deeper than the abyss, in the chaotic void where heroic legends have never been told and even great gods cannot peer—where the rules of matter and spirit cannot be described—the roar of anger could be heard even by mortals on the ground.

Although they couldn't clearly hear the language of that roar, they could feel the fury within the sound.

A great existence was enraged.

His fury became a tangible pressure, intimidating the monsters on the ground—who possessed no intelligence and only the instinct to seek advantage and avoid harm—to crawl on the ground, not daring to lift their heads.

Yet, the humans who possessed intelligence refused to bow. They raised their fragile heads, looking toward the distant horizon they could not see.

After a contemptuous snort, the terrifying pressure shrouding the Dream World suddenly vanished.

The blood moon shattered, and the silver moon shone like a disk;

The Divine Tree blossomed, petals falling like rain, merging into the ground;

The black water receded, and amidst the azure waves, sea-race warriors holding sharp weapons charged forward on the tides;

The Human Emperor, possessed by a holy spirit, tore through space, his army assembling behind him, awaiting the order to march;

The holy spring in the Elf sanctuary dried up, and the former guardians of the sanctuary jumped one after another into the abyss at the bottom of the spring;

The Dwarf King stepped into the underground magma, waving his axe and charging at the front, while the Dwarf Sages followed, pushing magic cannons;

Abyssal demonic energy swirled like clouds, and the elegant Demon Kings, holding the holy scripture "Biography of the God of Self (Authored by Xia Xifeng)," were conducting pre-battle mobilization...

Leio and Perilla held hands, watching the Hope Sun, which had grown a size larger, and wept with joy, sobbing uncontrollably.

Sule leaned on Amuro’s shoulder, his face pale as paper, blood weeping from his eyes, yet his smile was exceptionally brilliant.

"I see... a short sword of vengeance named 'Adventura' stabbed into His heart."

"Hahahahaha, the god who destroys the world will surely be destroyed by the world! As expected, he will be destroyed by the world!"

"The Heavenly Father is going to win."

Amuro wiped the blood-tears from Sule’s face, shed from prying into a war he shouldn't have.

Sule lifted his blood-stained face: "The Outer Gods have lost the protection of the Creator God. Amuro, go kill them all and let the dead rest in peace."

"Yes," Amuro said. "Wait a moment, I will be back soon."

The world’s energy trembled.

The Dragon God, who was busy stuffing medicine into Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang—who were lying on the ground, separated and playing dead—looked toward the distance in surprise.

Ah, no, our world is so young, and it already has a second transcendent?! Is this reasonable?!!

Is the Heavenly Father’s luck just too good? No wonder he provokes the jealousy of the Creator God next door!

chunks.chineseText:
夏兮风一边笑一边咳血：“肯定是阿穆若老师！阿穆若老师都超脱了，我的老师肯定也超脱了。说不定他们早就是超脱者，只是不声不响，闷声隐居。嘿嘿，我的老师们真厉害。以后我们也要这么厉害……咳咳咳咳……”

龙神回过神，继续塞药：“夏兮风！你闭嘴！少说话多吃药！”

秦琅默默吐血，默默被灌药。

即使他和夏兮风自出生就睡在同一个摇篮里，他也不能理解，都伤到动弹不得，七窍流血，身体都干瘪得快变成干尸了，夏兮风怎么还能说出这么一长串的话来？话痨难道也是什么概念性能力吗？

作者有话要说：

正文完结。

十月下旬开宋穿，宋穿写完后开耽美玄幻大长篇《我与龙傲天寿命共享》。以后历史文和耽美文仍旧轮流写，只看耽美的看官可以提前收藏着等我，文案如下：

萧瑱在娘胎里就中了奇毒，六岁遇袭经脉俱断，虽遇奇迹得了神功勉强续了经脉，成了名冠天下的九天门之主，时至弱冠，寿命也不过一载了。

当他被背叛时落入奇异秘境，增寿的灵丹妙药没遇到，却有一孱弱少年拿着石刀威胁自己，要与自己立下性命共享的契约。

“我的寿命只剩不到一载，你确定？”

“你、你别想反悔！你刚刚同意了！”

少年郎色厉内荏，握着石刀的双手微微颤抖。

居然有人主动要求短命，萧瑱叹气颔首：“行。”

穿越的陶煦得了至高传承，却一点都不高兴。

这个世界以武为尊，弱肉强食，自己小胳膊小腿的，还怀璧其罪，能活过几日？

没办法，他只好以性命要挟一个好人，求他保护自己了。

之后……

“阿兄就是最好的！最厉害的！最完美的！”

陶煦星星眼。

“不，阿煦才是最好的。”

萧瑱摸摸头。

萧瑱本以为这是两个短命鬼的故事，没想到他与他的阿煦携手武途，从凡俗的武林走向更广阔的世界，脱凡入圣，登临绝顶，竟一路奔着长生去了。

——

接下来是“后记”，后记是正文时间线上的真正结尾，不列入“番外”中，会影响订阅率；后记写完后的if线和竹马回忆全部列为“番外”，可以选择订阅，不会影响订阅率。

大家晚……早安_(:з」∠)_。

Xia Xifeng laughed while coughing up blood: "It must be Teacher Amuro! Teacher Amuro has transcended, so my teachers must have transcended too. Maybe they were transcendents all along, just quiet and living in seclusion. Hehehe, my teachers are truly amazing. In the future, we will be just as amazing... *cough cough cough cough*..."

The Dragon God came to his senses and continued stuffing medicine: "Xia Xifeng! Shut up! Talk less and take more medicine!"

Qin Lang silently spat blood, silently being force-fed medicine.

Even though he and Xia Xifeng had slept in the same cradle since birth, he still couldn't understand how Xia Xifeng could say such a long string of words when he was injured to the point of being unable to move, bleeding from his seven orifices, and his body was so withered he was almost a mummy. Was being a chatterbox also some kind of conceptual ability?

Author's Note:

The main story is finished.

In late October, I will start a Song Dynasty transmigration novel. After that is finished, I will start a long-form Danmei fantasy novel, "My Lifespan Shared with the Dragon-Proud-Heaven." From now on, historical novels and Danmei novels will be written in turns. Readers who only read Danmei can bookmark it in advance and wait for me. The blurb is as follows:

Xiao Tian was poisoned while in his mother's womb. At six, he was attacked and his meridians were severed. Though he miraculously obtained a divine technique that barely mended his meridians and became the world-renowned master of the Nine Heavens Sect, by the time he reached adulthood, he had less than a year to live.

When he was betrayed and fell into a strange secret realm, he didn't find any life-extending elixirs, but instead, a frail youth holding a stone knife threatened him, demanding to enter into a life-sharing contract.

"I have less than a year to live. Are you sure?"

"Y-you! Don't even think about going back on your word! You just agreed!"

The youth was bluffing, his hands holding the stone knife trembling slightly.

To think someone would actively seek a short life. Xiao Tian sighed and nodded: "Fine."

Tao Xu, who transmigrated, obtained a supreme inheritance, but he wasn't happy at all.

In this world where martial arts are supreme and the strong prey on the weak, he was small and frail, and his possession of a treasure was a crime in itself. How many days could he live?

With no other choice, he had to threaten a good person with his life, begging him to protect him.

Afterward...

"Big Brother is the best! The most powerful! The most perfect!"

Tao Xu’s eyes sparkled like stars.

"No, Ah Xu is the best."

Xiao Tian patted his head.

Xiao Tian had originally thought this was the story of two short-lived people, but he didn't expect that he and his Ah Xu would walk the martial path hand-in-hand, moving from the mundane martial world to a broader realm, transcending the mortal and becoming holy, reaching the pinnacle, and actually heading toward immortality.

——

Next is the "Afterword." The Afterword is the true ending on the main story’s timeline. It is not included in the "Extras," so it will not affect the subscription rate. The "if" lines and childhood memories written after the Afterword will all be listed as "Extras." You can choose to subscribe to them; it will not affect the subscription rate.

Good evening... good morning, everyone. _(:з」∠)_

chunks.chineseText:
第132章 后记一

战争扫尾持续了五年才结束。

精灵们把世界树圣地变成了育苗圣地，各处收集神树果实后，在育苗圣地培育成树苗，再扛着小树苗在全世界种树。

树苗种下的地方，如毒蘑菇般的彩色天地重新变回单调朴素的绿水蓝天。

矮人们在贤者院的带领下探测各地异变的地下矿脉，打造地下堡垒把危险的地方圈起来。

人类会做的事太多，便成了一块砖，哪里需要哪里搬。不过他们更喜欢注册成佣兵，在各个禁地探险。

而与世隔绝的深渊恶魔正在积极和地面合作。毕竟仅靠他们恢复深渊环境，会把他们累死，效果还会很差。

末世虽然结束，但世界的异变要恢复还需要许多年。

战争扫尾时，在最初末世之战中大放异彩的希望之城城主夏兮风、秦琅就没有了存在感。

原因无他，这俩一直躺着养伤，足足躺了五年才升回传说。

解读出“艾德文图拉世界的墓碑”后的第一年，两人是睡过去的。

苏尔为他们打造了水晶棺，将当时还有意识的两人丢进去封印。

莱欧和佩瑞拉等夏兮风和秦琅的友人特意从战场回来探病，和不知道会睡多少年的好朋友告别。

他们看着水晶棺里长满灰黑色触须的银色发光黏稠玩意儿，都震惊无比。

“你别告诉我这是你们的神体？怎么和邪神似的？”莱欧说，“能不能选一个好看的神体？”

黏糊糊并且发光的夏兮风回答道：“能，但这样不会硌得慌。”

莱欧看着棺材里的“液体”般的夏兮风和他“怀里”的秦琅，不得不承认，这样确实不挑睡的地方，只要有个装水的罐子就成。

前世是邪神的辛格和原定命运会变成邪神的佩瑞拉大为震撼。而已经胖……大了好几圈的希望之日和水神对夏兮风、秦琅的选择点了个赞。祂们自然概念的神灵就喜欢这种方便舒适的神体，只有自我、智慧、进化等和人类相关的神灵才喜欢用人形。

莱欧手贱，想试试黏糊糊夏兮风的手感。

苏尔把莱欧提着后衣领丢出门，将所有探病的人都赶走，封闭了夏兮风和秦琅的养伤地。

神体破碎，神火熄灭。普通神灵得闭关个几十上百年才能稳固伤势。夏兮风和秦琅第二年就破关而出。

两人的境界跌落到最初刚入世界的时候，据说是“用经验值换了新身体”，从头开始练级。

不过身体换了，他们的神魂还伤着。两人当了五年的普通人，戴蒙快乐极了。

弱小的普通人就乖乖待在城里干活吧，我！传说强者戴蒙！将投身战场啰！

戴蒙留书出走，夏兮风和秦琅被堆积成山的城务埋没。谁不称一句一报还一报，活该？

伤得太重，两人好得很慢。五年后两人重登传说，还是因为主线任务结束的结算奖励。

末世结束，系统送来了大量经验和珍稀神药，夏兮风和秦琅终于修复了神魂，迅速登临传说。

阿穆若终于能本体回家。

他抱着手臂打量夏兮风和秦琅。

一般人在面对创世神的威压后都会留下很重的心理阴影，要重回境界很难。

夏兮风和秦琅被天父保护得很好，按理说应该缺乏绝地求生的历练，面对这个难关会更难过。

谁知道夏兮风和秦琅毫无心理阴影，还向对方创世神比了个中指。

阿穆若眉头挑动了一下，看向莱欧和佩瑞拉。

两位半身人疯狂摇头。

我不是，不是我。不是我们把风和琅教坏的！

“算了，活着就好。”阿穆若道，“那群神灵都伤得不轻，短时间内应该不会再出现灭世危机。你们可以放很长的假。”

夏兮风眼含希冀：“阿穆若老师，你的意思是，我们可以不当城主了？”

阿穆若微笑：“不，我的意思是，当城主等于放假。”

别说活泼好动的夏兮风，连秦琅都露出了丧丧的表情。

两人都不是喜欢权力的人，只觉得一城的琐事实在麻烦。

戴蒙大笑三声，直呼两位甩手城主活该。希望之城草创阶段是最忙碌的时候，两人居然携手跑路，把偌大的城池丢给他。虽然他们说是去拯救世界，但叔叔都能留个分身当城主，同样点燃神火的夏兮风和秦琅，绝对不可能做不到。

他们就是懒！

戴蒙冷笑道：“现在我已经点燃神火，你们还是传说，别想再偷跑。无论去哪，都留个分身干活！”

夏兮风扑到秦琅怀里假哭。

秦琅拍了拍夏兮风的背，和夏兮风一同饱受戴蒙淫威之苦。

不过夏兮风和秦琅还是跑路成功了。

主线任务最终奖励“回家”下发，他们要回家探个亲。虽然他们可以留个分身，但两人故意只留了一封信，赌的就是戴蒙已经对一手建立的希望之城感情很深，不可能对希望之城群龙无首的困境视而不见。

至于他们回来会不会被戴蒙暴揍……那是肯定会啊！

秦琅：“为什么你一定要挑衅戴蒙？”

夏兮风辩解：“人活着就是要挑衅一切。”

秦琅不认可夏兮风，但夏兮风都跑了，他当然也不能留下自己干活。有难同当有苦同吃，两人一同跑路，回来后一同被揍。

不过秦琅还是比夏兮风善良一些，提前通知了莱欧和佩瑞拉回来帮戴蒙分担城务。

虽然半身人动不动就想开宴会，但干活也还是很利落的。

可怜的猫猫管家好不容易和主人相处了五年，主人又丢下猫猫跑了。

为什么主人不能带着猫猫一起跑？我们可以给主人做饭跑腿洗衣服！猫猫很能干的！

夏兮风哭笑不得。

现在没了危险，他们旅游的时候确实可以带上猫大猫二，反正魔导车里房间很多，互不干扰。但他们要回地球啊，地球上可没有能直立行走的可爱猫猫人。

“走，老秦，咱们回家！”

“嗯。”

……

每年夏季暑假，各地都会进行防溺水提醒，但每年都有悲剧发生。

在梧城，这场悲剧撕心裂肺，震动全国。

事件发生才一天，搜救还没结束，媒体争相报道，网络热搜登顶……无论是只会看电视的老年人，还是已经摒弃电视只玩手机的年轻人，都记住了一个名字，“夏兮风”。

夏兮风为幼儿园小朋友挡刀并制伏歹徒的新闻又被人翻出来，看过的人无人不为年轻英雄的逝世落泪。

如果英雄是牺牲在见义勇为力有不逮时，还能说悲壮。可夏兮风死在“水鬼”夺命，就只会让人愤怒。

网红无视警告跑到浅滩中间拍摄大坝放水，夏兮风已经快把人都救上来了，那网红却把力竭的夏兮风推向浮木，导致夏兮风被砸沉水。

当时还有未成年玩水。夏兮风跳下水的时候，许多人也跟着救人。

夏兮风力竭的时候，岸上一些水性不好，不敢救人的人也接力入水，想给夏兮风搭把手。

当夏兮风被浮木砸中时，很多人都拿着游泳圈想去救人，其中就有夏兮风的好友秦琅。
chunks.englishText:
Chapter 132: Postscript (Part 1)

The mop-up operations following the war dragged on for five years before finally coming to an end.

The elves transformed the World Tree sanctuary into a nursery. After collecting seeds from the divine trees across the lands, they cultivated them into saplings in the sanctuary, then trekked across the globe to plant them.

Wherever these saplings took root, the monotonous, drab green and blue skies returned, replacing the toxic, mushroom-like kaleidoscopic landscapes that had plagued the world.

Under the guidance of the Academy of Sages, the dwarves surveyed the mutated underground mineral veins, constructing subterranean fortresses to seal off the most dangerous zones.

Humans, being versatile, became the "utility bricks" of the world—moved wherever they were needed most. However, they preferred registering as mercenaries to explore the various forbidden zones.

Meanwhile, the Abyss demons, once isolated from the world, were actively cooperating with the surface dwellers. After all, relying solely on themselves to restore the Abyssal environment would have worked them to death, and the results would have been abysmal.

Although the apocalypse had ended, it would take many years for the world’s mutations to fully subside.

During the post-war cleanup, Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang—the City Lords of the City of Hope who had shone so brilliantly during the initial battles of the apocalypse—had completely faded into the background.

The reason was simple: the two had been lying in bed recovering from their injuries, taking a full five years to ascend back to the rank of Legend.

For the first year after deciphering the "Tombstone of the Adventura World," the two had spent it in a deep slumber.

Su Er had crafted crystal coffins for them, sealing the two inside while they were still conscious.

Friends like Leo and Perilla had returned from the battlefield specifically to visit, bidding farewell to their dear companions who might sleep for who knew how many years.

They were utterly shocked to see the silver, glowing, viscous blobs covered in gray-black tentacles resting inside the crystal coffins.

"Don't tell me this is your divine form? Why does it look like an Evil God?" Leo remarked. "Couldn't you have chosen a better-looking divine form?"

The glowing, gooey Xia Xifeng replied, "We could, but this way, it doesn't feel uncomfortable."

Looking at the "liquid" Xia Xifeng in the coffin and the Qin Lang "cradled" in his arms, Leo had to admit that this form certainly wasn't picky about where it slept—as long as there was a jar to hold the liquid, it was fine.

Singer, who had been an Evil God in a past life, and Perilla, who was fated to become one, were deeply shaken. However, the Sun of Hope and the Water God, who had grown... significantly larger, gave a thumbs-up to Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang’s choice. Deities of natural concepts preferred such convenient and comfortable divine forms; only deities related to self, wisdom, and evolution—concepts tied to humanity—preferred humanoid shapes.

Leo, being mischievous, wanted to test the texture of the gooey Xia Xifeng.

Su Er grabbed Leo by the back of his collar and tossed him out the door, chasing away all the visitors and sealing off the recovery site.

With their divine bodies shattered and their divine fires extinguished, ordinary deities would have to seclude themselves for decades or even centuries to stabilize their injuries. Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang, however, broke through their seclusion in the second year.

Their cultivation levels had plummeted to when they first entered the world. It was said they had "traded their experience points for a new body" and were grinding levels from scratch.

But while their bodies were replaced, their divine souls remained wounded. They spent five years as ordinary people, much to Damon’s delight.

*Weak, ordinary mortals should just stay in the city and do their chores! I, the Legendary powerhouse Damon, shall throw myself into the battlefield!*

Damon left a note and ran off, leaving Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang buried under mountains of city administration work. Who wouldn't call that "what goes around comes around"?

Because their injuries were so severe, they recovered very slowly. It took five years for them to regain their Legendary status, and that was only because of the completion rewards from the main quest.

With the apocalypse over, the system delivered a massive influx of experience and rare divine medicines, finally allowing Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang to repair their divine souls and rapidly ascend to Legend once more.

Amuro was finally able to return home in his true form.

He crossed his arms and scrutinized the pair.

Usually, people left with deep psychological trauma after facing the pressure of a Creator God, making it difficult to return to their peak.

Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang had been well-protected by the Heavenly Father; logically, they should have lacked the tempering of life-or-death struggles, making this hurdle even harder to overcome.

Who would have thought that Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang would have zero trauma, and even flipped off the opposing Creator God?

Amuro’s brow twitched as he looked at Leo and Perilla.

The two halflings shook their heads frantically.

*It wasn't us! We didn't teach Feng and Lang to be like that!*

"Forget it, as long as you're alive," Amuro said. "Those deities are all heavily wounded; there shouldn't be another extinction-level crisis for a long time. You can take a very long vacation."

Xia Xifeng’s eyes lit up with hope. "Teacher Amuro, do you mean we don't have to be City Lords anymore?"

Amuro smiled. "No, I mean that being a City Lord is equivalent to a vacation."

Not to mention the lively Xia Xifeng, even Qin Lang wore a look of utter despair.

Neither of them were people who craved power; they just found the trivial matters of running a city to be an absolute nuisance.

Damon laughed three times, calling the two "hands-off" City Lords exactly what they deserved. The City of Hope’s founding stage was the busiest time, yet they had run off together, dumping the massive city on him. Although they claimed it was to save the world, his uncle could leave a clone to act as City Lord, so Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang, who had also ignited their divine fires, were definitely capable of doing the same.

They were just lazy!

Damon sneered, "Now that I’ve ignited my divine fire and you two are still just Legends, don't even think about running off again. Wherever you go, leave a clone to do the work!"

Xia Xifeng threw himself into Qin Lang’s arms and fake-cried.

Qin Lang patted Xia Xifeng’s back, both of them suffering under Damon’s tyranny.

However, Xia Xifeng and Qin Lang still managed to escape.

The final reward for the main quest, "Return Home," was issued, and they had to go back to visit their families. Although they could have left clones, they deliberately left only a letter, betting that Damon had grown too attached to the City of Hope he helped build to ignore the chaos of a leaderless city.

As for whether they would be beaten to a pulp by Damon when they returned... that was a certainty!

Qin Lang: "Why did you have to provoke Damon?"

Xia Xifeng defended himself: "To be alive is to provoke everything."

Qin Lang didn't agree, but since Xia Xifeng had already run off, he couldn't stay behind to do the work alone. They would share the hardships and the suffering; they ran off together, and they would be beaten together upon their return.

However, Qin Lang was still kinder than Xia Xifeng, having notified Leo and Perilla in advance to return and help Damon share the administrative burden.

Although the halflings wanted to throw a banquet every other day, they were quite efficient when it came to work.

The poor cat butler had finally spent five years with his masters, only for them to abandon him and run off again.

*Why couldn't the masters take the cat with them? We can cook, run errands, and do laundry for the masters! Cats are very capable!*

Xia Xifeng was caught between laughter and tears.

Now that there was no danger, they could indeed bring Cat One and Cat Two along on their travels—the magic-guided carriage had plenty of rooms, and they wouldn't get in each other's way. But they were returning to Earth, and there were no cute, bipedal cat-people on Earth.

"Let's go, Old Qin, we're going home!"

"Yeah."

...

Every summer, there were warnings about drowning prevention, yet tragedies occurred every year.

In Wu City, this particular tragedy was heart-wrenching and shook the entire nation.

Only a day after the incident, before the search and rescue had even concluded, the media was reporting it frantically, and it had topped the internet trending lists. Whether it was the elderly who only watched TV or the youth who had abandoned TV for their phones, everyone remembered one name: "Xia Xifeng."

The news of Xia Xifeng shielding kindergarten children from a knife-wielding attacker and subduing the criminal was dug up again. No one who read it could hold back tears for the passing of such a young hero.

If a hero died while failing to save someone, it could be called tragic. But for Xia Xifeng to die because of a "water ghost" (a drowning victim pulling a rescuer down) was enough to incite pure rage.

An internet celebrity had ignored warnings and ran to the middle of a shallow shoal to film the dam releasing water. Xia Xifeng had almost saved the people, but that celebrity had pushed the exhausted Xia Xifeng toward a piece of driftwood, causing him to be struck and pulled under.

There were minors playing in the water at the time. When Xia Xifeng jumped in, many others followed to help.

When Xia Xifeng became exhausted, some people on the shore who weren't strong swimmers but wanted to help also jumped in, trying to lend a hand.

When Xia Xifeng was struck by the driftwood, many people grabbed swimming rings to try and save him, among them his close friend, Qin Lang.

chunks.chineseText:
水流湍急，下水救人的人很快上岸，沿着岸边奔跑，找寻夏兮风的踪迹。只有秦琅一直不肯上岸，和夏兮风一同失踪。

夏兮风事迹被报道时，秦琅也被提起。

连秦琅的大学同学都不知道，秦琅竟然是华国高智商俱乐部成员，立志投身理论物理，愿意为研究清贫一生，已经被某中科院大佬预定博士生。

围观群众气得把手中的瓜都砸了。

为什么水鬼不能判刑？！已经有多少见义勇为的好人被水鬼害了！！

“啊？你立志投身理论物理？”夏兮风瞠目结舌，“我怎么没听说过？”

秦琅：“我也没听说过。”

夏兮风：“那看中你的科学院大佬……”

秦琅：“俱乐部线下聚会时得到过联系方式，说想读博就找他。我说我不想读。”

夏兮风挠挠头。他就记得，秦琅根本不想动他那超高的智商搞什么理论研究，就想找一个能赚钱又轻松的研究，早点出专利，早点躺平吃专利费。

谁规定了智商高就一定要做出一番事业？秦琅一直都很懒，连玩游戏都懒得看剧情。

夏兮风唏嘘：“我还以为我们能回到活着的时候，没想到我俩身份都已经销户了。”

他们回地球时才知道，本土创世神的劳务派遣从来不派遣活人。无论是病逝意外身故还是寿终正寝，创世神只会在他们死亡前那一刻捞人丢去其他世界，不会干涉他们在原本世界的命运，破坏他们在原本世界的生活关系。

夏兮风眼睛都要哭瞎了。他真的把秦琅害死了。

神皇差点弄死他没给他留下心理阴影，他把秦琅害死的心理阴影就算超脱了都好不了。

秦琅：“还浪不浪了？”

夏兮风：“以后我路见不平一定拉你一起去，你不去我就不去！你来评定我们会不会遇到危险！”

秦琅嘴角抽了抽：“不要随便转嫁压力。”

两人嘴贫了几句，搞清楚现状后，给父母托梦，通知他们第二天待在家里别出门，他们要回来探亲。

我们没死，只是穿越啦！

“回梦世界之前，我要先杀个人。”

“哦，好。”

夏兮风一边准备催眠熏香，让两边彻夜难眠的父母倒头就睡，一边点头应道。

按照法律，他们不能这么做。但他们都死了，这是恶鬼索命，不归阳间的法律管。

“老秦啊，系统说，我们可以换个身份照顾爸妈到老，也可以帮爸妈用魔法无痛再生一个养老，后者再给我们爸妈各一千万养老钱，选哪个？”

“当然选一千万。”

“呃……”

chunks.englishText:
The current was swift. Those who jumped in to save others quickly returned to shore, running along the bank to search for signs of Xia Xifeng. Only Qin Lang refused to come ashore, disappearing along with Xia Xifeng.

When Xia Xifeng’s deeds were reported, Qin Lang was also mentioned.

Even Qin Lang’s college classmates didn't know that he was a member of a high-IQ club in China, determined to devote himself to theoretical physics and willing to live a life of poverty for his research, having already been scouted by a big-name academician at the Chinese Academy of Sciences as a doctoral candidate.

The onlookers were so angry they smashed the melons they were holding.

*Why can't "water ghosts" be sentenced?! How many good people who tried to help have been killed by them already!!*

"Ah? You were determined to devote yourself to theoretical physics?" Xia Xifeng was dumbfounded. "How come I never heard of that?"

Qin Lang: "I hadn't heard of it either."

Xia Xifeng: "And that big-name academician who scouted you..."

Qin Lang: "I got his contact info during an offline club gathering; he said if I wanted to pursue a doctorate, I should look him up. I told him I didn't want to."

Xia Xifeng scratched his head. He only remembered that Qin Lang had no intention of using his high IQ for theoretical research; he just wanted to find a lucrative and easy field, get patents early, and lie flat on the royalties.

Who said that having a high IQ meant you had to achieve something grand? Qin Lang had always been lazy; he was even too lazy to watch the cutscenes in video games.

Xia Xifeng sighed, "I thought we could return to when we were alive, but I didn't expect our identities to have already been deregistered."

They only realized when they returned to Earth that the local Creator Gods never dispatched living people. Whether it was death by illness, accident, or old age, the Creator God would only pluck people away at the very moment of their death, never interfering with their fate in their original world or disrupting their relationships.

Xia Xifeng’s eyes were almost swollen from crying. He had truly caused Qin Lang’s death.

The God Emperor had almost killed him without leaving him with any psychological trauma, but the trauma of causing Qin Lang’s death wouldn't go away even if he transcended.

Qin Lang: "Still want to go out and 'wave' (be reckless)?"

Xia Xifeng: "From now on, if I see injustice, I’ll definitely drag you along! If you don't go, I won't go! You’ll be the one to judge if we’ll encounter danger!"

Qin Lang’s mouth twitched. "Don't shift the pressure onto me so casually."

The two bickered for a bit, and after clarifying the situation, they sent dreams to their parents, notifying them to stay home the next day and not go out, as they were coming to visit.

*We aren't dead, we just traveled to another world!*

"Before we return to the dream world, I want to kill someone."

"Oh, okay."

Xia Xifeng nodded while preparing hypnotic incense to ensure their parents, who had been sleepless with grief, would fall into a deep slumber.

According to the law, they couldn't do this. But they were already dead—this was a vengeful ghost seeking retribution, which wasn't governed by the laws of the living.

"Old Qin, the system says we can either take on new identities to look after Mom and Dad until they’re old, or we can use magic to painlessly regenerate them a new life for their retirement, and the latter comes with ten million for each of them. Which one should we choose?"

"Obviously the ten million."

"Uh..."
